gist: Opening music tag at the start of the video.
Channel disclaimer: it does not promote, support or encourage drugs, alcohol or other intoxicants.
Disclaimer that the content shared on the platform is for information and education only.
Channel says it is committed to a positive, responsible environment, follows community guidelines and asks viewers to watch with care.
Greeting, a warm welcome and thanks to everyone for joining the class.
Announces today's class topic: planets in houses, signs, and the 12 houses inside a kundli.

hindi: 12 भाव कुंडली के 12 बने इसलिए हैं क्योंकि हमारे पास सूर्य के द्वारा 12 महीने होते हैं
says: The chart has exactly 12 houses because the Sun gives us 12 months in a year; he ties the number of houses to the Sun's twelve monthly stages.
ambiguity: He uses 'bhava' for the 12 divisions but the Sun-month link is really the 12 signs; he does not separate house from sign here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts derive the 12 rashis from the Sun's yearly round (one solar month per sign); houses are the 12 divisions counted from the lagna, not months themselves.

hindi: तो जब एक गोल जोडियक में पूरे के पूरे अंतरिक्ष के गोले के अंतर्गत जब गोल घूमता है सूरज यानी घूमता है सूरज नहीं जब घूमते हैं हम सब सूरज के साथ सूर्य के इर्दगिर्द
says: He begins to say the Sun goes round the whole zodiac sphere, then corrects himself: it is we, all of us on Earth, who go round the Sun inside that great sphere of space.
ambiguity: The first half is the geocentric view (Sun circling the zodiac) and the correction is heliocentric; the change of view is his own and he does not say which one the chart uses.
classical_check: Differs: Jyotish calculations are geocentric, with the Sun moving through the sidereal zodiac in a year; the Earth-round-the-Sun picture is modern astronomy, not a classical rule.

hindi: तो एक इतने बड़े अंतरिक्ष गोल घोले में घूमते हैं जो 360 डिग्री का है 360 मींस पूरा इससे ऊपर होता नहीं
says: The space sphere we travel in is 360 degrees; he stresses that 360 means the complete circle and nothing can go beyond it.
classical_check: Agrees: the zodiac is a full 360-degree circle, twelve signs of 30 degrees each.

hindi: और इसके अंदर 303 डिग्री के टुकड़ों में सूरज देवता गोल गोल घूमते हैं यह सूर्य की एक 30 डिग्री की 30 30 डिग्री का हर खाने में ग्रह घूमता है ऐसा मानक चलते हैं
says: Inside the circle the Sun moves through pieces of 30 degrees, and in the standard (mānak) scheme each 30-degree box is a zone a planet travels through; this is the accepted convention that he is about to question.
ambiguity: '303 डिग्री' is a caption slip for 30 degrees. 'ऐसा मानक चलते हैं' could mean 'this is the standard we follow' or 'we assume this as a rough standard'.
classical_check: Agrees: every rashi is exactly 30 degrees and the Sun spends about a month in each.

hindi: यानी कि जो 12 भाव कुंडली के होते हैं जो आपकी जन्मपत्रिका होती है उस कुंडली के अंदर आपका एक खाना 30 डिग्री का होता है और इस 30 30 डिग्री को टोटल करते हैं तो 360 डिग्री होता है
says: The 12 houses of the birth chart are 12 boxes (khana) of 30 degrees each, and twelve times 30 gives the full 360. In the standard picture a house box and a sign box have the same size.
ambiguity: He uses 'bhava' and 'khana' for the same 30-degree box, which blurs house and sign; the unequal boxes in the next lines show that he means house boundaries are what can vary.
classical_check: Agrees for whole-sign and equal-house charts, where each house is 30 degrees; differs for Sripati, KP and Placidus houses, which are unequal.

hindi: जो मोटे तौर पर बात है वह एक्चुअली यह है कि जब धरती गोल गोल घूमती है सूरज के इधर उधर तो धरती देवी
says: He calls the equal 30-degree picture only the rough version and says the real picture comes from how the Earth goes round the Sun; the sentence breaks off at 'Mother Earth' and the point continues in the next lines.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk edge, so what 'actually' happens is only given in the next chunk.
classical_check: Differs: classical Jyotish keeps every sign at exactly 30 degrees and does not derive house size from the Earth's path.

hindi: यह सूरज अंकल हो गए अब धरती यहां पर गोल घूमती है तो धरती ऐसे घूमती है धरती ऐसे नहीं घूमती ऐसे नहीं घूमती ऐसे घूमती है
says: He draws the Sun in the middle ('uncle Sun') and shows by gestures that the Earth does not go round in a plain even circle but follows a different shape; the caption cannot show what shape he draws.
ambiguity: Most of the sentence is gesture ('ऐसे' = like this), so the real content is only inferred from the 30, 32, 28 and 25 degree boxes that follow.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Surya Siddhanta also corrects the Sun's position for its uneven speed, but sign boundaries stay at 30 degrees.

hindi: तो कहीं 30 डिग्री होता है कहीं 32 डिग्री कहीं 28 डिग्री कहीं 25 डिग्री यानी कि टोटल तो 360 डिग्री ही होता है लेकिन कहीं ज्यादा कहीं कम तो पूरा 30 होता ही नहीं
says: In the real sky the boxes are not equal: one is 30 degrees, another 32, 28 or 25. The total is still 360, but some boxes are wider and some narrower, so an exact 30 never occurs.
cells_derived_method: He gives the sizes but not which box gets which size, so no single cell can be filled. By his logic every house box differs from 30 degrees, so a planet near a boundary can land in the neighbouring box; this fits the idea that a house touches more than one sign, although he does not say '2 to 3 signs per house'.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether he means the house boxes or the sign boxes. The 32, 28 and 25 figures look like illustrations, not measured values.
classical_check: Differs: in every Jyotish system, KP included, a sign is exactly 30 degrees of longitude. What is unequal in KP is the house (cusp) division, and the days the Sun takes per sign; his boxes mix up time and arc.

hindi: यह हमारा केपी मेथड का मुख्य बेस बनता है
says: He says this uneven division of the 360 degrees is the main base of the KP (Krishnamurti Paddhati) method.
classical_check: Partly agrees: KP uses unequal Placidus house cusps and star-lord and sub-lord divisions of unequal width; its core is the sub-lord table rather than unequal sign sizes.

hindi: कृष्णमूर्ति नाम से कितने बड़े साइंटिस्ट रहे मान के चलो जो इतने बड़े ज्ञानी थे जिन्होंने यह बताया कि आपके कुंडली में ग्रह और राशियां दाएं बाएं घूम जाते हैं
says: He praises K. S. Krishnamurti, founder of KP, as a great scientist-scholar who showed that in a chart the planets and signs shift left and right, meaning a planet's house is not fixed simply by the sign it sits in.
cells_derived_method: A planet's house comes from the house cusps, not from its sign alone. A planet close to the start or end of a sign can move to the neighbouring house, while a planet in the middle of a sign rarely moves. The examples below are derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries with the ascendant at 4 degrees Aries. A planet at 2 degrees Aries is in the 1st house by sign, but by cusp it lies before the ascendant and moves back to the 12th house.

Derived, not said by him: lagna Libra with the 10th cusp at 8 degrees Cancer. A planet at 3 degrees Cancer is in the 10th house by sign, but by cusp it lies in the 9th house, so its work and status results are shared with the 9th.

Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer with the 5th cusp at 25 degrees Libra. A planet at 27 degrees Libra is in the 4th house by sign, but by cusp it moves forward into the 5th house, so home matters mix with children and learning.

ambiguity: 'दाएं बाएं घूम जाते हैं' is read as planets or signs shifting to the neighbouring house; it could also mean the signs rotate in the chart.
classical_check: Agrees in part: KP and bhava-chalit place a planet by house cusps, so it can sit in a different house from its rashi; classical whole-sign charts do not shift planets.

hindi: उनका ज्योतिष इसलिए फेमस हुआ कि वह यह बता दिया करते थे कि एक हवाई जहाज 1114 मिनट पर चला है मेलबर्न से और इंडिया में 750 मिन पर लैंड करना है
says: KP became famous, he says, because Krishnamurti could tell about a flight that left Melbourne at some minute past 11 and was due to land in India at a fixed morning time, by how many minutes it would differ.
ambiguity: '1114' and '750' are read as 11:14 and 7:50; the numbers may be wrong. The sentence continues in the next row with his answer.
classical_check: Silent: this is an anecdote with no source; minute-level answers are claimed for KP horary, but nothing here can be checked, so it counts as no evidence until measured.

hindi: तो वह बता देते थे 11 मिनट लेट आएगा सोच के चलिए चमत्कृत करने वाली हैरान करने वाली बात
says: In the story Krishnamurti would answer that the flight would come 11 minutes late, and he asks the audience to think how astonishing that is.
ambiguity: It is not stated which chart or rule gave the 11 minutes.
classical_check: Silent: no KP text states how a delay in minutes is read from a chart.

hindi: कि वो यह बता दिया करते थे 11 मिनट लेट आएगा 20 मिनट पहले पहुंचेगा यह कैसे संभव है वह ग्रहों की ऐसी गणना करते थे जबरदस्त
says: He repeats the claim and adds that Krishnamurti could also say a plane would land 20 minutes early. He explains this by very powerful planetary calculation, not by any single named rule.
ambiguity: The earlier chunk ends mid-sentence, so this row carries the second half of the anecdote.
classical_check: Silent: unverified anecdote; the project treats it as unproven accuracy.

hindi: तो यह अन्य ज्योतिषियों से एक अलग बात है कि 30 30 डिग्री का खाना नहीं लेना
says: KP stands apart from other astrologers because it does not take the chart as twelve equal boxes of 30 degrees each.
ambiguity: 'खाना' (box) may mean house or sign; the contrast is with the usual equal-box chart.
classical_check: Agrees in part: KP uses unequal cusp-based houses while Parashari charts use equal or whole-sign houses; signs themselves stay 30 degrees in KP too.

hindi: इसलिए लाइफ में वेरिएबल बहुत ज्यादा है यह शब्द उठा कि सैकड़ों लोग एक ही समय पैदा होते हैं लाखों होते हैं उन सब की कुंडली तो सेम होती है फिर उन सबका जीवन अलग क्यों है
says: Life has very many variables, and the question is raised that hundreds or lakhs of people are born at the same time with the same chart, so why are their lives different? This is the same-time-birth (twin) problem.
ambiguity: 'इसलिए' may link back to the unequal boxes or forward to the question; either way the question is the main content.
classical_check: Agrees that the problem exists: classical authors answer it with finer divisional charts such as D-60 (shashtiamsa) and with karma; KP answers it with sub-lords.

hindi: राम पैदा हुए तो क्या पूरी धरती पर राम ही पैदा अकेले नरेंद्र मोदी पैदा हुए तो अकेले वही हुए कृष्ण के टाइम अकेले सैकड़ों बच्चे हुए होंगे तो वही वहां क्यों पहुंचे
says: Examples for the same-time-birth problem: when Ram was born others were born too, likewise at Modi's birth and at Krishna's time, yet only they rose to such heights; so a chart alone does not explain who reaches the top.
ambiguity: They are rhetorical questions; the answer is given in the next sentence.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts quote Rama's and Krishna's charts as strong examples but do not discuss why other same-time births stayed ordinary.

hindi: क्योंकि उनके जन्म से भाग्यशाली उनके कर्म से भाग्यशाली और प्रारब्ध से भाग्यशाली यह अलग-अलग जीवन का हिसाब बनता है
says: The difference between lives comes from three kinds of luck: luck at birth, luck from one's own karma, and luck from prarabdha (the part of past karma now ripe); together they make each life's separate account.
ambiguity: 'जन्म से भाग्यशाली' could mean family and place of birth, or a lucky birth moment.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical teaching names prarabdha, sanchita and kriyamana karma; a separate luck of birth is his own addition.

hindi: अब अपने जीवन के अंदर पूर्व जन्म के संस्कार के द्वारा कृष्ण की जो आत्मा आई वह इस जन्म में ऐसे उठी
says: Through impressions (samskara) carried from past lives, the soul that came as Krishna rose to that height in this birth; past-life samskara decides how high a soul climbs.
ambiguity: The sentence runs on into an example ('जैसे उदाहरण...') that is recorded in the next row.
classical_check: Agrees: classical Jyotish reads past-life merit (purva-punya) from the 5th house and the 9th house.

gist: Sets up an example: two babies, one a farmer's child and one a landlord's child, are born together and are placed side by side after birth (continues in the next chunk).

hindi: के बाद एक ही हॉस्पिटल एक साथ ही समझो सिंगल बेड पर रखे हुए हैं अब कुंडली तो सेम होना चाहिए सब सेम
says: Picturing the two babies in one hospital on one bed, he says their charts must be identical in every respect, since the same moment and place of birth give one chart.
ambiguity: 'सिंगल बेड' is read as one shared bed; it only stresses the same time and place.
classical_check: Agrees: the same moment and place give the same chart in every system; only very fine divisions or KP sub-lords can separate births minutes apart.

hindi: तोब उन दोनों को अपने अपने जीवन में इस लेवल पर पैदा होने के बाद इतना उठना है यह उनके उठने का मापदंड है
says: With one chart, both children must rise by the same amount from the level they were born at; the chart fixes the size of the climb, the measure of rising, and not the final position.
ambiguity: 'तोब' is read as 'तब' (then). 'इस लेवल पर' means the social level of the family at birth.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give chart results in absolute terms; reading them as a climb from the family base is his own scaling idea.

hindi: तो चूंकि यह किसान के यहां पैदा हुआ है तो यह उठने के बाद बच्चा जो है जमीदार बन जाएगा हद से हद यही होगा
says: Because the first child is born into a farmer's home, after his rise he will become a landlord at most; the family level he starts from puts a ceiling on the result.
ambiguity: 'हद से हद' means at most; he gives the farmer-to-landlord step as an illustration, not as a fixed scale.
classical_check: Silent: the idea that birth background caps what a chart can deliver is not in classical texts, though practising astrologers often say it.

hindi: अब जमीदार के य जो बच्चा पैदा हुआ वो क्या बनेगा वो एमएलए बन जा जाएगा उठे दोनों बराबर ही है लेकिन किस तल से उठे हैं यह एक समझने की बात है
says: The landlord's child, with the same rise, becomes an MLA. Both climbed equally but from different base levels, so a chart should be read as a rise from the family base and not as an absolute rank.
ambiguity: 'एमएलए' is the Member of Legislative Assembly; the titles are only examples of two steps on a ladder.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text compares equal charts from different family levels.

hindi: इसलिए ज्योतिष के अंतर्गत आपको यह जानना बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है कि मनुष्य की ह्यूमन कॉन्शियस 6 पर अल्फा ब्रेन इतनी ज्यादा स्ट्रांग है
says: Introduces a mind model he says astrology students must know: the human conscious part, which the caption puts at about 6 percent, is so strong that it dominates how people think.
ambiguity: '6 पर' is read as 6 percent but the number may be wrong. 'अल्फा ब्रेन' is unclear (alpha brain waves or just a label for the conscious part), and the sentence runs on into a remark to the audience.
classical_check: Silent: the conscious, subconscious and unconscious division is modern psychology and not part of Jyotish texts.

gist: Tells the audience that if nothing seems to sink in, that is the conscious brain not grasping it.

hindi: एक तीन तल है हमारे ब्रेन के एक कॉन्शियस ब्रेन हैय आंखें खोली देखा तभी चल रहा है अदर वाइज नहीं चलता
says: The brain has three levels. The first is the conscious brain, which works only while you are awake with eyes open and noticing, and otherwise does not run.
ambiguity: 'तल' (level) means layer of the mind; the other two levels are named in the following chunks.
classical_check: Silent: the three-layer mind is a modern frame, not a Jyotish concept.

gist: Starts a driving example: you are driving and a mobile phone call comes in, and your attention suddenly drifts (continues in the next chunk).

hindi: हटी सड़क से ध्यान हटा और कॉन्शियस ब्रेन चला गया फोन पर सबकॉन्शियस ने टेकओवर कर लिया
says: When attention leaves the road and the conscious brain goes to the phone, the subconscious takes over the driving; the subconscious is the layer that runs learned routines when conscious attention drops.
ambiguity: 'हटी' is the tail of the sentence from the previous chunk ('तंद्रा हटी', the trance broke).
classical_check: Silent: modern psychology, not a Jyotish statement.

gist: Dramatises the subconscious saying 'I will drive the car, brother' and driving the car in its own way.

hindi: आप किसी से प्रेम में है सबकॉन्शियस ब्रेन प्रेम कर रहा है यानी कि वोह ब्रेन जो आदत पड़ चुकी है
says: Being in love is the work of the subconscious brain, the layer of habit, where feelings that have become settled run automatically.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish reads love through the 5th and 7th houses and Venus, not through brain layers.

hindi: मेरे बच्चे से मुझे प्यार है मुझे अपने घर से बड़ा प्यार है रिश्ते से प्यार है ये सब कॉन्शियस है
says: Love for one's child, home and relationships all sit in this habit layer, so attachments run on habit and not on fresh decisions.
ambiguity: The caption says 'कॉन्शियस' but from the pattern he means 'सबकॉन्शियस' (the run-on word 'ये सब' is probably 'ये सब-कॉन्शियस').
classical_check: Silent: modern psychology, not a Jyotish rule.

gist: Example of a lover's quarrel and bad news from the child's school that disturb the conscious brain.
Dramatised dialogue between the layers: the subconscious says all is fine and the child and partner are good, while the conscious voice says he was abused and enmity will follow.

hindi: कॉन्शियस ब्रेन जैसे ही क्लेश में आता है हमारी बुद्धि भ्रष्ट हो जाती है सबकॉन्शियस टेकओवर कर लेता है
says: As soon as the conscious brain falls into conflict (klesh) our judgement is spoiled and the subconscious takes over.
classical_check: Silent: modern psychology; classical texts speak of the Moon-Mercury mind under affliction rather than brain layers.

hindi: सबकॉन्शियस टेकओवर करते ही हमारा गाड़ी चलने लगती है और सबकॉन्शियस ब्रेन फिर भी लड़के को लड़की के पीछे दीवाना रखता है
says: Once the subconscious takes over, life keeps running on its old tracks, and it keeps the boy mad after the girl even after a fight; attachments survive conscious quarrels.
ambiguity: 'हमारा गाड़ी चलने लगती है' is a figure of speech for life running by itself.
classical_check: Silent: not a Jyotish rule.

gist: The subconscious's inner voice: 'I did love you, the fight was only in the conscious brain, I will keep going no matter what'.

hindi: अब अनकॉन्शियस ब्रेन यानी जो ब्रेन आपका अपने आप सारे काम चला रहा है
says: The third level is the unconscious brain, the one that runs all your bodily and life work by itself, without your giving it any direction.
ambiguity: The sentence starts at the end of one chunk and ends in the next.
classical_check: Silent: modern frame, not a Jyotish concept.

hindi: एक ब्रेन वो है जो सांस ले रहा है उसको आप कोई निर्देश नहीं दे सकते वो आपकी लाइफ में तथास्तु करता है
says: One part is the brain that breathes for you; you cannot give it instructions, and in your life it simply says 'so be it' (tathastu) to what is already set.
ambiguity: 'तथास्तु करता है' is read as 'it ratifies or grants what is set'; it could also be a joke about a blessing.
classical_check: Silent: not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: तूने जो मर्जी करना है मैंने तेरा सांस चलाना है तूने कहीं भी जाना है तेरा खाना पहचाना है तू कुछ भी करेगा जीवन के हार्ट बीट रेगुलेट करूंगा जीवन को चलाऊंगा
says: In the voice of the unconscious: whatever you choose to do and wherever you go, it keeps your breath going, digests your food and regulates your heartbeat; it runs life regardless of your wishes.
ambiguity: 'खाना पहचाना' is probably a caption slip for 'खाना पचाना' (digest the food). The speaker is the unconscious, in first person.
classical_check: Silent: not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: अब जो हमारा अनकॉन्शियस ब्रेन है वो वो वाला ब्रेन है जो 12 पर प्रारब्ध है वो आपकी जन्म कुंडली है
says: The unconscious brain is the one that holds prarabdha (the caption gives about 12 percent), and that is your birth chart; the horoscope is the record of the unconscious layer.
ambiguity: '12 पर' is read as 12 percent but may be a caption error; it is not clear what the other layers get, and 6 plus 12 does not make 100.
classical_check: Agrees broadly: classical Jyotish takes the birth chart as a map of prarabdha karma; the 'brain layer' and the percent are modern terms.

hindi: जिसके अंतर्गत लिखा है भाई तेरी बॉडी में यहां तिल होगा तू साइंस पढ़ेगा तू बायोलॉजी छोड़ेगा तू एक बार क्लास छोड़ेगा
says: He says the chart already holds fine details: a mole at a given spot on the body, that you will study science, that you will drop biology, and that you will bunk a class once.
cells_derived_method: He names no house or sign. By classical topic: studies come from the 4th and 5th houses, body marks from the sign or house matching the limb, so these are mapped by me, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Taurus puts the 5th house in Virgo, ruled by Mercury, so schooling would lean toward analytical and science subjects.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries makes the 1st house Aries, the head and face in the body map, so a mole there would be read from the lagna.

ambiguity: 'यहां' (here) is a gesture to a body spot that the caption cannot show.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Samudrika and Jataka texts tie moles and body marks to houses and signs and education to the 4th and 5th, but give no rule for dropping biology or skipping a class.

hindi: एक बार तू प्यार करेगा एक बार तेरी शादी खराब होगी या एक बार जो भी बिजनेस जॉब करना है यह हो गया अनकॉन्शियस फिक्स
says: The chart also fixes that you will fall in love once, that a marriage will go wrong once, and whichever business or job you take; all of this is 'unconscious fixed'. This is a general claim, not a dated prediction.
cells_derived_method: He gives no house or sign. By classical topic: love comes from the 5th house, marriage from the 7th, and work from the 6th and 10th; these links are mine, not his.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries puts the 5th house in Leo, ruled by the Sun, so a love affair would be read from the Sun and from planets in Leo.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Taurus puts the 7th house in Scorpio, ruled by Mars, so marriage trouble would be looked for through Mars.

ambiguity: 'एक बार तेरी शादी खराब होगी' is a marriage-going-wrong claim stated as fixed for everyone; it may be a general illustration and not a rule for all charts.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts give the 5th for love and the 7th for marriage and work, but do not say these events are fixed for every native.

hindi: बहुत से लोगों कोय पता ही नहीं कैसे जी रहे हैं क्योंकि जीवन चला हुआ है अपनी गति से अपने आप ही चला हुआ है
says: Many people do not know how they are living because life runs by itself at its own pace; most of living is automatic and not steered by the conscious mind.
classical_check: Silent: it echoes the classical idea that prarabdha drives events, but is not worded as a rule.

hindi: जिंदगी हम क्या कर रहे हैं हमें पता ही नहीं हमें कोई करा रहा है जैसे हम सांस ले रहे हमें पता ही नहीं
says: We do not know what we are doing in life; something is making us do it, just as we do not know we are breathing. The agent behind our actions is the unconscious, which in his scheme is the prarabdha written in the chart.
ambiguity: 'कोई' (someone) is not named; I read it as the unconscious or prarabdha from the previous passage, not as a deity.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the classical doctrine that ripe past karma drives events, though the breathing picture is his own.

hindi: हमारे बच्चे से हमारा झगड़ा हो रहा है क्यों हो रहा है पता ही नहीं हम अपने जीवन में सुखी है कुछ भी हो रहा मकान
says: As an example he says we fight with our own child without knowing why, or feel content in life while things go on happening to us (the sentence breaks off at 'makan'); events happen through us with no conscious cause.
ambiguity: The tail 'कुछ भी हो रहा मकान' is garbled and the sentence is cut by the end of the batch; the example about a house (makan) is probably continued in the next batch.
classical_check: Silent: an illustration, not a rule.

hindi: बन गया अपने आप ही बन गया ढूंढ ढूंढ के मर गए नहीं बन रहा
says: Continuing the house example, he says that for one person the house just got built by itself, while others search and search until they die and no house gets built; results often arrive regardless of effort.
ambiguity: This is the tail of the cut sentence from the previous batch ('...कुछ भी हो रहा मकान'), so the missing subject (a house) is assumed. The exact claim is unclear.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts tie property to the 4th house, its lord and Mars, but he gives no rule here.

hindi: अब सब कॉन्शियस ब्रेन है जो ट्रेंड हुआ है ट्रेंड कैसे हुआ
says: The subconscious brain is the layer that has been trained, and he poses the question of how that training took place, which the next lines answer through repeated experience.
ambiguity: The caption spells 'सब कॉन्शियस' as two words; it is read as 'subconscious'.
classical_check: Silent: the subconscious is a modern term and classical Jyotish has no trained-brain idea.

hindi: अब आपने जन्मपत्री देखनी सीखनी है थोड़ी सी पल्ले कुछ नहीं पड़ा लेकिन आ गया बच्चा अपने आप जीते जीते सीख रहा है
says: Even if learning to read a horoscope seems to make no sense at first, it still sinks in over time, the way a child learns just by living; learning reaches the subconscious without any visible effort.
ambiguity: 'आ गया' (it came) is read as 'the understanding arrived anyway'; it could also refer to the child arriving.
classical_check: Silent: not a Jyotish rule, it is a teaching remark on how astrology is learned.

hindi: राम की पूजा करते हैं नहीं कृष्ण की करते हैं अल्लाह को मानते हैं ये सब कॉन्शियस डेवलप हो गया
says: Whether a person worships Ram or Krishna or follows Allah, that faith is something the subconscious has developed, so religious belief is a trained habit and not a free choice.
ambiguity: The caption says 'कॉन्शियस' where 'सबकॉन्शियस' fits the argument; the extra 'सब' is probably the run-on 'ये सब' spelling.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish ties faith and choice of deity to the 5th and 9th houses and Jupiter, not to brain layers.

hindi: कॉन्शियस ब्रेन से आपने कुछ ज्ञान लिया ओहो धर्म यह होता है
says: The conscious brain takes in knowledge, for example 'oh, this is what dharma is', and that intake is how the subconscious later gets trained.
ambiguity: 'ओहो धर्म यह होता है' is read as a quoted thought of the learner.
classical_check: Silent: not a Jyotish rule.

gist: His opinion that religion fools us and trains us in a particular way, so we get stuck in useless worldly attachment (moh-maya).

hindi: अब तीनों ब्रेंस के अंतर्गत ज्ञान आ गया एक रेडीमेड शिक्षा आ गई जो आपने ली है
says: He now lists the knowledge gathered under the three brains; the first item is the ready-made education that you have already taken in from outside.
ambiguity: It is not clear which of the three brains holds this first item; the list that follows has four items for three brains.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts link learning loosely to the 4th and 5th houses, but he does not say so.

hindi: एक आ गया प्रारब्ध एक आपकी जन्मपत्री आ गई यानी जैसे लिखा है वैसे चलेंगे भै
says: The second item is prarabdha, which is your horoscope: life will run as it is written, and he ties this to the unconscious layer.
ambiguity: 'भै' is a spoken filler (brother).
classical_check: Agrees: classical Jyotish reads the birth chart as the map of prarabdha karma.

hindi: एक आ गया सबकॉन्शियस ब्रेन जान लिया आपने कुछ कुछ ज्ञान के द्वारा कुछ कुछ ठीक करना है
says: The third item is the subconscious brain: with the knowledge you have gained, some things can be corrected, so this is the layer that is open to repair.
ambiguity: 'कुछ कुछ ठीक करना है' may mean 'some things need to be fixed' or 'some things can be fixed'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts accept remedies (upaya) that soften results, which is the idea behind correction.

hindi: एक हो गया कॉन्शियस यानी कृपा कि अब आपको कृपा लेनी जाननी है कृपा हर समय नहीं मिलती हर समय आप जागे हुए नहीं होते आपने कृपा लेनी है
says: The fourth item, which he calls conscious and equates with grace (kripa): you have to learn to receive grace, but grace is not there at every moment because you are not awake and aware at every moment.
ambiguity: 'कॉन्शियस यानी कृपा' is a loose equation, probably meaning awareness is the door through which grace is taken, not that conscious and grace are the same.
classical_check: Partly agrees: tradition accepts the grace of a guru or deity as modifying results, but gives no rule on when it is available.

hindi: कॉन्शियस ब्रेन का खेल क्या है अनकॉन्शियस में से निकाल लेता है वो चीजें लेकिन बिना सबकॉन्शियस के नहीं होगा बड़ी खिचड़ी है
says: The conscious brain's game is to pull things out of the unconscious (the written chart), but it cannot do so without the subconscious, so the three layers are a big tangled mixture (khichdi).
ambiguity: 'निकाल लेता है वो चीजें' could mean the conscious brain draws out knowledge or draws out the fated events.
classical_check: Silent: not a Jyotish rule.

gist: Says there is a class for that topic, calls the audience by the nicknames Changu, Mangu and Pingu, and returns to today's subject, which is Jyotish.

hindi: तो आप अपने ज्ञान के द्वारा सबकॉन्शियस ने सब कुछ सुन लिया कि राहु ये है मंगल ये है भाव ये अभी सुन भी लेगा सबकॉन्शियस
says: Through astrology study the subconscious has heard everything, such as 'Rahu is this, Mars is this, this house means that', and it will go on listening to such facts without objection.
ambiguity: Rahu, Mars and 'bhava' are only examples of facts a student hears; no meaning is given to any of them here.
classical_check: Silent: it is a remark about learning and not a rule about Rahu, Mars or houses.

hindi: फिर भी कहेगा नहीं आजर जिंदगी तो ऐसे ही चलानी है हमें तो ऐसे ही पता है
says: Even after listening, the subconscious says 'no, life has to go on as it always has, this is how we know it', so knowing the facts of astrology does not by itself change a person's habits.
ambiguity: 'आजर' is a caption slip, probably 'आखिर' or 'अरे'.
classical_check: Silent: it is a remark on behaviour, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: अनकॉन्शियसली सब कुछ हो रहा है गाड़ी बन रही है गाड़ी ठुक रही है चलते चलते कौन चाहता है एक्सीडेंट करना पता नहीं कैसे हो जाता है
says: Everything is happening unconsciously: cars get built and cars get dented, and nobody wants to cause an accident, yet it happens without anyone knowing how.
ambiguity: 'गाड़ी बन रही है गाड़ी ठुक रही है' is read literally as a car being made and a car being hit; it may also be a figure of speech for life's progress and setbacks.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts tie accidents to the 8th house, Mars, Saturn and Rahu, but he gives no rule here.

hindi: कौन चाहता है जबरदस्ती मरना मरने गए फिर भी हड्डी टूट गई बच गए कुछ नहीं हुआ बैठो फिर भी बच गए
says: Nobody wants to die on purpose, and people who set out to die only broke a bone and survived; he uses this to show that outcomes are not governed by the conscious wish. It is a general fate claim, with no prediction, advice or timing.
ambiguity: It touches on survival after an attempt to die; it is told as an illustration, and 'बैठो' is probably a spoken filler.
classical_check: Silent: it fits the classical idea of fixed longevity (ayu) but gives no rule and no dates.

hindi: अब इंसान करे क्या अब कॉन्शियस ब्रेन के द्वारा जानना है कि हमें समझ में आ रहा है तब हम कह सकते हैं कि हमने भाग्य में परिवर्तन किया
says: What can a human being do? Only when the conscious brain truly knows and understands what is going on can we say that we changed our fate.
ambiguity: 'जानना है कि हमें समझ में आ रहा है' is read as becoming aware that one is understanding, in other words real understanding and not mere hearing.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical remedies are meant to reduce results and not to cancel prarabdha; he limits change to real understanding.

hindi: आपने मौसम कितना ठंडा हो रहा है आपने परिवर्तन किया मौसम में नहीं आपने खुद जैकेट पहनी हीटर लगाया आपने मौसम में परिवर्तन किया यह कहा जाता है एक्चुअली आपने खुद पर किया
says: Weather analogy: when it gets cold you do not change the weather, you put on a jacket or switch on a heater; people say they changed the weather but really they changed themselves. So any remedy changes the person and not destiny or the planets.
ambiguity: The first words are a rhetorical question ('how cold is the weather getting?'), so the sentence is a little jumbled in the caption.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: tradition compares a remedy to an umbrella that softens the rain without stopping it.

hindi: तो खुद पर काम वो व्यक्ति कर सकता है जो कॉन्शियस ब्रेन को समझे यानी कि अपने ब्रेन को कमांड दे कि भैया इधर रह यहां सुन समझ ले कुछ अकल ले ले सबकॉन्शियस उससे ट्रेंड होगा कॉन्शियसली बार-बार आप
says: Work on oneself is possible for the person who understands the conscious brain: command your own brain to stay here, listen and understand, and the subconscious gets trained by repeated conscious practice.
ambiguity: The sentence ends with 'आप' and continues into the next chunk with the swimming example.
classical_check: Silent: self-training of the mind is not a Jyotish rule, though the tradition of japa and sadhana works on a similar idea.

hindi: स्विमिंग करने जाते हैं सबकॉन्शियसली बॉडी सीख जाती है फिर कुछ करने की जरूरत नहीं है आपको अपने आप पल्ले पड़ जाता है
says: Swimming example: you go to swim again and again, the body learns subconsciously, and after that no effort is needed because it comes by itself; repeated conscious practice becomes automatic.
ambiguity: The start 'स्विमिंग करने जाते हैं' continues the sentence 'कॉन्शियसली बार-बार आप' from the previous chunk.
classical_check: Silent: a learning analogy, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: आप जानते हैं मुझे अपने बच्चे को डांटना नहीं है फिर आप डांट बैठते हैं पता नहीं क्यों आप जानते हैं चोरी नहीं करनी है लेकिन आप चोरी कर बैठते हैं पता नहीं क्यों क्योंकि सबकॉन्शियस ट्रेंड है
says: The gap between knowing and doing: you know you should not scold your child, or steal, yet you do it without knowing why, because the subconscious is trained that way.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts ascribe such lapses to the Moon, Mercury and Rahu in the mind houses, but give no layered model.

hindi: यह आपके सबकॉन्शियस को बदलने की बात है
says: The real task is changing your subconscious and not just collecting facts, which is the target of any remedy or practice.
ambiguity: 'यह' points to the whole topic being taught, so the sentence is a summary and not a rule.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical remedies aim to shift the mind (Moon) and habits, though the subconscious wording is his.

hindi: यही वो सबकॉन्शियस है जो आपके चित्रगुप्त के द्वारा अपने आप रीड कर लेता है यहां नीला रंग है य ला रंग है और बॉडी अपने आप एक नई शेप लेने लगती है डिफरेंटली शरीर काम करने लगता है
says: The subconscious reads, through your Chitragupta (the divine recorder), inputs such as 'here is blue, there is another color' without being told, and the body then starts to take a new shape and work differently. This is how he explains the effect of colors and surroundings on a person.
ambiguity: 'य ला रंग' is garbled (probably 'पीला', yellow, or 'लाल', red). It is not said who or what Chitragupta is in his planet scheme.
classical_check: Silent: Chitragupta is a Puranic recorder of deeds; no Jyotish text links him to reading colors. Some traditions pair him with Ketu, but he does not say so here.

hindi: इसी प्रिंसिपल के ऊपर वास्तु काम करता है
says: Vastu works on this same principle: the subconscious reads the surroundings, and the body and life change with them.
ambiguity: 'इसी प्रिंसिपल' points to the previous sentence about the subconscious reading colors and shapes.
classical_check: Differs: classical Vastu works through direction, zones and presiding deities of the plot, not through the subconscious reading the surroundings; this is his own explanation.

hindi: आपकी जिंदगी के अंदर जितने ये ग्रह हैं ये उसी तल पर आपको उठा के ले जा रहे जितना आप लिखा के लाए हो
says: The planets in your life lift you only to the level that you came with written; they deliver the written rise and no more.
ambiguity: 'उसी तल पर' is read as 'to that level that is written for you'; no particular planet is named.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical results of dasha and transit are limited by what the birth chart promises.

hindi: कोई कोई बच्चा होता है जो कंगाली से उठता है और बंगले में जाकर पहुंचता है रॉकेट वो वो है जिसने कॉन्शियस ब्रेन को समझ लिया
says: Some children rise from poverty to a bungalow like a rocket; that is the one who has understood the conscious brain, so conscious understanding is what allows a steep climb.
ambiguity: 'रॉकेट' is read as 'rocket-like rise'; whether the rise exceeds the planets' written level is not stated.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts read a rise from poverty to wealth from Raja yogas and dhana yogas in the chart, not from understanding the conscious brain.

hindi: तो प्रथम बात आप उतना ही उठोगे जो फिक्स है
says: First point: you will rise only as much as is fixed for you; the climb has a ceiling set in advance.
ambiguity: It sits oddly with the 'rocket' remark in the previous row; he may mean the planets' share is fixed while the conscious brain decides how fully it is used.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the classical idea that the chart caps what dasha can give; it seems to conflict with his rocket remark, and he returns to this in the later 'optimum level' talk.

hindi: राम के साथ होए वही जो राम रची राखा वही फिक्स हुआ पत्नी के साथ झंझट होना था राज्य मिलना नहीं था उस समय वनवास होना था
says: Ram's life is shown as fixed: whatever Ram has ordained is what happens, and the trouble with his wife, not getting the kingdom, and the exile at that time were all fixed in advance.
ambiguity: 'राम रची राखा' quotes the Tulsidas line 'होइहि सोइ जो राम रचि राखा'; whether he means Ram the person or God's design is not clear.
classical_check: Agrees with the story: Ram's exile and separation from Sita are fixed events in the Ramayana; he gives no chart rule.

hindi: यह कहानी है ही है किसी हालत के अंदर नहीं परिवर्तित होती
says: The story, he says, is what it is and does not change under any condition; the fixed events of Ram's life cannot be altered.
ambiguity: The sentence is garbled ('है ही है'); 'कहानी' may mean the story of Ram or the fixed script of a life in general.
classical_check: Differs in tone from his own earlier line that remedies and understanding can change fate; it also sits against the classical view that remedies soften results.

hindi: हमारे सोलर सिस्टम में प्लेनेट है वरुण जो 14 साल एक राशि में रहता है
says: The planet Varuna (Neptune) in our solar system stays about 14 years in one sign, which fixes how long a Neptune sign period lasts.
cells_derived_method: none: he gives one duration for every sign, so the statement does not vary across house or sign cells.
ambiguity: 'वरुण' is Neptune in his 12-planet scheme; 14 years is a rounded figure for the actual 13 to 14 years.
classical_check: Agrees with astronomy: Neptune's orbit is about 165 years, so about 13.7 years per sign. Neptune is absent from classical Jyotish, so the 14-year significance is his own scheme.

hindi: 14 ही साल का बड़ा भारी महत्व है सूर्य चंद्र मंगल सब एक अलग किस्म के 14 साल की साइकिल पर चलते हैं
says: The 14-year period is of great importance, and he says the Sun, Moon and Mars all move on a different kind of 14-year cycle.
ambiguity: It is not clear what the 14-year cycle of the Sun, Moon and Mars is; he may mean that Varuna's 14-year clock rules them in his scheme.
classical_check: Differs: classical periods are Sun 1 year, Moon about 27 days and Mars about 1.9 years, with dasha lengths of 6, 10 and 7 years, so no 14-year cycle is stated for them.

hindi: यह 14 साल ही वह साल है जिसमें 12 वर्ष का वनवास हुआ पांडवों को उसके बाद एक वर्ष अज्ञातवास और 14 वर्ष में युद्ध
says: As evidence for the 14-year period he points to the Pandavas: 12 years of forest exile, then 1 year of hidden living, and the war came in the 14th year.
ambiguity: He adds 12 plus 1 to get 13 and puts the war in the 14th year; he does not say the exile itself lasted 14 years.
classical_check: Agrees with the epic: the Pandavas had 12 years of exile and 1 year hidden, and the Kurukshetra war followed. Linking this to Neptune is his own.

ambiguity: 'य पार्टीशनिंग' is unclear: it may mean the 12-house division of the chart or the split of the mind into three parts. The subject of 'उठाता है' is also not given.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text speaks of a partitioning in fate.

hindi: इसलिए याद रखो जो दुख लिखा है उसे बढ़ाओ मत
says: Remember: do not increase the sorrow that is already written for you; the written share is fixed, and adding to it through your own reactions is the avoidable part.
ambiguity: It is a 'do not' and gives no method for how to avoid adding to the sorrow.
classical_check: Partly agrees: tradition advises restraint in the face of fated sorrow and warns against feeding it with anger.

hindi: सोच लो मेरे को बच्चे से इतना दुख मिल रहा है बस खत्म आज मैंने संबंध ही तोड़ दिया पर यह मोह नहीं छूटता क्योंकि हम मूर्खता करते रहते हैं पागलपन करते रहते हैं
says: Example: you decide 'I am getting so much sorrow from my child, enough, I have cut the relationship today', yet the attachment (moh) does not leave, because we keep doing foolish things; cutting off a relationship in anger does not end the pain.
ambiguity: It is advice by example; he does not say that breaking a bond is never right, only that it does not remove the attachment.
classical_check: Silent: a teaching remark, not a Jyotish rule; classical texts tie the child bond to the 5th house and Jupiter.

gist: A garbled passage ('हमें चेक करना है सब चाहिए हमें चाहिए ज्ञान हम लेते भाग देता है...') about needing knowledge and whether we take what fate gives; the grammar is lost, so nothing is recorded.

hindi: जैसे अ मोदी जी है उनका भाग्य भी चल रहा है और अपना चेतना भी विकास कर र
says: Take the Prime Minister example: his fate is running and he is also developing his own consciousness; both work together in his rise, fate and conscious growth.
ambiguity: The sentence ends in 'कर र' (a cut word, probably 'कर रहे हैं'). It is an anecdote about a living public figure; no chart is given.
classical_check: Silent: an illustration of fate plus effort working together.

hindi: भाग्य उठे गए उतना जितना ज्ञान होगा भाग्य उठता ही बृहस्पति और बुध के कारण है
says: Fate rises as far as there is knowledge, and fate rises only through Jupiter and Mercury; these two planets carry the rise of fortune and are tied to how much a person learns.
ambiguity: 'भाग्य उठे गए' is garbled (probably 'भाग्य उठेगा'); 'only because of' is stronger than he may intend.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Jupiter is the natural significator of knowledge, wisdom and fortune (with the 9th house) and Mercury of intellect; 'only through them' is stronger than the classical view.

hindi: बृहस्पति मुख्य है
says: Of the two planets that raise fortune, Jupiter is the main one.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the natural significator of wisdom, teachers and fortune.

gist: Says Jupiter was discussed last time too and that a separate new class on Jupiter will be held.

hindi: बृहस्पति इज किंग सबसे बड़ा तोप है वो सारे अपने आप में तोप है लेकिन इस मामले में बृहस्पति तोप है
says: Jupiter is the king and the biggest cannon: every planet is powerful in its own way, but in this matter, the rise of fortune through knowledge, Jupiter is the top gun.
ambiguity: 'तोप' (cannon) is slang for an expert; 'इस मामले में' limits his claim to the rise of fortune.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Jupiter is called the guru of the gods and the greatest benefic; 'king' is his own image.

hindi: इसीलिए गुरु गुरु गुरु शब्द का बहुत मामला दिया जाता है कि कोई ना कोई आपका मेंटर इंग्लिश में मेंटर को मेंटर कहा जाता है यह गुरु का महत्व हर जगह है
says: That is why the word guru is given so much weight: everyone needs some mentor, and the importance of a guru is found everywhere; Jupiter's role in life is the teacher or mentor.
ambiguity: The implied advice, to find a mentor, is not said as a command.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the natural karaka of teachers and gurus, and the 9th house is the house of the guru.

hindi: एक करोड़पति है एक मोदी जी है मतलब भाग्य तो दोनों का बड़ा है लेकिन उनका फेम हुआ इनका फेम नहीं हुआ हुआ ना किसी को कैश दे दिया
says: A crorepati and the Prime Minister both have big fortune, but one got fame and the other did not; someone was given cash instead. Fate gives the same big fortune in different forms: fame to one, cash to another.
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next chunk ('दे दिया'); 'किसी को कैश दे दिया' is read as 'one man was given cash'.
classical_check: Silent: it matches the classical split between Raja yogas (status) and Dhana yogas (money), but he names none.

hindi: क्या लेना चाहते हो आप आपके जीवन में आपकी प्लेट के अंदर चार सब्जी आ गई एक पनीर हो गया एक आलू हो गए एक आपके करेला
says: What do you want to take from what fate offers? Life puts four dishes on your plate, paneer, potato and bitter gourd among them, and the choice is yours; the plate stands for the different gifts fate lays out.
ambiguity: The opening question links to the cash-or-fame point in the previous row.
classical_check: Silent: an analogy for choosing among fated gifts.

hindi: और कोई बोलो थकी सब्जी कोई दाल ले लो चलो अच्छी ले लो अब आपको जो पसंद है वो ले ली दूसरी छूटेगी
says: Someone says take the dal or another dish, take the good one; you take what you like and the other one is left behind; choosing one gift means leaving the others.
ambiguity: 'थकी सब्जी' is garbled (probably a third dish name).
classical_check: Silent: an analogy, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: आप तन चूज करते हो मन चूज करते हो धन आप चूज क्या करते हो
says: You can choose the body (tan), the mind (man) or wealth (dhan); the question is which of the three you pick, and the three gifts are set against one another.
ambiguity: It is a rhetorical list; he does not say that one cannot have more than one.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give these as separate houses (1st body, 4th mind, 2nd and 11th wealth) but not as a forced choice.

gist: Example of a famous bodybuilder (Ronnie Coleman) who went for body and money first, after which, in his telling, his own body broke down and he was nearly finished. It is health information about a named person and is not recorded as a claim.

hindi: अगर कुछ बढ़ाओ ग कुछ घटेगा जरूर
says: If you increase something, something else will surely decrease; the total is fixed, so a gain in one area costs another.
ambiguity: 'ग' is a caption slip for 'तो'.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts state no conservation law, though trade-offs between houses are read in practice.

hindi: एक घर में एक डाइनिंग टेबल है और बड़ी लेया और बड़ी लिया सोफे हटेंगे कहां से लाओगे
says: Home analogy: with one dining table in a house, if you bring a bigger one, the sofas will have to go, because the space is fixed; a fixed space means growth in one place pushes something else out.
ambiguity: The caption garbles 'लेया' and 'लिया' (bring and take).
classical_check: Silent: an analogy for the fixed quota of a chart.

hindi: यह कोटा है 30 30 डिग्री का य मोटे तौर पर चलता है इसमें कभी 25 भी चल सकता है 29 भी चल सकता है
says: The quota is 30 degrees per box, broadly; at times a box may be 25 and at times 29, so the boxes are not exactly equal. This ties back to the unequal boxes in the earlier lines, but here he gives only smaller sizes.
cells_derived_method: He gives sizes but not which house or sign gets which, so no cell can be filled. By his logic every box differs a little from 30 degrees, so planets near a boundary can fall into the neighbouring box.
ambiguity: Whether 'कोटा' means the share of each house or each sign is not clear; the earlier chunk gave 32 and 28 as well.
classical_check: Differs for signs: a sign is exactly 30 degrees in every system. Sizes such as 25 or 29 can apply only to unequal house divisions such as Placidus or Sripati.

hindi: तो आपका जन्म जब होता है तो 12 भावों में होता है
says: When a person is born, the birth is set inside the 12 houses; every birth chart is built from the 12 house divisions.
classical_check: Agrees: a birth chart is a division of the sky into 12 houses at the moment of birth.

gist: Announces that today's class is about the main points of the 12 houses.

hindi: यह भाव जो हमारे हैं ये एक व्यक्ति की तरह होते हैं जैसे कि मनुष्य हो ये जैसे एक इंसान है ये इस प्रकार से मोटे तौर पर ये ऐसे बैठा हुआ है कुंडली के अंदर ऐसे मान के चले
says: The houses together are like one person, a human being, who sits inside the kundli like a body; the chart is a body map in which each house is a part of the person.
cells_derived_method: He has not yet given the house-to-body-part table. Using the classical Kalapurusha mapping, the house decides the body part and the sign colours it; the examples below are my derivation and not his.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Gemini puts Leo in the 3rd house (arms and shoulders), so the arm and effort area carries the Sun's proud, strong tone.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries puts Cancer in the 4th house (chest and heart region), so that area is read through the Moon, with a soft, emotional tone.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Pisces puts Scorpio in the 9th house (thighs), so that area is read through Mars with an intense, driven tone.

ambiguity: The sentence is spread across two chunks; no house-to-part mapping is given here, the head comes only in the next lines.
classical_check: Agrees: the Kalapurusha model maps the 12 houses to the limbs of a person from the head (1st) to the feet (12th).

hindi: इसी को हम गाड़ी के तौर पर भी ले सकते हैं कि जैसे ये आपकी गाड़ी हो गई कि यह गाड़ी है यह गाड़ी की हेड लाइट्स है यह आगे का हिसाब हो गया
says: The same layout can be pictured as a car: the headlights are the front part, standing for the accounts of what lies ahead; a car is another way to hold the twelve parts of life together.
ambiguity: No house number is assigned to any car part, so this is only a picture of front versus back.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts use the Kalapurusha body and not a car model.

hindi: यह गाड़ी है ये एक डोर हो गई यह दूसरी डोर हो गई पीछे तक का हिसाब किताब बन गया गाड़ी की पूरी बॉडी हो गई
says: The doors and the rear complete the car: the two doors stand in the middle and the back end carries the accounts of what lies behind, so the whole body of the car gives a front-to-back map.
ambiguity: Which houses are the doors and which are the rear is not said.
classical_check: Silent: no classical car model.

hindi: ये ड्राइवर सीट है यह साथ की ये पिछले लोग बैठे हुए हैं और इस प्रकार पिछली टेल लाइट्स है इस प्रकार गाड़ी का मॉडल बन गया हर चीज को इस परे लगा सकते हैं
says: The driver's seat, the seat beside it, the rear passengers and the tail lights complete the car model, and he says every item of life can be fitted onto this model.
ambiguity: 'इस परे लगा सकते हैं' is read as 'can be fitted on this'; it is not said which house is the driver's seat.
classical_check: Silent: no classical car model.

hindi: तो यह हमारा पहला भाव है पहला भाव जिसको लेते हैं हम टॉप पर जैसे कि मुंडी पहला भाव है भाई
says: The first house is taken at the top of the chart and is the head (slang 'mundi'); the chart is read starting from the head.
cells_derived_method: The 1st house is the head whatever sign rises, and the sign colours it. The examples below are derived and not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Taurus makes the head house a Venus sign, so the head and face are read through Venus, with a stress on the face and throat.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Scorpio makes the head house Mars-ruled, so the head is read through Mars, with a sharp and intense tone.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Pisces makes the head house Jupiter-ruled, so the head is read through Jupiter, with a soft and broad tone.

ambiguity: 'टॉप पर' fits the North Indian diamond chart, where the first house sits at the top.
classical_check: Agrees: the 1st house is the head and the self; the head of the Kalapurusha is the 1st.

hindi: ये यह पहला भाव जो है हमारा इस भाव से ही कुंडली शुरू होती है इस प्रथम भाव में
says: The kundli begins from this first house; it is the starting point from which all counting of houses and reading of the chart is done.
ambiguity: The sentence trails into the next one ('इस प्रथम भाव में ये भाव जो होते हैं').
classical_check: Agrees: all counting of houses starts from the lagna, the 1st house.

hindi: ये भाव जो होते हैं फिक्स होते हैं एक दो तीन चार ऐसे चलता है उल्टा 12 ये तो भाव है
says: The houses are fixed in place and numbered 1, 2, 3, 4 and so on round to 12 in the reverse (anticlockwise) direction; the house positions in the chart never move.
ambiguity: 'उल्टा' is read as anticlockwise; it could also mean counting in reverse order.
classical_check: Agrees: in the North Indian diamond chart the houses are fixed positions counted anticlockwise from the top diamond.

hindi: अब मजे की बात है इसमें राशियां घूमती है और उन राशियों के साथ-साथ ग्रह घूमते हैं
says: The interesting part is that the signs rotate through the fixed houses and the planets move along with the signs; the house frame stays while the zodiac and the planets turn through it.
cells_derived_method: Because the signs rotate through fixed houses, every sign can fall in every house, which gives 12 x 12 cases; the lagna of any case is sign number minus house number plus one. He does not say 144 here. The examples below are my derivation.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer puts Virgo in the 3rd house, so effort, siblings and short travel carry the practical, analytical Virgo tone (Mercury).
Derived, not said by him: lagna Gemini puts Aries in the 11th house, so gains and friends carry the fiery, quick Aries tone (Mars).
Derived, not said by him: lagna Libra puts Taurus in the 8th house, so hidden matters and sudden change carry the steady, possessive Taurus tone (Venus).

ambiguity: 'घूमती है' is the daily turning of the sky; he does not yet say how fast.
classical_check: Agrees: the rising sign moves through the zodiac during the day while the planets stay in their signs.

hindi: एक राशि में बृहस्पति जाके फिक्स हो गया मंगल फिक्स हो गया
says: A planet such as Jupiter or Mars goes into a sign and gets fixed there; it holds its sign for a while as a fixed point in the sky.
ambiguity: Jupiter and Mars are examples; no sign is named yet.
classical_check: Agrees: a planet's sign is set by its longitude and it holds that sign for a time.

hindi: एक नंबर राशि होती है मेष मेष वृष मिथुन कर्क ऐसे चलता है एरीज टोरस जेमिना कैंसर
says: Sign number one is Aries (Mesh), then Taurus (Vrish), Gemini (Mithun) and Cancer (Kark), each also given its English name; the signs run in this order starting from Aries as number 1.
ambiguity: Only the first four signs are named; 'मेष मेष' is a repeat. The numbering Aries = 1 matches what is confirmed in this series.
classical_check: Agrees: Aries is the first sign, followed by Taurus, Gemini and Cancer.

hindi: इन राशियों में आपका एक ग्रह फिक्स हो गया अंतरिक्ष में
says: Your planet is fixed in one of these signs out in space; a planet's sign is a place in the sky, and it is separate from the house, which is a frame of the day.
ambiguity: The contrast with the house is implied by the lines that follow, not said in this sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: the sign is set by the planet's zodiac longitude, while the house depends on the lagna.

hindi: अब वो सारा दिन भर में मान लो 24 घंटे का दिन है दो दो घंटे घर में घूम रहा है
says: Take a 24-hour day: over the day a planet passes through all the houses, about two hours in each, because the sky turns once in a day.
ambiguity: 'वो' (it) is the planet, and 'घर' is the house; 12 houses in 24 hours give two hours each.
classical_check: Agrees: the rising sign changes about every two hours on average (about 1 to 3 hours depending on the sign and latitude).

hindi: तो वो ऐसे घूमता है सूरज यहां आया या जो भी है मंगल है मंगल यहां मंगल यहां मंगल मंगल ऐसे ऐसे हर दो घंटे बाद कुंडली में शो होगा यह कुंडली बनती है ऐसे गोलगोल घूम रहा है
says: So the Sun, or Mars, or any planet, shows up in a different house of the kundli every two hours, as if it goes round and round through the fixed houses; this is how the kundli is formed.
ambiguity: He points with gestures ('यहां'), so the actual houses cannot be seen in the caption.
classical_check: Agrees: planets barely move in their signs during a day while the rising sign cycles through all twelve signs.

hindi: तो जब यहां पर भाव में आया तो पहले भाव में है राशि नंबर मान लो एक है फिर वो दूसरे भाव में है राशि नंबर एक है तीसरे में राशि नंबर एक है
says: A planet in sign number 1 (Aries) is in the first house at one moment, then in the second house, then in the third, still in sign 1; the sign stays the same while the house changes through the day, so one sign can sit in every house.
cells_derived_method: By the same logic the pattern holds for houses 4 to 12 and for every sign, giving 144 cells; the lagna of each cell is sign number minus house number plus one. He states only houses 1 to 3, and the examples below are my derivation.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Capricorn puts Aries in the 4th house, so a planet in Aries acts on home, mother and peace of mind with Aries' fire, a different result from the same planet in the 1st.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Libra puts Aries in the 7th house, so the same Aries planet acts on marriage and partners, directly opposite the lagna.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer puts Aries in the 10th house, so the planet in Aries acts on career and public standing.

ambiguity: 'मान लो एक है' makes sign 1 an example, which I read as Aries; the pattern for all signs is implied, not stated.
classical_check: Agrees: the sign comes from the zodiac and the house from the lagna, so the same sign falls in a different house for each lagna; this is how the 12 x 12 grid of cases arises.

hindi: राशि के साथ चिपटा हुआ है वो कुछ दिन के लिए एक महीना छ महीना जो भी टाइम आए
says: A planet stays stuck to its sign for some days, a month or six months, whatever time it takes, while the house changes every two hours; the sign changes slowly and the house quickly.
ambiguity: 'जो भी टाइम आए' means the time varies by planet; he does not give figures for any one planet.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon stays about 2.5 days in a sign, the Sun, Mercury and Venus about a month and Mars about 1.5 months, but Jupiter stays about a year, Saturn about 2.5 years and Rahu or Ketu about 1.5 years, so 'six months' is loose.

hindi: लेकिन भाव यही है भाव कभी भी नहीं बदलेगा आपके कभी भी जिंदगी में ऐसा नहीं हो सकता कि भाव बदले यह फिक्स है
says: The house stays the same: its meaning never changes in your life, it is impossible for a house to change, and it is fixed.
ambiguity: 'भाव नहीं बदलेगा' means a house's matters are constant; it does not say the sign in it stays.
classical_check: Agrees: house significations are fixed while signs and planets move through them.

hindi: आप बेडरूम बेडरूम ही है ये आपका सिर ही रहेगा चाहे कुछ भी हो जाए
says: A house is like a room: a bedroom is always a bedroom, and the head house is always your head, no matter what comes into it.
ambiguity: 'ये आपका सिर' points at the first house of the drawn chart.
classical_check: Agrees: the 1st house stands for the head and body, whatever sign or planet is in it.

hindi: शनि महाराज यहां आए यहां चोट मार दी फिर शनि महाराज यहां आए
says: When Saturn comes into a house it hits that place, and then it moves on to the next house to hit that one (the sentence breaks off); Saturn's passage hurts whichever life area or body part the house holds.
cells_derived_method: He names no house and only gestures ('यहां'). By the head logic of the 1st house, Saturn in the 1st hits the head and personality, and in the 7th it hits partnerships; the examples below are derived and not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Libra with Saturn in Libra, where Saturn is exalted, puts the blow on the head and self, but an exalted Saturn gives discipline and a hard hit, not plain damage.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Libra puts Aries in the 7th house and Saturn in Aries is debilitated, so the hit lands on marriage and partners with added weakness.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries puts Capricorn in the 10th house, and Saturn in its own sign Capricorn presses on career and status, giving delay and discipline.

ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the end of the batch. 'चोट मार दी' may be literal (injury) or figurative (setback), and he does not say whether this is the natal position or a transit.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn's transit through or aspect on a house is said classically to trouble that house's matters (Sade Sati and Ashtama Shani are read from the Moon); he does not name the house here.

hindi: यहां मारी इधर आए इधर मारी इधर आए शनि महाराज जहां जहां घूम रहे हो वहां वहां चोट मार रहे हैं या प्यार कर रहे हैं या पैसा दे रहे हैं लेकिन यह भाव फिक्स है
says: Saturn is the moving agent: wherever Saturn travels it either strikes a blow, shows love, or gives money, depending on what area it is passing through, but the house box itself is fixed. So the life-area (and body-area) belonging to a box never changes; only what the travelling planet does there changes.
cells_derived_method: What a transiting Saturn does = Saturn's restricting, delaying, disciplining nature x the topic of the house being crossed x the sign Saturn is in at that time (own or exalted sign tends to give, enemy or debilitated sign tends to hit).

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn crossing the 11th box in its own sign Aquarius (lagna Aries) leans towards 'gives money' - steady gains and slow but reliable income.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn crossing the 8th box while in debilitated Aries (lagna Virgo) leans towards 'hits' - sudden stress, hidden troubles and obstacles.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 7th box (lagna Aries) leans towards 'love' - committed, durable partnership and steady dealings with others.

ambiguity: The opening words are a hand gesture on the chart (hit here, come here). 'भाव' here means the fixed box of the chart, not the sign number that changes with lagna. He does not say whether the reference point is the lagna or the Moon.
classical_check: Classical gochara (transit) is mostly measured from the natal Moon, not from fixed lagna boxes; he speaks of fixed boxes. Agrees that a transit effect depends on the house crossed; silent on reference point.

hindi: तो यह आपका सिर चेहरा ही है यह आपका चेहरा ही है किसी भी हालत में आपका चेहरा है ये यह कभी नहीं बदलेगा सेम है
says: The box he points at is your head and face, and it stays your head and face in every chart, whatever happens; the body part belongs to the box, not to whichever sign or planet happens to sit in it. This is the first (lagna) box.
cells_derived_method: The body part is tied to the house number only. The sign that sits in the 1st box changes with the lagna, so the sign's own body rulership and nature colours the type of head or face trouble or look; a planet there shows how the head and face are affected.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars's sign on the head box (lagna Aries) - head and face carry Mars traits, such as heat, scars, a quick temper showing in the face.
Derived, not said by him: Venus's sign on the head box (lagna Taurus) - a broad, pleasant face, with the neck and throat region also stressed in the sign-body scheme.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn's sign on the head box (lagna Capricorn) - lean, bony, serious face and a body that shows age early.

ambiguity: He is pointing at the chart and does not speak the house number; assumed to be the 1st (lagna) box because head and face come first in the body order.
classical_check: Agrees: Kalapurusha and Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra (BPHS) give the 1st house as head and face.

hindi: ये ये आपकी दाई आंख है राइट आंख आख राइट आंख
says: The next box he points at is your right eye (said three times). Seen from the front, the person's right is the viewer's left, so this is the box beside the lagna on the left side, the 2nd house.
cells_derived_method: Right-eye matters are read from the 2nd box; the sign in it and the planets in it show the kind of eye strength or strain, with the Sun and Moon as natural eye significators.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Sun's sign on the right-eye box (lagna Cancer) - the right eye is bright but sensitive to glare and strain (tradition reading, not a diagnosis).
Derived, not said by him: Mercury's sign on the right-eye box (lagna Leo) - sharp, analytical eyes that tire from close reading or screens.
Derived, not said by him: Mars and Ketu's sign on the right-eye box (lagna Libra) - intense gaze, with irritation or injury tendency to the right eye.

ambiguity: Box number is not spoken, only pointed at. The 2nd is inferred from chart geometry (mirror of the left eye box) and from classical order.
classical_check: Agrees with the common tradition: 2nd house = right eye (also face and speech), 12th house = left eye.

hindi: यह आपकी लेफ्ट आंख है
says: The box on the opposite side of the lagna from the right eye is the left eye, which is the 12th house.
cells_derived_method: Left-eye matters are read from the 12th box; the sign and planets there colour the type of eye trouble, and the 12th's own themes (loss, sleep, foreign lands) run alongside.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter and Ketu's sign on the left-eye box (lagna Aries) - dreamy or tired left eye, with losses, sleep and foreign themes in the same box.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury's sign on the left-eye box (lagna Cancer) - restless, strain-prone left eye, linked to heavy reading or screen time and to scattered spending.

ambiguity: The house number is not spoken; 12th inferred as the mirror of the right-eye box.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts give the 12th house as the left eye.

hindi: यह राइट कंधा है यह लेफ्ट कंधा है
says: The next pair of boxes are the right shoulder and the left shoulder; by the mirror geometry of the figure these are the 3rd and 11th houses.
cells_derived_method: Right-shoulder matters from the 3rd box, left-shoulder matters from the 11th box; the sign in each box and the planets in it colour the type of shoulder strength or strain.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars's sign on the right-shoulder box (lagna Aquarius) - strong, athletic shoulder that is prone to bruising or overuse.
Derived, not said by him: Moon's sign on the left-shoulder box (lagna Virgo) - the left shoulder carries emotional load and tension.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn's sign on the right-shoulder box (lagna Scorpio) - stiff, slow-to-loosen right shoulder.

ambiguity: House numbers are not spoken; 3rd and 11th are inferred from the mirror-pair layout of the figure.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical gives the 3rd house shoulders, arms and right ear, and the 11th the left ear and calves or ankles; a left shoulder for the 11th is his own mirror symmetry.

hindi: यह आपका चेस्ट एरिया है
says: The next box is your chest area; this is the box used for the chest-problem examples that follow, taken here as the 4th house.
cells_derived_method: Chest and heart matters are read from this box; the sign in it and planets in it (the Sun for the heart, the Moon for the breast and lungs side) colour the type of chest strain.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Cancer is the natural chest sign and sits in the chest box (lagna Aries) - strong emotional link to the chest, sensitive to stress.
Derived, not said by him: the Sun's sign on the chest box (lagna Taurus) - heart-centred, with the heart carrying the load of pride and responsibility.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn's sign on the chest box (lagna Libra) - tightness and cold in the chest area, slow-building complaints.

ambiguity: No house number is spoken. By his mirror layout both the 4th and 10th boxes sit on the chest line, and he later ties the 10th to chest strain through the Sun. The 4th is assumed.
classical_check: Agrees: Kalapurusha and BPHS give the 4th house as chest and heart.

hindi: यह आपका घुटना है राइट यह लेफ्ट घुटना है
says: Lower on the figure are the right knee and the left knee; from his own later remark (Saturn in the 5th box gives right-knee pain) the right knee is the 5th box, and by mirror symmetry the left knee is the 9th box.
cells_derived_method: Knee trouble is read from the box assigned to that knee, with the sign and planets in it colouring the kind of strain; Saturn, as the joint and bone significator, is the natural planet to check.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn's sign on the right-knee box (lagna Virgo) - stiff right knee that complains in cold weather and with age.
Derived, not said by him: the Moon's sign on the left-knee box (lagna Scorpio) - left knee reacts to emotional strain and damp, cold weather.

ambiguity: No house number is spoken for either knee; 5 and 9 are inferred from the mirror-pair layout and from his later 5th-box knee example.
classical_check: Differs: classical Kalapurusha puts the knees in the 10th house (and the thighs in the 9th); his 5th = right knee comes from his own chart geometry.

hindi: यह आपका गुप्तांग है गुप्त स्थान
says: The box at the bottom centre of the figure is the private part, the hidden place; on the geometry that is the 7th box.
cells_derived_method: Matters of the private parts are read from this box, with the sign and planets in it (Mars, Venus and Ketu especially) colouring the nature of the issue.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars and Ketu's sign on the private-part box (lagna Taurus) - strong drive and secrecy around the area, with inflammation tendency (tradition reading, not a diagnosis).
Derived, not said by him: Venus's sign on the private-part box (lagna Aries) - refined, balanced; matters tied to pleasure and partnership.
Derived, not said by him: if the secret place were instead the 8th box, Pisces there (lagna Leo) would link it to Jupiter and Ketu themes of hidden, subtle complaints.

ambiguity: The caption cannot tell whether he points at the 7th (bottom centre of the figure) or the 8th (the classical house of the hidden place); 7th taken from geometry.
classical_check: Differs in house: classical Kalapurusha gives the genitals to the 8th house (and the lower abdomen to the 7th), although 'hidden place' matches the 8th's name.

hindi: यह आपका राइट पैर है यह लेफ्ट पैर
says: The two boxes flanking the bottom centre are the right foot and the left foot, which by geometry are the 6th and 8th boxes.
cells_derived_method: Foot and ankle matters are read from the box assigned to that foot, with the sign and planets in it colouring the type of strain.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Pisces, the natural foot sign, on the right-foot box (lagna Libra) - sensitive feet and soles, prone to swelling or soreness (tradition reading).
Derived, not said by him: Venus's sign on the left-foot box (lagna Libra) - well-cared-for feet but vulnerable to comfort-related trouble.

ambiguity: No house numbers spoken; 6 and 8 inferred from the figure's layout, which also leaves the 12th as the left eye.
classical_check: Differs: classical Kalapurusha puts the feet in the 12th house (Pisces); his right foot = 6th and left foot = 8th is his own geometry.

hindi: यह मोटे तौर पर शरीर हो गया
says: He closes the body-mapping section: in rough terms the whole chart is a drawing of the physical body, head to feet, with the right and left halves mirrored across the boxes.
classical_check: Agrees with the Kalapurusha idea that the twelve houses map onto the body from head to feet, though the exact left/right assignment is his.

hindi: अब इसका मजेदार बात क्या होती है ज्योतिष में हमने य कुंडली में देखा कि यार बंदे को चेस्ट की प्रॉब्लम है या नहीं देखा सामने आया
says: He introduces the practical use of the body map: when we read a kundli to see whether a person has a chest problem, we look at the chest box and see what shows up there. The sentence is cut off at the end and carries on in the next line.
cells_derived_method: The same method for any body complaint: find the box assigned to that body part, then check which planet sits there and in which sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a chest query on a chart with Aries in the chest box (lagna Capricorn) is read through Mars's condition.
Derived, not said by him: a chest query on a chart with Pisces in the chest box (lagna Sagittarius) is read through Jupiter and Ketu.

ambiguity: Caption ends mid-thought ('देखा सामने आया'); the chest box is assumed to be the 4th as in the previous rows.
classical_check: Agrees in method: classical medical astrology reads the body part from the house and sign, then the planets afflicting it.

hindi: बंदा यहां पर कहीं कोई ग्रह डिस्टर्ब है यानी मंगल मान लो चार नंबर का ये नीच का होता है तो सीधा छूटते बोलो तेरे को चेस्ट की प्रॉब्लम है उसे चेस्ट की प्रॉब्लम होगी
says: If some planet is disturbed in the chest box, for example Mars in sign number 4 (Cancer, where Mars is debilitated), he says you can tell the native straight away that he has a chest problem. This is a health claim by the speaker, recorded as his tradition claim and not as a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: A debilitated or afflicted planet strains the body part of the box it sits in. Moving the same debilitated Mars to other boxes moves the strain to that box's body part.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: debilitated Mars in the head box (lagna Cancer, where Mars is also lord of the 5th and 10th) - head heat and low vitality tendency.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Mars in the private-part and lower abdomen box (lagna Capricorn) - strain in that region and heated friction with the partner.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Mars in the karma box (lagna Libra) - weak drive at work, with strain on the chest and knee zone of his map.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर' could be sign number 4 or house number 4; 'नीच का' (debilitated) fits only sign Cancer, so sign is taken. Whether the chest box is the 4th house or the Cancer sign anywhere is not resolved; in an Aries-lagna chart the two coincide.
classical_check: Mars is classically debilitated in Cancer and Cancer rules the chest in Kalapurusha, so the idea is consistent; classical texts do not give a flat 'he will have a chest problem'.

hindi: मान लो सूर्य यहां बैठा है दो नंबर सात नंबर राशि और भी कई कॉमिनेशन है ये बहुत डिटेल जाएगा झे हार्ट अटैक होगा
says: With the Sun in the chest box in sign number 2 or 7 (Taurus or Libra, both Venus signs) he says a heart attack will come; he adds that there are many more combinations but they are too detailed for now. The heart-attack statement is a health claim by the speaker, recorded only, not a prediction to reuse.
cells_derived_method: The Sun is the heart significator, so the Sun badly placed (enemy or debilitated sign) strains the heart whichever box it sits in; the box decides which body area is strained alongside.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: debilitated Sun in Libra on the chest box (lagna Cancer) - strained heart and chest, with pride or authority problems at home.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Sun in Libra in the lagna (lagna Libra) - low vitality, weak constitution and an ego that is not backed by strength.
Derived, not said by him: Sun in Taurus, an enemy sign, in the karma box (lagna Leo) - career recognition that comes with heart strain from work pressure.

ambiguity: The caption is garbled at 'झे हार्ट अटैक' (likely 'तुझे' or 'मुझे'). 'दो नंबर सात नंबर' is read as signs because he says 'राशि'; they could also be house numbers.
classical_check: Sun is debilitated in Libra and inimical to Venus's signs, and is the heart karaka, which fits the weak-heart idea; a named 'heart attack' is a modern medical prediction not found in classical texts.

hindi: यहां बैठ गया है किडनी पे आ जाएगा घुटने के साथ यही किडनी कह रही है एक साइड क्या एब्डोमेन पूरा का पूरा
says: He says that a planet sitting in the box near the knees comes onto the kidney along with the knee, and adds a half-audible phrase about one side and the whole abdomen. A disturbed planet in that lower box is therefore said to hit the kidney and abdomen area. The caption is garbled, so the planet and the exact box are not clear; the content is a health claim recorded only.
cells_derived_method: Kidney and abdominal complaints are read from the lower-body boxes (classically the 6th for intestines and the 7th for kidneys and lower abdomen), with the planet and sign there colouring the complaint.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars in its own sign in the kidney and lower-abdomen box (lagna Libra) - inflammation-prone area, with heat and sharp pain tendency (tradition reading).
Derived, not said by him: Mercury in its own sign Virgo in the intestine and abdomen box (lagna Aries) - sensitive digestion, nervous stomach.

ambiguity: Garbled: 'यही किडनी कह रही है एक साइड क्या' cannot be fully made out. Which planet and which box he means is not stated; 'knee with kidney' also does not match any classical house pairing.
classical_check: Classical Kalapurusha places the kidneys in the 6th or 7th and the knees in the 10th, so a joint kidney-knee link is not classical; silent here.

hindi: ये चार नंबर का मंगल हो गया ओवरी में सिस्ट होगा लड़की को इनविटेशन होगी नहीं होगी उस परे डिपेंड करता है
says: The same Mars of number 4 (debilitated in Cancer), sitting in this pelvic and abdominal box, is said to give an ovarian cyst to a girl or woman; whether the garbled 'इनविटेशन' (probably ovulation) happens or not depends on that planet. This is a reproductive-health claim by the speaker, recorded only.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Mars in a water sign strains whichever pelvic or reproductive area the box points to; the 5th box also carries womb and fertility themes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: debilitated Mars in the 5th box (lagna Pisces) - womb and fertility area under Mars strain, with children themes also heated.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Mars in the 7th box (lagna Capricorn) - lower abdomen and partner-related strain, with heated friction in the marriage.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Mars in the 8th box (lagna Sagittarius) - hidden, deep-seated pelvic trouble with sudden flare-ups.

ambiguity: The caption word 'इनविटेशन' is garbled (probably ovulation or inflammation); the box he sits Mars in is not named, only that it is the area of the ovary.
classical_check: Mars is debilitated in Cancer, and classical medical astrology links Mars with surgery, inflammation and the blood; a named ovarian cyst is not classical, so the claim is his own.

hindi: यह आपका कर्म का स्थान है आपके जीवन के अंदर
says: The box he points at now is the place of karma, meaning action and work, in your life; this is the 10th house.
