cells_derived_method: The 10th box shows career and public standing; the sign in it shapes the style of work and the planets in it show how it plays out.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn's sign on the karma box (lagna Aries) - structured, slow, responsibility-heavy career.
Derived, not said by him: the Moon's sign on the karma box (lagna Libra) - work involving the public, care and food, with a changing career pattern.

ambiguity: The house number is not spoken, but 'कर्म का स्थान' is the standard name of the 10th.
classical_check: Agrees: the 10th house is the karma bhava in all classical texts.

hindi: अगर मान लो सूर्य बहुत ताकतवर बैठा हुआ है और यही कर्म का स्थान है तो आपके जीवन में सूर्य जितना पावर पकड़ता जाएगा उतना आप काम ऊंचा कर रहे हो और उतना ही चेस्ट पर जोर मार रहे हो
says: If a very strong Sun sits in the karma box (10th), then the more power the Sun gathers, the higher your work and standing climb and the more pressure you are putting on your chest at the same time. Career height is paid for in chest or heart strain; this is his health claim, recorded only.
cells_derived_method: A strong Sun raises authority and public standing in the 10th; as heart significator the same Sun puts load on the heart and chest. The sign decides how strong the Sun is: exalted in Aries, own in Leo, weak in Libra.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: exalted Sun in the 10th (lagna Cancer) - peak rank and fame, and by his logic the largest chest load from overwork.
Derived, not said by him: Sun in its own sign in the 10th (lagna Scorpio) - authority and leadership roles, with strain from the pride and burden of command.
Derived, not said by him: Sun in Saturn's sign (enemy) in the 10th (lagna Aries) - effort without matching recognition, so the chest claim is weaker by his own logic.

ambiguity: 'ताकतवर' is not defined (sign strength, house strength or Shadbala). 'Chest' was the 4th box earlier, here it is tied to the 10th through the Sun's heart role; he does not reconcile the two.
classical_check: Sun in the 10th gains directional strength (digbala) and gives rank and fame (BPHS); the link of fame with heart strain is his own reading from the Sun as heart karaka, silent in classics.

hindi: कैसा मजेदार है इसलिए आपको य रीडिंग जाननी जरूरी है कि मैं बहुत ज्यादा ऊंचा उठ गया काम में बहुत फेम हो गई तो मेरे चेस्ट पे अटैक दे देगा
says: He tells the student that you must know this reading in advance: if you rise very high in your work and gain a lot of fame, the strong Sun can give an attack on your chest. This is a warning-style health claim by the speaker, recorded only.
cells_derived_method: A chart with a strong Sun on the karma box carries the warning; the further a person rises in the area of that box, the more the body part of the box is loaded.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: exalted Sun in the 10th (lagna Cancer) is the sharpest case for this warning, since rank and workload peak together.
Derived, not said by him: Sun in Jupiter's friendly sign in the 10th (lagna Pisces) - fame through teaching or advising, with the warning milder as the Sun is not extreme.

ambiguity: The 10th is implied by 'work and fame' but not named in this sentence; 'अटैक' is a medical word he uses loosely.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not tie rising fame to a heart episode.

hindi: ये आपको खुद कॉन्शियस ब्रेन से जानना पड़ेगा ना
says: He adds that this knowledge must be known by the person himself with the conscious brain: the chart is meant to be understood in advance and acted on with awareness, not left to run on its own.
classical_check: Silent; the idea of acting with awareness against a fixed chart is close to purushartha versus prarabdha, but he frames it in modern conscious/unconscious terms.

gist: He says he will do only this much and no more; the unfinished 'if you have known and understood this' continues in the next line.

hindi: कि इतना ही दुलार करना है बच्चे को
says: Having understood the planetary reading, he says a parent should give the child only this limited measure of affection and pampering; this completes the unfinished sentence from the previous line and sets up the 5th-box example. It is a do-and-don't advice, recorded as tradition.
cells_derived_method: The limit on pampering applies where the planet in the children's box is hostile to the parent's own significator. The planet and sign in the 5th box decide whether the limit is needed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in its own sign in the 5th (lagna Libra) - a serious, reserved child, so a hovering parent meets distance; the limit on pampering applies.
Derived, not said by him: the Moon in its own sign in the 5th (lagna Pisces) - a close, warm bond is welcomed, so the limit on pampering is weak or not needed.

ambiguity: 'इतना ही' is not quantified anywhere; the 5th is implied from 'बच्चे' and the next sentence.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts judge the 5th house for children but do not give a pampering rule.

hindi: यह आपका संतान का खाना है यह पांच नंबर है
says: The box he points at is the box of children (santan), the box numbered five, meaning the 5th house. Here five is the house number; in the next sentence he uses five again as the sign number of Leo.
cells_derived_method: Children and their relationship to the parent are read from the 5th box; the sign in it and the planets in it show the nature of the children and of the bond.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Leo, the Sun's sign, on the children's box (lagna Aries) - proud, dignified children and strong parent-child feelings.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter's sign Pisces on the children's box (lagna Scorpio) - gentle, spiritual or learned children, with Jupiter as the natural significator of children supporting the box.

ambiguity: 'पांच नंबर' is a house number here; it could be confused with the sign number 5 (Leo) used in the very next sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: the 5th house is the putra bhava, the house of children.

hindi: मान लो यहां शनि बैठा हुआ है शनि पांच नंबर सूर्य की राशि के अंदर शत्रु है तंग करेगा आपको अपने बच्चे से
says: Take Saturn sitting in the children's 5th box in sign number 5, Leo, which is the Sun's sign. Saturn is an enemy there, so it will trouble you through your child.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in the Sun's sign is in an enemy sign everywhere. The house it sits in decides which area of life carries the trouble; the same Saturn-in-Leo placement moves from children to career, partner or home in other boxes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Leo in the 10th (lagna Scorpio) - friction with authority and a father figure through the career.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in Leo in the 7th (lagna Aquarius) - a domineering or distant partner; trouble comes through marriage.
Derived, not said by him, for contrast: exalted Saturn in the 5th in Libra (lagna Gemini) - the bond with children is steady and dutiful rather than troubling.

ambiguity: None for the planet and sign; the 'मान लो' is an assumed example, not a general rule for all charts.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn in the 5th house is a classical indication of difficulties around children, and Sun and Saturn are natural enemies, so Saturn in Leo is in an enemy sign.

hindi: जितना दूर-दूर का रिश्ता बनाए रखोगे सूर्य चंद्रमा दुश्मन एक दूसरे के जितना दूर का रिश्ता बनाए रखोगे उतना ज्यादा बच्चा आपको प्रेम करेगा
says: The more of a distant relationship you keep from the child, he says, the more the child will love you: because Sun and Saturn (the caption says Moon) are enemies of each other, closeness provokes friction and distance keeps the affection. It is a behavioural advice recorded as tradition.
cells_derived_method: The distance rule holds where the 5th-box planet is an enemy of the parent's significator (Sun for a father, Moon for a mother). A friendly planet in the 5th would reverse it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: father with Saturn in Leo in the 5th (lagna Aries) - keep a formal, spaced bond; over-involvement triggers resistance.
Derived, not said by him: Sun exalted in Aries in the 5th (lagna Sagittarius) - the Sun is strong there and no enemy planet sits in the child's box, so the distance rule is not needed.

ambiguity: The caption reads 'सूर्य चंद्रमा दुश्मन' (Sun and Moon enemies), which is probably a mishearing of 'सूर्य शनि' given the Saturn-in-Leo context; the cell is carried over from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Sun and Saturn are classical enemies; Sun and Moon are classical friends, so the spoken 'Sun-Moon enemies' differs from the texts and is most likely a caption error. The behavioural advice itself is not classical.

hindi: आप छाया के पास जा रहा है सूरज बहुत पास जा रहा है
says: Image for the same rule: you, like the Sun, are going very close to Chhaya, the shadow (here Saturn, the Sun's shadow-born son); the Sun pressing too close to its shadow is why the relation turns into friction.
ambiguity: 'छाया' most likely means Saturn (Chhaya-putra, son of Surya and Chhaya), but 'chhaya grah' can also mean Rahu and Ketu; in this Saturn-in-Leo context Saturn is assumed.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic story that Saturn is the son of the Sun and Chhaya, and with Sun-Saturn enmity; the use as a parenting rule is his own.

gist: Analogy of two female friends: affection lasts while the friendship stays at a distance; when one tries to get close the other seems to avoid her and the first calls her rude and bad.

hindi: मित्र का खाना मित्र यहां से होता और यहां से अगर ऐसी स्थिति में यह बन रहा है तो हो सकता है कि आप अपने जीवन के अंदर अपनी सहेली के ज्यादा क्लोज जा रहे लड़ाई और झगड़ा हो जाएगा
says: By the same logic for the friends box: if a similar hostile configuration shows in the box that gives you friends (he points at two spots), you may be going too close to a female friend, and it will end in quarrel and fight.
cells_derived_method: The closeness-brings-friction logic applies to any box where the planet is an enemy of the person's own significator: in the 11th it shows through friends, in the 7th through the partner, in the 5th through children.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars's sign on the friends box (lagna Gemini) - competitive friendships where over-closeness quickly turns into arguments.
Derived, not said by him: the Moon's sign on the friends box (lagna Virgo) - emotionally clinging friendships, where too much closeness breeds hurt and fights.

ambiguity: 'मित्र यहां से होता और यहां से' points at two boxes without naming either; the 11th is assumed as the classical house of friends. The planet is not named.
classical_check: The 11th is the classical house of friends and gains; the closeness rule is his own and silent in classics.

hindi: जैसे कि बच्चे के साथ शनि यहां है जिन दिनों में बाप अपने बच्चे के साथ बहुत ज्यादा प्रेम जताता फिरे केयर करेगा ना उसके राइट घुटने
says: With Saturn in the children's 5th box, in those days when a father goes around showing his child very much love and care, his right knee (the 5th box is the right knee in this body map) is the part affected. The pain itself is stated in the next line. A health claim recorded only.
cells_derived_method: Saturn on a box brings its stiffness and pain to that box's body part when the matching life area is overactive. Moving Saturn to the 9th box would put the same strain on the left knee, with father, guru and fortune themes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: debilitated Saturn in the 5th (lagna Sagittarius) - right-knee trouble with a harsher edge during over-fussing over children.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn in its own sign in the 5th (lagna Libra) - the same link, but milder, since Saturn is comfortable there.
Derived, not said by him: exalted Saturn in the 9th (lagna Aquarius) - strain goes to the left-knee box; theme is duty to father and teacher rather than to children.

ambiguity: 'जिन दिनों में' (in those days) is not tied to a dasha, a transit or simple behaviour; the right knee = 5th box is his geometry and is not stated in numbers here.
classical_check: Differs: classically Saturn in the 5th harms children matters, and knees belong to the 10th house; the knee link is his own.

hindi: में पेन आएगा ग्रह पावर पकड़ रहा है व उतनी ही ताकत से काम कर रहा है घुटना नहीं पकड़ेगा
says: Completing the right-knee claim: pain will come, because the planet is gathering power and acts on its body part with equal force, and he asks rhetorically whether the knee will not seize up. The strength of the planet sets the strength of the effect on its box's body part.
cells_derived_method: The intensity on the body part rises with the planet's strength (sign dignity, period activation) and falls when the planet is weak; the body part is fixed by the box.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 5th (lagna Virgo) - a strong planet in the right-knee box acts with force, so injury-type knee pain rather than stiffness.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 9th (lagna Leo) - weak Saturn in the left-knee box gives chronic, lingering stiffness rather than sharp pain.

ambiguity: 'घुटना नहीं पकड़ेगा' is a rhetorical question and is read as 'the knee will seize'; the planet is not named in this sentence, only carried from the previous one.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: a strong or activated planet gives stronger results; silent on the knee link.

hindi: मान लो यह हड्डी का एरिया है कोई और ग्रह है नेगेटिव तो आपको यहां कमर में दर्द आ जाएगी
says: Suppose the box he points at is the bone area and some other negative planet sits there; then you will get pain in the waist or lower back. Which box and which planet are not named. A health claim recorded only.
cells_derived_method: Bone and back complaints are read from the box that the body map gives to the spine or waist, with the malefic there (Saturn as bone significator, Rahu, Mars) colouring the type of pain.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: debilitated Saturn in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer) - bone and back strain from sustained work load.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in Virgo in the 4th (lagna Gemini) - vague, shifting back or chest-back discomfort with no clear cause.

ambiguity: The box is not named: 'यह हड्डी का एरिया' is pointed at on the figure. 'नेगेटिव ग्रह' (negative planet) is not defined as a malefic or as an afflicted planet.
classical_check: Saturn as bone karaka is classical; the waist as a chart box is not named here, so silent on the specific link.

gist: Explains the drawing: the figure is a person sitting with bent knees, drawn crooked, so the whole body maps onto the chart and this waist and knee area is nearly the same region.

hindi: यह पूरे के पूरे बाजू है पूरे के पूरे बाजू है
says: He says these boxes (said twice) are the whole arms, mapping the side boxes of the figure to the arms or limbs on each side. Which boxes he points at is not named.
cells_derived_method: Arm-related complaints are read from the side boxes assigned to the arms (likely 3 and 11 for the shoulders and arms, or 4 and 10 on the chest line), with the sign and planets there colouring the type.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mercury's sign on the right-arm box (lagna Aries) - nervous, restless arms and hands, prone to repetitive-strain trouble.
Derived, not said by him: Mars's sign on the left-arm box (lagna Gemini) - strong, injury-prone left arm.

ambiguity: Which boxes are the arms is not named. 'बाजू' can also mean sides. Candidates are 3 and 11, or 4 and 10, and the caption cannot settle it.
classical_check: Classically the 3rd house gives arms, hands and shoulders, which partly agrees with the 3 and 11 reading.

hindi: यहां कोई चोट है आपके एक्सपर्टीज से होगा कि आपने क्या पढ़ा कि आपको हड्डी में पेन हो गया अ आपको गोल्फर एल्बो हो गई है टेनिस एल्बो हो गई है क्या हो गया डिपेंड करता है
says: If there is an injury in the arm area, which specific ailment you name, such as bone pain, golfer's elbow or tennis elbow, depends on the reader's own expertise and what he has studied. The chart gives the zone and the reader supplies the specific complaint.
classical_check: Silent; classical medical astrology names classes of complaints, not modern conditions like tennis elbow.

gist: Teaching aside: as your knowledge and information grow you will learn to do the reading.

hindi: तब जाकर के आप जान सकते हैं आपका पत्नी के साथ क्लेश है आपका सप्तम स्थान देखेंगे यहीं से पत्नी है या पति है
says: To find out whether there is strife with your wife, you look at the 7th house; the spouse, wife or husband, is read from this box.
cells_derived_method: Spouse and marital friction are read from the 7th box; the sign in it shapes the spouse's nature, and the planets in it show how the relation plays out.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Venus's sign on the spouse box (lagna Aries) - a refined, partnership-oriented spouse; friction comes from indecision or appearances.
Derived, not said by him: Mars and Ketu's sign on the spouse box (lagna Taurus) - an intense, secretive spouse; friction through jealousy and control.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn's sign on the spouse box (lagna Cancer) - a duty-bound, cool or older-seeming spouse; friction through coldness and workload.

classical_check: Agrees: the 7th house is the kalatra bhava, the house of spouse and marriage.

hindi: कि गृहस्थ में तनाव और क्लेश रहता ही है अगर यहां ग्रह डिस्टर्ब है तो एक गारंटी है कि आपकी पत्नी या पति आप पर शक करेंगे शकी स्वभाव बना रहेगा
says: If a planet in the 7th box is disturbed, tension and strife stay in family life, and he calls it a guarantee that the wife or husband will suspect you and a suspicious nature will persist.
cells_derived_method: An afflicted planet in the 7th box brings its own flavour of distrust: Saturn through coldness and delay, Mars through anger, Rahu through illusion and obsession.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: debilitated Saturn in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra) - a cold, delayed marriage in which the spouse withholds trust.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Mars in Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) - an angry, heated partnership and suspicion that flares into arguments.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius) - obsessive suspicion built on rumour, messages and half-truths.

ambiguity: 'ग्रह डिस्टर्ब' is not defined (malefic, enemy-sign, debilitated or aspected); the 'guarantee' is his own strong wording for a tendency.
classical_check: Classical texts link an afflicted 7th house to marital discord, but none promises a guaranteed suspicious spouse; the guarantee is his addition.

hindi: इसकी करेक्शन करो इसकी करेक्शन होती है यहां की जो राशि हो जो ग्रह हो उस राशि के खाने पने की चीज अपनी झूठी खिला करो अपने पार्टनर को
says: Remedy for the spouse's suspicion: take the sign and planet in the 7th box and feed your partner, from your own leftover (jootha, half-eaten) share, a food or drink item belonging to that sign. A food-feeding remedy recorded as tradition only.
cells_derived_method: The item to share is chosen by the sign (and its ruling planet) in the 7th: Venus signs with sweets or dairy, Mars signs with red lentils or jaggery, Saturn signs with sesame or black gram, Jupiter signs with gram or turmeric. This mapping is the traditional food-planet table, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Venus's sign in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) - share a sweet or dairy item from your own plate with the partner.
Derived, not said by him: Mars's sign in the 7th (lagna Libra) - share a spicy or jaggery-based item from your own plate.
Derived, not said by him: Saturn's sign in the 7th (lagna Cancer) - share a sesame or black-gram item from your own plate.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter's sign in the 7th (lagna Virgo) - share a gram or turmeric item from your own plate.

ambiguity: 'राशि के खाने पीने की चीज' says the sign's items, not the planet's; the sign-to-food table is not given here. 'झूठी' is read as jootha (leftover from your own plate); 'यहां की जो राशि हो जो ग्रह हो' leaves open if a sign or a planet decides the item.
classical_check: Silent in BPHS; this kind of food-sharing upaya belongs to folk and Lal Kitab-style tradition.

gist: Mock alarm: 'Oh God, what did I tell you, this will become vashikaran (controlling someone by magic)'.

hindi: वशीकरण नहीं होएगा वशीकरण होएगा यह फैक्ट है यह सत्य है यह सत्य में काम करता है
says: On the leftover-food remedy he insists it works as a fact: the caption says both 'it will not be vashikaran' and 'it will be vashikaran', and then that it is fact and truth and works in reality. In effect he claims the remedy gives a real hold on the partner's attitude. Control over another person is an ethically sensitive claim, recorded only, not endorsed.
ambiguity: He says both 'वशीकरण नहीं होगा' and 'वशीकरण होगा' in one breath; it may be a rhetorical reply to the audience ('will it not work as vashikaran? it will'), so the polarity is uncertain. The 7th-box link is carried from the previous remedy.
classical_check: Silent; vashikaran is a tantra practice, not part of the Parashari rules.

hindi: जब हम उपायों के ऊपर जाएंगे तो यह बातें काम करेंगी कि छोटा सा एक धागा डाल ले तेरे डिस्क के अंदर पंगा ठीक हो जाएगा
says: He says that when they reach the remedies section such methods will be covered, for example putting on a small thread so that the trouble in your disc is fixed. A thread remedy together with a spinal-health claim, recorded only, not a diagnosis or treatment.
ambiguity: Which thread colour, which body part and which planet it is tied to are not given; 'डिस्क' is read as a spinal disc and 'पंगा' as trouble.
classical_check: Silent in BPHS; thread (dhaga) remedies belong to folk practice.

hindi: और ये होता है बच्चे की जेब में यह रंग का पेन या कपड़ा लगाकर ले जाओ बच्चा पेपर पास कर लेगा
says: Another example of a remedy: put a pen or a cloth of this colour in the child's pocket and send the child to the exam, and the child will pass the paper. The colour is gestured or lost in the caption.
cells_derived_method: The colour would be picked by the planet to be strengthened for studies, usually from the 4th, 5th or 9th boxes. Mercury is green, Jupiter is yellow, the Sun is red or orange. Method, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mercury in its own sign in the 5th (lagna Taurus) - a green pen or cloth to back intellect and exams.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter's sign in the 4th (lagna Virgo) - a yellow pen or cloth to back learning and education.
Derived, not said by him: Mercury's sign in the 9th (lagna Libra) - a green item for higher study and examinations.

ambiguity: 'यह रंग' (this colour) is not audible in the caption; no planet or box is named. The mapping above is the traditional planet-colour table, not his.
classical_check: Silent in BPHS; colour-based remedies are folk and Lal Kitab-style practice.

gist: Says astrology is alive to this day because of the magic and miracle in it; without these the claims would not have survived.
Anecdote about a boy sitting behind whose father's loan was not getting sanctioned; after four days of remedies the loan came through.
Points at a bearded man in the front row and says miracles happen and nobody knows how.
Anecdote about another boy, called useless and unwilling to study, who passed somehow and now earns five figures; he does not know himself how he passed.

hindi: ये उपायों से काम होता है लेकिन
says: He states that these things do get done through remedies (upay), but adds a 'but' that sets up the condition given in the next line.
ambiguity: The sentence ends on 'लेकिन' and the condition is in the next line.
classical_check: Agrees in general: classical texts prescribe remedies (shanti, daan, japa), though outcomes are conditional.

hindi: उपाय करने वाला सरेंडर करे फॉलो करे करते जाएंगे हो जाएगा अपने आप स्वतः सिस्टम बनता है
says: The condition for remedies to work: the person doing the remedy must surrender, follow the instruction and keep doing it; then it happens by itself and the system builds automatically.
ambiguity: 'सरेंडर' (surrender) is not defined: faith, obedience to the astrologer or giving up ego; it also does not say how long to continue.
classical_check: Agrees broadly: classical upaya traditions require shraddha (faith) and regular practice (niyama), so surrender and persistence match.

gist: Many people are sitting there; he considers naming someone with a pointed finger but decides it would not be right.

hindi: ये आपके जीवन की स्थितियां है जो आपके शरीर के ऊपर जाती हैं
says: The situations of your life pass onto your body: life events, pressures and relationships get registered physically, and that is why the chart's boxes can be matched to body parts.
classical_check: Silent as stated; classical medical astrology links house topics to body parts, not life situations to bodily symptoms.

hindi: आपके शरीर का जो हिस्सा पेन तकलीफ दे रहा है वही आपको बताता है कि आपकी कुंडली के अंदर कौन से खाने में गड़बड़ है
says: Reverse reading: the body part that is giving you pain or trouble tells you which box of your kundli is disturbed. A site of complaint points to a house, and from that house to the life area in difficulty.
cells_derived_method: Take the painful body part, find its box from the body map, then read that box's life topics. Example mapping: right knee gives the 5th, left eye the 12th, shoulder the 3rd or 11th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a persistent right-knee complaint points to the 5th box (lagna Aries) - look at children, creativity and the Sun and Saturn there.
Derived, not said by him: a persistent left-eye complaint points to the 12th box (lagna Cancer) - look at losses, sleep, foreign matters and Mercury's condition.
Derived, not said by him: a persistent shoulder complaint points to the 3rd box (lagna Aquarius) - look at effort, siblings, courage and Mars.

ambiguity: The body-part-to-box mapping used is his geometry from the earlier rows, and several of those assignments are inferred.
classical_check: Differs in method: classical medical astrology goes from chart to body part, not the reverse; the reverse use is his own practical technique.

hindi: कौन से खाने के गड़बड़ का महत्व क्या है क्योंकि ये जो खाना है इस ने के अंदर ही आपका धन है उसी में रिश्ते हैं प्रेम है शरीर है मृत्यु है जीवन है
says: The significance of a disturbed box: the boxes of the chart hold your wealth, your relationships, your love, your body, your death and your life. So a problem in one box is a problem in that area of life, and that is why it matters which box is disturbed.
cells_derived_method: Each life topic sits in a classical house: wealth in the 2nd, relationships and marriage in the 7th, love in the 5th, body in the 1st, death and longevity in the 8th. A disturbance in a box damages its topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a disturbed 2nd box (lagna Aries) points to wealth, family savings and speech.
Derived, not said by him: a disturbed 7th box (lagna Aries) points to marriage and partnerships.
Derived, not said by him: a disturbed 8th box (lagna Aries) points to longevity, sudden events and transformation.

ambiguity: 'ये जो खाना है' could mean each single box contains all of these topics or the twelve boxes together contain them; the second reading is more usual.
classical_check: Agrees: the houses of the chart cover wealth, marriage, children, body, longevity and so on, as in BPHS.

hindi: बच्चे हैं भविष्य है एंसेल प्रॉपर्टी है आगे का धन कमाने की स्थिति है नाम यश सब कुछ यही है
says: He continues the same list: children, the future, ancestral property, the capacity to earn money ahead, and name and fame, all of it is here in these boxes. In his words, everything of a life is contained in the chart.
cells_derived_method: Children are read from the 5th, ancestral property from the 4th, future earning from the 11th, and name and fame from the 10th. A problem in each box affects its topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: the 4th box (lagna Aries) carries ancestral property, home and mother.
Derived, not said by him: the 10th box (lagna Aries) carries name, fame and profession.
Derived, not said by him: the 11th box (lagna Aries) carries future earnings and gains.

ambiguity: 'एंसेल प्रॉपर्टी' is garbled and is read as 'ancestral property'; the topics are listed without house numbers.
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th is property, the 5th children, the 10th name and profession, the 11th gains.

hindi: हम या तो ऐसे ही कुंडली लेकर पैदा हु यूंही मर जाए तो वो तो प्रारब्ध हो गया अनकॉन्शियस माइंड है
says: If we are simply born with the chart and die just as it was written, without ever becoming aware, that is prarabdha (destiny) and the unconscious mind at work. The chart is fate only for the person who stays unaware.
ambiguity: The caption breaks at 'पैदा हु', read as 'पैदा हुए'; the unconscious mind is his own addition to the idea of prarabdha.
classical_check: Agrees with prarabdha karma as fixed destiny; the unconscious/conscious framing is modern and not in classical texts.

gist: Garbled: '12 पर में जिए मर गए कैसे जिए जी लिए यार'; seems to say that unaware people simply live and die inside the chart and that life does not turn out good by itself.

hindi: दिमाग इतना चुस्त है वो अपने आप को मोल्ड करना सीख लेता है
says: The brain is so sharp that it learns to mould itself around the situation: with awareness a person can adapt to what the chart gives and soften its effect.
ambiguity: Follows a garbled passage, so the exact contrast he draws with the unaware person is unclear.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with the purushartha idea that effort can modify results.

gist: Starts an illustration: if I get a toothache here, then my mouth and tongue adapt a lot; the sentence continues in the next batch.
Finishes the toothache illustration: the mouth cleverly saved the sore tooth and learned to chew with the rest, so he hardly needs a doctor; it is only an example.

hindi: हालांकि इधर का मेरा कौन सा हुआ नॉर्थ वेस्ट का एरिया होता है ओ माय गॉड कुछ डिस्टर्ब है घर में देखेंगे ये उसकी वजह से होता है
says: Vastu link: the mouth and teeth area he was just discussing corresponds to the north-west part of the home; if something is disturbed in the north-west of the house, that is said to be the cause of such a complaint. Health-related vastu claim, recorded only.
ambiguity: He asks which box the mouth is and answers north-west by direction, not by house number; the chart box for the mouth is not named.
classical_check: Vastu Shastra places the north-west under Vayu; no classical Jyotish text ties teeth to it, so this is silent or his own link.

hindi: यह सारा का सारा जो हिसाब किताब है हमारा यह तीन तावड़ा सारा बता देता है कि आपके जीवन में क्या दुख है
says: The whole accounting of the chart (the garbled phrase 'तीन तावड़ा' seems to mean this three-part or whole system) tells you everything that is the suffering in your life.
ambiguity: 'तीन तावड़ा' is garbled and cannot be translated; read as 'the whole system'.
classical_check: Agrees broadly: the chart is used to find areas of difficulty.

hindi: अगर आपके जीवन में एक ही लफड़ा है कि मुझे तो बच्चे से प्रॉब्लम है कुंडली के एक ही खाने को पांचवा घर है इसी को निहाल करके सीख लो आपके जीवन के अंदर वहीं से आप जान जाओगे मुझे
says: If your life has only one trouble, for example a problem with your child, study just that one box of the kundli, the 5th house, closely; from that box you will learn what you must do. The chart can be used one box at a time.
cells_derived_method: Pick the box of the troubled topic and read only its sign, planets and aspects.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: child trouble with Scorpio in the 5th is read through Mars and Ketu in that box.
Derived, not said by him: child trouble with Gemini in the 5th is read through Mercury in that box.

classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is the house of children.

hindi: अपने अपने स्पेसिफिक पोर्शन को प्रेम में तड़पे हुए परेशान है आप आपको स्वयं ही जान लेना है यह पांचवा और सातवा घर है
says: Each person must study his own specific portion; if you are tormented and troubled in love, you must work out yourself that these are the 5th and 7th houses.
cells_derived_method: Love troubles are read from the 5th (romance) and 7th (committed relation) boxes together.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Aries in the 7th gives a hasty, argumentative bond, read through Mars.
Derived, not said by him: Libra in the 5th gives a romantic, partnership-seeking love life, read through Venus.

ambiguity: The caption order is rough; 'पांचवा और सातवा' is taken as the love and partner houses.
classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is romance and the 7th is partnership.

hindi: आपके जीवन में नाम नहीं हो रहा पद नहीं उठ रहा नौवा दसवा घर समझ लो
says: If your name is not being made and your position is not rising, take the 9th and 10th houses as the boxes to study.
cells_derived_method: Reputation and rank are read from the 10th (action) with the 9th (fortune) supporting it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Taurus in the 10th gives slow, steady recognition through Venus-type work.
Derived, not said by him: Leo in the 9th brings luck through status and authority figures.

classical_check: Agrees: 10th is career and fame, 9th is fortune.

hindi: इसको सेट आपको इतना अपने आप को बदलने लायक क्रांतिकारी होना पड़ेगा मेहनत करनी पड़ेगी
says: To set these things right you must be revolutionary enough to change yourself and must put in hard work; knowing the box is not enough.
classical_check: Silent; matches the general purushartha idea.

gist: Says it takes 20 years for a child to become a graduate, who may still have built nothing; the sentence 'तो आप इन चीजों' runs into the next line.

hindi: के प्रति यदि जागरूक होते हैं तो आपकी जागरूकता आने वाली पीढ़ी वह छोटे-छोटे बच्चे जो सिर्फ कॉपी कैट्स होते हैं जो मां बाप को देखकर कॉपी करते हैं
says: If you become aware of these things, your awareness passes to the coming generation: small children are copycats who copy their parents, so a parent's awareness is picked up by the child.
ambiguity: The first words continue a sentence from the previous line ('तो आप इन चीजों के प्रति').
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वही कॉपी कैट हो करके कहेंगे यार कुछ है और वह इतनी ज्यादा जल्दी पकड़ेंगे क्योंकि उनका ब्रेन खाली है कुछ पकड़ा नहीं है तो हमारे आने वाली पीढ़ियां बहुत तेजी से उठेंगी
says: The children will copy and say 'there is something in this' and will grasp it very fast because their brains are empty and have not yet fixed on anything, so the coming generations will rise very quickly.
classical_check: Silent; a social claim, not a rule.

gist: Says this subject should be in the study curriculum, with a small syllabus so that students are amazed and ask how such miracles happen.

hindi: यह बड़े-बड़े चमत्कार बैठते हैं यह हमारा चेहरा आंख इत्यादि इत्यादि यह शरीर का हमारा हिस्सा हो गया
says: Recap of the body part of the chart: the box of the face, the eyes and so on is the portion of our body; the chart's first boxes are the physical body.
ambiguity: No box numbers are spoken; face and eyes are taken as the 1st, 2nd and 12th boxes from the earlier mapping.
classical_check: Agrees: head, face and eyes belong to the 1st, 2nd and 12th.

gist: Says they will build plenty more accounting from the boxes of this same kundli; the list of box meanings follows.

hindi: हमारा यहां पर मैं हूं यह मेरा धन है कोष बैंक बैलेंस
says: The first box is 'I', the self; the next box is my wealth, the treasury, the bank balance. So the 1st is the self and the 2nd is money.
cells_derived_method: Self matters read from the 1st box, savings from the 2nd box.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Taurus in the 2nd gives a strong savings habit under Venus.
Derived, not said by him: Sagittarius in the 2nd gives wealth through teaching or advice under Jupiter.

ambiguity: Numbers not spoken; order from the pointing.
classical_check: Agrees: 1st self, 2nd wealth.

hindi: यह मेरा ते है रिलेशंस रिश्ते ये मेरे भाई हैं भाई बहन
says: The next box (the garbled 'ते' is probably the third) is relations and bonds, my brothers and sisters.
cells_derived_method: Sibling matters read from the 3rd box.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Aries in the 3rd gives bold, competitive siblings.
Derived, not said by him: Pisces in the 3rd gives gentle, dreamy siblings.

ambiguity: 'ते' is garbled; 3rd assumed from siblings.
classical_check: Agrees: the 3rd is siblings.

hindi: मां बच्चे शत्रु स्पाउस पति या पत्नी मृत्यु हे हे
says: Continuing round the boxes: mother, children, enemies, spouse (husband or wife), death. These are the 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th and 8th houses in order.
cells_derived_method: Each topic is read from its box in order.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Virgo in the 6th gives enemies and diseases of a nervous, analytic kind.
Derived, not said by him: Pisces in the 8th gives hidden, spiritual-leaning transformation.

ambiguity: Numbers not spoken; order inferred.
classical_check: Agrees: 4th mother, 5th children, 6th enemies, 7th spouse, 8th death.

hindi: एक बार हे ससुराल एम राल टपकती रहती है ना मौत आती है य से
says: The 8th box holds the in-laws and death; in a half-joking, garbled line he says the mouth keeps drooling at the thought of death coming from here.
cells_derived_method: In-laws and death matters read from the 8th box.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Scorpio in the 8th (its own natural place) gives deep, hidden matters and intense in-law ties.
Derived, not said by him: Gemini in the 8th gives changeable, talk-driven in-law dealings.

ambiguity: Caption garbled (एम राल = probably लार); house number not spoken.
classical_check: Agrees: 8th is death and in-laws.

hindi: यह पिता कार्य लाभ व्यय एक्सपेंसेस
says: The following boxes: father, work, gains, and expenses, meaning the 9th, 10th, 11th and 12th houses.
cells_derived_method: Each topic is read from its own box.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Libra in the 11th gives gains through partners and social circles.
Derived, not said by him: Cancer in the 12th gives spending on home and family.

ambiguity: Numbers not spoken; order inferred.
classical_check: Agrees on 10th work, 11th gains, 12th expense; father in 9th follows the northern convention, not the 4th.

hindi: इसी में हमारा गला है बीमारी है चाकर है वर्कर्स
says: In this same box he places the throat, illness, and servants or workers; this fits the 6th for illness and servants, while the throat is classically the 2nd.
cells_derived_method: Illness and staff read from the 6th box.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Capricorn in the 6th gives chronic, stiff illness and hard-working staff.
Derived, not said by him: Cancer in the 6th gives digestive-emotional ailments and caring workers.

ambiguity: Which box 'इसी' refers to is not clear; throat is out of place for the 6th.
classical_check: 6th is disease and servants in the classics; throat belongs to the 2nd.

hindi: यह मेरा पराक्रम है कितना पराक्रमी है कितना मेहनती है हम
says: This box is my valour: how courageous and how hardworking I am.
cells_derived_method: Courage and effort read from the 3rd box.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Scorpio in the 3rd gives fierce, persistent effort.
Derived, not said by him: Libra in the 3rd gives diplomatic effort that avoids open confrontation.

ambiguity: Box not named; 3rd taken from 'पराक्रम'.
classical_check: Agrees: the 3rd is parakrama bhava.

hindi: यह हमारी सेट है प्रॉपर्टी व्हीकल गाड़ी जमीन जायदाद
says: This is the box of property, vehicles, cars, land and holdings: the 4th house.
cells_derived_method: Property and vehicles read from the 4th box.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Taurus in the 4th gives comfortable homes and good vehicles.
Derived, not said by him: Aries in the 4th gives restless, fast-changing homes and sporty vehicles.

ambiguity: 'सेट' is garbled, maybe 'सीट'.
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th is property and vehicles.

hindi: मित्र इन्हेरिटेंस जमीन जायदाद पहले से क्या मिलेगी इन्हेरिटेंस
says: Friends, and inheritance: what land and property will come to me from before. Friends sit in the 11th and inheritance is classically the 8th.
cells_derived_method: Friends from the 11th; inherited property from the 8th or the 4th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Gemini in the 11th gives many light, talkative friends.
Derived, not said by him: Taurus in the 8th suggests inherited money or land.

ambiguity: Box for inheritance is not named; the two topics may be pointed at separate boxes.
classical_check: 11th friends agree; inheritance is classically the 8th.

hindi: यह बच्चे हैं यहां से मेरा प्रेम है प्रेम प्रेमिका इनट्यूशन
says: This box is children, my love and beloved, and intuition: the 5th house.
cells_derived_method: Children, romance and intuition read from the 5th box.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Cancer in the 5th gives emotional, intuitive romance.
Derived, not said by him: Capricorn in the 5th gives reserved love and late children.

classical_check: Agrees: 5th is children, romance, intellect.

hindi: पढ़ाई हायर स्टडी यह साधारण पढ़ाई है नॉर्मल यह मेरी पढ़ाई है हायर स्टडीज विदेश जाने का हिसाब किताब यहीं से
says: Study: ordinary schooling sits in one box and higher studies in another, and the account of going abroad comes from the higher-study box (9th).
cells_derived_method: Higher education and foreign travel from the 9th; ordinary schooling from the 4th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Sagittarius in the 9th gives higher education and long journeys.
Derived, not said by him: Virgo in the 9th gives technical or medical higher studies.

ambiguity: Which box is ordinary study is not stated (4th or 5th); 9th is assumed for higher study.
classical_check: Agrees: 9th higher study and foreign travel.

hindi: मेरे पि कृपा है पितर पितर मुझे क्या देंगे यहां से
says: The blessings of the forefathers (pitar) and what they will give me are read from this box, which is the 9th house of fortune and ancestors.
cells_derived_method: Ancestral grace read from the 9th box and the Sun.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Leo in the 9th suggests grace from authoritative ancestors.
Derived, not said by him: Capricorn in the 9th suggests grace delayed by duty.

ambiguity: The box number is not spoken; the garbled 'पि' is read as 'पितर'.
classical_check: Agrees: the 9th is father and ancestors.

hindi: मेरे कार्य का हिसाब किताब कि मैं कार्य करूंगा कैसा काम करूं जो काम होगा व यहां से होगा लेकिन
says: The account of my work, what kind of work I will do, is read from this box: the 10th. The sentence ends on 'but' and continues in the next line.
cells_derived_method: Work and career read from the 10th box.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Virgo in the 10th gives analytic, service-type work.
Derived, not said by him: Leo in the 10th gives authority and leadership roles.

ambiguity: Box not named; 'कार्य' is taken as the 10th.
classical_check: Agrees.

hindi: कार्य कैसा करू कैसे किस प्रकार का होगा
says: Completing the previous 'but': the 10th shows that work happens, and the kind and manner of that work are also read from the box's sign and planets; how much capacity you have for it is a separate matter coming next.
cells_derived_method: Type of work follows the sign and planets of the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Aquarius in the 10th points to technology or social-cause work.
Derived, not said by him: Cancer in the 10th points to care, food and public-facing work.

ambiguity: Fragmentary; the box is carried from the previous line.
classical_check: Agrees in method.

hindi: य शत्रु है यहां मेरे कोर्ट कचहरी है कोर्ट यहां सार सारे के सारे मेरे रोग हैं कष्ट कह लो यह कष्ट
says: This box holds enemies, court cases and litigation, and all my diseases or sufferings: the 6th house.
cells_derived_method: Enemies, courts and disease from the 6th box.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Aries in the 6th gives fiery enemies and inflammatory ailments.
Derived, not said by him: Pisces in the 6th gives hidden enemies and foot or immunity troubles.

ambiguity: Number not spoken.
classical_check: Agrees: 6th is enemies, litigation and disease.

hindi: यह पति पत्नी यह मेरे सेक्स ऑर्गन यह संतान की कैपेबिलिटी यहां से भी ये बच्चे हैं ये स्पर्म और एग की क्वालिटी है
says: The 7th box holds husband or wife, my sex organs, and the capability to have children, including sperm and egg quality. Fertility is a reproductive-health claim, recorded only.
cells_derived_method: Reproductive capacity and spouse from the 7th, with the 5th for the child.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Scorpio in the 7th (Mars and Ketu) stresses strong drive and reproductive-organ sensitivity.
Derived, not said by him: Taurus in the 7th gives a sensual bond under Venus.

ambiguity: Number not spoken; matches the earlier private-part box.
classical_check: 7th for spouse and genitals agrees; sperm and egg quality is not classical.

hindi: कैसी संतान होगी साइंटिस्ट पैदा होगा राक्षस पैदा होगा लेकिन ये संतान पैदा करने की क्षमता है कि नहीं है यह हमारी सेक्सुअल लाइफ है
says: What kind of child you get, a scientist or a demon, is read from the 5th, whereas the capacity to produce a child and the sexual life are the 7th. Two separate questions: quality from one box, capacity from the other.
cells_derived_method: Child quality from the 5th, capacity and sexual life from the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Aquarius in the 5th suggests an inventive, unconventional child.
Derived, not said by him: Cancer in the 7th gives an emotional, nurturing marital sex life.

ambiguity: Which box is 'here' is not spoken; the split is inferred.
classical_check: Silent on capacity as a 7th matter.

hindi: यहां से हमारा बिजनेस है कैसा बिजनेस करेंगे वो यहां से है लेकिन बिजनेस कैपेबिलिटी है बिजनेस या जॉब अगर ये न खाना खराब हो हम बिजनेस नहीं कर सकते
says: What business you will do is read from the 10th; but the capability for business as against a job is read from the 7th, and if that box is spoiled you cannot do business.
cells_derived_method: Choice of business from the 10th; ability to run it from the 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Aries in the 7th gives bold but quarrelsome business dealing.
Derived, not said by him: Virgo in the 7th gives careful, service-oriented dealing.

ambiguity: The 10th and 7th are inferred from 'यहां से' and later 'यहां हमारा बिजनेस है'.
classical_check: 7th for business partnerships agrees; 10th for profession agrees.

hindi: यहां हमारा बिजनेस है यहां हमारी पार्टनर है लाइफ की पार्टनर होती है पत्नी यहां से पार्टनरशिप है
says: The 7th box is where business dealings, the partner, the wife as life partner, and business partnership are read.
cells_derived_method: Partners of both kinds read from the 7th box.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Gemini in the 7th gives talkative, youthful partners.
Derived, not said by him: Capricorn in the 7th gives serious, older partners.

classical_check: Agrees.

gist: Fragment: 'such accounting happens, the partner became' - the thought continues in the next line.

hindi: पार्टनरशिप का खाना खराब है उससे प्रेम नहीं होगा चलेगा नहीं हिसाब सेक्स होगा प्रेम नहीं होगा रोमांस होता है यहां प्रेम रोमांस वाला है रोमांस नहीं होगा यह चीजों का ही मामला सारा खराब है
says: If the partnership box (7th) is spoiled, love will not happen with the partner; there may be sex but no love and no romance, and all these matters go bad.
cells_derived_method: An afflicted 7th box damages the emotional side of a partnership; the affliction type decides if physical, emotional or both are lost.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 7th gives a cold bond, duty without warmth.
Derived, not said by him: Rahu in Scorpio in the 7th gives a physical, obsessive pull without lasting tenderness.

ambiguity: 'खराब' (spoiled) is not defined; the claim of sex without love is general.
classical_check: Afflicted 7th causing marital problems agrees; the sex-without-romance split is his.

hindi: यह है मृत्यु ससुराल यह ल्ट है हम जो आज बात कर रहे हैं कल्ट साइंस सारा यहां से है परा विज्ञान कल्ट
says: The 8th box is death, in-laws, and the occult: the cult (occult) sciences and para-vigyan that he is speaking about today are all read from here.
cells_derived_method: Occult and hidden knowledge from the 8th box.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Scorpio in the 8th gives a deep pull to tantra and research.
Derived, not said by him: Aquarius in the 8th gives interest in unconventional or scientific occult.

ambiguity: 'कल्ट' is the occult in his usage, not a sect.
classical_check: Agrees: the 8th is occult and hidden matters.

hindi: यहां से ही आप रेकी करते हैं यहीं से आप यह है जितना कि परा विज्ञान ल्ट की पढ़ाया करने में लग
says: Reiki and the other occult studies are practised from this 8th-box area; the sentence is garbled at the end.
cells_derived_method: Energy-healing and occult practice link to the 8th and its planets.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Pisces in the 8th favours subtle healing practices like Reiki.
Derived, not said by him: Virgo in the 8th favours systematic, method-based occult study.

ambiguity: Caption broken at the end.
classical_check: Reiki is not classical; silent.

gist: Says astrologers are busy in the dramas of predictions but should study the occult sciences, and that their benefit also comes from the 8th box.

hindi: मृत्यु आप मजे की बात देखें जैसे ही हम कल्ट यानी कि ज्ञान की ओर जाते हैं मृत्यु दूर भाग जाती है
says: Interesting point: as soon as we turn towards the occult, meaning knowledge, death runs away; going into the 8th-box knowledge pushes death far. Claim recorded, not a longevity prediction.
ambiguity: 'Death runs away' may be symbolic (fear or loss of life areas) rather than literal long life.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हमारे अंतरिक्ष में प्लूटो बैठा सबसे नीचे यमराज आपने देखा होगा यमराज य बड़ी इंटरेस्टिंग चीज है अब देखेंगे प्लूटो बैठ है यमराज
says: In our space Pluto sits at the very bottom and is Yamraj, lord of death; this is an interesting thing to look at next.
ambiguity: 'Bottom' means farthest in the sky.
classical_check: Pluto as Yama is his scheme; classical Jyotish has no Pluto.

hindi: यमराज से ठीक अग नेप्चून है बहुत बड़ा प्लेनेट है नेप्चून वरुण अगर आपके ऊपर कृपा है ना तो मृत्यु कुछ नहीं कर सकती ऐसे लोग मृत्यु को भी हरा देते हैं
says: Just before Yamraj comes Neptune, a very big planet, Varuna; if Neptune's grace is on you, death can do nothing, and such people even defeat death. Claim recorded, not a longevity prediction.
ambiguity: 'अग' is garbled, read as 'आगे'; 'grace' of Neptune is not defined by sign or house.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts have no Neptune.

gist: Story of sage Markandeya, a devotee of Shiva and one of the immortals, whom Yamraj came to take but could not.
Repeats that Pluto is Yamraj with Neptune just before it, and that with Neptune's grace death will not come.

hindi: यहां आप धरती पर है ये र अर्थ यहां पे मौत आती है या मौत के पास हम जाते हैं तो हमारे जीवन में प्रेम मर गया पैसा मर गया प्यार मर गया झंझट मर गया
says: On earth, death comes to us or we go near death, and then areas of life die: love dies, money dies, affection dies, even troubles die. Death in the chart is felt as the dying of life areas.
cells_derived_method: The area killed depends on the box where the death planet or 8th influence falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: death influence on the 2nd (Scorpio) points to money drying up.
Derived, not said by him: death influence on the 7th (Aries) points to love or partnership dying.

ambiguity: Garbled start ('ये र अर्थ'); may be symbolic, not about physical death.
classical_check: Silent as stated.

hindi: यह मर गया वो मर गया मरता है ना दोस्ती मर गई हमें लगता मकान मर गया काम क्यों नहीं हो रहे क्योंकि बीच रास्ते में हमने एक तो गुरु को नहीं देखा हमने गुरु को नमस्कार नहीं किया गुरु
says: Friendship died, the house died: why are things not working? Because on the way we did not see or bow to the guru and took no guru's grace; if we take it, the work gets done. A guru-grace remedy, recorded as tradition.
ambiguity: Guru here may be a teacher, not the planet.
classical_check: Guru worship is a classical remedy for Jupiter.

hindi: बृहस्पति की बृहस्पति के रूप में गुरु है एक यानी कोई गाइड करने वाला जो बताए गुरु क्या करता है वो कृपा लेता है कहां से कृपा लेता है वो यहां से कृपा लेता है

hindi: यानी आपकी कुंडली के अंदर आपका सफाई कर्मचारी जो साफ करने वा मृत्यु साफ करती

hindi: किसी की भी सुन रहे हैं तो क्लासेस सुन र ओशों की सुन रहे हैं किसी और की सुन रहे हैं आप ना ल्ट को टच कर रहे हैं आपके ना काम बनने लगेंगे

hindi: विज्ञान तेल लेने गया भाड़ में आप देखोगे आपका लाइफ का लेवल बढ़ रहा है आप फ्लैट से उठके बड़े मकान में आ गए अपने आप ही आपकी चीजें बन गई आपकी प्रमोशन हो गई
says: Never mind the science: you will see your life level rise, you move from a flat to a bigger house, things get made by themselves and you get promoted. These are the claimed results of staying with this knowledge. Outcome claim recorded only.

hindi: आप घूम फिर रहे होश पता नहीं कहां से हो रहा है पल्ले कुछ नहीं पड़ रहा है अगर पल्ले पड़ गया तो तो कृपा मिलनी शुरू हो गई आपको खुद कृपा बनानी आ जाएगी

hindi: आप अपने अंदर गुरु ऑन कर लोगे बाहर का गुरु घंटाल की जरूरत नहीं
says: You will switch on the guru inside you, so an outside guru is not needed. This conflicts with his earlier advice to make some guru, so inner guru is the end goal and an outer one the path.

hindi: आपके जीवन में मृत्यु रुकी रहेगी
says: In your life death will be kept halted for those who go into the occult and vastu; a protection claim, recorded only and not a longevity prediction.

hindi: काल के देवता है टाइम और मृत्यु के बियोंड है शिव यानी मृत्यु का भी संघार कर सकता है शिव

hindi: यह शिव कृपा करते यानी कि बड़ी भयंकर शिव की कृपा मिलती है शिव है चंद्रमा यानी मुन्ना ही

hindi: कृपा कर देता है मुन्ना ही चंद्रमा मुन्ना ही शनि के स्थान पर रहता है इसलिए मुन्ना ही शनि भी है तो मुन्ना ही कृपा कर रहा है

hindi: यानी शिव पले रुष्ट पले तुष्ट अभी के अभी आपका सारा ताकत छीन लेंगे अभी के अभी आपको अपने से ज्यादा ताकत दे देंगे
says: Shiva is displeased in a moment and pleased in a moment: he can snatch all your strength right now or give you more strength than you have right now.
ambiguity: 'पले' stands for 'पल में'.
classical_check: Agrees with Shiva as Ashutosh, quickly pleased.

hindi: यह मुन्ना है यह चंद्रमा यह आपका पूर्ण रूप से बचाव करता है
says: This 'Munna', the Moon, fully protects you.
classical_check: Silent as a protective claim.

hindi: जब जब जीवन में मन डूब रहा है मन क्या है चंद्रमा डूब रहा है मींस मृत्यु म स्थान में य मृत्यु स्थान डूबने का स्थान है
says: Whenever the mind sinks in life, meaning the Moon is sinking, it means the Moon is in the death box (8th); the death box is the place of sinking.
cells_derived_method: Moon in the 8th shows a sinking mind; the sign changes how: debilitated Scorpio worst, exalted Taurus softer.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: debilitated Moon in Scorpio in the 8th - deepest low moods.
Derived, not said by him: exalted Moon in Taurus in the 8th - sinking is cushioned by emotional steadiness.

ambiguity: 'मींस' is 'means'; Moon in the 8th is assumed.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon in the 8th is a classical sign of mental unrest.

hindi: आप उसी टाइम कोई भी कल्ट की कोई चीज सुन लो किताब पढ़ लो लिख लो कर लो हाथ में कल्ट की किताब जेब में हनुमान चालीसा कुछ भी कल्ट है सब यह डाल के घूमो
says: At that time, listen to something occult, read a book, write, and carry an occult book in hand and a Hanuman Chalisa in your pocket; anything occult will do.
ambiguity: 'कल्ट' stands for occult or spiritual texts.
classical_check: Reading or carrying scripture is a common remedy.

hindi: आपको अपने आप दिन सुधरने शुरू होंगे पता नहीं कैसे आपको खुद ही पले नहीं पड़ेगा
says: Your days will start improving by themselves without your knowing how, and you will not even understand it. Outcome claim of the remedy.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: गीता ग्र के साथ में जेब में चलो करना कुरना कुछ नहीं जरूरत नहीं है उसकी लेकिन आप उसके टच में हो ऑटोमेटिक
says: Walk with the Gita or a similar text in your pocket; you need not do anything else, because being in touch with it is enough automatically.
ambiguity: 'ग्र' is probably 'ग्रंथ'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अल्ट की कृपा से आपके मृत्यु की मृत्यु हो जाएगी यानी भी आपका कुछ नहीं बिगाड़ सकता
says: By the grace of the occult, the death of your death happens: Yamraj also cannot harm you. A protection claim, recorded only.
ambiguity: 'यानी भी' is probably 'यमराज भी'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसके आगे ठीक इमीडिएट आगे इसके आगे भाग्य यह आपके पिता है और यही आपका भाग्य है
says: Right after the in-laws house comes the house of fortune (bhagya); he says this same house stands for your father and also for your luck, so father and fortune are read from one bhava.
cells_derived_method: The 9th house topics (father, luck) are coloured by the sign on the 9th and that sign's lord: a fire sign gives bold dharmic luck and an authority-type father, an air sign gives luck through contacts and a talkative father, a water sign gives emotional luck and a protective father.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 9th in Sagittarius (Jupiter's own sign) - father and luck are read through Jupiter's condition; a teacher-like father and luck through guidance and dharma when Jupiter is sound.
Derived: 9th in Gemini (Mercury-ruled) - luck comes through trade, writing and networks; father seen as talkative and business-minded, with a dual pattern in fortune.
Derived: 9th in Scorpio (Mars-ruled, Uranus in his scheme) - luck arrives after upheaval; an intense or secretive father; fortune through inheritance or research.

ambiguity: The caption does not say '9th' aloud; the house is inferred from the sequence (in-laws just before, then fortune) and from bhagya = father.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts give the 9th as bhagya and pitru (father) bhava, though some texts read father from the 10th, which he does not do here.

gist: Wordplay on 'sasural' and 'raal' (drool): jokes that talk about in-laws just makes you drool and tells the audience not to get caught in that loop.
Digression: the in-laws are simply one part of life, 'we got stuck on sasural so be it', and he moves on to the next point.

hindi: यह हो गए एक हिस्सा हमारे जीवन का यह हो गए जी छह खाने ठीक है 1 दोती च पा 6 अब यहां से हमारे चले 1 दोती च पा 6
says: He divides the chart into two blocks of six boxes; the count 1 to 6 is run once for the first block and restarted for the second block, so each half is a six-house part of life.
ambiguity: '1 दोती च पा 6' is garbled 'ek, do, teen, char, paanch, chhah' (1 to 6). Which six boxes 'yah' means is not clear: the self half (1-6) or the in-laws onward half (7-12).
classical_check: Classical texts do not name two sixes, but the 1-6 / 7-12 split matches the below-horizon and above-horizon halves of the chart, which many traditions use.

hindi: यह पति का है तो यह पत्नी का है यह पत्नी का है तो यह पति का है भाई आधे आधे हैं दोनों
says: One half of the chart belongs to the husband and the other half to the wife; whichever side you take as 'self', the other side becomes the spouse, so the two halves are shared 50-50 between the couple.
cells_derived_method: The reading flips with viewpoint: house h in one block mirrors house h+6 in the other block (2nd and 8th, 4th and 10th, and so on). Each house topic in the self block is read again in the spouse block with the sign on that house shaping the style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the 2nd in Taurus is the husband's own money and family in his block; its mirror in the other block, the 8th, then carries the wife's family and resources.
Derived: the 8th in Scorpio is the mirror of the 2nd, so it holds the wife's family and what comes with her, coloured by Scorpio's intense, secretive nature.

ambiguity: Which half is 'pati' and which is 'patni' depends on whose chart is read, and he flips it; he does not number the houses.
classical_check: Fits the classical use of the 7th as spouse and house-from-house reading (the 2nd from the 7th is the 8th); the 'each half belongs to a partner' framing is his own.

hindi: एक यन है एक यंग है एक प्लस है एक माइनस है प्रोटॉन है एक इलेक्ट्रॉन है एक इलेक्ट्रॉन है एक पॉजिटन है
says: He backs the husband-wife halves with polarity pairs, yin and yang, plus and minus, proton and electron, electron and positron, saying the two halves are opposite charges that complete each other.
ambiguity: 'यन/यंग' is yin/yang and 'पॉजिटन' is positron; the physics pairs are metaphors, not anything the software can compute.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish speaks of Shiva-Shakti and purusha-prakriti, not particle physics.

gist: Tells viewers who have watched his earlier classes that they will catch this quickly.

hindi: अब ये हमारा ठेका ही नहीं है यानी हमें अपनी पत्नी भी हमारी इतनी औकात नहीं कि हम कर सके पत्नी भी
says: He says the partner is not in our own control: we do not have the standing to produce even our own wife by ourselves, so partner matters belong to the other half of the chart, outside self-effort.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 7th shows how the partner arrives and how little the native controls it: movable signs bring a partner through quick events, fixed signs through long-standing family ties, dual signs through changes of plan.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 7th in Libra (Venus-ruled) - partner comes through social or negotiated channels; a refined, balanced spouse.
Derived: 7th in Capricorn (Saturn-ruled) - partner arrives late and through duty or family arrangement, with the native having little say in the timing.

ambiguity: The sentence is rhetorical and partly garbled ('कर सके पत्नी भी'); the 7th is inferred from 'patni'.
classical_check: Agrees only loosely: the classical 7th is the spouse, but the claim that we have no control over getting a wife is his own wording.

hindi: हमें ससुराल से मिलती है इसलिए ससुराल सबसे टॉप पर है
says: Since the wife comes to us from her parents' home, the in-laws house is ranked as the topmost, most important place in this half of the chart.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 8th colours the in-law family: a water sign gives emotional, home-bound in-laws, an air sign gives unconventional or talkative in-laws, an earth sign gives practical, property-minded in-laws.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 8th in Cancer (Moon-ruled) - in-laws are emotional, family-centred and attached to their home; bonding goes through feeling.
Derived: 8th in Aquarius - in-laws are unconventional or detached, with a large circle; the bond is intellectual rather than warm.

ambiguity: The house number is not spoken; 8th is taken from the sequence (in-laws, then death in the next sentence). 'Top' most likely means most important, not the top of the diagram.
classical_check: Differs in emphasis: classically the 8th is the spouse's family and wealth (2nd from the 7th) but is not called the most important house.

hindi: ससुराल कहां है मृत्यु यमराज आप किससे करते हो भगवान से क्या करते हो डरते रहते हो
says: He puts the in-laws house at the place of death and Yamraj, and adds that people keep living in fear of God and of death, so this house carries a fear element.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 8th shapes what the fear and endings look like: fire signs give sudden shocks, earth signs fear of loss of security, water signs fear tied to emotional bonds.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 8th in Taurus (Venus-ruled) - fear centres on losing comfort, possessions and security.
Derived: 8th in Sagittarius (Jupiter-ruled) - fear is tied to belief, with endings handled through faith or guidance.

ambiguity: 'आप किससे करते हो भगवान से' is a garbled phrase, probably 'whom do you fear - God'. 'Yamraj' may be only the death deity, not necessarily the planet Pluto of his 12-planet scheme.
classical_check: Agrees that the 8th is the house of death and longevity; calling it the in-laws is derived (2nd from the 7th).

hindi: जिंदगी यहीं से शुरू होती है ससुराल से ही भाई ससुराल से पत्नी आई फिर पैदा बच्चे हुए फिर हम भी ऐसे ही पैदा हुए
says: Life itself starts from the in-laws side: the wife comes from there, children are born, and we ourselves were born the same way from our own parents' union, so this house is treated as the start of lineage.
ambiguity: The pointer 'yahin' is unnamed; it follows the in-laws discussion, so the 8th is assumed.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give lineage through the 5th (children) and 7th, not the 8th.

hindi: तभी तो हुआ तो पत्नी के दमप तो हुए तो स्त्री ही तो महान हुई तो स्त्री का स्थान तो यही हुआ ना इसलिए जब तक उसकी कृपा कृपा फपा सारे ड्रामे इसी के पास है

ambiguity: 'स्त्री का स्थान' suggests the 7th but the flow is still on the in-laws (8th); 'कृपा फपा' is garbled and 'this' is not numbered.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not make the wife-side houses the holder of all life events.

hindi: देखो यह हमारे सेक्स की संतुष्टि होती है यह संतुष्टि का खाना है संतुष्टि यह हमारे मोक्ष का द्वार है यह बैड कंफर्ट्स है सेक्सुअल लाइफ
says: He names one box as the place of sexual satisfaction, the gate to our moksha and the bed-comforts (sexual life) house, the box of fulfilment.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 12th shapes how fulfilment and release show up: Venus-ruled signs give sensual comfort, Jupiter-ruled water signs give spiritual release, earth-sign Mercury gives an anxious, analytical bed life.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 12th in Pisces (Jupiter's own sign) - strong pull to moksha, deep sleep and imaginative bed comfort.
Derived: 12th in Taurus (Venus-ruled) - strongly sensual comforts and spending on luxuries in private life.
Derived: 12th in Virgo (Mercury-ruled) - private life is analytical and over-thinking, so ease is harder to reach.

ambiguity: No number is spoken here; later (44:06) he says 'bed comforts is this 12th', so the 12th is used. The 8th also carries sex and moksha in classical texts, so it could be the 8th.
classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is shayya-sukha (bed pleasures) and moksha; the 8th is the other moksha-trikona house.

hindi: जिसका यह खराब है सेक्स तो होगा बैड कंफर्ट्स नहीं होंगे यानी साइंटिस्ट पैदा होगा कि नालायक बेबी पैदा होगा
says: If this house is spoiled, intercourse still happens but bed comfort and fulfilment are missing, and he adds that the child of such a union comes out at an extreme, either a scientist type or a useless baby.
cells_derived_method: How the spoiling shows depends on the sign on the afflicted 12th: fire signs give friction and haste, cold earth signs give duty without pleasure, water signs give emotional distance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: afflicted 12th in Scorpio - an intense but conflict-ridden bed life with secrecy and mistrust.
Derived: afflicted 12th in Capricorn (Saturn-ruled) - intimacy turns into duty, cold and joyless.

ambiguity: It is unclear whether the 'scientist or useless baby' line is a joke or a real claim, and the 12th is assumed from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts tie children to the 5th, so a claim about the child's quality from the 12th is not found.

hindi: ये ये सारा पत्नी के पास है हमारे पास इसी के पास खर्चा है सारा धन सारा खर्चा एक्सपेंसेस
says: He says all this (satisfaction, moksha, bed comforts) sits with the wife's side, and that this same house holds all spending, with money going out and every kind of expense.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 12th shows the style of outflow: air signs give many scattered small outlays, fire signs give spending on show and prestige, Saturn-ruled signs give planned, heavy duty spending.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 12th in Gemini (Mercury-ruled) - many small outlays on travel, phones and communication.
Derived: 12th in Leo (Sun's own sign) - spending on display, status, children and entertainment.
Derived: 12th in Capricorn (Saturn-ruled) - planned, heavy spending on duties and obligations.

ambiguity: Gender claim 'wife has all the money' is rhetorical; the house is inferred from 'expenses'.
classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is vyaya bhava, the house of expenses and losses.

hindi: बीमारी रोग हॉस्पिटल एक्सपेंस बीमारी खर्चा यह पत्नी के पास है
says: Illness, hospital expenses and money lost on sickness are also placed in this same wife-side house, so medical outlay is read here and not only from the 6th.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 12th shows the pattern of the outlay: Mars-ruled signs give sudden, procedure-type spending, Saturn/Pluto-ruled signs give long, drawn-out spending and institutional stays.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 12th in Aries (Mars-ruled) - sudden, short, urgent medical spending.
Derived: 12th in Aquarius - slow, long-drawn spending and time spent in institutions.

ambiguity: He does not say '12th' here; he does not mention the 6th, where classical texts keep disease itself.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 12th is hospitalisation and confinement, while disease itself is the 6th house.

hindi: हमारी काल पुरुष की कुंडली काहे जो पुरुष और प्रकृति की बात तो प्रकृति इधर है
says: He calls the Kaal Purush kundali a purusha-prakriti chart: purusha (the male principle) is the self side and prakriti (the female principle) sits in the other, spouse-side half.
ambiguity: 'काहे जो' is garbled; 'इधर' points to a diagram half, presumably houses 7 to 12.
classical_check: Kaal Purush as the natural zodiac is classical; splitting it into purusha and prakriti halves is his own framing from Sankhya vocabulary.

hindi: सारी काम भी देखो उसके पास है पत्नी के आने के बाद ही काम होते क बार सेट उससे पहले तो भूखा नंगा भिखारी होता उसके आने के बाद ही भाग्य उठता है
says: Work and career are also controlled from the wife-side half: a man's work gets set up only after the wife arrives, before that he is a hungry pauper, and his fortune rises only after her arrival.
cells_derived_method: How the rise happens follows the signs on the 9th and 10th: fire signs bring a sudden jump after marriage, earth signs a slow steady build, air signs a rise through new contacts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 10th in Taurus (Venus-ruled) - career builds slowly and steadily once the spouse's support and stability arrive.
Derived: 9th in Aquarius - fortune rises through the spouse's network and groups, in a sudden, unexpected way.

ambiguity: House numbers are not spoken ('kaam' = 10th, 'bhagya' = 9th); 'क बार सेट' is garbled and may mean 'business set'.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not link career and fortune to marriage timing in this way, though the 7th is said to support the 10th.

gist: Shah Rukh Khan example: his luck was already very good but got triggered only after his wife came into his life.

hindi: ऐसे स्त्रियों का भी होता है बिल्कुल खाली जिंदगी पति के आने के बाद ट्रिगर हुआ है ऐसा भी होता है
says: The same holds for women: a life that was blank can get triggered once the husband enters it, so the spouse works as a trigger in both directions.
cells_derived_method: The kind of trigger the husband brings in a woman's chart depends on the sign on her 7th: fire signs bring status and drive, water signs bring emotional shelter, air signs bring social opening.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 7th in Leo (Sun's own sign) - husband brings status and visibility that start her career or life direction.
Derived: 7th in Pisces (Jupiter's own sign) - husband brings shelter and a spiritual or caring setting that opens her life.

ambiguity: 'Trigger' is used loosely, with no named house or planet.
classical_check: Agrees loosely: the husband's coming is a known turning point for women in marriage-linked results, but classical texts give no such rule.

hindi: लेकिन भाग्य का हिसाब किताब साथी से मिलता है इसलिए साथी बहुत आवश्यक है
says: He concludes that the ledger of one's fortune is settled through the partner, which is why having a partner is very necessary.
ambiguity: 'Saathi' could mean spouse or any life partner; no house numbers spoken.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts link the 9th and 7th through the 3rd-from-the-7th, but do not say fortune is settled via the partner.

hindi: क्या विवाह आवश्यक है जीवन में धले के बहुत बड़ा पंगा बहुत बड़ा प्रिजन है बहुत बड़ा लफड़ा लेकिन हां चाहिए क्योंकि इसे उठाएगा कौन कार्य कैसे करोगे कार्य में संबल कैसे लाओगे
says: Is marriage necessary? He calls it a hassle and a prison but says yes, it is needed, because without a partner nobody lifts your fortune and your work gets no support.
ambiguity: 'धले के' is garbled; the claim is presented as general advice, not chart-specific.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical view that the householder stage is needed for dharma, artha and kama; the wording is colloquial.

hindi: अल्ट ज्ञान यह ज्ञान सारा यही है यह तो कृपा का ज्ञान है
says: He says the whole knowledge of this half is the knowledge of kripa (grace): what comes to you from the partner and in-law side is received as grace, not earned.
ambiguity: 'अल्ट ज्ञान' is garbled (possibly 'ultimate knowledge'); 'yahi' is unnamed and refers to the spouse-side half.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no 'kripa' category for the 7th-12th block.

hindi: यहां से कृपा मिलती है यह है कृपा बैठे बिठाए इंसान के अंदर इंटू आ गई कृपा
says: Grace is received from this half, and it shows up as something arriving in a person unasked while sitting idle, 'intu' (probably intuition), which he labels kripa.
ambiguity: 'इंटू' is probably 'intuition'; the pointer 'yahan' is unnamed.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not define kripa as sudden intuition.

gist: Wordplay on 'vikaar' as 'weak car' versus 'strong car', with 'munna' talking from inside; he calls it nonsense himself.

hindi: बकवास भी यही से होती है विकार भी सारे यहां यहां और यहां से होते है छ आ इनका दोस्त है तीन
says: Nonsense and all vikaar (defects, vices) also arise from this half, from three spots he points at; the caption suggests the 6th and 8th (with the 12th unstated), and the 3rd as their friend.
cells_derived_method: The sign on each of these houses shows the type of fault: Mars-ruled signs give anger and rashness, Venus-ruled signs give indulgence, Mercury-ruled signs give deceit or restlessness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 6th in Aries (Mars-ruled) - the fault pattern is anger, quarrels and rashness.
Derived: 8th in Taurus (Venus-ruled) - the fault pattern is indulgence and possessiveness.
Derived: 3rd in Gemini (Mercury-ruled) - the fault pattern is restlessness, gossip and half-truths.

ambiguity: 'छ आ' is probably 'chhah, aath' (6, 8); the third pointed spot is likely the 12th but is not stated, and 'dost' 3 is a loose phrase.
classical_check: Agrees with 6-8-12 as the dusthana; some texts add the 3rd as a lesser bad house.

gist: Audience question: when you say woman or marriage do you mean the opposite gender, and what if the person is not married but in a live-in.

hindi: तो उसकी क भी मि उसकी लिविन में भी कृपा मिलेगी 100% लिविन में भी कृपा मिलेगी ये बहुत बड़ी बात है
says: Answering the question, he says the grace of the partner-side houses arrives fully even in a live-in relationship without marriage, so the effect belongs to the partner role and not to the legal marriage.
ambiguity: 'क भी मि' is garbled; the 100% is his assertion, not a measured rate.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts speak of vivaha and the 7th, and live-in is a modern case.

hindi: 101 पर आठ प्रकार के विवाह है एक गंधर्व विवाह पिशाच विवाह भी है बताया तो आप गंदर विवाह कर लेते
says: He says there are eight kinds of marriage, naming Gandharva and Pishacha among them, and that once told people may choose a Gandharva (love) marriage; this widens 'marriage' beyond the formal ritual.
ambiguity: '101 पर' is garbled and 'तो आप गंदर विवाह कर लेते' may be a joke.
classical_check: Agrees: the Dharmashastra lists eight kinds (Brahma, Daiva, Arsha, Prajapatya, Asura, Gandharva, Rakshasa, Paishacha).

gist: Refers viewers to his old marriage class, which he thinks has two parts, 'by God's grace'.

hindi: उसके अंदर आठ प्रकार के विवाह में पिशाच विवाह भी है अगर आप किसी को उठा के बिला
says: He repeats that Pishacha vivah is among the eight and describes it as carrying someone off by force, which sets up the film example that follows; the sentence is cut at the end of this slice.
ambiguity: 'उठा के बिला...' continues as 'रहे हैं' in the next slice; it likely means carrying someone away.
classical_check: Differs on detail: in the Dharmashastra abduction is Rakshasa vivah, while Paishacha is the seduction of a woman who is asleep, intoxicated or unaware.

gist: Film example: Pinjar (Urmila Matondkar, Manoj Bajpayee abducts her); he praises the audience member who recalled the title.

hindi: और उसके पश्चात भी जीवन बदलता है
says: Even after such an abduction-style (Pishacha) marriage the man's life still changes, meaning the partner-house effect works no matter how the union came about.
ambiguity: It is not said whether the change is good or bad; the subject is the film character.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not say the form of marriage changes the 7th's effect.

hindi: तो स्त्री के ग्रह बहुत पावरफुल होते हैं क्योंकि वो एक्स एक्स है पुरुष एक्स और वा है ये अलग कहानी है ये आपका भाग्य उठता ही तब है स्ट्रेंथ आती है
says: A woman's planets are very powerful, he says, because she carries XX against a man's XY (which he sets aside as another story), and your fortune rises only when that strength reaches you.
ambiguity: 'वा' is garbled for Y; it is unclear whether 'strength' means the wife's planets or the whole spouse-side half.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give no rule that women's planets are stronger, and the genetics reasoning is his own.

hindi: यह आपका ससुराल हो गया ससुराल से कैसा रिश्ता है अगर यहां ग्रह आपको पता हो कि आपका ग्रह खराब है और आप ससुराल से रिश्ता सोच रहे हैं तो क्लेश ही रहेगा जिंदगी भर
says: This house is the in-laws and shows the bond with them; if the planet here is afflicted and you still expect a good relation with the in-laws, there will be strife for life.
cells_derived_method: The kind of friction follows the sign on the afflicted 8th: movable signs give sudden repeated quarrels, fixed signs give rigid, long-lasting rifts, dual signs give shifting positions.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: afflicted 8th in Aries (Mars-ruled) - sharp, quarrel-prone in-laws; clashes erupt suddenly and cool quickly.
Derived: afflicted 8th in Capricorn (Saturn-ruled) - cold, duty-bound in-laws; the strife is formal and long-lasting.
Derived: afflicted 8th in Pisces (Jupiter-ruled) - trouble comes through confusion or misreading rather than open fights.

ambiguity: 'ग्रह' here means the house or its planet; 'afflicted' is not defined and no specific malefic is named.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: afflictions to the 8th and the 7th-from-7th are read as trouble with the spouse's family.

hindi: यह बड़ी भारी समस्या है इसलिए आपको ये समझना जानना जरूरी है कि ससुराल से ग्रह अच्छा होने का योग ही नहीं है
says: He calls this a heavy problem and says you must first learn from the chart whether any yoga for a good relation with the in-laws exists at all.
ambiguity: The 'yoga' for good in-law relations is not defined here; the sentence runs on into the next row.
classical_check: Silent: no classical yoga is named for the in-laws.
