hindi: तो ससुराल से क्लेश बनाओ ही मत एक्सपेक्टेशन छोड़ दो यार मेरी कुंडली में नहीं है होना ही झगड़ा आखिर में तो मुद्दा ही एकदम आउट हो जाता है आपका
says: Advice: if the chart shows no yoga for harmony with the in-laws, do not manufacture quarrels, drop expectations and tell yourself it is not in your chart; the issue then fades by itself.
ambiguity: The advice is behavioural; 'मुद्दा आउट' means the issue disappears.
classical_check: Silent: it is a counselling remark, not a classical remedy.

hindi: यह आपका भाग्य बनता है इस जन्म का यह आपका पूर्व जन्म का भाग्य है
says: Two boxes are named for fortune: one builds this birth's fortune and the other holds fortune carried from the past life, splitting luck into present effort and past credit.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 9th shows how past credit appears: fire signs as drive and boldness, water signs as inherited blessing or emotional merit, earth signs as steady material support.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 9th in Aries (Mars-ruled) - luck is self-made, needs initiative; past credit shows as courage.
Derived: 9th in Pisces (Jupiter's own sign) - strong inherited or spiritual merit; luck arrives with little effort.

ambiguity: Which two boxes he points at is not said; likely the 9th for this-birth fortune and the 5th for past-life merit.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 9th and 5th are the past-merit (purva punya) houses, but classical texts do not split the 9th into 'this birth' and 'past life'.

hindi: यह भाग्य का लाभ हुआ तो आपके जीवन में अपने आप ही मेनी फोल्ड सक्सेस होगी अपने आप ही उठ उठ के जाओगे जीवन के अंदर
says: If the gain of fortune takes place, meaning this house is activated, success in your life will multiply many-fold on its own and you will keep rising automatically.
cells_derived_method: The style of rise follows the sign on the 9th: earth signs give steady accumulation, air signs give rise through networks and ideas.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 9th in Taurus (Venus-ruled) - the many-fold success comes steadily, as accumulated comfort and assets.
Derived: 9th in Aquarius - success multiplies through groups, networks and innovation.

ambiguity: 'भाग्य का लाभ' could mean the 11th (gain) or activation of the 9th; the 9th is taken.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts say a strong 9th gives luck but no 'automatic many-fold' rule.

hindi: यह आपके कर्म का स्थान है क्या काम आप करते हैं
says: He names the house of karma, the place that shows what kind of work you do.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 10th shapes the type of work: Saturn-ruled signs give structured or authority work, Mercury-ruled signs give communication and trade, Moon-ruled signs give care and public-facing work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 10th in Capricorn (Saturn's own sign) - structured, authority or government-type work.
Derived: 10th in Gemini (Mercury-ruled) - work in communication, trade, writing and teaching.
Derived: 10th in Cancer (Moon's own sign) - work with the public, food, homes and care.

ambiguity: The 10th is not spoken; it is taken from the sequence after the 9th.
classical_check: Agrees: the 10th is karma bhava, the house of profession.

hindi: चेस्ट आपके इसके पास है बिजनेस का योग
says: He says the yoga for business is held by the house he points at; which house is not clear, and 'chest' is probably a garble of 'best' or 'checked'.
ambiguity: The pointer 'isake paas' is unnamed; it may be the 10th (just named) or the 7th (partnership); 'चेस्ट' is unreadable.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: business is read from the 7th and 10th.

hindi: इसके पास है नौकरी का योग यहां से आपका देख नौकरी यहां से भी देखी जाती है कार्य और यहां से भी बिजनेस यहां से भी देखा जाता है और यहां से भी मिलजुल कर के कार्यक्रम चलता है
says: Service (job) yoga sits with another house; job and work are read from more than one house, business likewise from more than one, and the final picture comes from combining them.
cells_derived_method: Which house leads depends on the sign on the 6th, 7th and 10th: service signs favour a job, movable signs favour own business, and the 10th sign decides how the two combine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 6th in Virgo (Mercury-ruled) - clerical, analytic or service work suits; job yoga is stronger.
Derived: 7th in Libra (Venus-ruled) - partnership business and trading come to the fore.
Derived: 10th in Aries (Mars-ruled) - self-driven leadership, which leans towards own business over a job.

ambiguity: No house numbers are spoken; likely the 6th for job, the 7th for business and the 10th as the combining house.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: job from the 6th and 10th, business from the 7th and 10th.

hindi: इसी के यहां से फेम है आपकी फेम यश फेम भी यहां है फेम यह कार्य का स्थान है कार्य पूर्ण रूप से कार्य को समर्पित है एक प्रकार से य घर
says: Fame and public name (yash) are read from the karma house; he calls it a house wholly given to work, and also the place where reputation comes from.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 10th shapes the kind of fame: fire signs give fame through authority and visibility, earth signs through skill and service, water signs through compassion or the arts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 10th in Leo (Sun's own sign) - fame through authority, leadership and creative visibility.
Derived: 10th in Virgo (Mercury-ruled) - a reputation for skill, detail and service.
Derived: 10th in Pisces (Jupiter's own sign) - recognition for compassion, arts or behind-the-scenes work.

ambiguity: The house is unnamed; it follows from 'karya ka sthan'.
classical_check: Agrees: the 10th gives kirti (fame) and karma.

hindi: इसके ठीक बाद आपका लाभ का ग्रह है भाई यह आपके बड़े भाई बहन ताऊ इत्यादि होते हैं यहां से आपके छोटे भाई बहन होते हैं
says: The house right after the karma house is the house of gains (labh); he gives it elder brothers and sisters and paternal uncles (tau), and says younger siblings come from the other box he points at.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 11th shows the character of elder siblings and gains: fixed air Aquarius gives a detached, networked group, Mars-ruled signs give forceful siblings, Venus-ruled signs give comfort-loving ones.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 11th in Aries (Mars-ruled) - elder siblings are forceful and competitive; gains through effort and initiative.
Derived: 11th in Libra (Venus-ruled) - elder siblings are refined and sociable; gains through partnerships.
Derived: 3rd in Sagittarius (Jupiter's own sign) - younger siblings are well-meaning and philosophical, with a taste for travel.

ambiguity: 'ग्रह' means house; the 3rd is not named for younger siblings but is the classical house.
classical_check: Agrees for elder siblings (11th) and younger siblings (3rd); differs on tau, as the father's younger brother is the 11th (3rd from the 9th) and the elder brother of the father would be the 7th.

hindi: इसके पास लाभ है लॉन्ग ट्रेवल विदेश यात्राएं
says: He attaches gains and also long journeys and foreign trips to the house he is on, linking income and overseas travel as topics of one house, though the travel part may be a jump to the 9th or 12th.
ambiguity: Long travel and foreign trips are classically the 9th and 12th, not the 11th; the caption lists them right after gains, so he may have moved on without naming the house.
classical_check: Differs: the 11th is gains, while long journeys are the 9th and foreign residence the 12th.

hindi: आपके पास पैसा कमाते हो 00 रप किसी के पास र लगा के रप आता है किसी के पास रप लगाकर 100 यह डिपेंड करता है यहां से
says: How much money you earn, whether the figure comes with few or many zeros after the rupee, depends on this house, so the size of income is read here.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 11th shows the type of income flow: earth signs give steady accumulation, air signs many small streams, water or transformative signs irregular income through others' money.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 11th in Taurus (Venus-ruled) - steady, accumulating income through finance or comforts.
Derived: 11th in Gemini (Mercury-ruled) - many small income streams through trade and writing.
Derived: 11th in Scorpio (Mars-ruled) - irregular income through others' money, commissions or research.

ambiguity: The figures are garbled ('00 रप', 'र लगा के'); only the claim that income size depends on this house is clear.
classical_check: Agrees: the 11th is the house of income and gains.

gist: Repeats that this house stands for the elder brother or sister and for the paternal uncle (tau), leading into the remedy that follows.

hindi: आप उनकी सेवा कर रहे हो मा उसी से ग्रह इग्नाइट हो गया ऑटोमेटिक लाजवाब हो जाएगा कैसे कमाल की चीज इसलिए रिश्तों को पूजा जाता है
says: If you serve the elder sibling or paternal uncle, this house is ignited automatically and becomes excellent; this, he says, is why relationships are honoured and worshipped.
ambiguity: 'ग्रह इग्नाइट' means house activation, not a named planet; 'मा' is garbled.
classical_check: Silent as a named remedy; service to elders is a general dharmic prescription, not a classical 11th-house remedy.

hindi: अब ये लोग कहते हैं आप अपने जीवन में सूर्य को सुधारना चाहते हैं सूर्य कैसे सुधरेगा पिता आपके सूर्य समान है उनकी सेवा करिए
says: He quotes the stock remedy other teachers give: to fix a weak Sun, treat your father as the Sun and serve him.
ambiguity: He is quoting a rule he is about to attack; the sentence begins in the previous slice.
classical_check: Agrees with the common remedy of serving the father for the Sun, a traditional general upaya.

hindi: क्या खाक करिए पिता का स्थान ही खराब है अगर यहां मान लो शनि महाराज की यहां पर दृष्टि है कार्यक्रम है तो बच्चा बाप के साथ रहेगा ही नहीं क्या खाक करेगा
says: He rejects the stock Sun remedy: if the father's house itself is afflicted, say by Saturn's aspect on it, the child will not even live with the father, so serving him is impossible and the remedy fails when the chart contradicts it.
cells_derived_method: Saturn aspects the 3rd, 7th and 10th from its seat, so it reaches the 9th from the 7th (3rd aspect), the 3rd (7th aspect) or the 12th (10th aspect). The strength and style of the separation depend on Saturn's dignity and the sign it sits in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in the 7th in Libra aspects the 9th by its 3rd aspect - father is respected but the child lives apart through duty and work.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in the 3rd in Aries aspects the 9th by its 7th aspect - a cold, strained relation with the father, with the child leaving home early.
Derived: Saturn in its own sign in the 12th in Capricorn aspects the 9th by its 10th aspect - distance from the father through foreign residence or work far from home.

ambiguity: 'शनि महाराज की दृष्टि' is on 'this' house, assumed the 9th (father's house); 'कार्यक्रम है' is filler.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn's aspect on the 9th gives distance or strain with the father; the idea that serving father then becomes impossible is his own inference.

gist: Mocks people who make universal laws like 'serve your father' and asks 'from where do you do it'.

hindi: पता लगा कोई क्रूर ग्रह है बाप ही क्रूर है वही दारू पीके पीटता है सबको तो उसका क्या करोगे भाड़ में गए सारे उसूल ये क्या करोगे उसका कोई सिर पैर नहीं है
says: If a cruel (malefic) planet makes the father himself cruel, a drunk who beats everyone, then the 'serve your father' rule collapses; remedies must be filtered through what the father's house and planet show.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 9th and the malefic in it show the type of harsh father: fire signs give a violent, quick temper, Saturn-ruled signs a cold, strict, distant father, Mars-ruled water signs a secretive, domineering one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: malefic on the 9th in Aries (Mars-ruled) - hot-tempered father who shouts or hits.
Derived: malefic on the 9th in Capricorn (Saturn-ruled) - strict, cold father, distant and harsh in discipline.
Derived: malefic on the 9th in Scorpio (Mars-ruled) - secretive, domineering father with intense, hidden anger.

ambiguity: No planet or house number is named; 'क्रूर ग्रह' is a generic malefic.
classical_check: Agrees that malefics on the 9th and on the Sun give a harsh father; the conclusion that universal remedies fail is his own.

hindi: इसलिए यह बहुत डेप्थ की बात है लेकिन बिकता यह है आप अपने माता-पिता की सेवा करें आप मित्रों से परम सुंदर व्यवहार करें कहां से करें आपके खुद के ग्रह टेढ़े हैं आप हो ही बदतमीज
says: This is a deep matter, he says, but what sells is simple advice like 'serve your parents, behave beautifully with friends'; you cannot do that if your own planets are crooked and your nature is rude, so conduct follows the chart, not the sermon.
ambiguity: No planet or house named; 'ग्रह टेढ़े हैं' means afflicted planets in general.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not discuss popular advice; the point matches the view that behaviour follows the chart.

hindi: आपकी कुंडली में शनि की दृष्टि है सूर्य के ऊपर आप बाप को खा जाओगे उल्टा आप उसको पीटो ग ऐसी स्थिति होगी
says: If Saturn aspects the Sun in your chart, the relation with the father turns hostile; he says in strong idiom that you would 'eat' your father or even beat him. Recorded as a harsh father-conflict claim, not as a prediction of the father's death.
cells_derived_method: Saturn aspects the Sun only when the Sun sits 3rd, 7th or 10th from Saturn. The house the Sun holds and its sign decide which area of the father relation is hurt: authority and status, or home and upbringing.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in the 10th in Aries (exalted) with Saturn in the 4th opposite it - father is a figure of authority, but a cold, distant relation from the home side.
Derived: Sun in the 5th in Leo (its own sign) with Saturn in the 11th opposite it - a proud, rigid father; the native resists his authority and clashes over his ideas.

ambiguity: 'बाप को खा जाओगे' is idiom for severe harm or hostility, and 'पीटो ग' is garbled; no timing or death is claimed.
classical_check: Agrees broadly: Saturn's aspect or contact with the Sun is a classical sign of strained relations and distance with the father.

hindi: आपका बेड कंफर्ट्स का ग्रह है ये 12वां आपका यहां पर ग्रह दृष्टि और ग्रह खराब है ये बात करेंगे हम
says: He names the 12th house outright as the house of bed comforts and says planets, aspects and afflictions on it will be taken up later.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 12th shapes the private-life comfort: Libra gives partner-oriented harmony, Aquarius gives a detached, unconventional private life.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 12th in Libra (Venus-ruled) - refined, partner-oriented comfort and harmony in private life.
Derived: 12th in Aquarius - detached, unconventional private life with limited warmth.

ambiguity: 'ग्रह' here means house; this is the only spot where the 12th is named aloud in this slice.
classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is shayya-sukha (bed comforts).

hindi: ये फिक्स भाव है यहां पर आपका जो ग्रह जैसा है वैसा
says: He begins to say this is a 'fix' (fixed or settled) bhava where whatever planet sits behaves as it is; the sentence is cut at the end of the slice so the full meaning is not available.
ambiguity: 'फिक्स भाव' could mean a fixed (sthira) house or 'fixed result'; the sentence has no ending and the house is assumed to be the 12th.
classical_check: Silent: it is unclear what is claimed.

hindi: बिहेवियर बेड पर पति या पत्नी का आपस में होगा स्त्री का आपका यहां का ग्रह डिस्टर्ब है वो बेड पर ही पति से बहस करेगी और लड़ाई होगी सेक्स से भी लेनदेन नहीं
says: If the planet on the bed-comfort house is disturbed in a woman's chart, the couple's behaviour on the bed turns bad: she argues with her husband right there, a fight breaks out, and even sex is no longer an exchange between them.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the afflicted 12th decides the style of the bed-time conflict: Mars-ruled signs give heated, sudden arguments, Mercury-ruled signs give nagging and fault-finding, Saturn-ruled signs give cold silence and resentment.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: afflicted 12th in Aries (Mars-ruled) - heated arguments that flare up suddenly at night and die out quickly.
Derived: afflicted 12th in Virgo (Mercury-ruled) - nagging and fault-finding at bedtime, with criticism instead of warmth.
Derived: afflicted 12th in Capricorn (Saturn-ruled) - cold silence and stored resentment instead of open arguing.

ambiguity: 'यहां का ग्रह' is the 12th house by context (previous slice names it) and 'disturbed' is not defined; he speaks of a woman's chart but the same could hold for either spouse.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: afflictions to the 12th (shayya sukha) spoil bed pleasures; the claim of fights on the bed is his colourful gloss.

hindi: बेड कंफर्ट्स निनी नींद के टाइम सोने गए हैं तो सोते सोते लड़ाई एक बार होएगी उसके बाद ही नींद आएगी
says: Without bed comfort, the couple goes to sleep and a fight happens first, and only after it does sleep come, so the quarrel becomes a bedtime routine and sleep itself is tied to this house.
cells_derived_method: How the bedtime quarrel ends depends on the sign on the afflicted 12th: water-sign Mars-ruled Scorpio gives an intense row that ends in a silent grudge, Venus-ruled Libra gives a polite, passive-aggressive row settled by negotiation.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: afflicted 12th in Scorpio - an intense bedtime row ending in a silent grudge, with sleep coming late.
Derived: afflicted 12th in Libra (Venus-ruled) - a polite, passive-aggressive argument; sleep returns once some peace is made.

ambiguity: 'निनी' is garbled, probably 'नींद' or 'nahin'; 'bed comforts' and sleep are treated as one topic.
classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is classically both shayya sukha and nidra (sleep).

gist: Acted-out dialogue of a quarrelling couple ('a glass of milk? a TV serial? let's have a fight, OK') who must fight before they can sleep.

hindi: यह आपका लाभ का ग्रह है यह आपका व्यय का ग्रह है व्यय हॉस्पिटल एक्सपेंसेस बीमारी यहां से होगी मौत यहां से होगी
says: He moves from the 11th (gains) to the 12th (expenses) and says expenses, hospital spending, illness and death are all read from the 12th. The death claim records only the house signification; no event or date is claimed.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 12th shows where the outflow goes: Cancer sends it to home and family, Sagittarius to travel, teachers and religion, Aquarius to groups and long-drawn institutional costs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 12th in Cancer (Moon's own sign) - heavy outlay on home and family; hospital spending tied to mother or family care.
Derived: 12th in Sagittarius (Jupiter's own sign) - outlay on travel, teachers and religious causes; spending abroad.

ambiguity: The house numbers 11 and 12 are not spoken; they follow the sequence (karma, labh, vyaya). 'मौत यहां से होगी' is a house meaning only.
classical_check: Partly differs: the 12th is expenses, hospitalisation and loss, while death itself is the 8th house.

hindi: हॉस्पिटल पर खर्चा कहां से करोगे यहां से करोगे पैसा कमाओगे जॉब के थ्रू किसको दोगे किसको नहीं दोगे इस पर डिपेंड करेगा
says: Hospital money will be paid from the income side that you earn through a job, but to whom you give and whom you refuse is decided by the expense house, so the 12th steers where earnings flow out.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 12th shows who receives your outflow: Leo gives to children and people one wants to impress, Virgo to dependants and service staff, Pisces to the needy and to charity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 12th in Leo (Sun's own sign) - money goes to children and to people one wants to impress.
Derived: 12th in Virgo (Mercury-ruled) - money goes to dependants, helpers and routine service costs.

ambiguity: 'यहां से करोगे' is a pointer to the gains house; the sentence is loose and the split between the 11th and 12th is inferred.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give the 11th as income and the 12th as outflow but not this giving-and-refusing split.

hindi: मौत यानी कि उस पैसे को चलाना भी आएगा कि उसका तबाह करके सत्यानाश कर दोगे खुद ही मार दोगे कि चलाओगे या फिर उस पैसे को आप ऐश अयाशी मस्ती चैरिटी दान में दोगे
says: The 12th shows whether you will know how to run your money or ruin it and 'kill' it yourself, and whether you pour it into luxury and fun or into charity and giving; here 'death' means the death of the money.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 12th shows the direction of the outflow: Taurus gives luxury and food, Sagittarius gives charity and religion, Scorpio gives money lost in secret or risky matters.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 12th in Taurus (Venus-ruled) - money flows into luxury, food and comforts.
Derived: 12th in Sagittarius (Jupiter's own sign) - money flows into charity, teachers and religious causes.
Derived: 12th in Scorpio (Mars-ruled) - money is lost through secret ventures, other people's demands or risky matters.

ambiguity: 'मौत' here means the destruction of the money, not a person; no investment advice is given.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: the 12th is vyaya, spending on pleasures (bhoga) or on dharma and charity.

hindi: मोक्ष भी यही है दान में दान भी यही से दोगे
says: Moksha is also in this house, and the act of giving in charity is done from here too, so liberation and donation are two faces of the 12th.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 12th shapes the type of giving: Pisces gives selfless giving, Leo gives giving with visibility.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 12th in Pisces (Jupiter's own sign) - quiet, selfless giving and a natural inclination towards liberation.
Derived: 12th in Leo (Sun's own sign) - generous giving that likes to be seen and named.

ambiguity: 'दान में दान' is a stumble; the claim is that moksha and charity both sit here.
classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is moksha and also expenditure on dharma.

hindi: आपके जीवन में लिक्विड कैश कितना अरेंज कर सकते हो
says: He poses the measure of this house: how much liquid cash you are able to arrange in your life is read from the 12th.
ambiguity: The sentence is a question that continues in the next slice; the 12th is assumed from the thread.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give the 2nd and 11th for money in hand, not the 12th.

hindi: आप लिक्विड कैश मीस जब पैसे चाहिए आ गए सब यहां से
says: He defines liquid cash as money that turns up the moment it is needed, and says all of it is to be read from this 12th house.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 12th shows how readily cash appears: Gemini and Sagittarius give quick, flexible access, Capricorn gives cash only after planning, Scorpio gives cash that comes in lumps through others.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 12th in Gemini (Mercury-ruled) - cash is easy to arrange through quick small deals and contacts.
Derived: 12th in Capricorn (Saturn-ruled) - cash is available only after planning and saving, and arrives slowly.

ambiguity: 'मीस' is a caption slip for 'means'; the identification of liquid cash with the 12th is his own.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts read money in hand from the 2nd and 11th; the 12th is outflow.

hindi: अगर आपके बेड कंफर्ट बहुत अच्छे हैं आप चैरिटी करते हैं आपके पास हमेशा धन खर्चे के लिए होगा
says: If bed comforts are very good and you give to charity, you will always have money available for spending, so a well-working 12th assures cash for outflow.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 12th colours how the comfort and giving show: Sagittarius brings abundance through generosity, Libra brings it through harmony with the partner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: well-placed 12th in Sagittarius (Jupiter's own sign) - generosity and faith keep funds available for spending.
Derived: well-placed 12th in Libra (Venus-ruled) - a harmonious private life with the partner keeps spending funds available.

ambiguity: 'Very good' bed comfort is not defined by any planetary condition.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not link bed comfort and charity to cash availability.

hindi: इसलिए बेड पर कभी लड़ाई मत करो कहा जाता है बेड केतु का स्थान माना जाता है
says: Hence never quarrel on the bed, since the bed is held to be Ketu's place; a bed fight is a disrespect to Ketu and so spoils the 12th's results.
ambiguity: The bed-Ketu link is a traditional saying he reports ('कहा जाता है'); the effect on the 12th's results is implied, not stated.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu is a karaka of moksha and the 12th; classical texts link the bed with the 12th and Venus, not Ketu.

hindi: लड़की को कंघा दिया जाता है शादी के टाइम दर्पण दिया जाता है शीशा शीशा शुक्र होता है उसको ब दिया जाता है पलंग केतु होता है
says: At a wedding the bride is given a comb, a mirror (glass belongs to Venus) and a bed (Ketu), so each wedding gift carries a planet that travels with her.
ambiguity: 'उसको ब दिया जाता है' is garbled, likely 'bed is given'; the comb is not assigned a planet.
classical_check: Agrees that mirrors and glass belong to Venus; assigning the bed to Ketu is his own link.

hindi: ऐसी ऐसी कुछ चीज श्रृंगार के सामान दिए जाते चांदी सोना चंद्रमा सूर्य यह सब दिया जाता है
says: Make-up items, silver (Moon) and gold (Sun) are also given at the wedding; every gift stands for a planet that the bride takes along into her new home.
ambiguity: He lists silver-Moon and gold-Sun in one breath; the make-up items are not assigned a planet.
classical_check: Agrees that silver is the Moon's metal; gold is classically Jupiter and the Sun, so this agrees only partly.

hindi: इसके कारण से वह अपना ग्रह लेकर दूसरे घर जाती है अगर किसी लड़की की कुंडली के अंदर कोई ग्रह बहुत स्ट्रांग है
says: Because of those gifts the bride carries her own planets into the second home, so a planet that is very strong in her chart moves with her to the marital household.
ambiguity: The sentence is incomplete and runs into the Mercury and Mars example; 'carrying a planet' is symbolic and no mechanism is given.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not have this carrying-of-planets idea, though the D9 and 7th house show what the marriage adds.

hindi: मान लो बुध है बुध धन का कारक है मंगल पराक्रम का कारक है तो बाप का घर छोड़कर व दूसरे घर जाती है
says: He gives an example: Mercury, which he calls the significator of wealth, and Mars, significator of valour, are strong in the daughter's chart, and she leaves her father's house for the other home.
ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next row; 'मान लो बुध है' means 'suppose Mercury is strong'.
classical_check: Mars as karaka of parakrama (3rd house courage) agrees; Mercury as karaka of wealth differs, as the classical dhana karaka is Jupiter and Mercury rules trade and intellect.

hindi: अपना मंगल बुध भी ले जाती है वहां तो र मालामाल हो ग बाप कंगला हो गया
says: She takes her Mars and Mercury along: the marital home becomes rich and the father's home becomes a pauper, so a daughter's strong planets shift prosperity from her father's family to her husband's.
cells_derived_method: What she takes depends on where the strong planet sits and in which sign: a strong Mercury shows trade and money skills, a strong Mars shows drive and professional courage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in its own sign in the 11th in Virgo - a daughter with trade and accounting skill whose earnings and gains go to the husband's household after marriage.
Derived: Mars exalted in the 10th in Capricorn - a daughter whose professional drive and courage lift the husband's household once she moves.

ambiguity: 'वहां तो र मालामाल हो ग' is garbled and 'father became poor' may be a figure of speech.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe prosperity moving from father's to husband's house through the bride's planets.

hindi: तो लड़की के विवाह के टाइम यह जरूरी है कि माता-पिता उसका यूज कंगी शीशा उसका
says: At the girl's wedding it is essential that her parents keep back things she has used, her comb and mirror, so a share of her planets and fortune stays in the parents' home.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the slice end and continues with the bed or bedsheet; the planet link rests on his earlier statement that the mirror belongs to Venus.
classical_check: Silent: this is a folk custom, not in classical remedial texts.

hindi: पलंग नहीं तो पलंग की कोई चादर ही सही वो रख ले उसकी जूता चप्पल कोई रख ले य हालांकि बहुत डीप है पर मोटे तौर पर भी रख लेंगे
says: If the bed itself cannot be kept back, a bedsheet will do, and someone may keep her shoes or slippers; he admits the logic is deep but says even this crude version is enough.
ambiguity: The bedsheet and footwear are substitutes for the bed and the personal items; the planet link (Ketu for the bed) comes from his earlier line.
classical_check: Silent: a folk custom, not found in classical upaya texts.

hindi: तो भी आपकी बिटिया अपना भाग्य यहां भी छोड़ जाएगी वहां भी मल्टीप्लाई करेगी क्योंकि स्त्री भाग्य की खाती है
says: Even with the crude version, your daughter leaves her fortune behind in the parents' home and also multiplies it at her in-laws, because a woman lives on her fortune.
ambiguity: 'स्त्री भाग्य की खाती है' means a woman lives off her luck; no house or planet is named.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe fortune being left behind by a bride, though the 9th-house luck is read separately in each chart.

hindi: उसका स्त्री होना ही अपने आप में सुंदर और पूर्ण उसकी समस्या है व खुद से संतुष्ट नहीं है
says: A woman's being a woman is already beautiful and complete in itself, and her only problem is that she is not satisfied with herself.
ambiguity: The sentence is a general remark on the feminine principle; he turns to Venus next but does not name it here.
classical_check: Silent: it is a psychological observation, not a classical rule.

hindi: कौन सी स्त्री ज्यादा भोग कर पाती है जो सादा सिंपल सिंपल से सिंपल रहती है और खुद को तुष्ट करना जानती है
says: The woman who enjoys life more is the plain, simple one who knows how to satisfy herself, so contentment, not want, brings the greater enjoyment (bhoga).
ambiguity: No planet is named; it sets up the Jupiter and Venus contrast that follows.
classical_check: Silent: a lifestyle remark, not a classical rule.

hindi: प्रकृति ने स्त्री तत्व चाहे पुरुष में हो चाहे स्त्री में यह बनाया ही ऐसा है कि क्या आप संतुष्ट है
says: Nature built the feminine element, whether it sits in a man or a woman, so that it keeps asking 'are you satisfied?', making restlessness the default setting of the feminine principle.
ambiguity: The sentence ends in a question; the intended point (the feminine principle questions contentment) is inferred from the following Jupiter and Venus contrast.
classical_check: Silent: this is Sankhya-style vocabulary, not found in Jyotish texts.

hindi: संतुष्ट कौन है बृहस्पति क्योंकि बहुत बड़ा राजा देवता है एक प्रकार से संतुष्ट कौन है बृहस्पति बाय डिफॉल्ट गुरु है
says: Jupiter is named the contented planet: he is the great king-god and by default the guru, so satisfaction is his natural state.
ambiguity: 'राजा देवता' means he is the king-like teacher of the devas.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is the guru of the devas; calling him the 'contented' planet fits his satvik, expansive nature but is not a stock classical phrase.

hindi: ज्यादा चाहिए कुछ नहीं कोई टशन ही नहीं है उसकी वो ज्ञान से इतना लब लब भरा है वो कहता है यही बहुत है मेरे पास कोई लेनदेन नहीं
says: Jupiter wants nothing more, has no show-off attitude, is filled to the brim with knowledge, and says 'this much is enough for me', with no give-and-take ledger.
ambiguity: 'लेनदेन नहीं' means no transactional demand, a contrast with Venus that follows.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is the karaka of knowledge, wisdom and contentment.

hindi: असंतुष्ट कौन है शुक्र ये है शुक्र कॉस्मस में शुक्र महाराज की खासियत है ये उल्टे चलते हैं उलट शुक्र उल्टा है उल्टा चलता है हमेशा
says: Venus is the dissatisfied planet, and its special feature in the cosmos is that it moves the opposite way to the others, always going against the grain.
ambiguity: 'उल्टा चलना' is meant for Venus's spin; it is not the astrological retrograde (vakri) motion.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts make Venus the karaka of desire and enjoyment, but 'dissatisfied' is his wording; Venus's retrograde rotation is true astronomy.

hindi: इसलिए कहा जाता है पत्नी को कुछ भी बोलो उल्टा ही चलेगी यह रिवर्स साइकोलॉजी की बात है
says: That, he says, is why people say whatever you tell your wife she will go the other way: a reverse-psychology habit that he links to Venus, the karaka of the wife.
ambiguity: Joking tone; the wife is tied to Venus as karaka, and no house number is given.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus is the karaka of the wife; the contrariness claim is a folk saying.

hindi: शुक्र क्लॉक वाइज चलता है अंतरिक्ष
says: He states that in space Venus turns clockwise, as the first half of a contrast with the Earth's anticlockwise turning that he finishes in the next slice.
ambiguity: He means Venus's spin; its orbit around the Sun goes the same way as the other planets. The sentence is cut at the slice end.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish texts; in astronomy Venus's rotation is indeed retrograde (clockwise seen from above the north pole).

hindi: में धरती एंटी क्लॉक वाइज चलती है उल्टा ही चलना है तो ऐसा नहीं कि उसने उल्टा चलना है उसकी चाल वही सीधी है क्योंकि वह पूरक है
says: The Earth turns anticlockwise, so Venus has to go the opposite way; he adds that Venus is not being contrary on purpose, its own motion is simply straight because it is the complement (purak) of the Earth.
ambiguity: The first words 'में' continue the previous slice; 'पूरक' (complement) is his key idea and it is not stated what Venus complements beyond the Earth.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not discuss rotation directions.

hindi: जो हमारे शास्त्रों में एक देवी है अदिति और दूसरी है दिति अदिति जो देवताओं की माता है अदिति इंफिनिटी यानी कि अनंत और द्विती मींस फाइना इट
says: To explain complementarity he cites two goddesses of the shastras, Aditi, mother of the devas and meaning the infinite, and Diti, meaning the finite, as a pair of opposites that complete each other.
ambiguity: 'द्विती' is a caption slip for Diti and 'फाइना इट' stands for 'finite'; it is not said which planet each goddess matches.
classical_check: Agrees that Aditi is the mother of the devas ('unbounded') and Diti the mother of the daityas; the 'finite' gloss is his own.

hindi: तो हमारे जीवन में में बहुत कुछ है लेकिन फाइट भी छाया सूर्य की पत्नी छाया भी है सूर्य की प्रकाश होता है
says: Life holds both the infinite and its opposite, and he pairs the Sun with a shadow: the Sun is light, and the Sun also has a wife called Chhaya (shadow), so each light has a shadow companion.
ambiguity: 'लेकिन फाइट भी' is garbled (maybe 'finite'); Chhaya as a wife of the Sun is the puranic Chhaya, not a graha.
classical_check: Agrees with the puranic account in which Surya has a wife Chhaya (shadow, created by Sanjna).

hindi: सूर्य की पत्नी छाया भी है उसके द्वारा शनि यमराज ये पैदा हुआ है वो भी छाया के संतान माने जाते हैं
says: Saturn and Yamraj are counted as children born through Chhaya, the Sun's shadow wife, so Saturn and Yama belong to the shadow side of the Sun.
ambiguity: 'Yamraj' may mean the death deity and not the planet Pluto of his 12-planet scheme, and the Puranas assign Yama to Sanjna in most versions.
classical_check: Agrees that Shani is the son of Surya and Chhaya; differs on Yama, who is usually the son of Surya and Sanjna.

hindi: वो छाया भी साथ ही उतने ही पावरफुल चलेगी यानी आपका प्लस भी साथ चलना है माइनस भी साथ चलना है दोनों ग्रह
says: The shadow side runs alongside, just as powerful as the light, so plus and minus must both travel together; both kinds of planet, light and shadow, are always present in a chart.
ambiguity: 'दोनों ग्रह' is vague; it may mean the Sun and Chhaya, or the plus and minus groups of planets; Rahu and Ketu are the classical 'chhaya grahas'.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not state the light-and-shadow balance as a rule, though Rahu and Ketu are called chhaya grahas.

hindi: आपका शुक्र उल्टा चलना जरूरी है तभी ताकि कॉस्मस में सिस्टम बना रहे
says: Your Venus must run against the grain so that the system in the cosmos stays balanced; Venus's contrariness is functional, a balancing weight that cannot be removed.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether 'उल्टा चलना' is the spin, the woman's attitude or both; he mixes the three.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text states this balancing role for Venus.

hindi: आपके जीवन में स्त्री शब्द उलट चलना जरूरी है स्त्री शब्द कौन सा है हमारा एक ब्रेन है स्त्री राइट ब्रेन लेफ्ट ब्रेन पुरुष ब्रेन ये इससे उल्टा ही चलता है
says: In your life the feminine element must run opposite; he identifies it with the brain, right brain as feminine and left brain as masculine, and says the feminine brain runs opposite to the male one.
ambiguity: 'स्त्री शब्द' is the feminine element ('tatva'); the left-and-right brain split is popular psychology, not an astrological measure.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no brain-hemisphere idea.

hindi: इसे चलना ही है अंदर से आवाज है आनी है नहीं
says: It has to run that way: the inner voice arrives and its first answer is 'no', so refusal is the default reflex of the feminine brain.
ambiguity: The sentence is garbled ('आनी है नहीं') and cut at the slice end; it may mean the voice that comes from inside is 'no'.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: A child refusing food ('eat, son' - 'no mama') and then taking a little bite and saying 'mama, it is very nice', used as an example of a first 'no'.

hindi: तो शुरू में ना बोलना नॉर्मल सी बात मान के चले आपका स्त्री ब्रेन बहुत पावर फुली चल रहा है
says: Take an initial 'no' as normal, because it only shows that your feminine brain is running powerfully; treat the first refusal as a sign of strength and not as rejection.
ambiguity: It is advice on handling a partner's first 'no', not tied to a planet or house.
classical_check: Silent: this is relationship advice, not a classical rule.

hindi: य नोनो करता है इलेक्ट्रॉन है इसके पास यह उलट चलता है शुक्र
says: That brain keeps saying no-no because it carries the electron (negative charge) and runs opposite, and he names this opposite-running one as Venus.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled ('य नोनो करता है'); the electron analogy repeats his earlier plus-minus charge pairs.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not give planets electrical charges.

hindi: जब ये शुक्र उलट नहीं चलता सीधा चलता है यानी बृहस्पति के अंतर्गत आ गया है
says: When Venus stops running opposite and goes straight, it means Venus has come under Jupiter's influence; Jupiter's contentment calms Venus's contrariness.
cells_derived_method: The calming depends on how Jupiter touches Venus, by conjunction or aspect, and on the house and sign they share: a strong Jupiter in a house of partnership or home gives contentment in relationships, while a weak Jupiter gives little relief.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer joined by Venus in the 7th - Venus's craving is softened into care and contentment in marriage.
Derived: Venus exalted in the 9th in Pisces with Jupiter in its own sign - desire turns into devotion and a contented, faith-led marriage.

ambiguity: 'अंतर्गत आ गया' is loose: it may mean conjunction, aspect or Jupiter's rulership; 'सीधा चलता है' is his image for being calm.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: a Jupiter-Venus link (conjunction or aspect) is classically read as a mix of guru and desire energy giving a refined, benefic result.

hindi: बड़ी सुंदर कथा है इसकी कि बृहस्पति देवताओं के गुरु हैं शुक्र दैत्यों के गुरु तो दैत्य के गुरु शुक्राचार्य
says: He opens the myth: Jupiter is the guru of the devas and Venus, as Shukracharya, is the guru of the daityas.
ambiguity: None beyond the filler 'तो दैत्य के गुरु'.
classical_check: Agrees: Brihaspati and Shukracharya are the gurus of the devas and the asuras.

hindi: जितने भी देवता मार देते थे दैत्यों को शुक्राचार्य फिर उनको जिंदा कर देते थे क्योंकि शुक्र के पास संजीवनी है
says: However many daityas the devas killed, Shukracharya brought them back to life, because Venus holds the Sanjivani (revival) knowledge, which makes revival a Venus power.
ambiguity: The myth is used as a symbol for Venus's power of recovery and regeneration, not as a prediction.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic story of Shukracharya's Mritasanjivani vidya.

hindi: शुक्र कहां है हमारे हृदय पर हार्ट के पास क्या संजीवनी बड़े से बड़ा गंद खाओ पियो गलत भावना सोचो रो पीटो आंसू बहाओ हृदय फिर संभाल लेता है
says: He places Venus at the heart and says its sanjivani power is the heart's ability to recover: whatever junk you eat, wrong feelings you think or tears you shed, the heart bounces back and carries on.
ambiguity: It is a symbolic body link, not a medical claim; 'गंद खाओ पियो' is rhetorical.
classical_check: Differs: the classical body part for the heart is the Sun, while Venus is given the reproductive system, kidney and face.

hindi: तो कितना पावरफुल है यानी एक तरह से हम बात करें नहीं शुक्री सबसे पावरफुल है सार ही है ऐसे ऐसे गुण है सबके
says: He calls Venus the most powerful planet in a way, then softens it by saying every planet has such qualities; the caption is garbled so the ranking claim is uncertain.
ambiguity: 'नहीं शुक्री' is garbled; it is unclear whether he really ranks Venus first or withdraws the claim.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not rank Venus above the others.

hindi: अब शुक्र के दम पर संजीवनी आती है आपके जीवन में पुनः आपने
says: Revival in your life, getting back on your feet after a collapse, comes on the strength of Venus; the sentence runs on into the next slice.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the slice end and completes with 'जीवित होना है'.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; it follows the Shukracharya myth.

hindi: जीवित होना है आपका शुक्र की कृपा चाहिए
says: To come alive again after a collapse you need Venus's grace (kripa), so the condition of Venus decides how well one recovers.
ambiguity: It completes the sentence from the previous slice; 'जीवित होना' is revival in a figurative sense, not a medical claim.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; it follows the Shukracharya myth.

hindi: इसलिए गाय की सेवा सनातन में इसलिए स्पेसिफिकली कहा गया गाय की हत्या मत करो गाय को मत खाओ
says: For that reason Sanatan specifically prescribes serving the cow and forbids killing or eating it; he ties the cow to Venus's grace as a remedy and a rule of conduct. Recorded as his tradition claim.
ambiguity: The link between the cow and Venus is implied from 'इसलिए' (therefore) after the Venus grace line; he gives no direct statement that the cow is Venus.
classical_check: Agrees that service of the cow and white items are common Venus remedies in later remedial texts.

hindi: क्योंकि आप अपने जीवन के अंदर एक तो बहु पत्नि कार्य नहीं करोगे आप अपने आप को सेक्सुअली इवॉल्व करोगे तो एक के साथ करोगे मल्टीपल जगह भटकाव नहीं आएगा
says: The reason he gives: with Venus's grace you will not take multiple wives, you will grow sexually with one partner, and there will be no wandering across many places.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 7th and Venus's condition show how steady the pairing is: Libra and Taurus favour a single devoted partner, dual signs raise the pull to variety.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 7th in Libra (Venus's own sign) - a settled single partnership; the pull is towards harmony with one person.
Derived: 7th in Gemini (Mercury-ruled, dual) - attraction to variety is stronger, so wandering is a real risk unless Venus is steady.

ambiguity: The 7th is inferred from 'wife' and 'partner'; the claim is that a strong Venus keeps one-partner loyalty, and no condition for 'strong' is given.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: a strong, well-aspected Venus and 7th favour marital stability; the 'multiple wives' framing is his own.

hindi: मल्टीपल टेढ़े मेढे उल्टू पुलटू बच्चे पैदा नहीं करोगे वो संतान पैदा करोगे जो लाभ दे यानी एक ही शेर भरा है 100 गीदड़ पैदा करके क्या करना है एक शेर भते
says: You will not father many crooked, mixed-up children but will have the kind of offspring who gives real benefit; he adds that one lion is worth more than a hundred jackals.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 5th suggests how many and what kind of children: Leo gives few, strong, leadership-type children, Gemini gives several restless, many-sided children.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 5th in Leo (Sun's own sign) - few but strong, proud, leadership-type children.
Derived: 5th in Gemini (Mercury-ruled) - several restless, many-sided children, which is the 'many' pattern he warns against.

ambiguity: 'एक शेर भते' is garbled; the 5th (children) is inferred from 'santaan'.
classical_check: Silent as a rule: classical texts read children from the 5th and Jupiter, not from Venus's grace.

hindi: तो यह बनता ही तब है जब स्त्री की कृपा मिलती है क्योंकि स्त्री ही हमें संतान देती है
says: That quality of offspring comes about only when the woman's grace is received, because it is the woman who gives us our children.
ambiguity: The houses are inferred: the 7th for the wife and the 5th for children; 'यह बनता' refers to the 'one lion' outcome.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts read children from the 5th and Jupiter for both sexes.

gist: Restates the war of the daityas with the devas and Venus keeping on reviving the daityas.
Body analogy: asuras, rudras, devas and daityas also exist inside the body, the Adityas regulate them, and demon-like cells (deforming blood cells, Covid) keep arising.
Resumes the myth: Venus began his sanjivani revival, so Jupiter ... (the sentence is cut at the end of the slice).
Myth: Jupiter, though himself a guru, sends his son off to Venus to learn the Sanjivani vidya (revival knowledge), and the son goes.
Myth: the boy fears Venus will refuse to teach a deva's son and may kill him, so he falls deeply in love with Venus's daughter instead.
Myth: the love between Jupiter's son and Venus's daughter grows beyond words, and she tells her father she will marry only him.
Myth: the daityas learn that Jupiter's son has come for Sanjivani and fear the devas will learn it too, recalling the Amrit kalash and Vishnu's Mohini form at the churning of the ocean.
Myth: the daityas kill the boy, Venus revives him through Sanjivani at his daughter's insistence, so they kill him again and prepare a liquid to be given to Venus to drink.
Myth: the daityas mash the boy and feed him to Venus, the daughter finds out and tells her father that her beloved is inside him.
Myth: Venus says the asuras did nothing improper by their own nature and calls the deed a terrible sin he did not like, but his daughter says she will die.

hindi: अब शुक्र जो प्रेम का दीवाना है मोह का दीवाना है ऐश रूप रंग स्त्री का कहना मानता है
says: Venus is mad about love, attachment, luxury and beauty, and for that very reason he obeys the woman; he reads the myth as showing that Venus's nature is to follow a woman's word.
ambiguity: 'ऐश रूप रंग' is a list (luxury, form, colour); the claim is drawn from the myth, not from a chart rule.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus is the karaka of love, desire, luxury, beauty and the wife.

hindi: इसलिए सब पुरुष चाहे कितना ही पत्नी से क्लेश करते हैं कहना उसी का इनडायरेक्टली स्त्री भी जानती है सत्ता मेरे हाथ में ही है
says: So every man, however much he quarrels with his wife, ends up doing what she says, and the woman indirectly knows that the real power is in her hand.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 7th shows how the wife holds that power: Venus-ruled earth Taurus gives a quiet hold through comforts and household taste, Mars-ruled Aries gives an open, forceful hold.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 7th in Taurus (Venus-ruled) - the wife steers through comforts and household taste, and the husband yields gradually.
Derived: 7th in Aries (Mars-ruled) - the wife is assertive and openly takes the lead; there are loud clashes but she still decides.

ambiguity: A generalisation about all men ('सब पुरुष'); the 7th is inferred from 'patni'; no condition on the chart is given.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not say that every wife holds the power; they discuss the 7th lord and Venus for the spouse's nature.

hindi: और व पुरुष कुत्ते की सिर्फ तर भकता है सिर्फ लेकिन उसके सुख के लिए दिन रात समर्पित रहता है
says: The man only barks like a dog, but his actual conduct is devoted day and night to her comfort, so his anger is noise while his service goes to the wife.
ambiguity: 'कुत्ते की सिर्फ तर भकता है' is garbled and probably means 'barks like a dog'; the sentence straddles the slice boundary.
classical_check: Silent: it is a social observation rather than a classical rule.

gist: Myth: Venus drinks the mixture, his daughter pleads, and he secretly teaches the Sanjivani vidya to the boy lying inside him.
Myth: having learned it, the boy tears his way out of Venus, who dies, and the boy then revives the dead Venus with Sanjivani.

hindi: यानी बृहस्पति और शुक्र की एक प्रकार की प्रेम और मैत्री बन गई शत्रुता से भरी हुई एक स्त्री के कारण
says: The moral he draws from the myth: Jupiter and Venus, who were full of enmity, ended up with a kind of love and friendship, and the reason was one woman, so a woman can bridge the Jupiter and Venus gap.
ambiguity: The friendship is mythic and symbolic; he does not name a chart yoga for it.
classical_check: Partly agrees: in the Parashari natural relations Jupiter treats Venus as an enemy while Venus is neutral to Jupiter, so some tension is classical; the bridging story is a Puranic tale.

hindi: इसलिए स्त्री में कितनी जान है वो कुछ भी बदल सकती है अंबुजा सीमेंट है वो एनीवे
says: Therefore a woman has enormous strength and can change anything; the Ambuja cement aside is a joke that she is unbreakable.
ambiguity: 'अंबुजा सीमेंट है वो एनीवे' is a throwaway joke about an advertisement; the main point is the woman's power to change things.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए आप जब बृहस्पति की कृपा लेते हैं स्त्री के द्वारा इसलिए कहा जाता है हर यज्ञ में पत्नी चाहिए राम यज्ञ में बैठे तो बोला सीता साथ लाओ
says: Jupiter's grace is received through the woman, and that is why it is said every yajna needs the wife; when Ram sat for a yajna he was told to bring Sita along.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 7th shows what kind of grace the spouse brings: Sagittarius brings wisdom and dharma, Scorpio brings change and transformation rather than ritual support.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 7th in Sagittarius (Jupiter's own sign) - the spouse brings teacher-like wisdom and dharma, and shared rituals favour the couple.
Derived: 7th in Scorpio (Mars-ruled) - the spouse brings transformation and intensity rather than ritual support.

ambiguity: Jupiter's grace is tied to the 9th and the wife to the 7th; he does not number the houses here.
classical_check: Agrees that a yajna needs the wife (sahadharmini) and that Ram used a golden Sita at his yajna (Uttara Kanda).

hindi: इसलिए पत्नी के बिना पुरुष अधूरा है इसलिए चाहे सोने की प्रतिमा बनाकर सीता लाई गई कहानिया है उसके बिना कार्य चलेगा नहीं
says: A man is incomplete without a wife; even a golden statue of Sita was brought to the ritual, and without the spouse the work does not proceed.
ambiguity: 'कहानिया है' marks the golden statue as a story he cites, not a verified record.
classical_check: Agrees with the Uttara Kanda account of the golden Sita at Ram's yajna.

hindi: तो आपके जीवन का सारा लाभ जो गवे भाव की हम बात कर रहे थे यह सारा का सारा लाभ और सारा व्यय यह आपका स्त्री के हाथ है अब यह
says: All your gains, the house they were discussing (the caption's 'gave bhav' is the gains house), and all your expenses are in the woman's hands; the sentence runs on into the next slice.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 11th and 12th shows how the woman handles money: earth signs keep it steady, air signs let it flow through many small channels.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 11th in Taurus (Venus-ruled) - the wife steadily builds and holds the household's gains.
Derived: 12th in Gemini (Mercury-ruled) - the woman's spending is quick and spread over many small outlays.

ambiguity: 'गवे भाव' is a caption garble for the gains (labh) bhava; the 11th and 12th are taken from the discussion of gains and expenses.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not place control of the 11th and 12th with the wife.

hindi: स्त्री के हाथ है अगर यह स्त्री की कुंडली में तो कहां चला गया यह उसी के हाथ है लेकिन पुरुष कैसा रखता है यह उस पर डिपेंड करता है
says: In a woman's own chart the control of gains and expenses is in her own hand, but how those play out depends on how the man keeps her, so the husband's treatment still shapes the result.
ambiguity: 'कहां चला गया' is a rhetorical aside; the houses are carried over from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not treat a woman's 11th and 12th as husband-dependent.

hindi: और पुरुष की कुंडली में क यह पत्नी के हाथ है
says: In a man's chart, the control of gains and expenses sits with his wife.
ambiguity: 'क' is a caption stray; the houses are carried over from the previous rows.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not place control of the 11th and 12th with the wife.

hindi: अच्छा पत्नी नहीं मानती है है नहीं तो यहां बैठा हमारा शुक्र यहीं बैठा हमारा राइट ब्रेन के अंदर स्त्री तत्व
says: If the wife does not listen, he turns inward: Venus, the feminine element in our right brain, sits inside us, so the thing to manage is our own feminine element rather than the wife.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled ('है है नहीं तो'); the meaning is a guess from the following saints example.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not place Venus in the right brain.

hindi: हम कितने शांति से कार करते हैं संत यह सीख जाते हैं शांत ड्रामा कर रहे हैं
says: Saints learn to act in calm; their calm is a conscious drama, a performed state and not a mood that simply happens to them.
ambiguity: 'कार करते हैं' is probably 'कार्य करते हैं' (work); no planet is named here but the point leads into Jupiter and Venus.
classical_check: Silent: it is spiritual advice, not a classical rule.

hindi: अगर क्रोध कर रहे हैं असंभव है कि वो क्रोध कर रहे हैं वो क्रोध ही कर रहे हैं लेकिन क्रोध नहीं कर रहे हैं
says: When a saint shows anger, it is impossible that he is really angry: he acts out anger and yet is not angry, so the display of anger is separate from the inner state.
ambiguity: The sentence is circular in the captions ('वो क्रोध ही कर रहे हैं लेकिन क्रोध नहीं कर रहे हैं'); the sense is that the outer act and inner state differ.
classical_check: Silent: it is a point of spiritual practice.

hindi: और वह भी देखते हुए साक्षी भाव में कर रहे हैं साक्षी भाव मींस उन्हें पता है हम क्रोध कर रहे हैं
says: They do this while watching, in sakshi bhava (witness mode), which he defines as knowing that you are angry as you are angry.
ambiguity: 'मींस' is the English word 'means'.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; sakshi bhava is a standard Vedantic term for the witness attitude.

hindi: उन्हें पता है हम प्रेम कर रहे हैं उन्हें पता है हम रो रहे हैं हम कष्ट में अगर हमें पता है तो हमारा साक्षी भावन है
says: The witness attitude holds for every state: they know when they love and when they cry, and if we are aware that we are in pain, we are in witness mode too.
ambiguity: 'साक्षी भावन' is a caption slip for 'sakshi bhav hai'.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish.

hindi: इसलिए बृहस्पति और शुक्र की मैत्री बहुत जरूरी है तो आपकी जन्म पत्रिका में जब जब ऐसी स्थिति बनती है कि बृहस्पति और शुक्र का मामला सेट ना रहे तो खराब
says: Therefore the friendship of Jupiter and Venus is essential, and whenever the Jupiter-Venus matter in the birth chart is not set (not in agreement), the result is bad.
cells_derived_method: The relation reads as set when each planet sits in the other's karaka house (Jupiter in the 7th, Venus in the 9th) or they aspect or join in friendly signs; it reads as not set when they are in 6/8 or 2/12 from each other or either is badly afflicted.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in its own sign in the 7th in Sagittarius sits in Venus's karaka house - the guru's calm settles the partner matter and the two planets are blended.
Derived: Venus in its own sign in the 9th in Libra sits in Jupiter's karaka house - fortune comes through the partner and refined dealings, so the two planets work together.

ambiguity: 'सेट ना रहे' is not defined: it could mean enmity, affliction, bad house relation or weak dignity of either planet.
classical_check: Agrees in outline that a bad Jupiter-Venus relation hurts marriage and luck; the exact test for 'set' is his own and not stated.

hindi: शुक्र का ऑटोमेटिक सातवां घर मालिक है यानी आपको साथी यहां से मिलता है
says: Venus is the automatic owner (natural significator) of the 7th house, which means your partner comes from here.
cells_derived_method: In the natural zodiac chart the 7th is Libra, a Venus sign, so the karaka also owns the sign there; in other lagnas the sign on the 7th changes the style of the partner Venus gives.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 7th in Libra (Venus's own sign) - the natural case, in which Venus owns both the house and the sign, so the partner is refined, balanced and a strong match.
Derived: 7th in Aries (Mars-ruled) - Venus as karaka sits uneasily over a Mars-ruled 7th, giving a forceful partner and a rougher partner dynamic.

ambiguity: 'ऑटोमेटिक मालिक' means natural ownership as in the Kaal Purush chart, where Libra is the 7th.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the natural karaka of the 7th house and of the wife.

hindi: बृहस्पति का ऑटोमेटिक नौवा घर मालिक है यानी
says: Jupiter is the automatic owner (natural significator) of the 9th house; the sentence ends here and the meaning, fortune, comes at the start of the next slice.
cells_derived_method: In the natural zodiac chart the 9th is Sagittarius, Jupiter's own sign, so the karaka also owns the sign there; in other lagnas the sign on the 9th changes how Jupiter's fortune shows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 9th in Sagittarius (Jupiter's own sign) - the natural case, in which Jupiter owns both house and sign, giving dharmic, teacher-guided luck.
Derived: 9th in Virgo (Mercury-ruled) - Jupiter as karaka sits over a Mercury-ruled house, so fortune comes through analysis and service rather than faith.

ambiguity: The sentence is cut mid-way ('यानी'); the continuation 'भाग्य' is in the next slice.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the natural karaka of the 9th house of dharma and fortune.

hindi: भाग्य यानी आपको पति मिलता है तो आपके जीवन में विशेष भाग्य का बदलाव आता है पत्नी मिलती है तो विशेष भाग्य का बदलाव आता है
says: Jupiter's house means fortune: when you get a husband or a wife, a special change of fortune comes into your life, so the arrival of the partner is a fortune turning point.
cells_derived_method: The kind of fortune change follows the sign on the 9th: fire signs give a rise in status and confidence, water signs give emotional shelter and spiritual turn.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 9th in Leo (Sun's own sign) - the partner's arrival lifts status, confidence and standing.
Derived: 9th in Pisces (Jupiter's own sign) - the partner's arrival brings emotional shelter and a spiritual or charitable turn.

ambiguity: No time or dasha is attached; it says the change comes 'when you get a partner', not at a particular age.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: the 7th-9th link (partner and luck) is classical; no timing is given by him.

hindi: इसलिए अपने जीवन साथी किसी भी स्वरूप में उससे कुत्ते खानी और लड़ाई मत करो
says: Do not squabble or fight with your life partner in any form, a conduct rule following from the Jupiter-Venus point that the partner brings the fortune change.
ambiguity: 'किसी भी स्वरूप में' covers spouse, live-in or any partner; 'कुत्ते खानी' means constant petty bickering.
classical_check: Silent: it is conduct advice, not a classical upaya.

hindi: इतना डिस्टेंस इतनी दूरी बनाकर रखो कि आप दूर जा सके अगर आप बहुत ही पास चले जाते हैं तो विस्फोट होने का खतरा है
says: Keep enough distance from the partner that you can still walk away; if you get too close there is a risk of explosion, so closeness must be measured.
ambiguity: 'विस्फोट' is figurative for a blow-up in the relationship; no chart condition is named.
classical_check: Silent: it is conduct advice.

hindi: क्योंकि यह उलट है बृहस्पति और शुक्र उलट है बहुत पास मत आओ
says: The reason for keeping distance: Jupiter and Venus are opposites of each other, so do not let them come too close, which may mean the two planets in close contact in a chart as well as the two partners in life.
cells_derived_method: If 'too close' means conjunction, the sign decides who dominates: in Venus's sign Venus leads and Jupiter's restraint gives way, in Jupiter's sign Jupiter leads and Venus's desires are channelled.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter and Venus together in the 2nd in Taurus (Venus's own sign) - Venus is at home and Jupiter is a guest, so the pull is towards comfort and money and Jupiter's restraint is overridden.
Derived: Jupiter and Venus together in the 9th in Sagittarius (Jupiter's own sign) - Jupiter is at home and leads, and Venus's desires are channelled into dharma and teachers.

ambiguity: It is unclear whether 'पास आना' means conjunction in the chart or closeness of the partners; the derived examples assume conjunction.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter and Venus are natural enemies in the Parashari scheme; classical texts do not call their conjunction explosive.

hindi: बृहस्पति का केसरी रंग है और यह मान के चला जाता है कि यही सनातन धर्म को देने वाला है
says: Jupiter's colour is saffron, and it is taken as given that Jupiter is the giver of Sanatan Dharma, so the planet stands for saffron and the dharmic tradition.
ambiguity: 'यह मान के चला जाता है' means it is generally accepted that Jupiter is the source of the dharma.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is the karaka of dharma and teachers; the usual colour for Jupiter is yellow, and saffron is close to it.

hindi: शुक्र जो है शुक्राचार्य शुक्र ही काबा में एस्टेब्लिश है काला संगे अश्वद वह शुक्र ही है
says: He claims that Venus (Shukracharya) is the planet established at the Kaaba and that the black stone (Sang-e-Aswad) is Venus; this is his own religion-linked claim, not from a Jyotish text.
ambiguity: 'काला संगे अश्वद' is the Black Stone (Hajar al-Aswad); the claim is about a symbolic identification, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent: no classical Jyotish text makes this identification.

hindi: इसलिए शुक्रवार को जुम्मा कहा जाता है शुक्रवार को ही सारी फिल्में रिलीज होती है शुक्रवार को ही कवि कविताएं लिखते हैं यह बातें बनी हुई है
says: Friday, Shukravar, is Jumma, the day of Muslim congregational prayer, and also the day films are released and poets write, so Venus's day is tied to worship, cinema and poetry.
ambiguity: 'ये बातें बनी हुई हैं' means these are established associations, and 'कवि कविताएं लिखते हैं' is a generalisation.
classical_check: Agrees that Friday belongs to Venus and that Venus is the karaka of the arts, cinema and poetry; the Jumma link is his own.

hindi: तो यह सारा का सारा जो कार्यक्रम है बुध के कारण से इस्लाम धर्म है जिसके अंतर्गत शुक्र की पूजा की जाती है इसलिए बुत परस्ती नहीं मानी जाती और यह
says: He says Islam falls under Venus, the religion in which Venus is worshipped, and so idol worship is not accepted in it; he links the faith to a planet and the lack of images to Venus.
ambiguity: 'बुध के कारण से' is probably a caption error (Mercury versus Venus), and the sentence trails into the next slice with 'और यह'.
classical_check: Silent: no classical Jyotish text links a world religion to a planet in this way.

hindi: दोनों एक दूसरे के शत्रु ये शत्रु ही रहेंगे शुक्र अधिक शत्रुता करेगा बृहस्पति से
says: The two, Jupiter and Venus with the traditions he linked to them, are enemies of each other and will stay so, and Venus holds the greater enmity towards Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'दोनों' continues from the earlier 'और यह'; it could mean the two planets or the two religions.
classical_check: Differs: in the Parashari natural relations Jupiter regards Venus as an enemy while Venus is neutral to Jupiter, which is the reverse of his claim that Venus is more hostile.

hindi: बृहस्पति इतनी शत्रुता करेगा नहीं बृहस्पति शत्रुता किसी से नहीं करता बृहस्पति कहता है बस अब मैं आ गया तो मैं बैठ गया हूं खत्म
says: Jupiter does not keep that much enmity; he bears enmity towards no one, and his attitude is 'now that I have arrived I am seated, that is it', so Jupiter is a settled, non-hostile planet.
ambiguity: 'मैं बैठ गया हूं' is Jupiter speaking in his own voice, used as an image of settled contentment.
classical_check: Differs in detail: classical texts list Mercury and Venus as Jupiter's enemies; the 'no enmity' claim describes his temperament.

hindi: इसलिए जुपिटर का स्वभाव इस प्रकार है कि मेरे आगे किसी की नहीं चलेगी वो गुरु है बहुत ताकतवर ग्रह है
says: Jupiter's nature is such that nobody's will prevails in front of him: he is the guru and a very powerful planet whose authority others yield to.
ambiguity: 'मेरे आगे किसी की नहीं चलेगी' is Jupiter speaking, an image of his authority; it is not a strength measure.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is the guru and a strongly benefic planet; it is silent on 'no one prevails against him'.

hindi: उसके आगे अंतरिक्ष का हम फोटोग्राफ देखें सूर्य उसको भी खींच रहा है उसकी भी नहीं चलती सूर्य भी आके आसन देता है महाराज बैठो
says: In space photographs even the Sun is shown being pulled by Jupiter, so the Sun's will does not prevail either, and the Sun himself comes and offers Jupiter a seat saying 'sit, maharaj'.
ambiguity: The 'photographs' refer to the Sun's wobble around the Sun-Jupiter barycentre; 'आसन देता है' is a respectful image.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts keep the Sun as the king of the planets and Jupiter as the minister-guru; this ranking of Jupiter above the Sun is his own.

hindi: चंद्रमा कहता उच चंद्रमा कौन है शिव सदाशिव शिव भी गुरु को प्रणाम करते हैं
says: The Moon, whom he identifies with Shiva (Sadashiv), tells Jupiter 'exalted' and Shiva himself bows to the guru, so Jupiter is honoured even by Shiva and is given the Moon's exaltation.
cells_derived_method: The Moon's own sign Cancer is the sign where Jupiter is exalted, so Jupiter placed there is honoured; the house it falls in shows where the guru's honour acts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in the 4th in Cancer - the guru is honoured in the Moon's own sign, giving a blessed home life, strong mother-bond and inner peace.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in the 10th in Cancer - an honoured career in teaching, counselling or advising, with public respect.

ambiguity: 'उच' is garbled (probably 'ucch', exalted, or 'ooncha'); he does not say Cancer aloud; the exaltation link is read from the classical rule.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is exalted in Cancer, the Moon's sign; calling the Moon Shiva is his own link.

gist: Encouragement to students: getting knowledge is essential, it does not matter if it does not sink in at once, they may not have used or implemented it yet, just keep going.
Children learn swimming after many tries; with time people always learn because the brain has mirror neurons.

hindi: ऑटोमेटिक होता है शुक्र स्त्री है जब संतान उत्पत्ति करती है तो चंद्रमा माता बन जाती है और ज्यादा प्रमोशन हो जाती है उसकी
says: Venus stands for the woman as wife. When she gives birth to a child she automatically turns into the Moon, the mother, and he calls that a bigger promotion than being Venus.
ambiguity: 'ऑटोमेटिक होता है' points back to something said before this slice, so what exactly is automatic is not fully visible.
classical_check: Venus as wife/women and Moon as mother are standard karakas; the idea that a woman moves from Venus to Moon status with childbirth is his own framing, not in the classics.

hindi: यानी थर्ड आई पर चले जाते हैं थर्ड आई पर चंद्रमा है शुक्र हृदय प है
says: Maps the two planets to body centres: the Moon sits at the third eye (mind, ajna level) and Venus sits at the heart. Becoming a mother lifts a woman from the heart level (Venus) up to the third-eye level (Moon).
ambiguity: 'हृदय प' is cut off, probably 'हृदय पर' (at the heart). 'चले जाते हैं' could mean the woman moves up or only her attention moves up.
classical_check: Silent in BPHS and Saravali; planet-to-chakra maps are modern and differ between teachers.

gist: Rhetorical question to the audience: is the Moon (mother) or Venus (wife) more important; he says both are hugely important and asks which one you could drop.

hindi: बृहस्पति कौन है लीवर
says: Jupiter is the planet of the liver: the liver in the body is read through Jupiter.
cells_derived_method: Derived: how strong Jupiter is by sign (exalted in Cancer, own in Sagittarius and Pisces, debilitated in Capricorn) and which house it sits in (6th and 8th are disease and chronic-trouble houses) decide how the liver karaka is read. Tradition tendency only, not a diagnosis.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn and sitting in the 6th house of disease; the liver karaka is weak and placed in the illness house, a tradition tendency toward liver or fat trouble (not a diagnosis).
Derived: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius on the 1st house (the body); the liver karaka is strong and on the body house, a tradition tendency toward a robust liver.

classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the classical karaka of the liver and body fat (medas).

gist: Sets up a question: many people have liver trouble, fatty liver is everywhere, why does it happen? The answer follows in the next sentences.

hindi: बृहस्पति कौन है संत वो कहता आटा घोल के पी जाएंगे ऐसा स्वभाव है
says: Jupiter is the saint (sant). His nature is austere contentment: he would be happy just drinking flour stirred in water and wants nothing rich.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the classical karaka of sages, renunciates, dharma and contentment.

hindi: आपके जिंदगी के अंदर आप क्या करते हैं या तला हुआ खाएंगे भाई समोसे दे दे कचौड़ी दे दे
says: In contrast to the saint, the ordinary person in daily life keeps asking for fried snacks such as samosa and kachori. This craving for rich food is the taste side of Venus working against Jupiter's austerity.
ambiguity: He does not name Venus in this sentence; the link to taste and Venus is made in the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent; Venus as taste and indulgence is classical, the fried-food example is his own.

gist: Aside to the room: the kachori has just arrived, he says he loves kachori and will eat it too.

hindi: और यह खाके आपने अपने शरीर के अंदर डाले और यह लेकर आप क्या हुए आप लिप्त हो गए लिप्त वाह आपका ब्रहस्पति वीक हो गया
says: After eating kachori, samosa and chole bhature you become 'lipt', stuck in indulgence. That attachment is what makes your Jupiter weak.
ambiguity: 'लिप्त' means attached or smeared with; Venus is not named here, the Venus link is inferred from the following chunk.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter weakened by Venus-type indulgence is his framing, not a classical rule.

hindi: बृहस्पति कौन था लीवर आपको फैटी लीवर होगा ग्रेड वन तो देगा ही देगा
says: Medical-type claim, flagged and not to be used as a diagnosis rule: because indulgence has weakened Jupiter, the liver planet, he says you will certainly get at least grade-1 fatty liver.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the same weak-Jupiter reading would be stronger when Jupiter is debilitated or afflicted in a house tied to food and intake. Tradition tendency only, not a diagnosis.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 2nd house (food and intake); rich-food habits hit the liver karaka hardest, a tradition tendency and not a diagnosis.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 9th house; the liver karaka is strong, so his weakening-by-indulgence warning is blunted and the tendency is mild.

ambiguity: The sentence runs across the chunk boundary at 58:08 ('ग्रेड वन तो' / 'देगा ही देगा').
classical_check: Silent on fatty liver; Jupiter as liver karaka is classical but a named disease grade is modern.

hindi: इसलिए अक्सर लोगों को तला हुआ छोड़ने को डॉक्टर कहता है वो एक्चुअली क्या छोड़ता है शुक्र छोड़ दो
says: When a doctor tells people to give up fried food, what is actually being given up is Venus. Cutting fried food is cutting Venus, which takes the load off Jupiter's liver.
ambiguity: 'शुक्र छोड़ दो' is an instruction to give up Venus-type pleasures, not a literal planet remedy.
classical_check: Silent; this is his reading of a dietary instruction in planet terms.

hindi: शुक्र स्वाद पैसा
says: Venus is taste (the pleasure of the tongue) and money.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Venus signifies enjoyment, luxuries and wealth, but the BPHS planet-taste list gives Venus sour and Jupiter sweet, so 'Venus = taste' is his broader sense of indulgence.

hindi: सारा का सारा साउथ ईस्ट का एरिया हमारे घर के अंदर शुक्र के कमांड में
says: Vastu link: the whole south-east zone of the house is under Venus's command.
classical_check: Agrees with Vastu texts, which give the south-east (Agneya) corner to Venus.

hindi: साउथ ईस्ट क्या देता है अग्नि अग्नि तत्व क्या देता है फायर पैसा फायर
says: The south-east corner gives agni, the fire element, and he ties that fire to money.
ambiguity: 'पैसा' could be the answer to what fire gives (fire brings money) or a stray aside; the caption is clipped.
classical_check: The south-east as the fire corner is classical Vastu; fire giving money is his own link.

gist: Movie joke 'Pushpa part two' (the 'fire hai main' line) used to play on the word fire.

hindi: वो फायर देता है फायर देता है उस फायर की वजह से ही शुक्र पकड़ता है
says: Because the south-east supplies fire, Venus gets its grip: Venus takes hold and works through that fire element.
ambiguity: 'शुक्र पकड़ता है' could mean Venus gets power, or that Venus clings and attaches. The caption does not settle it.
classical_check: Silent; Venus as a fire-driven planet is not classical (Venus is a watery planet in most texts).

hindi: यानी आप अपने जीवन में जब मोह से परे होते हैं मस्ती में होते हैं आपका लीवर रॉकेट की तरह काम करता है
says: When you live free of moh (attachment) and in a carefree, blissful mood, your liver, Jupiter's organ, works like a rocket. Detachment from Venus-type pleasure strengthens Jupiter.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter as detachment and wisdom is classical, the liver-performance claim is his.

hindi: और लीवर अकेला ऑर्गन है जो सब कुछ एक काट के दूसरे के लगा लो सब कुछ चलाता है शरीर में कोलेस्ट्रॉल लीवर में बनता है
says: Physiology claim, flagged as medical and not an engine rule: the liver is the one organ that keeps everything in the body running, and cholesterol is made in the liver.
ambiguity: The middle phrase 'एक काट के दूसरे के लगा लो' is colloquial and loosely means one can swap or compensate, with the liver still running all of it.
classical_check: Silent; liver making cholesterol is mainstream physiology, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: इस चक्कर में ना रहे कि हार्ट कुछ करता है उसके लिए अगर आपको कोलेस्ट्रॉल की प्रॉब्लम है तो हो मेडिसिन
says: Medical advice, flagged: do not assume the heart is the cause of a cholesterol problem; the cause sits in the liver, so look there.
ambiguity: 'हो मेडिसिन' is garbled (could be 'homeo medicine' or 'ho medicine'), and the sentence is cut off.
classical_check: Silent; this is lay medical opinion, not Jyotish.

hindi: क्यों बता रहा हूं मैं तो आप लीवर की दवाई ले लिप 52 होती है व साधारण तौर पे लिप 52 ले वह आपके कोलेस्ट्रॉल को ठीक करेगी
says: Medical remedy, flagged and not a diagnosis rule: for a cholesterol problem take a liver medicine such as Liv.52, which he says will fix the cholesterol.
ambiguity: 'लिप 52' is the caption's spelling of the Ayurvedic product Liv.52.
classical_check: Silent; this is a product recommendation, not a Jyotish remedy.

gist: Says that English-language (allopathic) cholesterol drugs will ruin you and create dependence, and prefers homeopathic medicines. This is a medical opinion, not astrology.
'एक्चुअली लिवर इज द कल्प्राज' - the last word is garbled (maybe 'kalp raj' or 'king'); possibly praising the liver as the chief organ, but the caption cannot confirm it.

hindi: त्याग दें जिस व्यक्ति ने साधारण रूप में जीवन का स्वाद त्याग दिया कि छोड़ो क्या रखा है उसको फैटी लीवर नहीं होगा
says: Medical-type claim, flagged: a person who has ordinarily given up the taste of life ('leave it, what is in it') will not get fatty liver, because the Venus load on Jupiter is gone.
ambiguity: 'त्याग दें' at the start is the tail of the previous thought and its subject is unclear.
classical_check: Silent; renunciation easing Jupiter's burden is his framing, not a classical rule.

hindi: वह दारू पीपी के निहाल हो जाए उसको फैटी लीवर नहीं होगा
says: Flagged, not safe advice: he claims the detached renunciate would still not get fatty liver even if he drank liquor until blissed out, so the protection comes from detachment and not from what is consumed.
ambiguity: 'वह' refers to the renunciate of the previous sentence. The claim sits awkwardly with the next sentence, which calls liquor the most dangerous thing.
classical_check: Silent; this sits uneasily beside his own next line that liquor is most dangerous, so it is an internal tension.

hindi: दारू सबसे खत नाक मानी जाती है दारू क्या है राहु
says: Liquor is regarded as the most dangerous thing for the liver, and liquor is Rahu.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu is the classical karaka of intoxicants, liquor and poisons.

hindi: बृहस्पति को कौन हिला सकता है सूर्य को ग्रहण कौन लगा सकता है इतना विशाल सूर्य सिर्फ राहु
says: Only Rahu can shake Jupiter, and only Rahu can eclipse something as huge as the Sun. Rahu is the one planet strong enough to afflict both.
cells_derived_method: Not cell-specific as stated; the cell-level readings come in the Sun-Rahu and Jupiter-Rahu rows that follow.
classical_check: Rahu eclipsing the Sun (grahan yoga) and Rahu with Jupiter (guru-chandala) are classical-later ideas; 'only Rahu' is overstated, since Saturn and Mars also afflict both and he himself names Saturn a few lines later.

hindi: राहु कहां है राहु है पितर
says: Rahu is the pitar, the ancestors; in his scheme Rahu stands for the ancestral line.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the house Rahu sits in shows where ancestor-linked disturbance is felt, and the sign nature adds the flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in the 9th house (father, dharma, ancestors) in Gemini; with Rahu as pitar, ancestor-linked disturbance shows up in luck and the dharma side of life.
Derived: Rahu in the 4th house (home, mother, roots) in Libra; ancestor-linked unrest shows in the ancestral home and inherited property.

ambiguity: 'राहु कहां है' is a rhetorical question and the answer is 'pitar'.
classical_check: Differs: Parashari reads ancestors and father from the Sun and the 9th house, with Ketu for past lineage; Rahu as pitar is a Lal Kitab and popular reading.

hindi: कुछ लोग भगवान की पूजा कर कर के मर जाते हैं भगवान सुनता नहीं क्योंकि पितर दोष होता है
says: Some people keep worshipping God all their lives and die without an answer, because pitra dosha (ancestor affliction) is blocking the worship. Worship of deities does not work until the ancestors are set right.
classical_check: Pitra dosha is a classical-later concept (Sun or 9th affected by Rahu or Saturn); the claim that it blocks all worship is popular tradition.

hindi: पि इससे भी बड़े हैं यानी सूर्य को भी ग्रहण लगाता है
says: The ancestors (Rahu's domain) rank above even the gods one worships, since Rahu can put an eclipse on the Sun itself.
ambiguity: 'पि' is 'पितर' clipped, and what 'इससे' refers to (God, the worship, or the Sun) is unclear.
