classical_check: Silent; ranking ancestors above deities is his own reasoning from the eclipse image.

hindi: यदि सूर्य के साथ राहु है तो सूर्य की शक्ति की बैंड बजा देता है
says: If Rahu sits with the Sun it wrecks the Sun's strength; the conjunction is an eclipse on the Sun.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the house the pair sits in decides which Sun topic is eclipsed (1st self, 9th father, 10th career), and the Sun's sign dignity decides how much strength is left to lose.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 10th (career, authority) with Rahu; the exalted strength is dimmed, so status comes with obstruction and doubts about reputation.
Derived: Sun in its own sign Leo on the 1st house with Rahu; self, vitality and confidence are eclipsed, so the person feels hidden or misread despite ability.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 9th (father, dharma) with Rahu; doubly afflicted, which fits his pitra-dosha reading of the father's line and blocked worship.

classical_check: Agrees: the Sun-Rahu conjunction (grahan yoga) is a classical-later affliction of the Sun.

gist: 'और बृहस्पति को भी राहु ही तंग कर सकता है' - repeats that only Rahu can trouble Jupiter, already said two sentences earlier.

hindi: लिवर को तंग कौन कर रहा है राहु
says: Medical-type claim, flagged: whoever is troubling the liver, the culprit is Rahu, because Rahu is the planet that afflicts Jupiter and so the liver.
cells_derived_method: Derived: read Rahu with or aspecting Jupiter, then let the house and Jupiter's sign dignity decide how hard the liver karaka is hit. Tradition tendency only, not a diagnosis.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu with Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 6th house of disease; a tradition tendency of liver strain, not a diagnosis.
Derived: Rahu with Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 9th house; strong Jupiter resists, Rahu's trouble is blunted, and 9th-house grace of ancestors helps.
Derived: Rahu with Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 2nd house of food and intake; indulgent eating and drinking strain the liver karaka most, a tendency only.

classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu with Jupiter (guru-chandala) is a classical-later affliction; the liver link is his.

hindi: अगर पित्रों की कृपा है पि कहां है पांचवे घर में
says: The ancestors (pitr) are read from the 5th house: if there is grace from the ancestors, it lives in the 5th.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the planet in the 5th and the sign it sits in decide whether the ancestors' grace is strong or afflicted.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu (his pitar) in the 5th house in the Sun's sign Leo; ancestor affliction at its sharpest, read on children and past merit.
Derived: Jupiter in its own sign Pisces in the 5th; ancestors' grace is strong and protective.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 5th; lineage duty and karmic debt are carried steadily, with delay but not denial.

ambiguity: 'अगर पित्रों की कृपा है' is an unfinished clause; 'पि' is 'पितर' clipped.
classical_check: Differs: Parashari reads ancestors and father from the 9th house and the Sun; the 5th is purva-punya (past merit) and lineage through children.

hindi: बृहस्पति का मालिक कौन है नौवा नौवे से पांचवे पर दृष्टि हमेशा रहेगी बृहस्पति की चाहे बृहस्पति यहां है यहां है यहां है
says: Jupiter is the lord of the 9th, and from the 9th its aspect always falls on the 5th, wherever Jupiter itself sits. So Jupiter always keeps a hand on the 5th house of ancestors.
cells_derived_method: Derived: in a real chart Jupiter aspects the 5th house only when it sits in house 1 (5th aspect), house 11 (7th aspect) or house 9 (9th aspect). He may instead mean the natural zodiac, where Jupiter's sign Sagittarius (sign 9) looks at Leo (sign 5).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius on the 1st house throws its 5th aspect onto the 5th house, so the claim holds.
Derived: Jupiter in Libra in the 11th throws its 7th aspect onto the 5th house, so the claim holds.
Derived: Jupiter in Leo in the 9th throws its 9th aspect onto the 5th house, so the claim holds.
Derived: debilitated Jupiter in the 2nd looks at the 6th, 8th and 10th, not the 5th, so 'always, wherever Jupiter is' fails as a placement rule.

ambiguity: 'नौवा' may mean Jupiter lords the 9th (natural zodiac, Sagittarius) or that Jupiter has the 9th aspect; 'यहां है' three times is gesture, so the claim 'wherever Jupiter sits' is unclear.
classical_check: Jupiter's 5th, 7th and 9th aspects are classical; 'always aspects the 5th from anywhere' is not true for placements, only for the natural-zodiac sign link.

hindi: पित्रों से संबंध रहेगा इसलिए आप अगर अपने जीवन में पित कृपा लेते रहते हैं
says: Because Jupiter keeps a link to the ancestors' house, the tie with the ancestors stays, so you should keep receiving pitr kripa, the ancestors' grace, throughout life.
ambiguity: 'पित कृपा' is 'पितृ कृपा' clipped; the sentence continues into the Rahu consumables line.
classical_check: Honouring ancestors (shraddha, tarpan) is a classical remedy; the Jupiter-link logic is his.

hindi: आप राहु दारू चाय कॉफी सब राहु है पी पी के अति मचा देंगे
says: Liquor, tea and coffee all belong to Rahu; people drink them endlessly and make a mess of themselves.
ambiguity: The opening 'आप राहु' reads as a continuation of the 'pitr kripa' sentence, so Rahu here is his consumables list.
classical_check: Rahu as the karaka of intoxicants is classical; tea and coffee as Rahu is a modern extension.

gist: Disclaimer to the room: he is not telling anyone to go and drink; understand this part carefully and let go of the rest if it does not land.

hindi: आपके लीवर में कुछ नहीं होगा लीवर में कुछ नहीं होगा मींस आपको कृपा खत्म नहीं होगी
says: Medical-type claim, flagged: if the ancestors' grace stays intact, nothing will happen to your liver even with Rahu substances around, which he explains as meaning the grace does not run out.
ambiguity: 'कृपा खत्म नहीं होगी' could refer to the ancestors' grace or to Jupiter's grace.
classical_check: Silent; protection of the liver by ancestor grace is his own claim.

hindi: लिवर खराब होता है सड़ने से कुड़ने से लड़ने से बहस करने से बृहस्पति दोष में आता है जब आप सड़ते हैं कुड़ते हैं चिल्ला के बोलते हैं
says: Liver damage comes from fretting, seething, quarrelling and arguing: Jupiter is afflicted whenever you burn inside, grumble or speak by shouting. A behaviour-based way Jupiter goes bad, flagged as medical-type.
classical_check: Silent; anger and argument harming Jupiter is his behavioural reading, not classical.

hindi: जिस जिस बच्चे के स्वभाव में है कि चिल्ला के बोलने लगा है ये टेस्टोस्टरॉन जोर मार रहा है टेस्टोस्टेरोन क्या है जो यंग एज में पुरुष बनाता है लड़के को और वो क्या है शुक्र
says: Any child who has started talking loudly is feeling testosterone surge. Testosterone is what turns a boy into a man in young age, and that force is Venus.
classical_check: Silent; mapping a modern hormone to Venus is his own, though Venus as virility and puberty is classical.

hindi: शुक्राणु बनते हैं उससे स्पर्म सीमन बनता है
says: Shukra the planet is also shukra the body fluid: sperm and semen are made by this same Venus force.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the classical karaka of semen and the reproductive fluid (shukra dhatu).

hindi: यानी शुक्र पावर पकड़ रहा है तो बृहस्पति डिस्टर्ब होता है इसलिए बृहस्पति क्या करता चिल्लाता है लड़के चिल्लाते हैं यंग एज में मम्मी ये नहीं खाऊंगा पापा क्या कर रहे हो
says: When Venus gains power, Jupiter gets disturbed, and a disturbed Jupiter shouts. That is why teenage boys shout at their parents over food and everything else.
classical_check: Silent; Venus rising and disturbing Jupiter in adolescence is his own mapping.

gist: Anecdote setup: many parents come to him saying their son has started shouting a lot. It runs on into the next chunk.

hindi: अरे वो चिल्ला नहीं रहा अभी अभी टेरन जोर मार रहा है वो बात ही कर रहा है आपको लग रहा है चिल्ला रहा है वो चिल्ला नहीं रहा
says: His reply to the worried parents: the son is not really shouting, testosterone is surging in him and he is simply talking. Parents hear it as shouting, so adolescent loudness should not be read as defiance.
ambiguity: 'टेरन' is a garbled 'टेस्टोस्टेरोन'.
classical_check: Silent; this is a parenting application of his Venus-rising idea, not a classical rule.

gist: Joke that men shout too, and that wives say the husband seems too cold lately so she will get him fired up a bit; the caption word 'बाहु' is garbled.

hindi: तो वो टेस्टोस्टेरोन बनता है पंप अप होता है पुरुष के अंतर्गत और वही शुक्र है वही भोग है
says: The testosterone that gets pumped up inside a man is Venus itself, and equally it is bhoga, the drive toward enjoyment.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus as bhoga and kama (enjoyment, desire) is classical.

hindi: यही विलासिता और भोग संत में समाप्त होती है या उसके अंदर कंट्रोल में होती है
says: In a saint, this luxury-seeking and enjoyment either ends or stays under control; Jupiter, the saint planet, governs Venus's bhoga.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter as the restrainer of Venus is his framing, though Jupiter as renunciation versus Venus as indulgence is classical.

hindi: तंत्र की क्रिया के अंदर तंत्र मींस सब मानसिकता के द्वारा शरीर का कार्य कराना
says: Defines tantra as getting the body's work done through the mind: the mental state leads and the body follows.
classical_check: Differs: classically 'tantra' means a body of texts and techniques (tan, to extend; tra, tool), not specifically mind-over-body; this is his working definition.

hindi: तांत्रिक सेक्स एक ऐसी चीज है जिसके अंतर्गत बृहस्पति के कंट्रोल्ड एनवायरमेंट में शुक्र का कार्य होता है तब संत पैदा होते हैं
says: Tantric union, he says, is Venus's work carried out inside a Jupiter-controlled setting (intent and mind governed); children conceived that way are born as saints.
classical_check: Silent in Parashari texts; the idea that the parents' state at conception shapes the child echoes the garbhadhan rite, but this tantric framing is his.

gist: Osho had ten or more brothers and sisters, yet only one became Osho; he asks why. It is a hook for the conception-state idea that follows.

Cites Yogananda's Autobiography of a Yogi: the swami says his mother once wished to approach conception and the child was born from that act; he asks what state of mind they were in. Anecdote, the principle comes in the next sentence.

hindi: तांत्रिक सेक्स के अंतर्गत हम शिव और पार्वती का आवाहन करते हैं उसके पश्चात होता है साइंटिस्ट पैदा होते हैं
says: In tantric union the couple invokes Shiva and Parvati first, and gifted children such as scientists are born after that. The divine state invoked at conception sets the child's nature.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the chunk boundary at 1:02:06; 'उसके पश्चात होता है' has a word missing before 'साइंटिस्ट'.
classical_check: Silent; invoking deities at conception is a tantric practice, not a Parashari rule.

hindi: या तो गलती से ऐसा हो जाता है तो बहुत रॉकेट जैसे बच्चे पैदा होते हैं जो चमत्कार करते हैं
says: Even when this state comes about by accident, without planning, very rocket-like children are born who do miracles.
ambiguity: 'या तो गलती से' is the tail of an either-or whose first half is the deliberate invocation in the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent; a testable-sounding claim about exceptional children with no classical support.

gist: Exhortation: if these practices were learned and understood, life would go very far.

hindi: आप इन दो ग्रहों के मात्र संयोग से यानी पितृ कृपा से और इससे कितना कुछ सेट कर लेते हो आप
says: Just by the combination of these two planets, which he equates with pitr kripa (the ancestors' grace), you set right a great deal in life.
ambiguity: 'इन दो ग्रहों' is not named: it could be Jupiter and Rahu (the ancestors' pair he built earlier), or Jupiter and Venus (the tantra pair); the phrase 'पितृ कृपा' favours Jupiter and Rahu.
classical_check: Silent; the claim is a general promise with no classical rule behind it.

hindi: राहु कुछ नहीं बिगाड़ पाता शनि कुछ नहीं बिगाड़ पाता वह बिगाड़ने आते हैं लेकिन वो देखते हैं यार गेट पर तो बृहस्पति खड़ा है
says: For such a person Rahu and Saturn cannot spoil anything: they arrive to spoil, see Jupiter standing guard at the gate, and turn back.
cells_derived_method: Derived: 'the gate' is a Vastu direction and not a chart house, so the nearest chart reading is a strong Jupiter on the 1st house (head, the gate of the body) or in the 9th (grace); a weak or debilitated Jupiter leaves the gate unguarded.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in its own sign Pisces on the 1st house stands guard at the head; Rahu and Saturn troubles are turned back in the tradition reading.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn on the 1st house; the guard is weak, so Rahu and Saturn get through.
Derived: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius in the 9th; guru and ancestors' grace protect, so Rahu and Saturn effects stay mild.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit that a strong Jupiter shields against malefics; 'cannot spoil anything' is overstated.

hindi: गेट कौन है घर का गेट नॉर्थ ईस्ट होता है हमारे खोपड़ी का गेट नॉर्थ ईस्ट है
says: The gate of a house is its north-east, and likewise the gate of our skull is the north-east: the entrance of the head sits in that corner.
classical_check: Agrees with Vastu: the Vastu Purusha's head lies in the north-east and the north-east is the preferred entrance.

hindi: और नॉर्थ ईस्ट का स्थान है ही बृहस्पति के पास
says: The north-east place belongs to Jupiter; it is Jupiter's own direction.
classical_check: Agrees: Vastu texts give the north-east (Ishanya) to Jupiter.

hindi: इसलिए ज्ञान आता है नहीं आता ज्ञान के बीच रहो सत्संग एक ऐसी प्रक्रिया है जो जीवन बदल देती है
says: Because the north-east gate is Jupiter's, knowledge comes in; if it does not come by itself, live among knowledge and in satsang, which he calls a process that changes your life.
ambiguity: 'नहीं आता' is missing its subject; it most likely means 'if knowledge does not come'.
classical_check: Agrees: satsang, guru seva and scripture study are classical Jupiter remedies.

hindi: आपका जीवन कमाल का हो जाता है आप इतने क्लोज हो जाते हैं ईश्वर के आप इमेजिन नहीं कर सकते आपके जीवन की स्थिति परमात्मा के साथ स साथ साथ चलती है
says: The result of satsang: life turns remarkable and you become so close to God that you cannot imagine it; your life's condition moves hand in hand with the Paramatma.
classical_check: Silent; a devotional promise, not a measurable Jyotish rule.

gist: Opens a story ('a lovely story, once a mother...'); the batch ends mid-sentence.
Story continues from the previous chunk: the mother brings a Laddu Gopal (baby Krishna idol) home, and the house has a small boy, Tinku.
She tells Tinku they have got Laddu Gopal; he asks who this is and she answers that it is God.
Tinku asks what the idol will do; she says it will sit in the main place and from now on nothing is eaten until it has been fed first.
Tinku fears the idol will eat his food too; his mother scolds him that one does not talk about God like that, and the little boy is in a real dilemma.
That evening the mother makes laddus and tells Tinku to offer them first; he protests that earlier she gave them to him and now this one arrives to eat them.
She repeats that it is God and goes to offer the bhog; Tinku watches anxiously to see how many laddus go missing, and none do.
Tinku decides he can put up with the idol and keep it in the house, since it left the laddus alone he calls it sensible; one caption phrase about throwing it out in the evening is garbled.
Tinku concludes the idol has at least a little sense.
He falls asleep after eating the laddus as prasad, then frets that Laddu Gopal ate them first and so they are leftovers, which he calls unfair.
He notices his mother keeps calling the idol 'Kana' and offering it money, and wrongly decides she must owe it money, some lending and borrowing business.
Next day before leaving for school he is told to bow to Laddu Gopal; he objects that he has already touched his mother's feet and now must touch the idol's too, and she insists it is God.
He grumbles that doing this every day is beyond him but obeys for today; the same drama repeats for three or four days.
Tinku develops open hostility toward the idol, scolds 'Kana' for his manners and calls the whole situation a big problem.
His mother keeps handing him chores for the idol: take off its clothes, put them back on, clean its utensils.
He rants at the idol that he does its work daily while it never does his: the physics teacher scolds him, he cannot write English, so let the idol do his homework.
Four or five days later the mother says her leg hurts but she must make halwa as bhog for God, and tells Tinku to fetch flour.
Tinku makes excuses over fetching the flour; the mother insists God must be hungry, and he mutters that the idol never eats anything and is just putting on a show.
Tinku grumbles about how much money his mother has spent on the idol and why she does not throw it out of the house, then takes the bag and goes off sulking.
Before leaving he talks to the idol while his mother sits inside: enough drama, you do no work and just lie here, and if you want to stay in this house you must do something.
He complains he would have to fetch the idol's flour and then eat the idol's leftovers, says the idol must behave, and heads out for the errand.
At the flour mill he finds Krishna himself, covered in flour, lifting the sack and bringing it over (the sentence finishes in the next chunk).
Krishna hands over the ground flour; Tinku says that was quick and well done, believes his threat worked on the idol, and says at least this is some work.
Krishna tells him to hurry off before Amma sees; at home Tinku puts the sack beside the idol and goes inside to play.
Amma later catches his ear and asks what mischief he did; he says he only brought the flour, and she asks why Kana's clothes are smeared with it.
Tinku says he only left the sack nearby and it must have blown over; he then remembers Krishna got floured while lifting it, and scolds the idol for not dusting off its clothes.
He tells the idol it must work without letting Amma find out or he will be beaten; two days later Amma sends him for a bucket of water (the purpose is stated in the next chunk).
The water is needed to wash the idol's utensils and give it a bath.
Tinku grumbles to the idol that another job has come up, says he brought the flour once but this is beyond him, and tells it to arrange the water itself next time, though he will bring it today.
At the pond he finds Krishna soaked and carrying a full bucket, who hands it over and says to hurry or there will be big trouble.
Tinku accepts, calling the idol a stubborn good-for-nothing who still gets the work done; at home he puts the bucket down and sees all of Krishna's clothes wet, as if bathed.
Amma arrives before he can explain and scolds him for throwing water on Kana over a small chore, saying she will not tolerate it.
Tinku says it was a mistake, unable to tell the truth that Krishna brought the water, since Amma would beat him if he said the idol did the work.
Two days later Amma says it has turned very cold and tells him to fetch firewood from the forest; his reply continues in the next chunk.
He agrees cheerfully and goes to the forest, calls 'Kana' to come on duty and says the logs are too big for him to lift together.
Amma, whose leg has eased, goes indoors; Tinku walks slowly into the forest and finds Krishna already walking ahead carrying the bundle of wood.
Tinku urges Krishna along; the two argue over who carries the load, with Krishna saying it is too heavy and Tinku worrying that Amma will see.
Krishna jokes that his shoulders are tiny while Tinku, fattened by eating laddus, is strong enough to carry it.
At home Amma, finding Tinku very late, goes outside, sees the idol is gone, and suspects the boy has made it disappear.
Already upset by the earlier flour and water incidents, she runs toward the forest and on the way sees Krishna walking behind carrying the bundle.
Krishna is taking tiny steps and being mischievous; he sees Amma, is stunned and thinks she will beat him; the batch ends mid-sentence.
End of the Krishna story: Amma lies down at the idol's feet and addresses Krishna; the words that follow are garbled in the caption.
Punchline: Krishna replies that everyone treated him as God but this boy alone treated him as his own, and that he would work for Amma too if she gave him that same standing.
Moral drawn from the story: we do not know how to make Krishna our own, and it takes a very high condition in life to know that God will work for you.
To receive his grace you must make him your own, without grovelling at his feet or becoming his slave.
Cites Arjuna, for whom Krishna did every kind of work, and says learning this relationship is very important.
Every kind of knowledge can come into your life if you ask him for grace; giving knowledge is his job, but we do not know how to take it.
Announces a rough rehearsal of the houses one by one: first, second, third, fourth, fifth and so on.

hindi: यह एसेंडेंट कहते हैं इसको लग्न धन भाव पराक्रम
says: Gives names to the first three houses in order: the 1st is the ascendant, called lagna; the 2nd is the dhana bhava (house of wealth); the 3rd is parakram (courage and effort).
ambiguity: He does not say 'first, second, third' next to each name; the mapping follows the order of his list, and the caption runs the names together.
classical_check: Agrees: lagna, dhana and parakrama are the standard names of houses 1, 2 and 3.

hindi: कितना हिम्मती है मनुष्य अगर तीसरा भाव पराक्रम देता है
says: The 3rd house gives parakram: it shows how courageous and bold the person is.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the sign on the 3rd house colours the style of courage (fire signs bold, earth signs steady, air signs verbal, water signs emotional).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries, Mars's own bold sign, on the 3rd house; courage and effort show up as quick, direct and even impulsive action.
Derived: Taurus on the 3rd house; effort is steady but slow and comfort-seeking, and courage appears mainly when security is not at risk.

ambiguity: The sentence runs across the chunk boundary at 1:10:06 ('पराक्रम' / 'देता है').
classical_check: Agrees: the 3rd house (parakrama bhava) rules courage, valour and effort.

hindi: और मनुष्य का तीसरा भाव बढ़िया नहीं है कुंडली में ग्रह सेट नहीं तो लोग कहते हैं तुम पराक्रमी क्यों नहीं मेहनती क्यों नहीं
says: If a person's 3rd house is poor because the planets are not well set, people ask why he is not brave or hard-working. The lack is the chart's condition and not his character.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the sign on a weakened 3rd house decides what the lack looks like to onlookers.

classical_check: Silent in classical remedy lists; instruments as a 5th-house (music and arts) remedy is his own.

hindi: अल्ट की ब्लेसिंग्स पित्र दोष विजडम
says: More 5th-house topics: blessings (the word before it is garbled), pitr dosha and wisdom.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the sign on the 5th house colours how ancestors' blessing and wisdom show.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo, the Sun's sign, on the 5th house ties the 5th to the father's line, so pitr dosha shows through the Sun and father; wisdom comes with pride.
Derived: Pisces on the 5th house; wisdom is intuitive and devotional, and blessings arrive through gurus and prayer.

ambiguity: 'अल्ट' is garbled; it is most likely 'ancestors' (as pitr dosha follows), but it could also be an English word clipped by the captioner.
classical_check: Repeats his earlier 5th-house ancestor and wisdom topics; the 9th is the classical home of ancestors.

hindi: आपका स्पर्म एग
says: Sperm and egg, meaning fertility itself, are 5th-house topics.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the sign on the 5th house colours fertility. Tradition tendency only, not a diagnosis.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus, a fertile Venus-and-earth sign, on the 5th house; a strong fertility reading.
Derived: Virgo, a sign classically called barren for children, on the 5th house; fertility reads reduced.

classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is the house of procreation; Gemini, Leo and Virgo are the classical 'barren' signs for it.

hindi: लिबिडो लिबिडो मींस किसी कार्य को करने के प्रति इच्छा सेक्स संबंधित इच्छा
says: Defines libido widely as the urge toward doing any act, with sexual desire as one form of it, and puts it under the 5th house.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the sign on the 5th house colours the strength and style of desire.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries on the 5th house; a high, direct drive in action and desire.
Derived: Capricorn on the 5th house; a reserved, controlled drive that builds slowly.

classical_check: Partly agrees: desire and sexual drive are read from the 5th and 7th and from Venus and Mars; his wider 'urge for any act' sense is his own.

hindi: प्रारब्ध
says: Prarabdh, the destiny carried from past lives, is a 5th-house topic.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the sign on the 5th house colours the nature of the merit carried.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius on the 5th house; stored merit from dharmic and teaching work shows as fortune.
Derived: Scorpio on the 5th house; destiny arrives through upheavals and intense karmic lessons.

classical_check: Agrees: the 5th house is purva punya, the merit of past lives.

hindi: लॉटरी आपकी लॉटरी लगती है कि नहीं लगती है

cells_derived_method: Derived: the sign on the 5th house decides the luck in chance gains.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius, Jupiter's lucky sign, on the 5th house; windfalls are more likely.

classical_check: Agrees: speculation and sudden gains are classical 5th-house topics.

hindi: अगर पांचवा भाव ठीक नहीं है आपकी लॉटरी नहीं लगेगी
says: If the 5th house is not in order, you will not win a lottery.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn on an afflicted 5th house; chance gains are blocked and only slow, earned money comes.
Derived: Gemini on an afflicted 5th house; small, scattered near-wins that never add up.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: an afflicted 5th is classically a poor sign for speculative gains.

gist: Addresses share-market traders in the room: you often work in the market and you say you want money to arrive in a sudden jolt.

hindi: आपके पास ऐसे आएगा पैसा के चल चला के आया कछुए की तरह और निकल गया एकदम पानी की तरह फिर आया कछुए की तरह
says: With a weak 5th house, speculative money crawls in like a tortoise and drains out at once like water, and then crawls in again. Recorded as his claim and not as investment advice.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: a weak 5th gives unstable speculative results; the tortoise-and-water image is his.

hindi: तो ये खेल होता रहता है जब तक ये घर इंप्रूव नहीं होगा ठीक नहीं होगा
says: This cycle of slow gain and fast loss keeps repeating until the 5th house is improved, and nothing changes before that.
ambiguity: 'इंप्रूव' is not tied to a particular remedy here; the 5th-house remedies come earlier in the same chunk.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: results change only when the afflicted house is strengthened or remedied.

hindi: छठा रोग बीमारी देखते हैं कितनी स्ट्रगल बीमारी डिजीज

hindi: डेट्स कर्जा कितना आपके ऊपर

classical_check: Agrees: debts and loans are classical 6th-house topics.

hindi: कोर्ट केस एनिमी दुश्मन

hindi: रिश्ते रिश्ते अपने यार दोस्त मित्र इत्यादि के साथ

gist: Slide aside: he says friends belong in the 4th house, that this had not come up on the slide, and then notes that friends have now appeared in the list (the 6th).

hindi: रिएक्शनरी नेचर आप कितना जबरदस्त तरीके से रिस्पॉन्ड करते हैं आपके नेचर में कितना अड़ सड़ना है

ambiguity: 'अड़ सड़ना' is colloquial for obstinacy and rigidity.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 6th is conflict and competitiveness; temperament as such is the 1st house and Mars.

hindi: लक इन करियर

hindi: सेक्सुअल प्रेफरेंस

hindi: स्पाउस स्पाउस की आपके पति या पत्नी साथी की सेक्स लाइफ के अंदर सेक्स में क्या प्रेफरेंस है वो सारी यहां से निकलती है

classical_check: Differs: the spouse and the spouse's nature belong to the 7th house.

hindi: एडिक्शन
says: Addiction appears a second time in the list, now under the 6th house.

Derived: Taurus on the 6th house; indulgence in food, sweets and comforts that turns into dependence.

classical_check: Partly agrees: addictions are read from the 6th, 8th and 12th with Rahu.

hindi: प्रिजन जेल जेल जाने का योग
says: Prison, meaning the yoga of going to jail, is a 6th-house topic.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the sign on the 6th house colours the route to confinement. Tradition tendency only, not a prediction.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn on the 6th house; confinement through rules, authority and legal formality.

classical_check: Agrees: the 6th, 8th and 12th are the classical houses of imprisonment.

hindi: यह अगर एरिया स्ट्रांग है तो आप जेल जा ही नहीं सकते आप कुछ भी कर लो
says: If this area of the chart is strong, you simply cannot go to jail, whatever you do.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the sign on a strong 6th house shapes how the protection works.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: a strong 6th house defeats enemies and legal threats, but 'whatever you do' is his strong wording.

hindi: कुछ भी यह वक है आप जेल जाओगे चाहे आपने कुछ नहीं किया
says: If this area is weak you will go to jail even if you have done nothing; the chart's condition, not your deeds, decides it.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: an afflicted 6th, 8th or 12th gives false cases and confinement; the independence from one's own acts is his emphasis.

hindi: इसलिए कोई पाप पुण्य की परिभाषा नहीं है

hindi: लोग कहते हैं भगवान पापों की सजा देता है नहीं भगवान कुछ नहीं करता भगवान आपके प्रारब्ध के किए कर्मों के अनुसार आपको आगे पैक कर देता है

classical_check: Agrees in part with the doctrine that results follow prarabdha karma; the claim that God does not punish is his own stance.

hindi: आपकी प्रथम ड्यूटी है कि आपको किसी हालत में शिक्षा लेनी है नहीं लेते शिक्षा तो गुरु लेना है नहीं लेते गुरु तो कृपा लेनी है कृपा नहीं लेते तो पितरों का आशीर्वाद लेना है

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: guru seva and honouring ancestors are classical remedies; the ladder ordering is his.

hindi: आप की लाइफ में शील्ड बनेगी आपको शील्ड चाहिए ही चाहिए हर हालत में विदाउट शील्ड कुछ नहीं चलेगा
says: These four sources of protection together form a shield in your life, and you must have a shield at all costs, because nothing works without one.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the idea of kavacha (protective cover) from guru, dharma and ancestors; the shield image is his.

hindi: शील्ड बनाने के ऊपर काम करें मनुष्य उसकी लाइफ एकदम बढ़िया हो जाएगी
says: Remedy: work on building that shield, and a person's life turns out excellent.
classical_check: Silent on the 'life becomes excellent' promise; the practices behind the shield are classical remedies.

hindi: सातवां हो गया पति का या पत्नी का स्पाउस का मैरिज
says: The 7th house is the husband or wife, the spouse, and marriage.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the sign on the 7th house colours the type of spouse and marriage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra, Venus's balance sign, on the 7th house; a harmonious, partner-centred marriage.
Derived: Aries on the 7th house; a spirited, independent and argumentative partner.

classical_check: Agrees: the 7th (kalatra bhava) is spouse and marriage.

hindi: बिजनेस पार्टनरशिप कंपैटिबिलिटी
says: Business partnership and compatibility are 7th-house topics too.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the sign on the 7th house colours the style of partnerships.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini on the 7th house; many partners and deals built on talk and contracts.
Derived: Capricorn on the 7th house; serious, formal and long-term partnerships.

ambiguity: This line is shorter than the next one, which defines the compatibility part.
classical_check: Agrees: business partnership is a classical 7th-house topic.

hindi: पार्टनर के साथ यानी आपकी पत्नी या पति के साथ आपका रिश्ता कैसा चलेगा
says: Compatibility here means how your relationship with your wife or husband will run.

Derived: Aquarius on the 7th house; a friendly but emotionally detached marital relationship.

classical_check: Agrees: marital harmony is read from the 7th house, its lord and Venus.

hindi: रिप्रोडक्शन सेक्स के थ्रू रिप्रोडक्शन
says: Reproduction through sexual union is also a 7th-house topic.

Derived: Virgo on the 7th house; a reserved, anxious union, so reproduction reads reduced.

classical_check: Partly agrees: sexual union is the 7th; children themselves are the 5th, which he also states.

hindi: बिजनेस भी आपका यहां पर है

Derived: Capricorn on the 7th house; large, formal and structured enterprises.

classical_check: Agrees: trade and independent business are classical 7th-house topics.

hindi: आपके बिजनेस के लिए पार्टनर के साथ रिलेशनशिप चौथे घर से आता है लेकिन बिजनेस का योग बनेगा या जॉब का योग बनेगा इसके साथ है

Derived: Virgo on the 7th house; job or service yoga is more likely than independent business.

hindi: आपके हर प्रकार की सेक्सुअल डिजीज वो सारी की सारी इसके पास है

Derived: Gemini on the 7th house; an air and nerve sign, so stress- or nerve-linked intimacy problems rather than structural ones.

classical_check: Agrees: the 7th and 8th rule the genitals and are the classical houses of venereal troubles.

hindi: आपकी बीमारी के अंतर्गत आपको कितना ज्यादा सहयोग रहेगा साथी के ग्रह के कारण वो इसके पास है

Derived: Aquarius on the 7th house; support that is practical and helpful but emotionally detached.

hindi: आपका पेट भी यहां पर है स्टमक भी यहीं पर है हमारा लिखा नहीं गया है स्टमक भी हमारा यहीं है

hindi: स्मॉल इंटेस्टाइन जो है वो यहां पर आता है इन दोनों पांचवें और नौवें भाव में

hindi: और लार्ज इंटेस्टाइन छठे और आठवें में आता है आठवें में मुख्य तौर पे आता है

Derived: Capricorn on the 6th house; a dry, slow bowel tendency.

hindi: यह आयु का भाव है आयु कितनी होगी

ambiguity: 'यह' refers to the 8th house, which he has just reached.
classical_check: Agrees: the 8th house (ayur bhava) is longevity.

hindi: सीक्रेट आप कितना सीक्रेट पैसा रखते हैं आप खुद नेचर में कितने सीक्रेट है
says: The 8th house is secrecy: how much secret money you hold and how secretive you are by nature.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the sign on the 8th house colours how much is hidden.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio on the 8th house; very secretive, with hidden money and a guarded nature.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 8th house; open and candid, so little is concealed.

classical_check: Agrees: the 8th is hidden things, secrets and hidden wealth.

hindi: कितना सडन अचानक आप चेंज करते हैं
says: The 8th house shows sudden change: how abruptly you change course.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the sign on the 8th house colours the style of sudden change.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries on the 8th house; abrupt, impulsive reversals.
Derived: Taurus on the 8th house; resists change for a long time and then breaks in one big move.

classical_check: Agrees: the 8th rules sudden events and transformations.

hindi: अल्ट साइंस यानी
says: Occult science is the next 8th-house topic he names, but the sentence stops there at the end of the batch, so the explanation is not captured.
cells_derived_method: Derived: the sign on the 8th house colours the type of occult interest.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio on the 8th house; a strong pull toward occult research and hidden knowledge.
Derived: Pisces on the 8th house; a mystical, intuitive and psychic-style occult interest.

ambiguity: 'अल्ट' is the caption's clipped 'occult'; the 'यानी' is cut off at the end of the batch.
classical_check: Agrees: occult studies and hidden sciences are classical 8th-house topics.

hindi: परा विज्ञान ईश्वर इसके बारे में कितना क्या सोचते हैं यह आठवा परा विज्ञान है
says: The 8th house is the house of para-vigyan, the hidden or occult science, and it shows how much and in what way a person thinks about God and the unseen.
cells_derived_method: The occult theme of the 8th takes its colour from the sign on it: fixed water or fire signs give deep probing interest, air signs make it intellectual curiosity, earth signs make it practical or sceptical. Planets placed there decide which hidden subject draws the person.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 8th in Scorpio, the natural sign of this house, gives intense research-style interest in occult and hidden matters.
Derived: a planet in the 8th in Gemini makes the interest in the unseen verbal and curious, reading and questioning rather than devotional.

classical_check: Agrees: the 8th is the classical house of occult, hidden matters and transformation; tying it to one's view of God is his own framing.

hindi: और इसके ठीक अगला नौवा घर जो है वो आपका साल्वेशन मुक्ति की तरफ है
says: The house right after the 8th, the 9th, points toward salvation or mukti; it is the house that shows the person's direction toward liberation.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 9th shows the style of the path toward liberation: Pisces or Sagittarius lean to devotion and teachers, Capricorn to discipline and duty, Aquarius to detached reasoning. Planets in the 9th add their own flavour to the path.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 9th in Pisces tilts the person toward devotional, surrender-type liberation.
Derived: a planet in the 9th in Capricorn makes the search for liberation slow, disciplined and duty-bound.

classical_check: Agrees in part: the 9th is dharma and fortune, and mukti is mainly the 12th; he treats the 9th as the gateway to it.

hindi: मुक्ति इसी मुक्ति को बवे घर पर मोक्ष ले जाते हैं हम
says: The mukti that begins in the 9th is carried by the 12th house to its end as moksha, so the 12th is the house of final release.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 12th shows the manner of final release: Pisces gives a natural, dissolving release, Taurus ties release to attachment to comforts, Virgo makes it through service. Planets in the 12th show what has to be let go.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 12th in Pisces points to release by dissolving and surrender, a natural moksha tilt.
Derived: a planet in the 12th in Taurus shows release blocked or delayed by attachment to comforts and spending.

ambiguity: The caption says 'bave ghar'; read as barahve (12th) because he names the 12th as moksha a few lines later.
classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is a classical moksha house.

hindi: जीवन साथी के कहने के बाद जीवन में सर्वप्रथम क्या होता है सातवा घर ऑन हुआ जीवन साथी आया आठवा घर क्या आ गया मौत
says: He walks the houses as a life story: when the 7th house switches on the life partner arrives, and the very next house, the 8th, is death.
cells_derived_method: How smoothly the 7th turns into the 8th depends on the signs: a harmonious sign on the 7th brings an easy partner arrival, a harsh or fixed sign on the 8th makes the following transformation sharper.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 7th in Libra suggests the partner arrives in a balanced, courteous way, a smooth switch-on of this house.
Derived: a planet in the 8th in Aquarius makes the transformation phase detached and sudden, not emotional.

ambiguity: 'Death' here is symbolic of the 8th house in the life sequence; he explains in the next sentence that it is the death of desires, not a literal prediction.
classical_check: Agrees that the 7th is spouse and the 8th is death and transformation; the 7th-to-12th life-story sequence is his teaching device.

hindi: सबसे पहले तो सेक्सुअल लाइफ के बाद मृत्यु होती है यानी कि इच्छाओं की मृत्यु फिर मनुष्य जाता है नौवें घर की तरफ यानी धर्म की तरफ
says: After sexual life comes the 'death' of the 8th house, meaning the death of desires, and only then does the person turn toward the 9th, the house of dharma.
cells_derived_method: The 8th shows how desire burns out (sign decides whether through excess, loss, or understanding) and the 9th sign shows which dharma the freed mind turns to.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 8th in Scorpio shows desire ending through a crisis or deep experience, not quietly.
Derived: a planet in the 9th in Sagittarius shows the freed mind turning to a teacher, philosophy or established religion.

ambiguity: The 'death' is explained as death of desire and not as physical death; this is his symbolic reading of the 8th.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give the 8th as longevity, death and occult; the death-of-desire reading is a modern or teaching interpretation.

hindi: फिर दसवा कुछ कर्म करता है ऐसा जो लाभदायक हो 11वें घर में और 12वां फिर मोक्ष ऑटोमेटिक
says: The sequence continues: in the 10th the person does action (karma) that is meant to be profitable, the profit shows in the 11th, and the 12th then brings moksha automatically.
cells_derived_method: Each step takes its character from its sign: the sign on the 10th decides the kind of action, the sign on the 11th the kind of gain, the sign on the 12th the kind of release.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 10th in Capricorn gives slow, structured action whose gain in the 11th comes late but lasts.
Derived: a planet in the 11th in Gemini makes the gain come through contacts, trade and information.
Derived: a planet in the 12th in Pisces makes the closing step quiet and spiritual.

classical_check: Silent on this narrative; the 10th, 11th and 12th meanings themselves match classical karma, gain and loss or moksha.

hindi: जीवन की यात्रा परिवर्तित हो जाती है साथी के आने के बाद कुछ लोग सातवें घर पर अटक जाते हैं कुछ आठवें नौवा क्लाइम करते हैं कोई दसवा कुंडलिनी की यात्रा है
says: After a partner arrives the life journey changes; some people stay stuck at the 7th, others climb up to the 8th, 9th or 10th, and he calls this climb a kundalini-like journey through the houses.
cells_derived_method: Where a person gets stuck is shown by afflictions: a heavily afflicted 7th or a strong fixed-sign 7th holds the person at partnership, while strong 8th or 9th indications push the climb on.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 7th in Taurus, a fixed earth sign, can hold the person to partner comfort and stop the climb.
Derived: a planet in the 9th in Pisces can lift the person beyond the partnership stage toward spiritual search.

ambiguity: The last clause about the 10th and kundalini is loose; it may mean the climb reaches the 10th, or that the whole climb is the kundalini journey.
classical_check: Silent: this is his teaching metaphor, not a classical rule.

hindi: ये नौवा धर्म का भाव है यहां से धर्म देखते हैं कि आप धर्म के प्रति कितने निष्ठावान है आप पागल तो नहीं या अधार्वा है कि नॉन बिलीवर है डिसबिलीवर है मिस बिलीवर है
says: The 9th is the house of dharma; from it one reads how loyal the person is to religion, whether fanatical, a non-believer, a disbeliever or holding a mistaken belief.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 9th colours the type of belief: fire signs give zeal, earth signs ritual and practice, air signs question and argue, water signs devotion.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 9th in Aries gives a zealous, fighting kind of faith.
Derived: a planet in the 9th in Virgo gives a ritual-heavy, analytical faith that checks details and doubts easily.

ambiguity: The word 'adharva' is garbled; it probably means a fanatic or over-devout type, but this is a guess.
classical_check: Agrees: the 9th is dharma, faith and religious conduct.

hindi: कुछ लोग ऐसे हैं जिनको बिलीव नहीं है उनकी कुंडली का नाइंथ हाउस डिस्टर्ब है
says: People who have no belief or faith have a disturbed 9th house in their kundli.
cells_derived_method: What counts as disturbed (malefic occupants, aspects, afflicted lord) interacts with the sign: the same affliction gives open atheism in a rational air sign and cold indifference in an earth sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an afflicted 9th with a planet in Aquarius gives rational, reasoned disbelief.
Derived: an afflicted 9th with a planet in Capricorn gives dry, practical indifference to religion.

ambiguity: 'Disturbed' is not defined; he does not say if it means occupants, aspects or the lord.
classical_check: Partly agrees: an afflicted 9th or 9th lord is read as weak dharma or faith, but classical texts do not equate it with unbelief.

gist: Non-believers sometimes visit an astrologer or pandit and say they do not believe in any of it.

hindi: कोई शनि जैसा ग्रह है तो सलिवेशन की ओर भेजता है कमाल की बात है शनि आपको मु मुक्ति और मोक्ष की तरफ ध्यान डालता है
says: A Saturn-like planet sends a person toward salvation; he finds it remarkable that Saturn turns the native's attention toward mukti and moksha.
cells_derived_method: The pull to renunciation is strongest where Saturn sits in the 9th or 12th and in a sign that is its own, Capricorn or Aquarius, or exalted in Libra; in fiery or sensual signs it is weaker.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 9th in its own sign Capricorn gives a serious, disciplined path to dharma and liberation.
Derived: Saturn in the 12th in its own sign Aquarius pushes toward solitude, detachment and renunciation.
Derived: Saturn in the 1st in exalted Libra gives a detached, sober personality drawn to inner seeking.

classical_check: Agrees in part: Saturn is the classical karaka of vairagya (detachment), while the moksha karaka is Ketu.

hindi: क्योंकि शनि विचो हा करता है फवा है परे फेंकता है शनि देर सवेर भोगने नहीं देता
says: Saturn throws things away, pushing the person off from attachments, so sooner or later it does not allow the native to go on enjoying (the garbled words appear to say it detaches).
cells_derived_method: Saturn takes away enjoyment in the area of the house it sits in or aspects: in the 2nd it limits wealth or food enjoyment, in the 5th it limits fun and children, in the 7th it limits marital pleasure.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 2nd in Capricorn limits enjoyment of money and food, saving over spending.
Derived: Saturn in the 7th in exalted Libra delays and restrains marital enjoyment but makes it durable.
Derived: Saturn in the 5th in Aquarius dries up fun and leisure in favour of duty and social purpose.

ambiguity: Two words ('vicho ha', 'fava') are unreadable; the sense is taken from 'pare phenkta hai' (throws aside) and 'bhogne nahin deta' (does not let enjoy).
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn restricts, delays and denies enjoyment in the house it holds.

hindi: जब ग्रहों पर आएंगे तो पता चलेगा रिश्ते मेरे बाप से मां से भाई बहन से क्यों खराब में शनि वगैरह जैसे ग्रह बहुत बड़ा रोल प्ले करते हैं
says: When he reaches the planets it will show why a person's relations with father, mother, brother and sister go bad; Saturn and similar planets play a big role in it.
cells_derived_method: The strain falls on the relative whose house Saturn holds or afflicts: the 9th and 10th for the father, the 4th for the mother, the 3rd for siblings, and gets sharper in signs hostile to that relative's karaka.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 4th in Aries, its debilitation sign, gives a cold or distant bond with the mother.
Derived: Saturn in the 3rd in Gemini gives distance or a sense of duty without warmth with siblings.
Derived: Saturn in the 9th in Leo, the sign of the Sun who is the father karaka and Saturn's enemy, shows friction with the father.

ambiguity: He says 'Saturn and similar planets' but does not name them here, so the full list is still to come.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn afflicting the houses and karakas of parents and siblings is a standard reading for estrangement.

hindi: आपके इष्ट देवता नौवें घर से देखे जाते हैं
says: Your ishta devata, the personal deity, is read from the 9th house.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 9th and the planets in or ruling it select the type of deity: fiery signs suggest strong or warrior deities, watery signs mother or river deities, Sagittarius or Pisces guru or Vishnu forms.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 9th in Sagittarius points to a guru-type or Vishnu-type deity.
Derived: a planet in the 9th in Scorpio points to a fierce or tantric form of deity.

classical_check: Differs in part: Jaimini reads ishta devata from the 12th from the Atmakaraka in the navamsa, and Parashari practice often uses the 5th and 9th lords; the 9th alone is his simplification.

hindi: इष्ट देवता की कहानी ये है कि आपका आपकी कुंडली में इष्ट कौन है यही ग्रह की पोजिशनिंग और ग्रह की राशि बताती है पूजा करनी भी चाहिए या नहीं
says: Which deity is yours in the kundli is told by the planet's position and its sign, and the same placement also tells whether the person should do puja at all.
cells_derived_method: The deity and the fitness for puja change with the house and sign of the key planet; a planet in the 9th or 12th in a spiritual sign supports worship, while a harsh placement can make puja unsuitable.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the key planet in the 9th in Pisces supports devotional puja and a Vishnu-type deity.
Derived: the key planet in the 6th in Scorpio points to a protective or fierce deity, with puja done as a struggle or remedy rather than ease.

ambiguity: He says 'the planet' without saying which one is the key planet; probably the 9th lord, the 5th lord or the Atmakaraka.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical methods choose the deity from specific planets, but 'whether to do puja at all' is his own addition.

gist: He says a full class on this topic is still left to come.

hindi: कुछ ऐसे योग होते हैं जिसके अंतर्गत मनुष्य ने अगर पूजा की वैष्णव माता के होकर आया रामेश्वर के मंदिर गया या कहीं भी गया आते ही उसको रोना पड़ता है दुखद घटना होती है या एक्सीडेंट हो जाता है
says: Some yogas are such that when the native does puja or pilgrimage (Vaishno Devi, Rameshwaram or anywhere) grief, a sad event or an accident follows soon after returning; recorded as his claim only.
ambiguity: He does not say which yogas, so the planets, houses and signs involved are not specified.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text lists a yoga where worship brings misfortune.

hindi: यानी उसने एक ऐसे घर के ऐसे खाने को ऐसे प्लेनेट को ऑन कर दिया है कि अब उसके जीवन के अंदर दरिद्रता चालू यानी उसे पूजा पाठ नहीं करना सूट करता है
says: Such a person has, by doing worship, switched on a particular house, box (khana) and planet combination, after which poverty starts in life; puja does not suit this native.
cells_derived_method: He thinks in terms of a house, a box and a planet being 'switched on', which matches the idea that each house-sign combination is a separate cell with its own result; which cells are harmed by worship is not given.
ambiguity: 'Khana' could mean the sign-box or the house-box of the chart; he names no specific cell, so no cell can be assigned.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not hold that worship can trigger poverty.

hindi: कुछ ग्रह मुस्लिम बनाते हैं कुछ हिंदू बनाते हैं कुछ जैनी बनाते हैं
says: Different planets decide which religion a person ends up following: some planets make the person Muslim, some Hindu, some Jain.
ambiguity: He does not say which planet maps to which religion; the list is expected later.
classical_check: Silent: no standard classical mapping of planets to named religions.

hindi: आप पता लगा गुरुद्वारे को मानते हैं आप हो सकता मुस मुसलमान धर्म को मान रहे हैं कई मुस्लिम ऐसे हो सकते हैं वो कहेंगे सनातन को मानेंगे ये अपने अपने ग्रहों का हिसाब किताब लगता है
says: A person born into one religion may not truly follow it: a Jain may not be fully Jain, a Hindu may follow something else or a gurudwara, a Muslim may follow Sanatan; this is each person's own planetary account, not the birth label.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not discuss conversion or mismatch between birth religion and chart.

hindi: आपका सत्य आप स्वयं क्या हो रिलीजन रिलीजस धर्म के प्रति आस्था अर्न ब्लेसिंग मेहनत करके
says: Listing what the 9th house stands for: your own truth and what you yourself are, religion and faith in dharma, and blessings that you earn by effort.
cells_derived_method: Earned blessing shows more in effort-friendly signs on the 9th (Capricorn, Virgo, Aries) and faith by grace in watery or Jupiter-ruled signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 9th in Virgo makes blessings come through disciplined effort and service.
Derived: a planet in the 9th in Cancer makes faith come through the heart and family tradition.

ambiguity: The sentence does not name the house; it is read as part of the 9th-house list. 'Earn blessing by hard work' may belong to the 9th (earned) and is set against the 5th (ready-made) in the next lines.
classical_check: Agrees: the 9th covers dharma, faith and fortune from past merit.

hindi: पांचवा घर का था बैठे बिठा रेडी मेड चौथी फेल है बंदा पांचवा घर स्ट्रांग है उसने सफल होना ही है
says: The 5th house gives a ready-made blessing without work: even a person who has failed in basic schooling (the 4th) will succeed if the 5th house is strong.
cells_derived_method: The kind of effortless success follows the sign on the 5th: Leo gives recognition and status, Sagittarius grace of teachers, Pisces intuition, Gemini luck through talk and contacts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a strong 5th with a planet in Leo gives success through natural authority and recognition without formal learning.
Derived: a strong 5th with a planet in Sagittarius gives success by grace of a guru or by wisdom that arrives unstudied.

ambiguity: 'Chauthi fail' can mean someone who failed class 4 or someone with a weak 4th house (basic education); he uses it as an example of a person with no formal ability.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the 5th is purva punya (past merit), intelligence and sudden gain.

hindi: बंदा किसी लायक नहीं है पढ़ने को लिखने को अकल से भी शायद पैदल है लेकिन उसकी लॉटरी लगती है लॉटरी लॉटरी से अर बनता है बैठे बिठा ज्ञान आ जाता है
says: A person who seems unfit for study and weak in intellect can still win a lottery, become very rich (the caption 'ar' is probably arabpati) and have knowledge come to him without study; he ties this to a strong 5th.
cells_derived_method: The 5th gives windfall and unstudied knowledge in a way that depends on sign: air signs give gains through contacts and information, water signs intuitive insight, fire signs sudden status.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 5th in Pisces suggests knowledge arriving by intuition or inspiration without study.
Derived: a planet in the 5th in Gemini suggests lucky breaks through talk, contacts and information.

ambiguity: The 5th house is not named in the sentence but follows directly from the 5th-house lines before it; the word 'ar' is garbled. Lottery is recorded as his claim, not as a betting suggestion.
classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is classically linked with speculation, sudden gains and past-life merit.

gist: Self-deprecating joke that we are unlettered, living only on grace and selling stolen goods.

hindi: करंट लाइफ लक इस जन्म का लक वो पूर्व जन्म का लक
says: He separates current-life luck (earned in this birth) from luck carried from a previous birth; both show in the chart.
ambiguity: He does not say which house shows which luck; from the lines before it, the 9th (earned) may be this-life luck and the 5th (ready-made) past-life luck, but that is not stated.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the 5th is purva punya and the 9th is bhagya; the exact pairing is not given by him here.

hindi: यह जॉइंट ऑफ ड्रैगन हैड टेल दिया यानी राहु और केतु का जोड़ एक राहु है मुंडी और एक धड़ है केतु आपका राहु और केतु यानी कि द्वार दूसरी दुनिया का द्वार
says: The joint of the dragon's head and tail is Rahu and Ketu: Rahu is the head and Ketu is the torso, and together they are the doorway to the other world.
cells_derived_method: The doorway shows where it sits: Rahu opens a door to the other world through the house and sign it occupies, Ketu through the house it occupies; the two always sit in opposite houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in the 8th in Cancer opens the other-world door through emotional and psychic sensitivity.
Derived: Rahu in the 12th in Gemini opens the door through foreign lands, dreams and communication.
Derived: Ketu in the 12th in Sagittarius gives a detached, moksha-leaning doorway through teachers and philosophy.

classical_check: Agrees: Rahu as the head and Ketu as the headless body is the classical myth; calling them a door to the other world is his phrase.

hindi: ट्रस्ट बिलीवर डिसबिलीवर आप कितना फेथ रखते हैं किसी पर कितना विश्वास रखते हैं
says: The 9th house also measures trust and faith: whether the person is a believer or disbeliever and how much faith he keeps in anyone.
cells_derived_method: The amount of trust follows the sign: water signs trust through feeling, earth signs trust only on proof, fixed signs trust slowly but hold on.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 9th in Pisces gives easy, sometimes gullible, trust.
Derived: a planet in the 9th in Virgo gives trust only after checking facts.

ambiguity: The sentence does not name the house, but the very next sentence ties belief to the 9th, so it is read as the 9th.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the 9th covers faith and conviction.

hindi: यदि नौवा घर डिस्टर्ब है आप बिलीव नहीं करते किसी प किसी की सुन के मान के राजी नहीं
says: If the 9th house is disturbed the person does not believe, and is not willing to listen to anyone and accept what he is told.
cells_derived_method: The style of the refusal depends on the sign: suspicious in Scorpio, argumentative in Gemini, cold-rational in Aquarius.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an afflicted 9th with a planet in Scorpio gives a suspicious person who believes only after testing.
Derived: an afflicted 9th with a planet in Gemini gives a person who argues every teaching.

classical_check: Partly agrees: an afflicted 9th is read as trouble with teachers and dharma; the 'does not listen' reading is his.

hindi: आपका नौम घर बहुत उत्तम बहुत स्ट्रांग है तो आप अपने जीवन में विश्वास को नहीं छोड़ते और आपको ईश्वर मिलता है
says: If the 9th house is very good and strong, the person never lets go of faith in life and God is met by him.
cells_derived_method: A strong 9th shows its faith differently by sign: steady, teacher-based faith in Sagittarius, emotional bhakti in Cancer, dharma through action in Aries.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a strong 9th with a planet in Sagittarius gives lasting faith and a trusted teacher.
Derived: a strong 9th with a planet in Cancer gives devotion rooted in family and a mother-type deity.

classical_check: Partly agrees: a strong 9th and 9th lord give dharma and fortune; meeting God is his promise, not a classical one.

hindi: किस रूप में मिलता है वो एक अलग कहानी लेकिन मिलता है वो ईश्वर का के खुद मिले
says: In what form God is met is a separate story to be told later, but he insists that the native with a strong 9th does meet the divine.
ambiguity: The final words ('Ishwar ka ke khud mile') are garbled, so the exact claim about meeting God personally is uncertain.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: 10वां कर्म भाव है कितने एंबिशियस है आप कितनी आप ड्यूटी करते हैं
says: The 10th is the house of karma: it shows how ambitious the person is and how much duty he performs.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 10th sets the form of ambition: Aries pioneering, Leo commanding, Capricorn patient, Virgo careful service.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 10th in Aries gives fast, pioneering ambition that takes the lead.
Derived: a planet in the 10th in Capricorn gives patient, duty-driven ambition that climbs slowly.

classical_check: Agrees: the 10th is karma, profession and status.

hindi: सेवा नहीं ये ड्यूटी 12वें घर से सेवा होती है 10वें घर से ड्यूटी होती है
says: He separates seva from duty: selfless service is read from the 12th house, while duty (a job obligation) is read from the 10th house.
cells_derived_method: The kind of service or duty follows the sign: caring, healing service in Virgo or Pisces on the 12th, rule-bound duty in Capricorn on the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 12th in Virgo shows service as care, healing and quiet help behind the scenes.
Derived: a planet in the 10th in Capricorn shows duty as a heavy, rule-bound responsibility.

classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not separate seva (12th) from duty (10th) this way; the 12th is loss and charity, the 10th is action.

hindi: यह जॉब करते हैं कर्म करते हैं क्या लाइवलीहुड लाइवलीहुड है ये
says: The 10th house covers the job one does, the action one takes and the livelihood.
cells_derived_method: The sign and planets on the 10th suggest the type of livelihood: an air sign points to trade or communication, an earth sign to land or production, a water sign to care or liquids.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 10th in Gemini points to a livelihood in trade, writing or communication.
Derived: a planet in the 10th in Taurus points to a livelihood in finance, produce or goods.

classical_check: Agrees: the 10th is the house of profession and livelihood.

hindi: एसेट शादी के बाद कितने एसेट है बड़ा इंटरेस्टिंग है अभी इसकी बात करेंगे
says: He raises the subject of how many assets one has after marriage, calls it very interesting and defers it to a later part of the lecture.
ambiguity: He does not say which house this belongs to; it follows the 10th-house list but may lead into the 11th (gain).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: काम करने की क्षमता लीडरशिप क्वालिटी कार्य के स्थान पर जगह
says: Also under the 10th: the capacity to work, leadership quality, and the place where the work is done.
cells_derived_method: The work capacity and workplace type follow the sign: Aries gives drive and open or outdoor places, Taurus steady output in comfortable places, Libra work in shared or public spaces.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 10th in Aries gives high drive and a leader who initiates in a competitive workplace.
Derived: a planet in the 10th in Libra gives leadership through partnership and a workplace dealing with the public.

ambiguity: The house is not named in this sentence; it is read as the continuing 10th-house list.
classical_check: Agrees: the 10th shows capacity for action, authority and place of work.

hindi: आपका बॉस बनना तय है कि नौकर बनना तय है
says: Whether a person is destined to be a boss or an employee is decided by the 10th house.
cells_derived_method: Commanding signs on a strong 10th lean to boss, service signs and weak 10th to employee: Leo or Aries lean boss, Virgo or Pisces lean employee.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 10th in Leo leans toward being the head or owner.
Derived: a planet in the 10th in Virgo leans toward skilled employment or staff roles.

ambiguity: The 10th is named in the following sentence ('ye dasve bhav se hota hai'), so the assignment is taken from there.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts read service versus independent work from the 10th and its lord.

hindi: एक योग होता है वन मैन शो जिसमें नौकर मालिक सेल्समैन सब आप ही होंगे तो कार्य चलेगा ये दसवें भाव से होता है
says: There is a one-man-show yoga where you yourself are servant, owner and salesman all in one, and the work runs only that way; it is read from the 10th house.
cells_derived_method: Signs that favour self-reliance (Gemini, Aries, Virgo, Aquarius) make a solo business more likely, while Libra or Cancer favour partnerships or teams.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 10th in Gemini suggests a self-run trading or services business with the person doing everything.
Derived: a planet in the 10th in Libra shows the opposite, work that runs only through a partner or team.

ambiguity: He does not give the planetary conditions of this yoga.
classical_check: Silent: no classical yoga with this name.

gist: He says he has kept the 10th house short because it is a very large subject with its own separate chapter.

hindi: ये 11वां है लाभ का ग्रोथ कितनी ग्रोथ होगी लाइफ में पौधा लगाते हैं इतना उगता है कि इतना बड़ा उगता है आपने छोटा सा काम किया कितना होगा
says: The 11th is the house of gain and growth; he compares it with planting a seed and asks how big it will grow, that is, how much a small piece of work will multiply in life.
cells_derived_method: The growth rate follows the sign: earth signs compound slowly and surely, fire signs grow fast and riskily, water signs through emotional networks.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 11th in Taurus gives slow, steady compounding growth of a small start.
Derived: a planet in the 11th in Aries gives fast, bold growth that can also fall quickly.

classical_check: Agrees: the 11th is labha, gain and fulfilment of desires.

hindi: मित्रता मित्रता हों के द्वारा लाभ
says: Friendship, and gain that comes through friends, belongs to the 11th house.
cells_derived_method: The nature of the friends and the gain through them follows the sign: Libra gives gain through partners and networks, Scorpio through intense loyal circles that can turn.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 11th in Libra gives gain through partners, networking and balanced friendships.
Derived: a planet in the 11th in Scorpio gives a few intense friends, and gain through them but with risk of betrayal.

ambiguity: The word 'hon' is garbled; read as 'mitron' (friends). The 11th is not named in the sentence but is the house under discussion.
classical_check: Agrees: the 11th is the house of friends and gains.

hindi: आपकी लॉन्ग यात्राएं आपने पैसे लगाए
says: Listed along with the 11th-house gains: long journeys and money you have invested, that is, returns from travel and from invested money.
ambiguity: The sentence does not name a house and is very short; long journeys are classically 9th or 12th, so it may be a separate list or a loose lead-in to the 11th-house return on investment.
classical_check: Differs if assigned to the 11th: long journeys are classically the 9th and 12th; this is only a fragment.

hindi: एक होती है लॉटरी पांचवे घर से लॉटरी में गेन कितना होगा ये 11वें घर से होगा
says: Lottery is a 5th-house matter (the luck itself), while how much is gained from the lottery is shown by the 11th house; recorded as his claim, not a suggestion to gamble.
cells_derived_method: The chance of a windfall is judged on the sign of the 5th (Aquarius or Gemini for sudden luck), and its size on the sign of the 11th (earth signs give a steady but moderate sum).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 5th in Aquarius suggests sudden, unusual windfall luck.
Derived: a planet in the 11th in Capricorn shows the amount kept and used soberly, moderate but lasting.

classical_check: Agrees in part: the 5th is speculation and the 11th is gain; the 5th-chance and 11th-amount split is his refinement.

hindi: प्रॉफिट अननोन सोर्स ऑफ गेन एक सीक्रेट पैसा आता है वो आठवें घर से आता है
says: Money that arrives secretly, from hidden or unrevealed sources, comes through the 8th house.
cells_derived_method: The hidden source follows the sign on the 8th: Scorpio inheritance or partner's money, Cancer through the mother's side, Pisces through foreign or spiritual channels.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 8th in Scorpio points to secret money from inheritance, insurance or partner's funds.
Derived: a planet in the 8th in Pisces points to hidden money from foreign or spiritual channels.

ambiguity: The phrase 'profit, unknown source of gain' leads into the next sentence and belongs to the 11th.
classical_check: Agrees: the 8th is the house of hidden and unearned money, inheritance and the partner's wealth.

hindi: और एक ये पैसा है 11वें घर से कि पता नहीं कहां से आता है कहीं से आता है
says: A different kind of money is the 11th-house money, which comes from nobody knows where, from some unknown source.
cells_derived_method: The unknown channel follows the sign on the 11th: air signs bring money through contacts, fire signs through opportunities, earth signs through steady side sources.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 11th in Gemini suggests money arriving from scattered contacts or small unexpected deals.
Derived: a planet in the 11th in Leo suggests money arriving through a patron or big contact.

classical_check: Agrees in part: the 11th is gain from many channels; 'unknown source' is his wording.

gist: Wish that if this knowledge were taught in schools from a young age, many children would gain, and some would learn the hard way by trying wrong remedies.
Some children would become gurus themselves through the grace of a guru, God or ancestors and change life dramatically.
He says astrology means taking the cosmos' help, like doing magic or miracles.

hindi: एलन मस्क जैसे आदमी एक बारबार बारबार शब्द होता है क्या ही कमाल कर रहे हैं वो क्या कमाल कर रहे हैं वो भोग करके इंद्र की कृपा से दुनिया भर की ऐश प्लस अयाशी करके कमाल कर रहे हैं
says: People like Elon Musk achieve wonders through enjoyment, by the grace of Indra (Uranus in his scheme), taking all the luxury and indulgence of the world; this is his illustration, not a checked chart reading.
cells_derived_method: The Indra route is strongest where Uranus sits in a house of gain or fame and in a sign that supports innovation, such as Aquarius.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Uranus in the 11th in Aquarius would give large gains through technology and new ideas, in his scheme the bhoga route.
Derived: Uranus in the 10th in Scorpio, which he sometimes assigns to Uranus, would give intense, disruptive power in career.

ambiguity: He names a living person but gives no chart; Indra is his name for Uranus. The claim is his illustration and not verified.
classical_check: Silent: Uranus is not part of classical Jyotish; Indra as a planet is his own scheme.

hindi: मोदी जैसे लोग क्या कमाल कर रहे हैं वो साधु की कृपा लेके यानी यानी कि नेप्चून की जैसे ग्रहों की कृपा लेकर साधु तोव लाकर अपने अंदर पूरी दुनिया के अंदर कमाल कर रहे हैं
says: People like Modi achieve wonders by taking a sadhu's grace, which he equates with the grace of Neptune-like planets, bringing a sadhu quality into themselves; his illustration of a second route to success.
cells_derived_method: The sadhu route is strongest where Neptune sits in the 9th, 12th or 1st and in a spiritual sign such as Pisces or Sagittarius.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 12th in Pisces would give an ascetic, mystical quality that works as power in public life.
Derived: Neptune in the 9th in Sagittarius would bring a saintly, guru-like presence and following.

ambiguity: A named public figure is used without any chart; the garbled 'tov' after 'sadhu' is not clear. Varuna is his name for Neptune.
classical_check: Silent: Neptune is not in classical Jyotish.

hindi: आप किसी भी रास्ते से कमाल कर सकते हैं यह जरूरी नहीं है कि भोगी हैं विलासी हैं हो सकता है उसके बिना भी हो
says: A person can achieve wonders by any route; it is not necessary to be a pleasure-seeker, and success can also come without enjoyment.
ambiguity: He does not say which planets map to the non-indulgent route; it is the contrast of the Indra (indulgence) and sadhu (renunciation) examples just before.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Calls Musk, Zuckerberg, Trump and Modi all 'bindaas' (carefree) and says they are what they are.
Says these people are daring, do not care about good or bad, can talk high-grade nonsense, and have a rare ease.

hindi: भाव से लाभ लेने के लिए यह जानना बहुत जरूरी है व्यय भाव बारवा बारवा भाव यह केतु का रेडीमेड भाव होता है
says: To benefit from the houses one must know the 12th, the vyaya (expense and loss) house, which is Ketu's ready-made house.
cells_derived_method: Ketu's natural link to the 12th makes Ketu in the 12th a moksha indicator; the sign decides the type of release: Sagittarius through philosophy, Pisces through surrender, Scorpio through occult practice.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in the 12th in Sagittarius gives a philosophical, detached path of release.
Derived: Ketu in the 12th in Taurus gives detachment from comforts and possessions.

ambiguity: 'Bhav se labh lene ke liye' is garbled and may mean 'to benefit from these houses'. 'Ready-made' appears to mean natural lordship, not stated precisely.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Ketu is a moksha karaka and the 12th a moksha house, though the classical karaka of the 12th is Saturn.

hindi: रेडीमेड भाव माने जाते हैं एक दो तीन चार सूर्य से शुरू
says: He begins to list the ready-made houses, one, two, three, four, starting with the Sun; the sentence stops at the end of this slice, so the full list is not here.
ambiguity: Cut off mid-sentence; it seems to start the natural planet-to-house list with the Sun, but only the Sun is named here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Sun is the natural karaka of the 1st; the rest of the list is not given here.

hindi: होकर 12 ग्रह 12 भाव के अंदर होते हैं यह मोक्ष का है
says: Closing his run of ready-made house and planet pairs, he says the twelve planets map onto the twelve houses, and that this last house, the 12th, is the house of moksha.
ambiguity: 'Hokar' is the tail of the sentence cut at the slice boundary. '12 planets in 12 houses' may mean his one-planet-per-house natural scheme, or just that planets sit in houses; only the 12th being moksha is clear.
classical_check: Agrees that the 12th is a moksha house; the twelve-planet scheme is his own and not classical.

hindi: मोक्ष क्या रखा संसार में ज्ञान हो गया यार अब तो कुछ बात ही नहीं है इसमें
says: The moksha state of mind is the feeling 'what is left in the world, knowledge has come, nothing matters in it any more'; the 12th house stands for this loss of interest in worldly things.
cells_derived_method: How easily the 12th produces this indifference depends on its sign: water signs dissolve attachment naturally, earth signs hold on to possessions and delay it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 12th in Pisces makes the 'nothing is left in the world' feeling natural and early.
Derived: a planet in the 12th in Taurus keeps pulling toward comforts, so the same detachment comes late and with struggle.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the 12th is classically vairagya, loss and moksha.

hindi: यह मोक्ष वाली वो स्थिति है जो कहता है संसार में सब कुछ रखा है संसार के बाहर भी सब रखा है और कुछ रखा है यहां भी कुछ नहीं रखा है तो बड़ी अजीबो गरीब सी बात होती है
says: The moksha position is paradoxical: it holds that everything is in the world, everything is outside the world too, and also that nothing is anywhere; he calls this a very strange state of mind.
ambiguity: The caption chain 'sab kuch rakha hai ... aur kuch rakha hai ... yahan bhi kuch nahin' is loose, so the exact contrast he draws is uncertain.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe the 12th as a paradox; this is his teaching colour.

hindi: आइसोले अकेले रहना जेल जाने की यात्रा का योग यहां से भी देखते हैं
says: The 12th house also shows isolation, living alone, and the yoga for a journey to jail or confinement.
cells_derived_method: The kind of confinement follows the sign: Capricorn strict, legal or duty-bound confinement, Pisces retreat, hospital or ashram seclusion, Aquarius social isolation.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 12th in Capricorn points to strict, rule-bound isolation, such as imprisonment or a hard solitary phase.
Derived: a planet in the 12th in Pisces points to seclusion in a retreat, hospital or ashram rather than jail.

classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is classically the house of confinement, isolation and imprisonment.

hindi: वेस्टेज बर्बादी कितना होगा धन का हिसाब किताब कितना बनेगा
says: The 12th also shows wastage and ruin, how much will be wasted, and what the money account will come to.
cells_derived_method: The style of waste follows the sign: Leo through show and display, Virgo through many small leaks, Sagittarius through travel and large gestures.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 12th in Leo shows money lost on display, entertainment and generosity.
Derived: a planet in the 12th in Virgo shows many small, careful-looking leaks of money rather than one big loss.

ambiguity: 'Dhan ka hisab kitab kitna banega' is loosely phrased and may mean the balance left after wastage.
classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is expenditure and loss.

hindi: चीजों के लिए जुगाड़ ये जुगाड़ का एरिया है आपका जुगाड़ जिंदाबाद
says: The 12th is the area of jugaad, the make-do arrangement of things; he cheers 'long live jugaad' as the 12th's gift of getting what one needs by some arrangement.
cells_derived_method: The way the arrangement arrives follows the sign: Gemini through contacts and quick talk, Capricorn through slow structured effort, Sagittarius through luck and helpers.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 12th in Gemini gets arrangements made through contacts, phone calls and quick wits.
Derived: a planet in the 12th in Capricorn gets arrangements made late and through persistence, not by luck.

classical_check: Silent: assigning jugaad to the 12th is his own reading; classically the 12th is loss and outflow.

hindi: ये ग्रह भाग्य ठीक है आपका बारम भाव का भाव ठीक है तो आपके पास जुगाड़ होंगे आपके पास हर चीज का अरेंजमेंट हो जाया करेगा जब जरूरत पड़ेगी तब आएगा
says: If your 12th house is in good condition, you will always have jugaad: an arrangement for everything will come together exactly when the need arises.
cells_derived_method: How good the 12th is depends on its sign and occupants: a benefic in a friendly sign gives easy arrangements, a malefic in a hostile sign gives them with struggle.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a well-placed planet in the 12th in Sagittarius brings arrangements through luck, teachers and well-wishers.
Derived: a planet in the 12th in Aries brings arrangements only when the person pushes and fights for them.

ambiguity: 'Ye grah bhagya theek hai' at the start is garbled and may mean the house lord and fortune are fine.
classical_check: Differs: classically a good 12th gives expenditure on good causes and foreign gain, not general jugaad.

hindi: जिनका 12वां भाव स्ट्रांग होता है उनको हम कहते हैं कि तुम अपने घर में सारे में एसी लगा लो पंखे मत लगाओ तुम्हारा जुगाड़ हो जाता है उनके पास पैसे पता नहीं कहां से आते हैं
says: To people with a strong 12th he says: put AC in every room and do not use fans, because your arrangement always works and money comes from nowhere; recorded as his spending-style advice, not financial advice.
cells_derived_method: The advice fits only if the 12th is truly strong; a 12th with a harsh sign or affliction would not support the same free spending.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a strong 12th in Sagittarius is the kind of cell he would call safe for comfort spending on faith that money arrives.
Derived: a 12th in Scorpio would call for more caution, as expenses there can be forced, hidden or tied to debts.

ambiguity: 'Strong' is not defined; he does not say which sign or planet conditions make the 12th strong.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text advises spending on comfort for a strong 12th.

hindi: अक्सर दुनिया में 80 पर लोग ऐसे हैं जो ये कहते हैं पता नहीं भाई भगवान दे ही देता है वो सिर्फ सिर्फ सिर्फ इस भाव से है
says: About 80 percent of people say 'who knows, God just gives'; he claims that this trust in a hidden provider comes purely from the 12th house.
ambiguity: '80 par' is probably 80 percent, but it is a loose estimate, not data; the caption may also have the number wrong.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give no such frequency or link.

hindi: यानी जिस व्यक्ति को मोह माया की मुक्ति का द्वार मिल गया वोह बवे भाव को जागृत कर लेता है कि कुछ नहीं रखा कोई बात नहीं साला मरने से भी नहीं डरेंगे डेरिंग होते हैं
