says: A person who finds the door out of attachment and illusion awakens the 12th house; he feels nothing matters, is not afraid even of dying, and becomes daring.
cells_derived_method: The fearlessness shows in the style of the sign: fire signs make it bold, water signs calm, air signs detached and witty.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an awakened planet in the 12th in Aries shows fearlessness as bold, even reckless action.
Derived: an awakened planet in the 12th in Pisces shows fearlessness as calm surrender and acceptance.

ambiguity: 'Bave bhav' is read as the 12th (barahva), the house he is discussing; fearlessness of death is a mindset claim, not a prediction.
classical_check: Silent: the 12th is classically moksha, but fearlessness through awakening it is his teaching.

hindi: उनके जीवन के अंदर एक प्लेनेट ऑन हो जाता है केतु और कई मल्टीपल चीजें मोटे तौर पर बारवा भाव
says: In such people one planet switches on, Ketu, along with several other things; broadly this is the 12th house at work.
cells_derived_method: How strongly Ketu switches on depends on its house and sign: in the 12th it works as pure detachment, in the 8th as occult depth, in the 4th as inner withdrawal.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in the 12th in Pisces, a sign he gives to Ketu in his scheme, would be a strong moksha switch.
Derived: Ketu in the 12th in Gemini gives detachment that comes through study, talk and restlessness of mind.

ambiguity: 'Kai multiple cheezein' is left unspecified, so the other things switched on are not named.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is the classical moksha karaka and the 12th a moksha house.

hindi: और यह भाव जिस ग्रह का जैसा बैठा है वैसा असर देते हुए मनुष्य को जुगाड़ देता है
says: The 12th gives the person his jugaad, but the effect takes the colour of whichever planet is sitting in it and how that planet sits.
cells_derived_method: Each planet in the 12th brings its own type of arrangement, shaped by its sign: a benefic in a friendly sign gives ease, a malefic in an enemy sign gives it with struggle.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the 12th in its own sign Sagittarius gives arrangements through faith, teachers and goodwill.
Derived: Mars in the 12th in its own sign Aries gives arrangements won by force, pushing and quick action.
Derived: Saturn in the 12th in its own sign Capricorn gives arrangements that come slowly, after delay and duty.

classical_check: Agrees in method: the occupant planet and sign colour a house's results; the jugaad theme is his.

hindi: तो इसका एक सादा डायलॉग है गारंटी की बात कि भगवान ने कभी रोटी की कमी नहीं दी और रोटी से ऊपर उठने भी नहीं दिया
says: His simple guarantee line for the 12th: God has never let you lack bread, and has also never let you rise above bread.
cells_derived_method: The size of the floor and ceiling shows through the sign: Virgo gives a modest, steady supply with little surplus, Sagittarius gives luck-based supply that is still capped.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 12th in Virgo gives a modest, steady supply of needs and rarely any surplus.
Derived: a planet in the 12th in Sagittarius gives needs met through luck and goodwill, with the ceiling lifted only by raising awareness.

classical_check: Silent: a floor and ceiling on income from the 12th is his own saying.

hindi: आप नालायक की श्रेणी में भी नहीं है किसी लायक नहीं है तो भगवान आपको 12वां भाव ऐसा सेट किया है कि रोटी तो देगा सर रोटी और रोटी से ऊपर नहीं उठने देगा
says: Even a person who does nothing and is fit for nothing, not even worth calling useless, has had the 12th set by God so that bread is certainly given but he is not allowed to rise above bread.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पर सर कॉशसनेस से रोटी को रोटी को कितना अब रोटी को कितना बड़ा बनाते हैं हम
says: The base supply of bread is given, but how big we make that bread depends on our consciousness; awareness decides how large the 12th's provision becomes.
ambiguity: 'Consciousness' is a general term here; he does not tie it to a particular planet or sign.
classical_check: Silent: a matter of effort and awareness, not a classical rule.

hindi: अब अंबानी जैसे लोग रोटी कितनी बड़ी बनाते हैं रोटी क्या है नेसेसिटी अंबानी जैसे लोग क्या कहते हैं अडानी जैसे लोग क्या कहते हैं यार एक बंदरगाह खरीदना है अब वो क्या है जरूरत है जैसे छोटे
says: Illustrating consciousness: for people like Ambani or Adani 'bread' means necessity on a giant scale, so buying a port is just a need, as a fan is for a small person; his illustration, not a chart reading.
ambiguity: Two named businessmen are used without any chart data; the sentence runs on into the next slice ('jaise chhote vyakti ka kya hai').
classical_check: Silent.

gist: A small man thinks about a fan and its Rs 500 bill; if he installs an AC he worries about a Rs 5000 bill, while the daring one says we will see and does not know where the money will come from.
Quip that the man is cash-short whether he fits a fan or an AC.
Ambani says he will take a Rs 10,000 crore loan to buy a port, and even with buildings and a huge empire he is still 'kadka' (cash-strapped) and has a loan.

hindi: लेकिन वो कड़का ही है और उसके पास लोन है 12वां भाव लोन का है
says: The 12th house is the house of loans and debt.
cells_derived_method: The nature of the loan follows the sign: Scorpio through other people's or joint money, Libra through partners, Capricorn through formal institutions.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 12th in Scorpio points to debt tied to joint, hidden or other people's money.
Derived: a planet in the 12th in Capricorn points to formal, long-term bank-type loans.

classical_check: Differs: classically debt is the 6th house; the 12th is outflow and loss. He puts loans in the 12th.

hindi: अगर ये 12वां भाव पढ़िया हो तो आपको लोन लेना चाहिए आप लोन लेके अर बन जाते हो कमाल के एक्टिवेशंस है आप लोन ले लो कर्जा आपको सूट करेगा रॉकेट बना देगा
says: If the 12th is good, you should take loans: debt suits you and takes you up like a rocket, and you become very rich (caption 'ar', probably arabpati) on borrowed money; recorded as his claim, not financial advice.
cells_derived_method: Whether borrowing helps depends on the quality of the 12th: a benefic in a supportive sign suggests borrowing that grows wealth, a malefic in a harsh sign suggests debt that grows without return.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a benefic in the 12th in Sagittarius fits his idea of a good 12th where leverage works out.
Derived: a planet in the 12th in Gemini suggests borrowing through contacts that can scale quickly but needs constant management.

ambiguity: 'Padhiya' is read as 'badhiya' (good); 'ar' is garbled. 'Good' 12th is not defined. This is a claim only; the entry takes no view on whether borrowing is wise.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give no rule that a good 12th favours borrowing.

hindi: यहीं से जुआ खेलने का कार्यक्रम होता है कि जुआ खेल के इंसान क्या जीतेगा
says: Gambling, and what a person would win by gambling, is also read from the 12th house; recorded as his claim, not a betting tip.
cells_derived_method: The type of gambling luck follows the sign: air signs through quick bets and unusual ideas, fire signs through bold risk, earth signs through slow cautious bets.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 12th in Aquarius points to unusual, sudden gambling outcomes.
Derived: a planet in the 12th in Taurus points to cautious betting with modest, slow results.

ambiguity: 'Yahin se' is read as the 12th, the house under discussion.
classical_check: Differs: classically speculation is the 5th house, with losses from the 12th; he assigns gambling wins to the 12th.

hindi: अगर ये ठीक नहीं तो हर किस्म का जुआ शेयर मार्केट का जुआ दिवाली की रात का शगन का जुआ प्रॉपर्टी में लगा देता हूं पैसा इसका जुआ सेट नहीं होगा
says: If the 12th is not good, no kind of gamble works for the person: not the share market, not the Diwali-night gambling, not putting money into property; recorded as his claim, not investment advice.
cells_derived_method: A weak 12th spoils bets in a way that follows the sign: impulsive loss in fire signs, loss through delay in earth signs, loss through confusion in water signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a weakened 12th with a planet in Aries gives losses from impulsive, hasty bets.
Derived: a weakened 12th with a planet in Capricorn gives bets that fail through blocks and delay.

ambiguity: 'Not good' is not defined; the property mention may refer to putting money in land as a form of gamble.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मानसिकता क्या चाहिए देखा जाएगा यार यह देखा जाएगा
says: The mindset that goes with the 12th's gamble and jugaad is 'dekha jayega', a carefree 'we will see to it when it comes' attitude.
ambiguity: He gives the attitude but does not say if it is a result or a requirement of a strong 12th.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्रह जहां से सुषुम्ना नाड़ी आपको मोक्ष देती है क्लास का नाम है देखा जाएगा उसी में सुषुम्ना नाड़ी की बात है
says: The sushumna nadi, the central energy channel, is where moksha is given; he says the class on this is named 'Dekha Jayega' and that sushumna will be taken up there.
ambiguity: The first word 'krah' is garbled, and the link to the 12th is only by context.
classical_check: Silent: sushumna belongs to yoga, not classical Jyotish.

hindi: जो यह करता है वो सहसरा चक्र को एक्टिवेट करता है
says: A person who lives by this 'we will see' attitude activates the sahasrara, the crown chakra.
ambiguity: 'Yeh karta hai' is vague; it may mean following the sushumna path or the carefree attitude. The 12th link is by context only.
classical_check: Silent: chakras belong to yoga practice, not classical Jyotish.

hindi: और यहीं से उस व्यक्ति के पास जुए के थ्रू भी धन आता है विंड फॉल अपने आप पता नहीं कहां से जुगाड़ होता है
says: From this same 12th house money also comes to that person through gambling, as a windfall that arranges itself from some unknown place.
cells_derived_method: The windfall style follows the sign: Aquarius or Gemini through sudden unexpected chances, Sagittarius through luck, Scorpio through hidden sources.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 12th in Sagittarius suggests windfalls arriving through luck and goodwill.
Derived: a planet in the 12th in Scorpio suggests windfalls from hidden or inherited sources.

ambiguity: 'Yahin se' could mean the sushumna and moksha route or the 12th; read as the 12th by the jugaad context.
classical_check: Differs: classically the 12th is outflow; windfall gain is the 11th or 5th.

hindi: बम की तरह पैसा आता है 11 भाव से और जुगाड़ का पैसा आता है बवे भाव से
says: He contrasts the two money houses: money that lands like a bomb, suddenly and in a lump, comes from the 11th, while jugaad money arranged from nowhere comes from the 12th.
cells_derived_method: The 11th's lump-sum gain comes in the style of its sign, and the 12th's jugaad money in the style of its own sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 11th in Aquarius gives sudden, large gains through networks and technology.
Derived: a planet in the 12th in Pisces gives quiet jugaad money through unseen helpers or foreign links.

ambiguity: 'Bave bhav' is read as the 12th.
classical_check: Agrees on the 11th as gain; differs on the 12th, which is classically outflow rather than a source of money.

hindi: इसी के पास बेड कंफर्ट्स है सेक्स लाइफ इसी के पास स्लीप है डेरिंग है
says: The 12th also holds bed comforts, sex life, sleep and daring.
cells_derived_method: The bed life follows the sign: Taurus sensual and comfortable, Aries restless and bold, Virgo anxious or light sleep, Pisces dreamy and deep sleep.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 12th in Taurus gives a sensual, comfortable bed life and sound sleep.
Derived: a planet in the 12th in Aries gives a restless, bold bed life and disturbed sleep.

classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is shayana sukha (bed pleasures), sleep and expenditure.

hindi: तीन तरीके हैं लकड़ी के बेड पर सोते हैं पति-पत्नी तो झगड़ा होता है तो रट आयरन के बेड पर सोए उस पर भी झगड़ा हो रहा है जमीन पर गद्दा बिछा के सोए
says: Remedy for a bad bed life: try three setups in turn, a wooden bed, a wrought-iron bed ('rat iron'), or a mattress laid on the floor, and see which one stops the quarrels between husband and wife.
ambiguity: 'Rat iron' is read as wrought iron. He does not link the choice of bed to any planet or sign; it is a trial-and-see remedy.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not prescribe bed materials; this is a vastu-style folk remedy.

hindi: तीनों में से एक में सेटलमेंट होएगी ही होएगी बेड कंफर्ट सेट होंगे प्रेम भले ना हो
says: One of the three bed setups will surely bring a settlement, so bed comfort will fall into place even if love may not.
ambiguity: 'Settlement' means peace in the bed life, not a legal settlement; he promises comfort but not love.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उसके लिए पांचवा सातवें घर की कहानी है भले ही उसके बाद तलाक भी हो जाए डिपेंड करता है अगर कुंडली के ग्रह खराब है
says: Love itself is a matter of the 5th and 7th houses, not the 12th; divorce may still follow later, depending on whether the planets in the kundli are bad.
cells_derived_method: The nature of love and marriage follows the signs on the 5th and 7th: Libra gives romantic charm, Scorpio gives intense, possessive pairing with a risk of break.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 5th in Libra gives charming, balanced romance.
Derived: a planet in the 7th in Scorpio gives an intense, possessive marriage with risk of a break if the planets are bad.

classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is romance and the 7th is marriage.

hindi: लेकिन हर हालत में यह तो सुधरेगा ही सुधरेगा किसी हालत में नहीं रह सकता कि सुधरे ना
says: Whatever the situation, bed comfort will certainly improve; it cannot remain unfixed in any case.
ambiguity: 'Yeh' is read as the bed comfort of the 12th just discussed; it may mean the bed settlement from the three-bed trial.
classical_check: Silent: a guarantee of this kind is not classical.

hindi: पहले भाव पर आपका चेहरा था हेड है ब्रेन है खोपड़ी
says: The 1st house stands for the face and head, the brain and the skull.
cells_derived_method: The part of the head stressed follows the sign on the 1st: Aries the skull and brain, Taurus the face and throat, Gemini the ears and nerves.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 1st in Aries stresses the skull and brain region of the body-map.
Derived: a planet in the 1st in Taurus stresses the face and throat region.

classical_check: Agrees: the 1st house and Aries rule the head in the Kalapurusha body map.

hindi: इसके अंदर कोई दोष है तो आपके ब्रेन में चोट देगा ग्रह सिर का दर्द देता है परेशानी देता है आधा सिर
says: If there is a dosha in the 1st house the planet hurts the brain, giving head pain, trouble and half-head pain; recorded only as his body-map claim, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The kind of head trouble follows the afflicted sign: fire signs bring injury or heat-type head pain, earth signs chronic stiffness, air signs nerve-type pain.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an afflicted 1st in Aries would, by his rule, show as head injury or sharp headache; not a diagnosis.
Derived: an afflicted 1st in Capricorn would, by his rule, show as chronic, slow-building head or bone strain; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: 'Aadha sir' is read as half-head pain (migraine-like); the sentence continues from the chunk before. No diagnosis is intended.
classical_check: Agrees in method: an afflicted lagna is classically linked to head troubles; the specific symptoms are his.

hindi: दूसरे का दांत दूसरे घर से दांत होते हैं टंग है जीभ थ्रोट राइट आई सलाइवा
says: The 2nd house covers the teeth, tongue, throat, right eye and saliva.
cells_derived_method: The stress falls on the part matching the sign: Taurus the throat, Gemini the voice and speech, Leo the right eye.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 2nd in Taurus stresses the throat and voice region.
Derived: a planet in the 2nd in Leo stresses the right eye and heart-linked energy of the face.

classical_check: Agrees: the 2nd is face, right eye, mouth, teeth, tongue and speech.

hindi: अगर यहां पर आपके शनि की दृष्टि है एक एग्जांपल है बहुत से ग्रहों की बात होगी तो आपकी नाक की हड्डी टेढ़ी होगी शनि की दृष्टि शनि बैठा होएगी
says: If Saturn aspects or sits in the 2nd house, as one example among many planets to come, the nasal bone will be crooked; recorded as his body-trait claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Saturn influences the 2nd by sitting in it or by aspecting it from the 12th (3rd aspect), the 8th (7th aspect) or the 5th (10th aspect); the sign changes the strength of the effect.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn sitting in the 2nd in Capricorn, its own sign, would by his rule give a crooked nasal bone.
Derived: Saturn in the 12th in its own sign Aquarius aspects the 2nd by its 3rd aspect, so the same nasal sign would apply.
Derived: Saturn in the 8th in exalted Libra aspects the 2nd by its 7th aspect, so the nasal sign would apply.

ambiguity: He mixes 'drishti' (aspect) and 'baitha' (sitting); either may count. 'Yahan par' is read as the 2nd house.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text names a crooked nasal bone for Saturn on the 2nd; this is his observation.

hindi: और ऐसे व्यक्ति को हर हालत में गर्दन के पीछे तिल का निशान होगा इसकी डिटेलिंग फिर दोबारा से भी होगी वो होना ही है
says: Such a person, with Saturn influencing the 2nd, will certainly have a mole mark at the back of the neck; he says the details will be covered again later.
ambiguity: 'Aise vyakti' is read as the person with Saturn on or aspecting the 2nd; the exact conditions and the 'har halat mein' guarantee are not detailed.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give no such mole rule for Saturn.

gist: He remarks how powerful astrology is, working at 101 (percent?) accuracy.

hindi: उस बंदे को आंख मूंद कह दो तेरा आईजी बढ़ा हुआ है क्योंकि शनि के दोष से आपका आईजी बढ़ता है जिसके कारण एलर्जी होती है
says: He says you can tell such a person with eyes closed that his IgE (immunoglobulin) is raised, because Saturn's affliction raises IgE and this causes allergy; recorded as his medical claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'Uss bande' refers to the Saturn-influenced 2nd person just before. 'IG' is read as IgE, the allergy antibody; the claim is not checked and no diagnosis is given.
classical_check: Silent: Saturn is classically linked to chronic and nerve troubles, but not to IgE or allergy by name.

hindi: फूड एलर्जी टेस्ट कराओ होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन लो पूरी जिंदगी लो पूरी जिंदगी ठीक रखेगा
says: His advice for that allergy: have a food-allergy test and take homeopathic medicine for life, which he says will keep you well; recorded as his claim, not as medical advice and not endorsed.
ambiguity: No dose, name or medicine is given; the remedy refers to the IgE and allergy claim just before.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नाक की हड्डी का ऑपरेशन मत कराओ शनि फिर अटैक मार देगा हर हालत के अंदर
says: Do not have the nasal bone operated on, because Saturn will attack again in every case; recorded as his claim, not medical advice and not endorsed.
ambiguity: 'Attack' is not described; it may mean the trouble returns after surgery.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not advise on surgery for this.

hindi: यही हमारा नाक है नाक लिखा नहीं गया है जीभ है
says: He notes that the nose also belongs to this 2nd house even though 'nose' has not been written on his list, then moves on to the tongue.
ambiguity: 'Yahi hamara naak hai' may mean the nose is part of this house, or it may only point to the discussion of the nasal bone; 'not written' refers to his board list.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 2nd covers the face; a nose is not named in classical lists.

hindi: आपके स्नोफिल काउंट्स बढ़ जाते हैं आपकी जबान सूखी सूखी रहती है स्नोफीलिया होता है आपको आपके मुंह के अंदर छाले पड़ जाते हैं आपका खाना खाते हुए थूक निकलते हुए बहुत दिक्कत हो जाती है
says: With the tongue and mouth of an afflicted 2nd, he says eosinophil counts go up, the tongue stays dry, mouth ulcers appear and eating and swallowing saliva become difficult; recorded as his claim, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The troubles show in the style of the sign on the afflicted 2nd: fire signs through heat and ulcers, earth signs through dryness and stiffness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an afflicted 2nd in Aries would, by his rule, show as heat-type mouth trouble such as ulcers; not a diagnosis.
Derived: an afflicted 2nd in Capricorn would, by his rule, show as dryness and stiffness of the tongue and swallowing; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: 'Snofil' is read as eosinophil. The sentence ends 'bahut dikkat ho' and finishes in the next slice ('jaati hai').
classical_check: Agrees in method that the 2nd rules the mouth; the specific blood-count claim is his.

hindi: आपकी नाक में सांस लेते हुए सांस जमती है साइनस के भयंकर मरीज सारा साइनसाइटिस वगैरह दूसरे में ही है साइनस भी इसमें ऐड करना पड़ेगा साइनसाइटिस आपका इसी के पास होता है
says: Blocked breathing in the nose, severe sinus patients and all sinusitis belong to the 2nd house; he says sinus must be added to its list; recorded as his body-map claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The congestion stresses the area of the sign: Taurus the throat and nose passages, Gemini the upper airways, Cancer the chest and watery mucus.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an afflicted 2nd in Taurus would, by his rule, point to throat and sinus congestion; not a diagnosis.
Derived: an afflicted 2nd in Cancer would, by his rule, point to watery, mucus-heavy sinus trouble; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: 'Dusre mein hi hai' is read as the 2nd house.
classical_check: Silent: sinus is not named in classical body-part lists for the 2nd.

hindi: एक आंख इसके पास है अगर दूसरे घर के अंदर किसी ग्रह का दोष है या बव घर में एक राइट आई एक लेफ्ट आई
says: The eyes are split between two houses: the right eye belongs to the 2nd and the left eye to the 12th, so a planet's fault in either house touches the matching eye.
cells_derived_method: The eye stressed follows the house, and the nature of the eye trouble follows the sign: Leo and Aries stress heat or light, Pisces or Cancer stress watery or tired eyes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a faulty planet in the 2nd in Leo would, by his rule, touch the right eye in a bright, heat-type way; not a diagnosis.
Derived: a faulty planet in the 12th in Pisces would, by his rule, touch the left eye with a watery or tired type of fault; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: 'Bav ghar' is read as the 12th; the caption says only one eye is the 2nd's and the right-left split is inferred from 'right eye, left eye'.
classical_check: Agrees: the 2nd is the right eye and the 12th the left eye.

hindi: आपकी ऑप्टिकल वेन में प्रॉब्लम आएगी आपके ऑप्टिकल वेन में प्रॉब्लम आने से रेटिना के अंदर पानी सूख जाएगा और दिखना बंद होगा
says: A fault in the 2nd or 12th brings trouble in the optic nerve ('optical vein'), which dries the retina and stops vision; recorded as his claim, not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'Optical vein' is read as the optic nerve. The houses are carried over from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Partly agrees: affliction of the 2nd and 12th is classically linked to the eyes; the optic nerve and retina mechanism is his.

hindi: इसका इलाज नहीं है धरती के ऊपर डॉक्टर ठीक नहीं कर पाता मात्र दो एक धागे पहनने से शनि महाराज जैसे ग्रहों के इलाज करने से
says: He claims this loss of vision has no cure on earth and doctors cannot fix it, but wearing one or two threads and treating planets like Shani Maharaj fixes it; recorded as his remedy claim, not medical advice and not endorsed.
ambiguity: 'Do ek dhaage' may mean a thread or two; which threads, colours or knots are not given.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give no thread remedy for retinal loss; the claim that doctors cannot treat it is his and not verified.

hindi: क्योंकि रेटीना और न्यूरो सारे शरीर का स्नायु नर्व्स नर्वस सिस्टम सारा शनि के पास है उसी से ठीक होता है
says: Saturn is the owner of the retina, the neuro system and the whole body's nerves and nervous system, which is why treating Saturn is said to fix such trouble.
cells_derived_method: Where Saturn sits colours which nerve area is stressed: in the 1st the head and brain nerves, in the 2nd the face and eyes, in the 6th the daily-routine nerve complaints.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 2nd in Capricorn stresses the nerves of the face and eyes.
Derived: Saturn in the 6th in Aquarius would, by his rule, show as nerve-type chronic complaints of the legs and circulation.

classical_check: Agrees in part: Saturn is the classical karaka of nerves, bones and chronic ailments; naming the retina specifically is his addition.

hindi: ये सलाइवा थूक मुंह में ये राइट शोल्डर राइट यर है तीसरा भाव राइट शोल्डर राइट यर
says: After saliva in the mouth (2nd), he moves to the 3rd house, which stands for the right shoulder and the right ear.
cells_derived_method: The stress follows the sign on the 3rd: Gemini the shoulders and arms, Taurus the ear-side neck, Capricorn stiffness in the joints.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 3rd in Gemini stresses the shoulders, arms and ears, its natural body area.
Derived: a planet in the 3rd in Capricorn gives stiffness in the right shoulder joint and a slow hearing change.

ambiguity: 'Yar' is read as 'ear'.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the 3rd is classically the ears and arms, with shoulders in the same area; the right-side split is his.

hindi: ये भाई है तीसरा भाई है हमारा यह भाई भाई है यह भाई बहन ये भी है
says: The 3rd house is also the house of brothers and sisters, our siblings.
cells_derived_method: The nature of the siblings follows the sign: Aries competitive and bold, Libra cooperative, Cancer caring.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 3rd in Aries shows bold, competitive siblings.
Derived: a planet in the 3rd in Libra shows cooperative, diplomatic siblings.

classical_check: Agrees: the 3rd is siblings, especially younger ones.

hindi: ये बड़े भाई बहन है ये छोटे भाई बहन
says: He splits siblings into elder and younger, pointing at two houses on the chart, one for elder brothers and sisters and one for younger.
ambiguity: Only 'ye' and 'ye' are said, pointing at the chart, so the houses are not named in the sentence; the next lines swap the 3rd and 11th, implying the 3rd younger and the 11th elder.
classical_check: Agrees with the usual split of the 3rd (younger) and 11th (elder), if that is what he points to.

hindi: इस प्रकार कुछ लोगों का उल्टा होता है जो बच्चे उल्टे पैदा होते हैं तो ये ट्विस्ट होगा
says: For some people the houses are reversed; children born the wrong way round (ulte paida) will show this twist, in which the roles of the sibling houses are swapped.
ambiguity: 'Ulte paida hote hain' may mean breech or reversed birth, or only a reversed life pattern; the houses 3 and 11 are named in the next sentence, not in this one.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe such a twist.

hindi: यह अपने दिमाग से एक्सपीरियंस के साथ व्यक्ति बता सकता है कि तेरा तीसरा भाव 11 की तरह काम कर रहा है और 11वां तीसरे की तरह वो भी ट्विस्टेड होगा एक्सपीरियंस से आता है
says: With experience a reader can tell that a person's 3rd house is working like the 11th and the 11th like the 3rd, a twisted or swapped pair; he says this comes only by experience.
cells_derived_method: A swapped 3rd and 11th would make effort-based gain and friend-based gain trade places: the 3rd's initiative shows as gains and the 11th's network as the source of siblings and courage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 3rd in Aquarius, a natural 11th sign, would be a pointer for the 3rd acting like the 11th, with gain through networks.
Derived: a planet in the 11th in Gemini, a natural 3rd sign, would be a pointer for the 11th acting like the 3rd, with gains from effort and writing.

ambiguity: He does not say how the swap is detected from the chart, only that it is learned by experience; the derived examples use the sign-to-house natural match as a possible clue.
classical_check: Silent: no classical rule of swapped house functions.

hindi: ये राइट शोल्डर राइट ईयर है यह शिफ्ट लेफ्ट पे भी
says: The right shoulder and right ear are of the 3rd, and the same pattern shifts to the left side as well; the sentence is cut at the end of the slice, probably leading to the left-side counterpart.
ambiguity: Cut off at the end of the slice; the house for the left shoulder and ear is not named here, probably the 11th.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 3rd and 11th are classically the right and left ears.

gist: He says it may happen differently in practice, but he is teaching 'by the book', as per the books.
Repeats that the right shoulder and right ear belong to the 3rd house, already stated in the previous slice.

hindi: कान के अंदर क्या समस्या है तकलीफ है आपके दूसरे और तीसरे भाव के बीच में प्रॉब्लम आएगी सर्वाइकल आएगा
says: Trouble inside the ear, and a cervical (neck-spine) problem, arise from the junction between the 2nd and 3rd houses; recorded as his body-map claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The neck and ear area is stressed by afflictions of the 2nd or 3rd; the sign shows the kind of strain: Taurus the neck and throat, Gemini the shoulders and arms.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an afflicted planet in the 3rd in Gemini would, by his rule, show as shoulder, neck and ear strain on the right side; not a diagnosis.
Derived: an afflicted planet in the 2nd in Taurus would, by his rule, show as neck and throat strain at the 2nd and 3rd junction; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: 'Beech mein' (between) the 2nd and 3rd is read as the junction or boundary of the two houses, or an affliction touching both.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 2nd and 3rd are classically linked to the neck, throat and ears; cervical trouble is his specific addition.

hindi: मजे की बात है ये एक ही साइड आ रहा है लेफ्ट साइड के अगर 10वें और 11वें में तो मानी 11 12 से नहीं आएगा सर्वाइकल आपका आएगा ही इ तरफ इसी तरफ से
says: Interestingly, this cervical trouble comes on one side only: it will come from the right side (2nd and 3rd) and not from the left-side houses (he says 10th and 11th, then 11th and 12th).
ambiguity: He first says '10th and 11th' for the left side, then 'not from 11 and 12'; likely the left-side counterparts are the 11th and 12th, mirroring the 3rd and 2nd. The caption is unclear.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not split the body into right and left by house.

hindi: अगर यहां ग्रहों का दोष है आपको सर्वाइकल होना ही होना है
says: If planets afflict this 2nd and 3rd junction, the person is certain to get a cervical problem; recorded as his claim, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The strength of the affliction depends on the planet and sign: a malefic in a hostile sign in the 2nd or 3rd makes the neck trouble more certain.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a malefic in the 2nd in Capricorn would, by his rule, make a stiff-neck type problem near-certain; not a diagnosis.
Derived: a malefic in the 3rd in Aries would, by his rule, make shoulder-and-neck trouble from sudden strain likely; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: 'Yahan' is read as the 2nd and 3rd junction named just before. 'Must happen' is his absolute wording.
classical_check: Silent: an absolute rule of this kind is not classical.

hindi: उस सर्वाइकल में क्या दोष है हड्डी का है शनि और सूर्य का दोष है
says: If the cervical problem is of the bone, the fault belongs to Saturn and the Sun.
cells_derived_method: A bone fault from Saturn or the Sun shows where those planets sit: the Sun in a weak sign gives weaker bones in that house's body part, Saturn in a hostile sign gives stiffness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the Sun in the 3rd in its debilitation sign Libra would, by his rule, point to a weak bone fault in the shoulder and neck area; not a diagnosis.
Derived: Saturn in the 2nd in its own sign Capricorn would, by his rule, point to stiffness of the neck bones; not a diagnosis.

classical_check: Agrees: the Sun and Saturn are both classical karakas of bones and joints.

hindi: आपका ब्लड सर्कुलेशन का है मंगल का दोष है
says: If the cervical or body problem is one of blood circulation, the fault is Mars's.
cells_derived_method: A Mars-type circulation fault shows in the body area of the house Mars occupies, and its strength varies with the sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 4th in its debilitation sign Cancer would, by his rule, show as a circulation fault in the chest and arm; not a diagnosis.
Derived: Mars in the 6th in its own sign Scorpio would, by his rule, give strong blood but heat or inflammation tendency in the lower body; not a diagnosis.

classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the classical karaka of blood.

hindi: आपका किस चीज का दोष है उस हिसाब से वायु का विकार होता है पेट में गैस होती तो चेस्ट में पहना जाता है बुध का दोष ऐसा बनता है
says: If the fault is of wind (vayu), with gas in the stomach rising to the chest, it is a Mercury fault; the type of problem decides which planet is at fault.
cells_derived_method: The wind fault is stressed in the area of the house Mercury sits in: the 6th the digestion, the 4th the chest.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in the 4th in its own sign Gemini would, by his rule, show as airy discomfort rising into the chest; not a diagnosis.
Derived: Mercury in the 6th in its debilitation sign Pisces would, by his rule, show as gas and weak digestion; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: 'Chest mein pahna jata hai' is garbled; read as the gas moving or spreading up to the chest.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Mercury is a nerve and air karaka, with vata effects; gas rising to the chest is his specific picture.

hindi: बुध सूर्य को डिस्टर्ब कर देता है बुध वायु है
says: Mercury disturbs the Sun, and Mercury is the wind (vayu) element; so wind from Mercury unsettles the Sun's domain of the heart, chest and bones.
cells_derived_method: The disturbance is strongest where Mercury sits close to the Sun or in the Sun's sign, and it shows in the body area of that house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in the 4th in Leo, the Sun's sign, would, by his rule, disturb the chest and heart area with airy discomfort; not a diagnosis.
Derived: Mercury in the 10th in Sagittarius would, by his rule, unsettle the back and chest region through nervous wind; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: How Mercury 'disturbs' the Sun (conjunction, aspect or sign) is not said.
classical_check: Differs in part: Mercury is classically tridoshic and a nerve karaka, not purely vayu; its closeness to the Sun is classically normal, since it is always near the Sun.

hindi: चौथा घर चेस्ट है लंग्स है हार्ट राइट आर्म दाया हाथ इधर इधर का सारा इलाका राइट एल्बो
says: The 4th house is the chest, lungs and heart, plus the right arm, the right hand and the whole area around it, down to the right elbow.
cells_derived_method: The stress falls on the part matching the sign: Cancer the chest and lungs, Leo the heart, Gemini the arms.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 4th in Cancer stresses the chest and lung area, the natural place of this sign.
Derived: a planet in the 4th in Leo stresses the heart and upper back.

classical_check: Agrees in part: the 4th is classically the chest and heart; assigning the right arm and elbow is his addition.

hindi: आपको टेनिस एल्बो हो रही है गोल्फ एल्बो हो रही है सब इसी की कृपा से है
says: Tennis elbow and golfer's elbow are all due to the faults of this same 4th house; recorded as his body-map claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The elbow strain follows the afflicted sign: fire signs through overuse and sudden strain, earth signs through stiffness and wear.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an afflicted 4th with a planet in Aries would, by his rule, show as overuse-type elbow strain; not a diagnosis.
Derived: an afflicted 4th with a planet in Capricorn would, by his rule, show as stiff, long-lasting elbow pain; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: 'Isi ki kripa' refers to the 4th just discussed; the cause is attributed only to the house, with no planet named.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not name elbow conditions.

hindi: इसके लिए आपको यहां टैटू बनवाया जाता है उस रंग का जो रंग आपका फेवरेबल है चौथे या 10वें घर के अंदर या यहां या यहां
says: Remedy: a tattoo is made on the body area of the 4th or 10th house (or at another pointed place) in the colour that is favourable to you; recorded as his tradition claim, not advice.
cells_derived_method: The favourable colour depends on the planet to be strengthened for that house: for the lagna Aries, the 4th lord is the Moon (white or silver) and the 10th lord is Saturn (dark blue or black).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Aries the 4th house is Cancer with the Moon as lord, so the favourable colour of the tattoo would be white or silver.
Derived: for lagna Aries the 10th house is Capricorn with Saturn as lord, so the favourable colour of the tattoo would be dark blue or black.

ambiguity: 'Favourable colour' is not defined; it is likely the colour of the planet to be strengthened, but he says the colour method is not yet taught. The pointing words 'yahan' are about spots on the body.
classical_check: Silent: tattoos as a Jyotish remedy are not classical; colour and gem remedies exist, but this is his own method.

hindi: टेंपरेरी तौर पे धागा बांधते हैं यहां किस रंग के ग्रह को एक्टिवेट करना है
says: Remedy: for a temporary effect a thread is tied at the same body spots, in the colour of the planet that is to be activated.
ambiguity: The planet and its colour are not named; he says each planet has its own colour and moves to that next.
classical_check: Silent: coloured threads are a folk remedy, not classical.

hindi: ग्रहों के अपने-अपने कलर्स हैं थोड़े-थोड़े से ग्रह के कलर्स हैं राइट फोर आर में इत्यादि ये सारा
says: Each planet has its own colour (the colours are slightly different for each planet); the tattoo or thread goes on the right forearm and similar spots, in the colour of the planet being worked on.
ambiguity: No colours are listed here; 'right fore-arm' is one of the spots named and the sentence trails off with 'etc.'
classical_check: Agrees in part: planet colours (red for Mars, white for the Moon and so on) are classical; the tattoo placement is his.

hindi: कोई यहां टैटू बनवा आता है कोई यहां कोई यहां कोई चेस पर बनाता है कोई पीठ पर वो एक ही बात है एक ही एरिया पीठ का एरिया भी वही है
says: Whether the tattoo is made on the arm, the chest or the back, it is the same thing, since the chest and back belong to one and the same house area.
ambiguity: The houses are not named here; they follow from the 4th or 10th just mentioned and the chest-and-back area is read as the same house region.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: राहु है शनि है लाल तिल सफेद काला तिल ये सारे के सारे जो हिसाब किताब चेस्ट के एरिया के बनते पीठ पर चेस्ट पर बाजू पर यह शनि महाराज जैसे ग्रहों के कारण ही है
says: If a planet like Rahu or Saturn afflicts the chest and back area, then the red, white or black moles and marks seen on the chest, back and arm are all due to Saturn-like planets.
cells_derived_method: The colour and spot of the mark follow the planet and the house area: a dark mole for Saturn or Rahu in the chest or back houses, a red mark for a hot planet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 4th in its own sign Aquarius would, by his rule, give dark moles or marks on the chest and right arm.
Derived: Saturn in the 10th in exalted Libra would, by his rule, give dark marks on the back and shoulders.

ambiguity: 'Yahan par' is read as the chest-and-back area of the 4th and 10th. 'White mole' is unusual and may mean a white patch.
classical_check: Agrees in part: moles and marks are classically read by house and planet; the colour link to Rahu and Saturn is his.

hindi: वन साइड ऑफ एडमन पांचवा खाना है वन साइड एब्डोमेन का यह वाला एरिया किडनी का एरिया अपेंडिक्स का एरिया अपेंडिक्स है किडनी है ओवरी है साइड कमर का एरिया है फ्लोटिंग रिब्स है
says: One side of the abdomen is the 5th house box: the kidney area, appendix, ovary, the flank at the waist and the floating ribs all belong to it.
cells_derived_method: The part stressed follows the sign: Leo the heart and upper abdomen, Virgo the intestines, Libra the kidneys, Sagittarius the hips and thighs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 5th in Virgo stresses the intestine and appendix region.
Derived: a planet in the 5th in Libra stresses the kidney and flank region.

ambiguity: 'Ek side' is read as the right side because the following lines say 'right side 5th'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 5th is classically linked to the upper abdomen and stomach; the kidney, appendix and ovary split by side is his.

hindi: हमारी रिब्स जो घूमने वाले रिब्स है जो मूवमेंट है वो सारी की सारी इधर है छोटे इंटेस्टाइन छोटे इंटेस्टाइन जहां खाने का नरिच मेंट बनता है जो ताकत लेता है
says: The moving (floating) ribs and the small intestine, where food's nourishment is made and strength is taken, also lie in this same area of the abdomen.
ambiguity: The house is not repeated; it is read as the 5th from the previous line. The small intestine could instead be the 6th (Virgo), as classical body maps put the intestines there.
classical_check: Differs in part: the classical body map puts the intestines under the 6th (Virgo), not the 5th.

hindi: ये हमारा गंधर्व देवता है इसके ठीक पश्चात हमारा भृंगराज आता है वो भी घर के अंदर देवता होता है वो भी यहां से भी करेक्ट होता है
says: A vastu link: this abdominal area corresponds to the Gandharva deity of the house, and just after it comes Bhringraj, also a deity inside the house; these house deities can also be corrected from this body spot.
ambiguity: The body area is 'this'; read as the small-intestine and abdomen region just discussed. It is not stated which house or direction of the home is meant.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Gandharva and Bhringraj are devatas of the vastu purusha mandala (both on the southern side); linking them to body areas and Jyotish houses is his claim.

gist: He says this part is for specialists who already know the science; they will catch it.

hindi: ये राइट थाई है थाई भी आपकी ये एरिया है आपका थाई का एरिया यानी यहां से यहां तक का ये इतना एरिया जो पकड़ा है यह एरिया आपका राइट साइड पांचवे भाव के अंदर है पांचवा घर

cells_derived_method: The thigh stress follows the sign: Sagittarius is the natural sign of the thighs, Gemini the muscles and nerves of the limb.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 5th in Sagittarius stresses the right thigh and hip, the natural place of this sign.
Derived: a planet in the 5th in Gemini stresses the nerves and muscles of the right thigh.

ambiguity: The 'here to here' is pointing on the body and cannot be read from the caption.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the thighs are classically Sagittarius and the 9th; putting the right thigh under the 5th is his body map.

hindi: ये पांच है पाच छ चार तीन दो एक
says: He counts the houses along the right side of the body, five, five, six, four, three, two, one, showing that the right half carries the houses 1 to 6 from head down to foot.
ambiguity: The counting is garbled and out of order (5, 5, 6, 4, 3, 2, 1); the stated meaning is inferred from the houses he names for the head, shoulder, chest, thigh and ankle.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not give a right-side and left-side house map of the body.

hindi: ये आपका राइट छठा घर जो है राइट एंकल है राइट एंकल मींस ये पंजा पैर का य आपका यह वाला एंकल पैर इस पैर के अंदर आपका छठा भाव है
says: The 6th house is the right ankle and foot, the part pointing to the ankle and the sole area of the right leg.
cells_derived_method: The foot and ankle stress follows the sign: Aquarius the ankles, Pisces the feet, Capricorn the knees above.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 6th in Aquarius stresses the ankle, the natural place of this sign.
Derived: a planet in the 6th in Pisces stresses the feet and soles.

classical_check: Differs: classically the feet are the 12th and Pisces, the ankles Aquarius and the 11th; he puts the right ankle and foot in the 6th.

hindi: आपके छठे भाव में शत्रु थे कोर्ट कचहरी थी बीमारी थी वेस्टेज थी नौकरी पर झगड़ा था बहुस से रिलेशनशिप थी कर्जे का हिसाब था जेल जाने का हिसाब किताब
says: The 6th house covers enemies, courts and litigation, disease, wastage, quarrels at work, a number of relationships, the account of debts, and the account of going to jail.
cells_derived_method: The style of the 6th's conflicts follows the sign: Scorpio hidden or intense enemies, Libra legal and partner disputes, Virgo workplace and service quarrels.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 6th in Scorpio points to secret enemies and intense legal fights.
Derived: a planet in the 6th in Libra points to court cases and disputes arising from partnerships.

ambiguity: 'Bahus se relationship' is read as 'bahut se relationship' (many relationships); it is not clear whether he means troubled or numerous ties.
classical_check: Agrees: the 6th is enemies, litigation, disease and debt; jail and wastage overlap with what he gave to the 12th earlier, so the two houses are given overlapping topics.

hindi: सिर्फ बाएं पैर में एक धागा मात्र उस ग्रह का बांध देने से जिस ग्रह की पॉजिटिविटी वहां होगी वह प्लेसमेंट से ही आपका वह घर ठीक हो जाता है
says: Remedy: just tying one thread of the right planet on the left foot, the planet whose positivity sits there, is said to set that house right through that placement alone.
ambiguity: He says the 6th is the right ankle but names the left foot for the thread; this may be a slip, or the mirror foot works; the caption cannot settle it. The 'planet whose positivity is there' is not named.
classical_check: Silent: a thread on the foot for the 6th is a folk remedy, not classical.

hindi: यह छठे भाव के पास आपकी रीड की हड्डी है
says: The spine, the backbone, lies with the 6th house in his body map.
cells_derived_method: The stress on the spine follows the sign: Virgo the lower digestive and lumbar region, Capricorn the bones and joints, Leo the upper back.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 6th in Virgo stresses the lower back and digestive region of the spine.
Derived: a planet in the 6th in Capricorn stresses the bones and joints of the spine.

ambiguity: 'Ke paas' (near) may mean the spine is next to the 6th or part of it.
classical_check: Differs in part: the classical body map puts the spine under Leo and the 5th, with Virgo and the 6th for the lower abdomen.

hindi: आपके छठे भाव में डिस्टरबेंस है कॉमिनेशन के हिसाब से होता है तो इनएविटेबल है कि l4 ए5 वन में आपके हर हालत में गैप होगा रीड की हड्डी में
says: If the 6th house is disturbed, depending on the combination, it is inevitable that there will be a gap in the spine at the L4 and L5 level (and likely S1); recorded as his body-map claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The spinal weakness follows the afflicted sign: earth signs through wear and degeneration, fire signs through injury.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an afflicted 6th with a planet in Capricorn would, by his rule, show as slow wear in the lower spine bones; not a diagnosis.
Derived: an afflicted 6th with a planet in Aries would, by his rule, show as sudden strain or injury in the lower spine; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: 'L4 E5 van' is read as L4-L5 and probably L5-S1 vertebral levels; the caption is garbled. 'Gap' presumably means a disc-space problem.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not name spinal levels.

gist: He says how to decide the colour of the thread has not been taught yet; the colour, the placements and the aspects are not known at this stage.
He says he has opened a very long khichdi (mixed bag) of material and wonders what he has done.
Devotional aside invoking Rama, Krishna and Jagannath, with the audience told to say the whole line now and then.
He says he will tell everything, keeps nothing to himself, has no tension, and everyone will learn it.
He urges people to learn quickly day and night instead of wasting years and money, to know it themselves and tell others.
Joke: someone asked if he would give everything away and he replied they will not find Brajesh Gautam's skull to use it.
Remark that a person who goes broke and learns the art of rising again to a bungalow has won; he says he has seen this.
He says it is done in a snap, nothing to it, it is his daily work, which he keeps playing with.
He jokes about being mad with pride, asks God what to do with it, then says learning this is beautiful and brings contentment to the soul.

hindi: सातवा घर रिप्रोडक्टिव ऑर्गन है सेक्सुअल प्रॉब्लम्स रिप्रोडक्टिव ऑर्गन
says: The 7th house is the reproductive organ and sexual problems are read from it; recorded as his body-map claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The stress follows the sign on the 7th: Scorpio the genitals, Libra the kidneys and lower back, Taurus the pelvic floor.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 7th in Scorpio stresses the genitals and reproductive organs, the natural place of this sign.
Derived: a planet in the 7th in Libra stresses the lower back and kidneys beside the reproductive area.

classical_check: Agrees: the 7th is classically the reproductive organs and sexual matters.

hindi: आपका राइट टेस्टिकल छटे घर में है एठ में लेफ्ट टेस्टिकल है
says: The right testicle belongs to the 6th house and the left testicle to the 8th.
cells_derived_method: The side and sign colour the fault: a planet in the 6th stresses the right organ, a planet in the 8th the left, with the sign deciding the nature.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 6th in Scorpio stresses the right testicle area, in the sign of the reproductive organs.
Derived: a planet in the 8th in Taurus would, by his rule, stress the left side with a stubborn, slow-healing type of fault; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: 'Eth mein' is read as the 8th (aath).
classical_check: Silent: right and left organ split by house is his body map.

hindi: आपकी राइट ओवरी लड़की की पांचवे घर में है नाइंथ हाउस में उसकी लेफ्ट ओवरी है फैलोपियन ट्यूब्स आपकी पांचवे में है
says: For a girl the right ovary is in the 5th house and the left ovary in the 9th house, and the fallopian tubes are in the 5th.
cells_derived_method: The side and sign colour the fault: the 5th stresses the right ovary and tubes, the 9th the left ovary, with the sign deciding the nature.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 5th in Libra stresses the right ovary and the kidney-side area.
Derived: a planet in the 9th in Scorpio would, by his rule, stress the left ovary in the sign of reproductive organs; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: 'Ladki' (girl) is read as female chart; whether the same split applies to the left-right mirror of the male chart is not said.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not assign ovaries by side to the 5th and 9th.

hindi: अगर इन घरों में दोष है तो रिप्रोडक्टिव एबिलिटी में प्रॉब्लम आती है सातवें घर के साथ रिप्रोडक्टिव एबिलिटी यानी कि संतान प्राप्ति
says: If these houses (5th, 6th, 8th, 9th) are afflicted, along with the 7th, reproductive ability suffers, which means trouble in having children; recorded as his claim, not a medical or fertility prediction.
cells_derived_method: The sign and planet on the afflicted house show the type of delay: Capricorn through delay, Scorpio through reproductive organ trouble, Cancer through emotional or hormonal causes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an afflicted 5th with a planet in Capricorn would, by his rule, show delay in having children; not a prediction.
Derived: an afflicted 8th with a planet in Scorpio would, by his rule, point to reproductive organ trouble; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: 'In gharon' refers to the houses of the organs just listed (5th, 6th, 8th, 9th); the 7th is added at the end.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the 5th and 7th are classically linked to conception and fertility; the 6th, 8th and 9th organ houses are his.

hindi: अब ये हम सबको संतान का पता है संतान पैदा होगी हमारी गाड़ी पैदा होती है सोफा पैदा होता है मकान पैदा होता है यह पैदा होता है चिजी बनाने का सारा कार्यक्रम भी सप्तम भाव से ही है
says: We all know about children being born, but he says cars, sofas and houses are also 'born'; the whole program of creating things, like procreation, comes from the 7th house.
cells_derived_method: The kind of thing created follows the sign on the 7th: Taurus possessions and comforts, Libra partnerships and deals, Capricorn structures and property.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 7th in Taurus would, by his logic, show creation of possessions, vehicles and household comforts.
Derived: a planet in the 7th in Capricorn would, by his logic, show creation of property and lasting structures.

ambiguity: 'Paida hota hai' is used loosely for acquiring or creating things; it is not clear whether he means acquisitions of objects are timed by the 7th.
classical_check: Differs: classically vehicles and home are the 4th and children the 5th; the 7th is partnership. Making creation the 7th's theme is his generalisation.

hindi: इसीलिए पत्नी या पति आने के बाद मेल और फीमेल दो एनर्जी सेट हो जाती है ये सप्तम भाव सेट हो जाता है
says: That is why after a wife or husband arrives, the male and female energies get set, and the 7th house is set.
cells_derived_method: How easily the two energies settle follows the sign on the 7th: Taurus settles into comfort, Aries stays competitive, Libra settles by compromise.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 7th in Taurus makes the pairing settle into steady, comfortable union.
Derived: a planet in the 7th in Aries keeps the pairing competitive, so the settling is slow and contested.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the 7th is the house of spouse and union of man and woman.

hindi: लड़कियों के यूटरस के जितने प्रॉब्लम्स और ऑपरेशन होते हैं सातव भाव में
says: All the uterus problems and operations of girls and women are read from the 7th house; recorded as his body-map claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The kind of uterine trouble follows the sign on the afflicted 7th: Scorpio structural or surgical, Cancer hormonal or emotional, Capricorn slow or chronic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an afflicted 7th with a planet in Scorpio would, by his rule, point to structural trouble that may need surgery; not a diagnosis.
Derived: an afflicted 7th with a planet in Cancer would, by his rule, point to hormonal or cyclical trouble; not a diagnosis.

classical_check: Agrees in part: the 7th is classically the genital organs; uterus operations specifically are his claim.

hindi: अब सातवा भाव डिस्टर्ब है और फिर वो गालियां बकरी मेरा हस्बैंड कुत्ता है हस्बैंड कुत्ता है
says: When the 7th house is disturbed, the wife begins to abuse and curse, calling her husband a dog; he uses this as an example of a disturbed 7th showing in marital quarrels.
cells_derived_method: The style of the quarrel follows the sign on the afflicted 7th: Aries open shouting, Scorpio bitter and cutting, Gemini sharp words.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a disturbed 7th with a planet in Aries would give open, loud quarrels and name-calling.
Derived: a disturbed 7th with a planet in Scorpio would give bitter, cutting abuse and long grudges.

ambiguity: This is an illustration with an insulting word, not a technical rule; the real claim is that a disturbed 7th brings abusive marital conflict.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: an afflicted 7th is classically linked to marital discord.

gist: Joke that a husband is anyway a dog, and the wife has not learned how to put a leash on him; how smart she is shows in leashing him, which he calls her artistry.

hindi: अगर वह पहले से ही गुरु आदमी है तो उसके पास गोपियां होंगी ढेर सारी फिर तुम्हें वो भी बर्दाश्त नहीं होगी जितने ये बड़े-बड़े चौधरी है ढेर सारी गोपियां
says: If the husband is already a guru-type man (Jupiter-like), he will have many gopis, women around him, and the wife will not tolerate even that, as with big bosses who have many gopis.
cells_derived_method: A Jupiter-like husband draws more admiration when Jupiter sits in the 7th in a strong sign, as it is the husband karaka for a woman's chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the 7th in its own sign Sagittarius would, by his logic, give a guru-like husband surrounded by many admirers.
Derived: Jupiter in the 7th in its own sign Pisces would, by his logic, give a gentle, spiritual husband whom many women look up to.

ambiguity: 'Guru aadmi' may mean a Jupiter-type man in the chart or simply a guru-like personality; no planet is named in the sentence.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Jupiter is the husband karaka in a woman's chart; the link to many gopis is his illustration.

gist: Krishna has too much male energy, he is the complete man (purna purush), while Ram is the best of men within propriety (maryada purushottam); understand the words prakriti and purush.
Story of Meera being stopped at a temple for being a woman and telling the pandit that only Krishna is a complete man and everyone else is a woman.
Says all women will be crazy about a purushottam and there is no need to burn with jealousy, because they are in love; the sentence is cut at the end of the slice.
Says it is a woman's dharma and nature to love, and that a woman does love, ending the Krishna and Meera passage.

hindi: आठवा भाव आपका लेफ्ट एंकल है बाया वाला छठा भाव राइट वाला था
says: The 8th house is the left ankle, the left-hand one, just as the 6th house was the right ankle.
cells_derived_method: The stress on the left ankle and foot follows the sign on the 8th: Aquarius the ankle, Pisces the foot, Capricorn the lower leg above.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 8th in Aquarius stresses the left ankle, the natural place of this sign.
Derived: a planet in the 8th in Pisces stresses the left foot and sole.

classical_check: Differs: classically the ankles belong to Aquarius and the 11th and the feet to Pisces and the 12th; his right and left body map puts the 6th and 8th there.

hindi: इसमें लेफ्ट पांव में होता है मृत्यु कारक
says: The left foot, under the 8th house, holds the death-causing (mrityu karak) indicator; recorded as his symbolic body-map claim, not a prediction of death.
cells_derived_method: The kind of crisis the 8th indicates follows its sign: Scorpio deep or sudden transformation, Aquarius abrupt breaks, Pisces dissolving or confusing endings.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 8th in Scorpio, the 8th's natural sign, intensifies the life-and-death theme of this house.
Derived: a planet in the 8th in Libra shows the 8th's crises coming through partners and settlements, a milder form.

ambiguity: 'Mrityu karak' is read as the death-related indicator of the 8th, not a foretelling of a death; it is not a date or a cause of death.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the 8th is the classical house of death and longevity; locating it in the left foot is his body map.

hindi: आप बीमार पड़े हॉस्पिटलाइज पड़े लेफ्ट पांव का ही धागा या टैटू भी करा देते हैं
says: Remedy: when you fall sick or are hospitalised, a thread is tied on the left foot, or a tattoo is also made there; recorded as his tradition claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: The thread colour or planet is not named here; he says earlier that colour has not yet been taught.
classical_check: Silent: a foot thread or tattoo is not a classical remedy.

hindi: इसमें कई बार वो आपको डिसाइड करके दे देगा कि आपकी लाइफ में मृत्यु से कैसे पला छुड़ाना पैर की चोट का क्या हिसाब करना है ससुराल के साथ रिलेशन कैसे बनाने
says: He claims this left-foot thread or tattoo often settles for you how to escape the death-risk in your life, how to handle a foot injury, and how to build relations with the in-laws; recorded as his claim, not a guarantee.
ambiguity: 'Woh' (it) is the planet or placement chosen for the thread; 'decide karke de dega' is loose and may mean it guides the choice or just sets things right.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not tie foot remedies to death-risk, foot injury or in-law relations.

gist: In-law quarrels are hard, and a woman is the one who joins, glue-like (the caption says 'alfi', probably Fevi as in Fevicol).
A wife cannot leave her mother's home; the husband says leave it, she says she has held on to him and will not let them go either, so a big fight follows.
A man says he wants the whole wife, lets go quickly when he does not get it, has a short, aggressive temper and swears, slaps or barks on the road.
The wife says do not worry, she will manage it all (the 'paon paon' phrase is garbled) and carry on.
The wife says she will neither leave her family nor leave him nor let him leave; this is the woman who makes a home.
The man, the donkey, never notices when she has leashed and fooled him; they fight, love and quarrel, but she does not let him go, and it is a misconception that he left her.
She can handle a lot, both her mother's home and the in-laws; she says she will fight it out and it will be done.

hindi: जिस स्त्री में पुरुष तत्व ज्यादा है उसका अष्टम भाव एक्टिवेट हो जाता है और उसको शारीरिक कष्ट होते हैं
says: In a woman with more of the male element (a dominant, masculine nature), the 8th house gets activated and she suffers physical troubles; recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: A woman's male-element tilt shows in her chart by masculine signs and planets; the 8th activated in a fire or air sign carries the physical strain in a more combative form.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an active 8th with a planet in Aries would, by his logic, give physical strain with a combative, assertive woman; not a diagnosis.
Derived: an active 8th with a planet in Leo would, by his logic, show a strong, commanding woman with strain on the heart and back; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: 'Purush tattva' (male element) is not tied to any planet or sign in the sentence.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not link a woman's dominant nature to the 8th.

hindi: उसको सारी की सारी यूरिनरी डिजीज होती हैं उसको यूटरस की दिक्कत होती है मंथ की डेट की दिक्कत आती है
says: Such a woman gets all the urinary diseases, uterus trouble and trouble with her monthly dates; recorded as his claim, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The kind of trouble follows the sign on the activated 8th: Scorpio the reproductive and excretory region, Libra the kidneys and bladder, Cancer the cyclical and hormonal side.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an activated 8th with a planet in Scorpio would, by his rule, point to reproductive and urinary trouble; not a diagnosis.
Derived: an activated 8th with a planet in Cancer would, by his rule, point to cyclical or hormonal irregularity; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: 'Mahine ki date' is read as the monthly cycle date.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the 8th is classically the urinary and reproductive organs; linking it to a woman's dominance is his addition.

hindi: ये ससुराल का लफड़ा है क्योंकि स्त्री की कुंडली में भी आठवा भाव पति का घर हो गया उसका ससुराल हो गया
says: This is the in-law trouble: in a woman's own kundli the 8th house is the husband's home, which means her in-laws' house.
cells_derived_method: How the in-laws show follows the sign on the 8th: Taurus a prosperous, conservative family, Scorpio an intense, secretive one, Aquarius a detached, unconventional one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 8th in Taurus shows the in-laws as comfortable and conservative.
Derived: a planet in the 8th in Scorpio shows the in-laws as intense and secretive, with hidden tensions.

classical_check: Agrees: the 8th is the 2nd from the 7th, so it is the husband's family and wealth, and also the mangalya (marriage longevity) house.

hindi: लड़की का अगर उसके आठवें घर के अंदर लड़की के झंझट वाला ग्रह है तो ससुराल में उसकी कभी बनेगी नहीं और कोई कहता रहे मैं बहुत अच्छी हूं मैं बहुत बुरी हूं सास बहुत गंदी है यह होना ही
says: If a girl has a trouble-making planet in her 8th house she will never get along in the in-laws' home, whatever anyone says about being good or bad or the mother-in-law being awful; it has to happen.
cells_derived_method: The trouble-making planet's style follows its sign: Mars in Aries gives open fights, Saturn in Capricorn gives cold distance and duty without warmth.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 8th in its own sign Aries would, by his rule, give open clashes with the in-laws.
Derived: Saturn in the 8th in its own sign Capricorn would, by his rule, give a cold, distant, duty-only relation with the in-laws.

ambiguity: 'Jhanjhat wala grah' is not named; the examples use Mars and Saturn as typical troublemakers. The sentence is split across two slices.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: malefics in the 8th are classically read as trouble with the husband's family.

hindi: फिर उपाय करके देख लो डिस्टेंस बनाओ कुछ वास्तु के उपाय करो चल जाए ठीक है नहीं तो रोते पिटते जिंदगी काटो
says: Remedy for the in-law clash: try remedies, keep a distance, and do some vastu measures; if it works, fine, and if not, one just has to live through it.
ambiguity: No particular vastu measure is named here.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says one could otherwise get vashikaran (control through occult means) done, whose scheme is separate, then garbled talk of looting and greed that cannot be read.
Sarcastic aside: we take property rather than amulets, so your planet gets set right as you struggle for bread and have no time or tension left to fight.

hindi: यहीं से आपका एनस है
says: The anus is also located under this 8th house in his body map.
cells_derived_method: The stress on the anal and excretory region follows the sign on the 8th: Scorpio its natural region, Virgo the digestive tract above it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 8th in Scorpio stresses the anal and excretory region, the natural place of this sign.
Derived: a planet in the 8th in Virgo stresses the digestive tract leading to it.

ambiguity: 'Yahin se' is read as the 8th, the house under discussion.
classical_check: Agrees: the 8th is classically the anus, genitals and excretory organs.

hindi: जितने लोग एनल फिशर्स होते हैं पोटी की प्रॉब्लम हो जाती है जितने लोगों को बीमारियां पड़ जाती है पेट के संबंधित पाइल्स इत्यादि सब मंगल दोष के कारण है
says: Anal fissures, stool trouble and stomach-related disease such as piles are all due to a Mars fault (Mangal dosha); recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Mars's effect on the anal region depends on its sign: strong and hot in its own sign, weak or irritable in its debilitation sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 8th in its own sign Scorpio would, by his rule, give heat-type anal trouble; not a diagnosis.
Derived: Mars in the 8th in its debilitation sign Cancer would, by his rule, give a weaker, irritable bowel and anal trouble; not a diagnosis.

ambiguity: 'Mangal dosh' is read as an afflicted Mars; the house is the 8th from context.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Mars is classically a karaka of piles and anal troubles; naming Mars as the sole cause is his strong form.

hindi: कोलोन यानी की लार्ज इंटेस्टाइन पॉटी की प्रॉब्लम इत्यादि वो सारे के सारे आठवें घर से आपका कंट्रोल होता है
says: The colon, the large intestine and stool problems are all controlled by the 8th house.
cells_derived_method: The stress on the large intestine follows the sign: Virgo the bowel function and digestion, Scorpio the lowest part of the colon.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 8th in Virgo stresses bowel function and absorption.
Derived: a planet in the 8th in Scorpio stresses the lowest part of the colon and the rectum.

classical_check: Differs in part: classically the intestines are the 6th (Virgo); the lower excretory part is the 8th.

hindi: अ साइंस में जब आप पढ़ते हैं इ विद्वता में इन चीजों के अंदर पढ़ाई लिखाई ज्योतिष में रेकी में फलाना ढम काना जान जून कुछ नहीं पाए यह ठीक होने लगता है ऑटोमेटिक
says: When a person studies science or these subjects, such as astrology, Reiki and the like, even if he learns nothing, this 8th-house trouble starts getting better automatically; recorded as his claim, not a treatment.
ambiguity: 'Yeh' is read as the 8th-house bowel and anal troubles just discussed; 'jaan joon kuchh nahin paye' (even without really learning anything) is loosely worded.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not claim study heals bodily trouble; it is his reading of the 8th as the occult house.

hindi: सत्संग कितनी कमाल की चीज है आपने महसूस किया होगा कोई सत्संग की कहीं आप जगह गए कुछ पल्ले नहीं पड़ रहा कीर्तन चल रहा राधे राधे कृष्ण कृष्ण जो भी फलाना ढम काना आपको शांति सी हो रही है
says: Satsang is a remarkable thing: even at a kirtan where you understand nothing, with Radhe Radhe and Krishna Krishna being sung, you feel a sense of peace.
ambiguity: No house or planet is tied to this; it follows his 8th-house point about study healing and is a general spiritual claim.
classical_check: Silent: satsang is a devotional practice outside Jyotish rules.

hindi: गुरुद्वारे गए शब्द चल रहे यूं ही आराम मिल रहा है पता नहीं क्यों उतनी देर को तो मिलता है अगर कंटिन्यूटी में ले आएंगे तो जीवन को बदल देता है
says: At a gurdwara too, with shabad playing, one gets comfort without knowing why, but only for that time; if brought into continuity it changes life.
ambiguity: 'Continuity' is not defined (daily practice or regular attendance).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये नौवां घर है आपका जो भाग्य का है इसके पास किडनी है लेफ्ट वाली थाई है आपकी लेफ्ट घुटना है घुटनों की प्रॉब्लम हो जाती है घुटने बोल जाते हैं
says: The 9th house, the house of fortune, holds the (left) kidney, the left thigh and the left knee, so knee problems and knees giving way are read from it; recorded as his body-map claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The stress follows the sign on the 9th: Sagittarius the thighs, Capricorn the knees, Libra the kidneys.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 9th in Sagittarius stresses the left thigh, the natural place of this sign.
Derived: a planet in the 9th in Capricorn stresses the left knee joint, the natural place of this sign.

ambiguity: 'Kidney hai left wali thai hai' is run together; kidney may be left kidney.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the thighs are classically the 9th and Sagittarius; knees are classically the 10th and Capricorn, so he moves the knee one house back.

hindi: लेफ्ट घुटना जो है आपका यह आपका वास्तु पुरुष को यदि देखेंगे तो राइट घुटना साउथ ईस्ट में चला जाता है लेफ्ट घुटना आपका नॉर्थ वेस्ट में चला जाता है
says: A vastu link: on the vastu purusha figure the right knee falls in the south-east and the left knee in the north-west, so knee troubles are tied to those two corners of the house.
ambiguity: He ties the left knee to the 9th but gives no house for the right knee; the vastu directions are named only for the knees.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the vastu purusha mandala places the knees at the north-west and south-east corners; linking them to Jyotish houses is his addition.

hindi: आपको राइट घुटने में प्रॉब्लम आ रही है साउथ ईस्ट करर के देखो वहां पर हरे रंग की बोतल रखो तेल की
says: Remedy: if you have a right-knee problem, go to the south-east corner of the house and keep a green-coloured bottle of oil there; recorded as his vastu remedy, not medical advice.
ambiguity: 'Karar ke dekho' is read as 'go to and see'; the type of oil is settled in the lines that follow.
classical_check: Silent: oil-bottle remedies in vastu corners are a folk remedy, not classical.

gist: Banter while he works out which oil it is, mustard, moong dal or amla, laughing that he does not know how to shop and saying he is useless, but it should be the green one.
He tells the audience to use their own minds, since everyone's third eye has been activated.

hindi: तो मूंग की दाल का तेल यानी हरे रंग का आंवले का तेल आपने कांच की शीशी में साउथ ईस्ट में रखना है वो आपका राइट घुटना राइट कोनी ठीक करेगा
says: Remedy detail: keep the green-coloured amla oil (which he calls moong dal's oil) in a glass bottle in the south-east; this will set right the right knee and the right elbow; recorded as his vastu claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: 'Moong dal ka tel' appears to be a slip for green amla oil, which he corrects himself; 'koni' is the elbow.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और लेफ्ट साइड प आपको प्रॉब्लम आ रही है लेफ्ट घुटना लेफ्ट कोनी तो वो आपको नॉर्थ वेस्ट में सरसों के तेल की बोतल रखनी है
says: Remedy for the left side: if the trouble is in the left knee or left elbow, keep a bottle of mustard oil in the north-west of the house; recorded as his vastu claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: No bottle material or colour is stated for the mustard oil.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: He remarks that this knee-oil side topic came out unnecessarily and that the pancreas, liver and spleen also popped up in the middle.
Returns to the 8th house with the same anal opening, fissure, abrasion on passing stool and piles trouble already described.

hindi: घर के साउथ साउथ वेस्ट में वैसलीन रखो नीली बोतल में मत रखना नीली आती है वैसलीन की एक पीली आती है उसमें रखना साउथ साउथ वेस्ट में आपको ऑटोमेटिक एनरिचमेंट मिलेगी
says: Remedy for the piles and anal trouble: keep Vaseline in the south-south-west of the house, in the yellow bottle and not the blue one, and enrichment will follow automatically; he adds he does not know how it works, so try it; recorded as his vastu claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: The 8th is named in the sentence before it (the repeat row), so it is taken as the house being treated; 'enrichment' is vaguely used.
classical_check: Silent: a Vaseline-in-SSW vastu remedy is a folk remedy, not classical.

hindi: हां इसी के पास आपका पैंक्रियास है लिवर है स्प्लीन है नेक है
says: The same house also holds the pancreas, liver, spleen and neck.
cells_derived_method: The stress follows the sign: Sagittarius the liver, Virgo the pancreas and digestion, Gemini the neck and nerves.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 9th in Sagittarius stresses the liver, the natural organ of this sign.
Derived: a planet in the 9th in Virgo stresses the pancreas and digestive balance.

ambiguity: 'Isi ke paas' is read as the 9th, which he was describing before the oil digression; the next slice says the 9th is the neck.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the liver is classically Jupiter and the 9th; the pancreas and spleen are not assigned classically.

gist: Banter about having started already, discussing first, what Papa will do in the south, and telling the little one (Munna) to tell Papa.

hindi: नौवा घर ही आपका गर्दन है यानी राहु और केतु यह दो है ये असुर है
says: Interesting point: the 9th house is itself your neck, which means the Rahu-Ketu junction; these two are asuras.
cells_derived_method: The neck link shows through Rahu or Ketu in the 9th: Rahu there puts a cloud over dharma, Ketu a detachment from it, shaded by the sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in the 9th in Sagittarius would cloud teachers and religion in the sign of Jupiter, the 9th's natural lord.
Derived: Ketu in the 9th in Pisces would make dharma a matter of detachment and mysticism.

ambiguity: The neck was earlier listed with the pancreas, liver and spleen under the 9th; here the 9th is the neck itself where Rahu and Ketu join.
classical_check: Differs: classically the neck is the 2nd and Taurus; the Rahu-Ketu link is the myth of Rahu's severed neck.

hindi: हमारे पास 11 असुर होते हैं एक के दो टुकड़े कर दिए गए गर्दन काट के दो 12 बन गए यह 12 असुर
says: We have 11 asuras, one of which was cut in two at the neck, making 12; so the twelve planets of his scheme come from 11 beings with one split into two.
ambiguity: 'Eleven asuras' is odd, as the planets are not all asuras; it may be loosely worded, and the count of 11 and 12 is his scheme for the twelve planets.
classical_check: Differs: the classical myth names one asura, Svarbhanu, cut into Rahu and Ketu, and has nine grahas, not twelve.

hindi: इनमें दो का जो जोड़ है ना वो नाइंथ हाउस में है यह बृहस्पति की कृपा से है क्योंकि इनको भी अब देव माना गया
says: The joint of the two cut halves, Rahu and Ketu, lies in the 9th house; this is by Jupiter's grace, because even they are now regarded as devas.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's grace over the junction is strongest when Jupiter is strong in or aspects the 9th; the sign decides how it shows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the 9th in its own sign Sagittarius would, by his logic, give the strongest grace over the Rahu-Ketu junction.
Derived: Jupiter in the 9th in its debilitation sign Capricorn would, by his logic, give weak grace, leaving the junction harder to manage.

ambiguity: 'Yeh' is read as the joint of Rahu and Ketu being in the 9th.
classical_check: Silent: the 9th as the Rahu-Ketu joint and Jupiter's grace are his teaching.

hindi: ग्रह नहीं है राहु केतु यह छाया है लेकिन यह दत्य माने जाते हैं
says: Rahu and Ketu are not real planets but shadows, yet they are counted among the daityas, the demon race.
ambiguity: 'Datya' is read as daitya (demon).
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu and Ketu are classically chhaya grahas (shadow planets) and demons in the myth, yet counted among the nine grahas.

hindi: राहु और केतु भी पूर्ण असर देते हैं ये इतने पावरफुल है कि बृहस्पति और सूर्य को भी पकड़ लेते हैं
says: Rahu and Ketu give full effects too; they are so powerful that they seize even Jupiter and the Sun.
cells_derived_method: The seizing is strongest when Rahu or Ketu sits with Jupiter or the Sun in the same house; the sign and house show which area is clouded.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu with Jupiter in the 9th in Sagittarius would cloud teachers, faith and fortune, a Guru-Chandal type pairing.
Derived: Rahu with the Sun in the 1st in the Sun's exaltation sign Aries would cloud self-confidence and vitality, an eclipse-type pairing.

ambiguity: 'Pakad lete hain' (seize) is read as conjunction-based eclipse or grip, not a particular aspect.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu with the Sun (eclipse yoga) and with Jupiter (Guru-Chandal yoga) are classical afflictions.

hindi: बृहस्पति के साथ केतु शेयर करता है आपका स्वाधिष्ठान चक्र
says: Ketu shares with Jupiter the svadhishthana chakra, the second energy centre of your body.
ambiguity: The chakra mapping is his own; systems differ on which planet rules the svadhishthana chakra.
classical_check: Silent: classical Jyotish has no fixed planet-to-chakra map; Jupiter and Ketu both being Pisces' lords is the link in his scheme.

hindi: नौ और नंबर राशि बादल अगर बृहस्पति के आगे आ जाए ज्ञान के ज्ञान के आगे बादल आ जाए तो बृहस्पति को ज्ञान सेक्स समाप्त कर देता
says: If a cloud comes in front of Jupiter, in front of knowledge, it ends Jupiter's knowledge and also the sex (svadhishthana) side; the sentence is cut off at the end of the slice.
cells_derived_method: A cloud over Jupiter in the 9th, the natural house of knowledge, would dim wisdom most; the sign decides how.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a cloud over Jupiter in the 9th in its own sign Sagittarius would, by his logic, dim knowledge and teachers where they are strongest.
Derived: a cloud over Jupiter in the 9th in its own sign Pisces would dim intuitive and spiritual knowledge.

ambiguity: 'No aur number rashi' is garbled, probably the 9th house and sign number 9; 'cloud' is not named but likely means Rahu or Ketu; the end is cut.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: an afflicted Jupiter, especially by Rahu in a Guru-Chandal yoga, is read as clouded wisdom.
