hindi: है सारे गुरु स्त्री के चक्कर में ही जिंदगी में बर्बाद होकर सत्यानाश पिटते हैं मतलब गुरु को फसाना है क जेल पहुंचाना
says: He claims that teachers and spiritual gurus are almost always wrecked in life through entanglement with women, and that the way to bring a guru down is to trap him through a woman and get him jailed. In astrology terms this is the guru significator (Jupiter) being spoiled through a woman-linked influence, though he names no planet in this sentence.
ambiguity: 'गुरु' can mean the planet Jupiter or a human guru; Venus is not named here, the woman-Venus link is read from 'स्त्री' and from the Ketu-agent sentence that follows.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not say gurus are ruined through women; the nearest idea is Jupiter harmed by Venus, which Jupiter treats as an enemy in the Parashari friendship table.

gist: Gives Asaram Bapu and a Shankaracharya who was jailed on accusations as examples of gurus brought down through women.

hindi: तो इसका नाश केतु के थ्रू क्योंकि केतु शुक्र और मंगल का एजेंट है मंगल का पूर्ण एजेंट है
says: He says the ruin of this guru-type person comes through Ketu, because Ketu works as an agent of Venus and Mars, and is a complete agent of Mars. So Ketu carries Venus and Mars results into the chart and delivers them as destruction.
ambiguity: 'इसका' is read as the guru or Jupiter-type person of the previous sentence.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Parashara gives Ketu the results of Mars and of the planet it sits with or the lord of its sign; the Venus-agent link is not classical.

hindi: केतु अकेली पूछ हनुमान जी की लंका में आग लगा दी थी ऐसी तैसी फेर दी थी छनि की केतु ने
says: He calls Ketu the lone tail and compares it to Hanuman's tail that set Lanka on fire, saying Ketu likewise burns and wrecks things completely. The picture is of a small appendage that can do out-of-proportion destruction.
ambiguity: 'छनि की' at the end is garbled and the object of the wrecking is not clear.
classical_check: Silent: the Hanuman-tail image is his own; classics call Ketu the tail (puccha) of the shadow serpent and give it a Mars-like nature.

hindi: यह केतु ही आपका अकेला है जो आपकी नेक को जोड़ता है तो बृहस्पति यहां जोड़ता है
says: He says Ketu is the single one that joins your neck, and that Jupiter does the joining at this same place. From the previous batch, the 9th house is his neck house and holds the Rahu-Ketu joint, so he is tying Ketu and Jupiter together at the 9th-house neck.
cells_derived_method: none: the sentence describes an anatomical link of Ketu and Jupiter at the neck, not a sign-dependent effect.
ambiguity: The house is not named in this sentence; the 9th is taken from batch 16 where he said the 9th house is the neck. 'यहां जोड़ता है' is vague about what Jupiter joins.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text makes Ketu the neck-joiner; the neck is classically Taurus (2nd) and the 9th is the thighs.

hindi: इस बृहस्पति को सूर्य मिल जाए तो नास पिट जाता है केतु मिल जाए तो नास पिट जाता है
says: He says Jupiter is ruined if the Sun joins it, and equally ruined if Ketu joins it. In his scheme a Sun-Jupiter or Ketu-Jupiter contact damages the guru, wisdom and grace significations.
cells_derived_method: The conjunction can fall in any house and sign. The house decides what Jupiter's damage lands on (speech and wealth in the 2nd, children and study in the 5th, spouse in the 7th), and the sign decides how much Jupiter can resist (own or exalted sign softens, debilitation worsens). Derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in its own sign with the Sun in the 5th, lagna Leo. By his rule the Sun's contact still hurts Jupiter, hitting children, study and advice, though the own sign softens the blow.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer with Ketu in the 2nd, lagna Gemini. Exaltation gives strength but Ketu's contact cuts speech, savings and family support in his reading.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn with the Sun in the 7th, lagna Cancer. A double hit on the partner and advisor side: weak Jupiter plus Sun's contact.

ambiguity: 'मिल जाए' is read as conjunction; it could also include aspect or close contact, he does not say.
classical_check: Differs: classically Sun-Jupiter is not ruinous unless Jupiter is combust (within about 11 degrees of the Sun); Jupiter-Ketu is called both a weakening and a moksha-jnana combination.

hindi: और बृहस्पति अगर पावरफुल है यानी आपके पास कृपा है आप गुरु समान है आप में श्रद्धा है भावना है आपका राहु और केतु जेब में है यानी आप सिर्फ किस्मत की खाओगे
says: When Jupiter is powerful, meaning divine grace is with you, you carry guru-like quality, and faith and feeling are present, then Rahu and Ketu are 'in your pocket' (under control). Such a person simply lives off destiny and luck.
cells_derived_method: He does not define 'powerful'. Classically it depends on sign dignity and house position, so the same sentence reads differently by cell. Derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in the 1st, lagna Cancer. The strongest form of his 'grace' picture; Rahu and Ketu stay subordinate and the person is carried by luck.
Derived: Jupiter in its own sign in the 9th, lagna Aries. Fortune house plus own sign; the 'eat from destiny' result is most natural here.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in the 6th, lagna Leo. Jupiter is not powerful here, so his 'Rahu-Ketu in the pocket' result would not follow.

ambiguity: 'पावरफुल' is not defined: strength by sign, house, aspect or by the person's own conduct are all possible.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Jupiter's strength and aspect is the classical protection against Rahu-Ketu affliction; Jupiter's aspect is said to reduce malefic harm.

hindi: ऐसे कई लोग हैं धरती पर शायद चौथी पास छटी फेल होंगे लेकिन भैया हर हालत में सफल है कुछ भी खा ले कुछ भी पी ले कुछ भी कर ले मौज है सब पचता है लक्कड़ अजम पत्थर हजम
says: He points to many people who may have barely finished school yet are successful in every situation, and who can eat, drink and do anything without consequence. He offers them as living proof of the grace-protected person he just described, who needs neither skill nor education to succeed.
ambiguity: 'ऐसे' points back to the powerful-Jupiter person of the previous sentence; no planet is named in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent: the nearest classical idea is purva-punya or a strong yoga giving success without effort, but no text promises immunity from consequences.

gist: Filler 'we say good thing, dirty thing, God's name'; caption is broken and carries no astrology claim.
Jokes that such a protected man could cook Maggi noodles in drain water and eat it with no stomach upset, and warns it is a dirty example.

hindi: वह बुरे से बुरा कर्म करते हैं सफल है क्योंकि उन पर किसकी कृपा है
says: He says such people may do the worst deeds and still succeed, then asks whose grace is on them. The answer is left unsaid but, from the lines before, it is the grace carried by a strong Jupiter, which in his view overrides their bad conduct.
ambiguity: Whose grace is not stated in this sentence; Jupiter is inferred from the preceding lines.
classical_check: Differs: classical karma doctrine says results follow deeds and planetary yogas; grace is a remedy concept, not a licence for bad conduct.

hindi: ऐसा उपाय सब सारे ग ठीक हो जाए नहीं हो सकता एक उपाय ऐसा सारे ग्रह ठीक हो ग्रह ठीक नहीं हो सकते
says: He states plainly that no single remedy exists that sets all the planets right at once; the planets cannot all be fixed together.
classical_check: Agrees in practice: classical upayas are prescribed planet by planet (graha shanti); no text offers one remedy for every planet.

hindi: ये बैलेंसिंग करेंगे यहां ठीक होंगे तो वहां गड़बड़ होंगे वहां गड़बड़ यहां गड़बड़ ठीक होंगे तो वहां गड़बड़ होंगे तो उनकी कृपा लेलो तो सारे ठीक नहीं हो जाएंगे ना किसी की भी कृपा
says: He says remedy work is a balancing act: fixing one planet or place disturbs another, and fixing that one disturbs the first again. So taking the grace of one deity or one person will not set everything right.
ambiguity: 'उनकी कृपा' is not tied to one named deity or planet.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe remedies as a trade-off; the nearest idea is that pacifying one planet can strengthen another that is its enemy.

hindi: ये निरंतर चलने वाला प्रोसेस है भोजन रोज करना पड़ेगा रोज सोना पड़ेगा आप वन टाइम तो मर ही सकते हैं
says: He says managing planets is a continuing process, like eating and sleeping every day, not a one-time fix; you can die only once, but tending your chart has to go on daily.
classical_check: Agrees: classical upayas such as japa, daan and puja are prescribed as repeated practice for a set count or period, not a single act.

gist: Muses that life is one very long jhamela (mess) and that anyone who thinks about it would say how big a mess it is.
Says Vastu is a huge mess too, and that someone just asked him to explain the Lo Shu grid and neurology and whether those also work.
Finishes the 'how big a mess' remark and says he will clear this up shortly before moving on.

hindi: जो एक नंबर दो नंबर तीन नंबर वाले ऐसे होते हैं किसी का तीन नंबर कुंडली में गलत जगह बैठा खून के आंसू रोता है वो छ नंबर कही बैठा और रोता है
says: Speaking in numerology terms, he says that for people of number 1, 2 or 3, if the number 3 sits in a wrong place in the kundli the person weeps tears of blood, and the same happens if the number 6 sits badly somewhere. So a number tied to a planet landing in a bad spot of the chart brings suffering.
cells_derived_method: none: he does not say which place counts as wrong, so no cell-by-cell reading can be derived from this sentence alone.
ambiguity: Which numbers he means is unclear: root or destiny numbers of the person, name numbers, or planet numbers. The planet for each number (for example 3 as Jupiter, 6 as Venus in common numerology) is not stated in this sentence. 'गलत जगह' is also undefined.
classical_check: Silent: ank jyotish (numerology) is not part of the classical Parashari texts.

gist: Cites two famous Indian cricketers in a bad patch as men 'crying tears of blood' with this number and that number.

hindi: वही नंबर है वही नाम है सेम नाम स्पेलिंग है उनकी क्यों बजी हुई है क्योंकि अभी दशा के अंतर्गत ऐसी जगह घूम रहे होंगे उनके नाम नंबर कि वह रुला रहे हैं
says: He argues that the same number, same name and same spelling can give good results at one time and bad at another. The present trouble comes because, under the running dasha, the name-numbers are travelling through a bad place and are making the person cry. So the dasha timing decides how a fixed name-number plays out.
ambiguity: How a name-number 'moves through a place' under a dasha is not explained; the link between numbers, planets and dasha lords is assumed from his earlier lectures.
classical_check: Partly agrees: dasha timing decides when a planet gives its fruit; name numerology itself is not classical.

hindi: तेंदुलकर को भी ढाई साल लगे थे सवा सैकड़ा मारते यह छोड़ते नहीं है यह बाप है सबका
says: He adds that even the greatest batsman took two and a half years to reach a century, and that 'this' spares nobody, being the father of everyone. The point is that no person, however gifted, escapes a bad period.
ambiguity: 'यह' is not named; it is read as the bad dasha or name-number phase of the previous sentence. 'सवा सैकड़ा' literally means 125 but is used loosely for a century.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts hold that dasha results apply to every native, kings and commoners alike.

gist: Repeats that this is a very big mess and life is just as big a mess.
Teases the host about whether he is married or has a girlfriend; the host denies having one and the speaker says he is clearing up his own misunderstanding.
Joke that one is enough and a second would not even let the first be formed, then settles that the wife is the girlfriend and says he does not know anything more.
Banter of 'I love you too' with the host, asks not to be beheaded, says his love is not that kind and he says it to everyone out of a bad habit.

hindi: यह पैंक्रियास स्न यानी कि आपके शुगर की प्रॉब्लम इत्यादि ब्लड प्रेशर फलान ढम कान ये सब कार्यक्रम यहीं से
says: He says the pancreas and spleen, along with sugar-related trouble, blood pressure and similar matters, all belong to this same place. This is his body-map link for the neck house region; it is a tradition claim, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: none: a body-zone claim with no sign dependence stated, so no sign reading is derived.
ambiguity: 'यहीं से' does not name the house; the 9th is read from batch 16, where the neck, pancreas, liver and spleen were placed near the 9th. 'फलान ढम कान' is the idiom 'and so on', not the ear.
classical_check: Differs: classical kalapurusha puts the neck at Taurus (2nd) and gives the 9th the thighs; pancreas and spleen are not classical house topics.

hindi: दसवा भाव आपका चेस्ट कार्यक्रम जहां से कार्य का देखते शरीर आपका चेस्ट लंग हार्ट टोसो ऊपर का पूरा का पूरा एरिया य एल्बो इत्यादि का कार्यक्रम हाथ उंगलिया य चौथे और दव घर के पास है
says: He assigns the chest zone to the 10th house, the house from which work is read: chest, lungs, heart, the whole upper torso, elbows, hands and fingers. He adds that these body parts sit with the 4th and 10th houses together.
cells_derived_method: none: a body-zone list with no sign dependence stated.
ambiguity: 'दव' is read as 'दसवें' (10th). It is unclear whether the 4th and 10th share every listed part or split them between them.
classical_check: Partly differs: classically the 4th owns the chest and heart, while the 10th owns knees and joints, not hands and fingers.

hindi: गवा आपका लेफ्ट शोल्डर लेफ्ट यर तीसरा घर आपका राइट वाला था यह लेफ्ट शोल्डर लेफ्ट यर है
says: He gives the left shoulder and left ear to a house whose name is garbled, read as the 11th. He reminds that the 3rd house was the right-hand counterpart (right shoulder, right ear) given earlier, so the 3rd and 11th are the right and left pair.
cells_derived_method: none: a left-right body pairing with no sign dependence stated.
ambiguity: 'गवा' is garbled and read as 'ग्यारहवां' (11th) because the 11th is the mirror house of the 3rd; the number is not spoken clearly.
classical_check: Agrees: classical limb-house pairing gives the right ear to the 3rd and the left ear to the 11th (as it gives the right eye to the 2nd and the left eye to the 12th).

hindi: और बारवा जो है आपका बाई आंख और न का कुछ पार्ट
says: He gives the 12th house the left eye and part of something starting with 'न', likely the nose or neck. Together with the right-eye 2nd, this keeps the left-right pairing going.
cells_derived_method: none: a body-zone claim with no sign dependence stated.
ambiguity: 'न का कुछ पार्ट' is cut off; it could be the nose (नाक) or the neck (नेक). The left eye part is clear.
classical_check: Agrees on the left eye: classical texts give the 12th the left eye; the nose or neck part is not classical for the 12th.

hindi: अच्छा बवे घर की एक स्पेसिफिक बात है आपका कमर कमर से निचला हिस्सा भी बारवा है
says: He adds a specific point about the 12th house: the waist and the whole lower part of the body below the waist also belong to the 12th.
cells_derived_method: none: a body-zone claim with no sign dependence stated.
ambiguity: 'बवे' and 'बव' are read as 'बारहवें' (12th) from the next words 'बारवा'.
classical_check: Partly differs: classically the 12th is the feet; the waist falls under the 6th and 7th and the lower trunk under the 7th and 8th.

hindi: कमर के निचला हिस्सा यदि आपके बव घर में डिफेक्ट या डिस्टरबेंस है तो आपको कमर कमर से नीचे हमेशा ही थके रहोगे हमेशा
says: He says that if the 12th house has a defect or disturbance, you will remain tired from the waist downward all the time. This is a tiredness complaint tied to the 12th house; it is a tradition claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: The 12th house is touched by 2 or 3 signs, and the sign nature would colour the kind of weakness. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 12th, lagna Aquarius. A heavy, slow Saturn-type sign in the 12th suggests stiffness and slow recovery in the lower body.
Derived: Aries in the 12th, lagna Taurus. A sharp Mars-type sign suggests sudden strain and overexertion rather than slow tiredness.

ambiguity: 'डिफेक्ट या डिस्टरबेंस' is not defined: affliction by a malefic, a weak lord or a bad sign are all possible readings.
classical_check: Silent: classics link the 12th to loss and the feet but do not tie 12th-house defects to waist-down fatigue.

hindi: अनजान व्यक्ति बारवा घर होता है
says: He says the 12th house stands for an unknown person, a stranger. So whatever comes from people you do not know, or is directed to them, is read from the 12th.
cells_derived_method: The house topic (the unknown, the far, strangers) is fixed; the sign in the 12th and its lord colour what kind of stranger. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini in the 12th, lagna Cancer. Strangers met through talk, writing, travel or trade; contacts abroad by message.
Derived: Sagittarius in the 12th, lagna Capricorn. Unknown teachers, foreigners and distant guides become the stranger figures.
Derived: Scorpio in the 12th, lagna Sagittarius. Hidden or secretive outsiders; strangers tied to secret dealings or sudden loss.

ambiguity: The caption may run on from the previous sentence; the clear core is '12th house is an unknown person'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the classical 12th covers foreign lands, outsiders, expenses and isolation, so 'stranger' fits loosely; it is not a standard karaka listing.

hindi: अनजान व्यक्ति को दान करने से कुछ स्पेसिफिक चीजें जो उस घर की हैं आपके कमर कमर से नीचे पैरों का धक्का ठीक
says: He prescribes giving a donation to an unknown person to set right certain specific things of the 12th house, namely the waist-down tiredness and the legs. The remedy follows from the 12th being the stranger house.
cells_derived_method: none: a house-level remedy with no sign dependence stated.
ambiguity: 'पैरों का धक्का' is garbled and read as tiredness of the legs, in line with the waist-down fatigue he just described. What to donate, how much and when are not said.
classical_check: Partly agrees: charity is a classical remedy for the 12th (vyaya) house and its lord, but no text lists waist-down relief as the result.

hindi: ठीक छठे बव के डिस्टरबेंस के कारण घर के बूढ़े बुजुर्ग माताएं या कोई दादा टाइप जाते हैं बाथरूम में फिसलते और हिप बोन टूटती है यह छठे बवे का चक्कर है
says: He says that when the 6th and 12th houses are disturbed, an old person at home, a mother or a grandfather type, slips in the bathroom and breaks the hip bone. He adds that this pair of houses does only that, hip-bone breakage first and foremost. It is an injury forecast and a tradition claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Both houses are touched by 2 or 3 signs. A bone sign (Capricorn) or a water-and-feet sign (Pisces) in these houses would match the slip-and-fracture picture. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 6th, lagna Leo. The bone and joint sign sits in the injury house, so fracture-type trouble fits his picture.
Derived: Capricorn in the 12th, lagna Aquarius. The bone sign in the loss house, with injury leading to hospital or confinement.
Derived: Pisces in the 6th, lagna Libra. The feet and water sign in the injury house, matching a fall on a wet floor.

ambiguity: 'छठे बव' is read as 'छठे और बारहवें' (6th and 12th). Which relative is shown by which house is not stated.
classical_check: Silent: classics link the 6th and 12th to illness, injury and loss in general; hip fractures of elders are not a classical statement.

hindi: इसी प्रकार यह बस लास्ट हमारा पहले घर से मैं खुद हूं कि मैं खुद से कैसा रिश्ता हूं
says: Closing his list of houses as relationships, he says the 1st house is the self: 'I myself', and it shows what kind of relationship I have with myself.
cells_derived_method: The 1st house topic (self and self-relationship) is fixed; the sign in the 1st gives the self-image. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra in the 1st, lagna Libra. Self-image built on balance and on how others see you; tends to measure itself against others.
Derived: Scorpio in the 1st, lagna Scorpio. An intense, self-scrutinising relationship with oneself; strong inner drive and hidden self-doubt.
Derived: Gemini in the 1st, lagna Gemini. A curious, talkative, restless self-relationship; keeps arguing with itself.

ambiguity: 'बस लास्ट' is read as the last item of the house-relationship list, though the 1st was named first in the order of houses.
classical_check: Agrees: the 1st (tanu bhava) is the self, body and personality.

hindi: कुछ लोग लगन के अंदर पहले घर में खराब राशि खराब ग्रह होगा वो खुद को मारते रहते हैं खुद के ही शत्रु है इसलिए लगन ठीक होना बहुत जरूरी है
says: He says people with a bad sign or a bad planet in the first house keep hurting themselves and are their own enemies, so the lagna must be sound. 'Killing himself' is figurative: self-sabotage and self-harming habits.
cells_derived_method: A bad sign for a planet means a debilitated or enemy sign; a bad planet means a malefic. The same malefic acts differently by sign in the 1st. Derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 1st, lagna Aries. Heavy self-doubt and harsh self-criticism; the person blocks himself.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 1st, lagna Cancer. Anger and hurt turned inward; moods that damage his own health and name.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 1st, lagna Libra. A weak sense of self; he gives away his own authority and undermines his own standing.

ambiguity: 'खराब राशि' and 'खराब ग्रह' are not defined; the examples use debilitation and malefic status as one possible reading.
classical_check: Agrees: an afflicted lagna or lagna lord is classically the main marker of poor self-image, health and fortune; 'enemy of oneself' is a modern phrase.

gist: Garbled caption about 'sendent' (perhaps ascendant or descendant) being seen from the first house; the meaning cannot be recovered.

hindi: दूसरे में सर्वेंट और पेट्स आपके जीवन के अंदर कितने आप पेट रखते हैं दूसरा घर डिसाइड करता है
says: He says the 2nd house shows servants and pets, and that the 2nd house decides how many pets you keep in your life.
cells_derived_method: The topic (pets and household helpers) is fixed; the sign in the 2nd and its lord colour how many and what kind. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus in the 2nd, lagna Aries. A fixed, comfort-loving sign; loyal, long-kept animals and a household that is slow to change.
Derived: Capricorn in the 2nd, lagna Sagittarius. A restrained, practical sign; few pets, and working or guard animals rather than lap pets.
Derived: Cancer in the 2nd, lagna Gemini. A nurturing sign; strong attachment to pets and household staff, who are treated as family.

ambiguity: 'सर्वेंट' and 'पेट्स' are both given to the 2nd; the earlier word 'सेंडेंट' just before it is garbled.
classical_check: Differs: classics give the 2nd wealth, family, speech and food; servants come from the 6th and pets are not a classical topic.

hindi: दोस्त दोस्त सर्वेंट इत्यादि के साथ कैसा रहेगा
says: He adds that the 2nd house also shows how your dealings will go with friends, servants and similar people around you, whether warm or strained.
cells_derived_method: The topic (everyday dealings with friends and helpers) is fixed; the sign decides the style of dealing. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo in the 2nd, lagna Leo. Helpful but critical with servants and friends; fussy about details and duties.
Derived: Aquarius in the 2nd, lagna Capricorn. Friendly but detached, equal in manner with friends and staff, little personal closeness.
Derived: Leo in the 2nd, lagna Cancer. Generous but commanding; likes loyal followers and expects respect from servants.

ambiguity: 'दोस्त' (friends) here is the 2nd house; elsewhere in this lecture friends are tied to the 11th, so the source of the word is a point to verify.
classical_check: Differs: classical friends and gains sit in the 11th and servants in the 6th; the 2nd is not the friends house.

gist: Sets up an example of Saturn sitting in the first house and begins counting signs one, two, three, four, five towards Leo; the caption breaks after that.

hindi: अब ये सिंह राशि काम कर रही है कि कर्क कर रही है या कन्या कर रही है यह भी है
says: Having put Saturn in a Leo first house, he asks whether the Leo sign is really the one acting in the lagna, or whether Cancer (the sign before) or Virgo (the sign after) is working there. The sign that does the work in a house must be checked and cannot be taken from the single sign name alone.
cells_derived_method: For Saturn in a first house labelled Leo, the acting sign may be Leo or either neighbour, so the reading blends the sign natures by how much of the house each sign covers. Saturn's dignity changes with each. Derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: if Leo acts, Saturn is in the Sun's sign, an enemy sign, in the 1st (lagna Leo). A hardened self, with authority and ego in conflict.
Derived: if Cancer acts, Saturn is in the Moon's sign, an enemy sign, in the 1st (lagna Cancer). Emotional coldness and a heavy burden of family duty.
Derived: if Virgo acts, Saturn is in a friendly sign of Mercury in the 1st (lagna Virgo). A disciplined, service-minded and hard-working self.

ambiguity: He names Cancer and Virgo as the alternatives but does not say why those two; they are read as the neighbouring signs that share the first house. The counting before it is garbled.
classical_check: Partly agrees: bhava-chalit and Sripati also move planets between houses, but classics name the house by the rising sign; the idea of several signs acting in one house is his multi-sign principle.

hindi: यह है हलवा जो पंडित जी कहते सिंह राशि लगन में आपके शनी के साथ जैसे किसी की सिं है तो वो क्या वो लगन में सिंह काम भी कर रही है कि नहीं ये देखना है
says: He mocks the ordinary pandit's shortcut, 'Leo in the lagna with your Saturn', as an easy halwa, and says the real job is to check whether Leo is actually working in the lagna or not. He criticises one-sign labelling as shallow.
cells_derived_method: The caution applies to every house, not only the lagna: a planet labelled in one sign may really be acted on by the neighbouring sign. Derived extension, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn labelled Libra (exalted) in the 10th, lagna Capricorn. If Virgo is what acts, the exaltation does not apply and Saturn is only in a friendly sign.
Derived: Saturn labelled Aries (debilitated) in the 3rd, lagna Aquarius. If Pisces is what acts, Saturn is not debilitated, so the weak reading should be dropped.

ambiguity: 'हलवा' is used ironically for something simplistic. 'जैसे किसी की सिं है' is cut off.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classics also warn that a planet near a sign boundary may change house in bhava-chalit; they do not say the pandit's single-sign reading is wrong.

gist: Tells the audience this subject is very long, that they will often get bored, but if they keep coming one day it will suddenly click.

School analogy: a child sleeps in class, is slapped by the teacher, works a bit by half-yearly, waits for holidays, and by class ten some understand and later become physicists, mathematicians, business magnates or IIT students.
Ends the school analogy: the pupils become rockets, and after a long time you will suddenly feel that you are following the subject.
Analogy of class one to class eleven: a first-class lesson seems fun, then confusing, and only in class eleven or later do you grasp what was said at the start.
Says the 'ras' (juice) of the subject starts forming now, from the occasional fireworks of insight along the way, and it will be different for each listener.
Film analogy: Matrix Part 2 is even more complicated than Part 1 and not understood, yet you cannot stop watching it.
Says Jyotish is an addiction: you will neither like it nor understand it, yet you will keep following, like a wife you are forced to live with and cannot live without.
Continues the wife joke: you cannot stay with her, but you cannot stay without her either, you need her.
Analogy of reading the Gita again and again: different words and a different understanding come each time, so keep meeting the text.
Joke that husbands do not go home because they need the wife; they go because she makes them feel they are worth nothing without her call.
Praises women as marvellous and says some 'combination' of theirs is terrifying; the word before 'jod' is garbled.

hindi: सर्वेंट तीसरा है यंगर ब्रदर
says: He gives the 3rd house to the younger brother (and, in the caption, servants). So younger siblings are read from the 3rd.
cells_derived_method: The topic (younger siblings) is fixed; the sign in the 3rd and its lord colour the sibling's nature and how close you are. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in the 3rd, lagna Aquarius. An assertive, competitive younger brother who pushes ahead of you.
Derived: Libra in the 3rd, lagna Leo. A diplomatic, partnership-minded younger sibling who keeps the peace.
Derived: Capricorn in the 3rd, lagna Scorpio. A serious, hard-working younger brother; the bond is dutiful and may have emotional distance.

ambiguity: 'सर्वेंट' just before 'तीसरा' may be the tail of his 2nd-house recap, or he may also be giving servants to the 3rd.
classical_check: Agrees: the 3rd is the house of younger siblings and courage; some texts also give it servants and dependents.

hindi: चौथा घर है मदर फैमिली रूट्स अपनी मम्मी को देखना है
says: He says the 4th house is the mother and the family roots; to look at your own mother, you read the 4th.
cells_derived_method: The topic (mother and roots) is fixed; the sign in the 4th and its lord colour the mother's nature and the kind of roots. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer in the 4th, lagna Aries. A nurturing, home-bound mother and deep family roots.
Derived: Aquarius in the 4th, lagna Scorpio. A detached, independent-minded mother; roots are in a wider community or away from the birthplace.
Derived: Leo in the 4th, lagna Taurus. A proud, dignified mother and a family that cares about standing.

classical_check: Agrees: the 4th is the house of the mother, home and roots (sukha bhava).

hindi: माता की आयु कितने साल तक चलेगी क्या कार्यक्रम बनेगा ये चौथे घर से आता है आपका
says: He says how long your mother's life will run and what course it will take is read from the 4th house. This is a longevity claim about a parent; it is recorded as said and must not be turned into a death date.
cells_derived_method: none: no examples are derived because longevity is not to be predicted in the engine.
ambiguity: 'क्या कार्यक्रम बनेगा' is loose and may mean the course of her life or her health events.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 4th is the mother's house and the 8th from the 4th (the 11th) gives her longevity; reading her life span from the 4th alone is a simplification.

hindi: इसी के पास फैमिली की रूट्स है आपका एंसेल प्रॉपर्टी है
says: He adds that the 4th house also holds family roots and ancestral property (inherited assets).
cells_derived_method: The topic (family roots and inherited property) is fixed; the sign in the 4th shapes the kind of property and how it comes. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus in the 4th, lagna Aquarius. Land, farm or valuable settled property passes down; stable roots.
Derived: Scorpio in the 4th, lagna Leo. Inheritance that comes with disputes, secrecy or shared claims.
Derived: Gemini in the 4th, lagna Pisces. A family with many moves, split or multiple properties and roots in trade or communication.

ambiguity: 'एंसेल' is read as 'ancestral'.
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th is classically the house of land, house and inherited property.

hindi: एंसे स्स क्या है चाचे मामे ताय दोस्त मित्र ऑफिस के कलीग्स इत्यादि ये कैसे क्या मिलते हैं
says: He runs through a list of relatives and associates, paternal uncles, maternal uncles, father's elder brother, friends and office colleagues, and asks how and what you get from them. The caption is broken and he does not say which house he means.
ambiguity: The house is not named; it is probably the 4th (roots and ancestors) leading into the 5th, but the caption runs across the timestamp break and the first word 'एंसे स्स' is garbled.
classical_check: Silent: classics place uncles in the 3rd, 4th and 9th by lineage, friends in the 11th and colleagues in the 10th; no single house holds this whole list.

hindi: पांचवें है पांचवा घर है पूर्वज पितरों की कृपा लेनी है
says: He says the 5th house belongs to the forefathers (poorvaj, pitar), whose grace you must take. So ancestral blessing is read from the 5th.
cells_derived_method: The topic (ancestors and their grace) is fixed; the sign in the 5th shows what kind of lineage and grace. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo in the 5th, lagna Aries. A proud, royal-style lineage; the ancestors' grace is strong but wants respect and recognition.
Derived: Scorpio in the 5th, lagna Cancer. Ancestral secrets and unresolved family matters; grace comes after the buried issue is faced.
Derived: Pisces in the 5th, lagna Scorpio. Saintly or devotional ancestors; grace comes through prayer, charity and quiet service.

classical_check: Partly agrees: classically the 5th is purva-punya and pitru-shapa is judged from it, while the father and forefather line is the 9th.

hindi: अगर यह डिस्टर्ब है तो भाड़ में गया भगवान पहले पितरों को पूजो यानी भाड़ में गया बृहस्पति पहले राहु सेट करो
says: He says that if the 5th house is disturbed, forget God for now and first worship the ancestors; in planet terms, set Jupiter aside for the moment and first set Rahu right. The ancestors come before the deity in the order of remedies.
cells_derived_method: A disturbed 5th depends on which planet and sign hit it. The remedy order is the same, but the cause differs. Derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Aquarius (Saturn's sign) in the 5th, lagna Libra. Rahu acts like Saturn here, so the block shows as delay and heaviness around children and study; Rahu first.
Derived: Rahu in Leo (the Sun's sign) in the 5th, lagna Aries. Rahu shadows the Sun's father-line significations; ancestral trouble shows as pressure on children and the father's side.

ambiguity: 'पितरों को पूजो' is read as ancestor worship; how and with what rite is not said. 'भाड़ में गया' is a dismissive idiom meaning 'put aside', not 'discard'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu in or aspecting the 5th is a classical pitru-dosha marker; ordering ancestors before the deity is his own priority.

hindi: राहु प्रसन्न होते ही वो बृहस्पति को छोड़ देता है सूर्य को छोड़ देता है
says: He says that as soon as Rahu is pleased, it lets go of Jupiter and the Sun. In his scheme Rahu grips these two, and pleasing it frees them to give their results.
cells_derived_method: The house where Rahu holds Jupiter or the Sun decides what gets freed. Derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu with Jupiter in its own sign in the 9th, lagna Aries. Rahu grips Jupiter in the fortune house; pleased Rahu releases dharma and father-line fortune.
Derived: Rahu with the Sun in Leo in the 1st, lagna Leo. Rahu grips the Sun in the lagna; once pleased it releases vitality, confidence and health.
Derived: Rahu with the Sun exalted in Aries in the 10th, lagna Cancer. A strong Sun held down by Rahu in the career house; freed, it gives status and authority.

ambiguity: 'प्रसन्न होते ही' is not tied to a particular remedy in this sentence.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu eclipses the Sun and Rahu with Jupiter is the Guru-chandala yoga; propitiating Rahu to ease them is a classical remedy.

gist: Asks the audience to understand the logic of this through an analogy from the body.
Body analogy: a headache means for sure that brain sodium is low; the report looks fine but potassium is high.
Explains on the board that cells hold potassium inside and sodium outside, which is why pain comes in the brain when sodium falls; a medical analogy, not astrology.
Analogy continued: raised potassium also lowers sodium, so a man who eats bananas daily on the best diet still gets a headache, and the fix is to reduce potassium.

hindi: आप भगवान को छोड़ दो पितरों को पकड़ लो भगवान अपने आप खुश हो जाएगा
says: Drawing the moral of the sodium analogy, he says to let go of God and hold on to the ancestors, and God will become pleased by himself. The ancestors are the real cause to fix, not the deity.
cells_derived_method: none: the remedy order is the same for every cell.
ambiguity: The 5th is inferred from 'पितर', which he tied to the 5th just before; this sentence does not name the house.
classical_check: Silent: classics treat pitru shanti and deity worship as separate remedies and do not rank ancestors above the deity.

hindi: आपका नाइंथ हाउस फल नहीं दे रहा क्योंकि पांचवा भाव डिस्टर्ब है
says: He says that the 9th house is not giving its fruit because the 5th house is disturbed. A disturbed 5th blocks the 9th's results.
cells_derived_method: Which sign sits in the 9th and in the 5th decides what is blocked. Derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius in the 9th with the 5th being Leo, lagna Aries. Jupiter's own sign should give fortune, but with the 5th disturbed his rule holds the fruit back.
Derived: Aries in the 9th with the 5th being Sagittarius, lagna Leo. Energetic fortune that keeps stalling until the 5th is set right.

ambiguity: 'फल नहीं दे रहा' is general; he does not say whether it means results of the 9th lord or of planets in the 9th.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 5th and 9th are the two trikona houses and support each other, but a disturbed 5th blocking the 9th is not a classical rule.

hindi: अगर आपको भगवान की तरफ से यानी इस जन्म के भाग्य काम ही नहीं कर रहा कहां किस्मत फूट गई आप पितरों को खुश कर लो वो ठीक हो जाएंगे
says: He says that if the God-given side, meaning the fortune of this birth, is not working at all and luck seems broken, you should please the ancestors and the fortune will be fixed.
cells_derived_method: none: the remedy is the same for every cell; only the diagnosis of which signs sit in the 5th and 9th differs.
ambiguity: The houses are inferred: 'भाग्य' is the 9th and 'पितर' is the 5th, from his nearby sentences.
classical_check: Silent: classics assign remedies for a weak 9th by its lord and afflictions; ancestor pacification for a blocked fortune is a modern link.

hindi: भगवान अपने आप भी ठीक है धूप आ रही है बादल हटवा दो यह पांचवा भाव है
says: He compares the situation to the sun already shining while a cloud covers it: God is fine and sending light, so just have the cloud removed, and that cloud-clearing is the 5th house. The ancestors' block is the cloud that hides divine grace.
ambiguity: The cloud image is not tied to any planet in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent: the cloud-over-the-sun image is his own and not found in classical texts.

hindi: पित अब पित खुश कैसे होते हैं पांचवे घर से ही संतान है प्रेम है
says: He asks how the ancestors get pleased and answers by pointing to the 5th house, which also holds children and love. So the way to please them lies in how you treat your children and your love.
cells_derived_method: The topics (children and love) are fixed; the sign in the 5th shapes the style of love and the nature of children. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra in the 5th, lagna Gemini. Refined, romantic love; children are charming and partnership-minded.
Derived: Capricorn in the 5th, lagna Virgo. Reserved, duty-bound love; fewer or later children and a serious upbringing.
Derived: Cancer in the 5th, lagna Pisces. Affectionate, nurturing love and a strong emotional bond with children.

classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is classically the house of children and romance (putra bhava).

hindi: आप प्रेम करो प्रेम में शक ना लाओ पांचवा घर लाजवाब पित कृपा कर्म के द्वारा
says: He advises you to love and not bring suspicion into love, calls the 5th house wonderful, and says the grace of the ancestors comes through action (karma). Behaviour of trust and love in the 5th-house areas is the way to earn it.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 5th shows how easily trust comes. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio in the 5th, lagna Cancer. Suspicion in love comes naturally, so the advice 'no doubt in love' is the main discipline.
Derived: Sagittarius in the 5th, lagna Leo. An open, trusting nature; the advice is easy and the ancestors' grace flows with little effort.

ambiguity: 'पित कृपा कर्म के द्वारा' is read as ancestors' grace through deeds; the caption is cut short.
classical_check: Silent: classical remedies for the 5th are mantra, charity and pitru rites; no text names suspicion-free love as the remedy.

hindi: पांच भाव बच्चे हैं आप अपने बच्चे को प्रेम करो नहीं पढ़ता प्रेम करो पितरों की कृपा मिलती है
says: He says the 5th house is children, so love your own child, even if the child does not study, and you will receive the ancestors' grace. Affection toward the child is the concrete act that pleases the ancestors.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 5th shows what kind of child you are dealing with. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini in the 5th, lagna Aquarius. A restless, curious child who struggles to settle in studies; affection works better than scolding.
Derived: Pisces in the 5th, lagna Scorpio. A dreamy, sensitive child who needs reassurance and warmth to learn.

ambiguity: 'पांच भाव' is read as 'पांचवां भाव' (5th house).
classical_check: Silent: classics do not say that loving your child brings ancestral grace; the 5th-house remedies are mantra and charity.

gist: Says many mothers come complaining that the child will not listen or the daughter does not understand, and that he tells them to give love instead of scolding.
Describes his counselling scene: he asks the children whether they like their parents, then makes the parents swear to give them love, and tells the child to report if they do not.

hindi: इस ड्रामे में पितरों से कृपा दिलवा रहे बच्चों को बच्चे अचानक सफल होना शुरू हो जाते हैं बच्चे अचानक अपना अच्छा परफॉर्म करने लगते हैं
says: He says that once parents give their children love, the ancestors' grace begins to reach the children: they suddenly start succeeding and performing well, feel some happiness, and a sweet bond develops. He presents this as the observed outcome of the remedy.
cells_derived_method: none: an outcome claim of the remedy, not dependent on sign.
ambiguity: No timeframe is given for 'अचानक' (suddenly).
classical_check: Silent: it is an anecdotal outcome claim with no classical basis.

hindi: और तीसरा है आपका यहां पर पोते पोते पोती पोते पतियों से अचानक प्रेम होता है पितर खुश हो जाते हैं उससे
says: As a third way to please the ancestors, he says that sudden love toward grandsons and granddaughters makes the ancestors happy. The grandchildren are another channel for pitar-pleasing affection.
cells_derived_method: none: the remedy does not change with the sign in the 5th.
ambiguity: 'तीसरा' is the third item of a list whose first two items are not clear; 'पोते पोते पतियों' is garbled; 'यहां पर' is read as the 5th-house topics.
classical_check: Differs: classically grandchildren are read from the 9th (the 5th from the 5th), though the 5th line is the route to them.

hindi: अब पोते पोते नहीं हो रहे बाप को बच्चा हो गया बच्चे को बच्चे नहीं हो रहे पितरों का दोष है पित दोष
says: He says that if a father has had a child but that child cannot have children, so no grandchildren are coming, it is a defect of the ancestors, pitra dosha. Delay in the next generation is read as an ancestral block.
cells_derived_method: A sign in the 5th that delays progeny (Saturn-ruled signs) would match this picture. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 5th, lagna Virgo. A Saturn-ruled sign on the children house delays progeny, so the ancestral-block reading fits.
Derived: Aquarius in the 5th, lagna Libra. Another Saturn-ruled sign on the 5th; late children and a heavy ancestral theme.

ambiguity: The sentence does not say which house shows the block; the 5th is inferred from the surrounding ancestors-and-children lines.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts (pitru shapa) list ancestral curse as a cause of childlessness and delayed children.

hindi: गया जाके आओ पितरों की कृपा लो कैसे भी लो गया इ लास्ट टॉप मोस्ट है चिजी बॉडी को लेकर जाना गया में आपके पित्र प्रसन्न होंगे
says: He prescribes going to Gaya to take the ancestors' grace by any means, calling Gaya the last and topmost remedy; there the ancestors will be pleased. He adds something about carrying the body or remains there, which is garbled.
cells_derived_method: none: a pilgrimage remedy not tied to a sign.
ambiguity: 'चिजी बॉडी को लेकर जाना' is garbled; it may refer to carrying ashes or offerings, and it is not clear what is to be taken to Gaya. The 5th is inferred from the ancestors theme.
classical_check: Agrees in tradition: shraddha and pind-daan at Gaya is the best-known remedy for pitru dosha in popular practice.

hindi: ये रिवर्स भी होता है जैसे अगर हम इष्टदेव की पूजा करें तो पित खुश होते हैं नहीं इष्टदेव को कुछ भी कर लो इष्टदेव तो
says: He asks whether it works in reverse, that is, whether worshipping your chosen deity (ishta-devata) pleases the ancestors, and answers no: whatever you do for the ishta-devata, he is anyway giving grace. The route is one-way, ancestors first.
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next timestamp; the 5th is inferred from 'पित'.
classical_check: Silent: classics do not state a one-way direction between ishta-devata worship and ancestor pacification.

hindi: कृपा दे ही रहा है अगर वह दे रहा है और पहुंच नहीं रही तो पित है बीच में
says: He completes the thought: the deity is giving grace anyway, and if it is given yet does not reach you, the ancestors are standing in between and blocking it.
ambiguity: This is a continuation of the previous sentence; 'पित' is read as the ancestors-block of the 5th.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text makes the 5th a gate between the deity's grace and the native.

hindi: बृहस्पति तो कृपा दे ही रहा है लेकिन हमें नहीं मिल रही राहु बड़ा हुआ राहु शांत करो राहु सेट करो
says: He says Jupiter is surely giving grace but we are not getting it, because Rahu has grown big; so pacify Rahu and set it right. Rahu's strength is what blocks Jupiter's grace.
cells_derived_method: A big Rahu depends on its house and sign. Derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Taurus, a sign many traditions treat as strong for Rahu, in the 10th, lagna Leo. A big Rahu in the career house blocks Jupiter's grace in work and status.
Derived: Rahu in Gemini, also treated as strong by some, in the 9th, lagna Libra. A strong Rahu over the fortune house; Jupiter's grace fails to reach until Rahu is calmed.

ambiguity: 'राहु बड़ा हुआ' may mean strong by dignity, placed in a powerful house, or simply dominant in the chart.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu is pacified by mantra, charity and worship when it spoils other planets' results, which is classical practice.

hindi: शनि और राहु शनि का एजेंट है राहु और राहु शनि का भी बाप है शब्द है गलत कहने को
says: He says Rahu is Saturn's agent, and then even that Rahu is Saturn's father, admitting the word is rough. So Rahu acts as Saturn but with greater force.
ambiguity: 'Agent' and 'father' point in opposite directions, one for a subordinate and one for a superior; the two labels sit oddly together.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu is said to give Saturn-like results (Shanivat Rahu), but 'father of Saturn' is his own phrase.

hindi: हनुमान जी काम करते हैं राम के सारे राम कुछ नहीं करते लेकिन राम के बिना कहे हनुमान कुछ नहीं करेंगे इसलिए राम की कृपा मिल गई हनुमान की तो मिल ही गई आपको शनि की कृपा मिल गई
says: Using the picture of Hanuman and Rama, he says Hanuman does all the work for Rama, yet acts only on Rama's word, so getting Rama's grace brings Hanuman's. By the same pattern, getting the boss planet's grace (Rahu) brings the worker planet's (Saturn) grace along.
ambiguity: He does not say which planet is Rama; Rahu as the boss and Saturn as the doer is read from the previous sentence, and it sits oddly with calling Rahu the 'agent' of Saturn.
classical_check: Silent: the Rama-Hanuman image for Rahu and Saturn is his own and contradicts his own 'agent' wording.

gist: Imagined audience reaction: Saturn with a liquor bottle, 'what are you making us do, what are you teaching us?'

hindi: बियर की बोतल गिफ्ट करो दारू की बोतल गिफ्ट करो इसके उपाय होते हैं
says: He says that gifting a bottle of beer or a bottle of liquor is one of the remedies for this planet. It is recorded as said (a folk remedy) and the engine should label it as a tradition claim, not as advice to drink.
ambiguity: 'इसके' does not name the planet; Saturn and Rahu are both in the preceding sentences, and the next sentence names Rahu.
classical_check: Silent: liquor is not a Parashari remedy for Rahu or Saturn; it is a folk or tantric offering.

hindi: नदी में बियर बहाई जाती है उस ग्रह को राहु को ठंडा किया जाता है जल में डाल के
says: He says beer is poured into a river, and that this is how that planet, Rahu, is cooled: by putting the offering in water. Rahu is treated as a hot planet that water calms.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical Rahu remedies often end with immersion of black items in flowing water; beer as the item is a folk practice.

hindi: राहु दान नहीं चाय की पत्ती हम अच्छा वाला लेंगे चाय की पत्ती लेंगे दारू बियर में नहीं जाएंगे गंदी बात बात नहीं करेंगे हम यहां पे
says: For Rahu's donation, he drops the liquor idea in this lecture and prefers donating good-quality tea leaves instead; he will not go into liquor or beer talk here. So tea leaves are his clean substitute for the Rahu daan.
ambiguity: 'राहु दान नहीं' could be read as 'Rahu donation: no (liquor)' followed by tea leaves; the mood is clear but the grammar is loose.
classical_check: Silent: classical Rahu daan lists black sesame, black or blue cloth, mustard oil and iron; tea leaves are a modern dark-item substitute.

hindi: लेकिन सबसे पावरफुल दारू है सबसे पावरफुल वेपन क्योंकि शराब के नशे के अंदर मनुष्य का ज्ञान मदहोश होता है
says: He says liquor is the most powerful weapon of all, because under the intoxication a person's knowledge goes into a daze. In his scheme Rahu's intoxicants are what numb Jupiter's wisdom.
ambiguity: 'सबसे पावरफुल' does not say whose weapon; it is read as Rahu's, given the preceding Rahu discussion, and 'knowledge' as Jupiter's domain.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Rahu is a classical karaka of intoxicants and Jupiter of knowledge; Rahu clouding Jupiter's wisdom is a standard reading.

gist: Begins a story of a guru who used to hand out bottles of liquor, a saint who lived in Russia; the caption is cut off at the end of the batch.

hindi: और दारू की बोतल पिला के भी बंदा सेंसेस में है यानी राहु जेब में है क्योंकि जुपिटर काम कर रहा है
says: He says that a man who stays in his senses even after being made to drink a bottle of liquor shows that Rahu is in his pocket, and the reason is that Jupiter is working in his chart. Staying clear-headed under intoxication is his practical sign of a working Jupiter over Rahu.
cells_derived_method: What makes Jupiter 'work' depends on sign and house, so the sign of dignity and the house change the claim. Derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in its own sign in the 1st, lagna Sagittarius. Self-command and a clear head; this fits his 'Rahu in the pocket' picture.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 4th, lagna Aries. Inner steadiness and a calm home base keep Rahu's pull weak.

ambiguity: He does not say how Jupiter 'works': by sign, house, aspect or by the person's conduct.
classical_check: Silent: the liquor test is his own; classically Jupiter's strength is the general protection against Rahu's confusion and addictions.

gist: Banter with the audience: 'that is why I say have a party, defame me even more than Munni'; he says he does not mean that kind of party but, fine, do that one too.

hindi: पार्टी करके आपको पता हो आप पार्टी में आपने अपमान नहीं किया खराबी नहीं की कुछ नहीं
says: He suggests a self-test through a party: afterwards you should know whether you insulted anyone or caused any trouble, and if you did neither, it confirms that Rahu is under your control. This is a folk diagnostic recorded as said; it is not advice to drink.
ambiguity: The sentence names neither Rahu nor Jupiter; it is read as the same test as the previous sentence, and the grammar is loose.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text offers a behaviour test of this kind for Rahu.

gist: Says many wives complain that the husband drinks a lot, and he asks what the actual suffering is: does he beat you or leave you short of money?
Says drinking is natural for the man and that a husband's real duty is to give money and not harass; compares it to a nurse on duty asking whether the medicine was given on time.
Tells wives that the husband needs protection like a child and that if he wants to drink, let him; it is his craving.
Begins a physiology claim that a man has a bigger liver than a woman, so that if she can take one peg he can take two and a half.
Continues the physiology claim: a woman's heart and brain are smaller, a man's brain is bigger, and God gave him a liver about 1.3 times larger so he can digest more liquor.
Says a man drinks because he needs dopamine or he sinks; when life stress hits, testosterone falls, and he would say there is nothing on earth and run off as a saint.
Says dopamine is therefore essential for him, which is why children eat chocolate, boys more than girls; asks the audience to note it.
Says a woman under tension has dopamine, serotonin and several hormones of her own, so her stress has nobody to attack and she cries easily.
Says women have less ego and men have a huge ego, so a man feels his empire is broken in front of him.
Says a woman answers 'forget it, I will raise you and the children too', which nature has given her, so stress does not ruin her and she does not sit with a bottle at seven in the evening.
Joke about men who found dopamine in bhajan: they sit two hours in japa from 5 am, no utensil may clatter, and they drink their wives' blood, which is deadlier than liquor and makes them more alive.

hindi: यह पांचवा छठा आपके राइवल्स है शत्रु दुश्मन
says: Resuming his list of houses, he says this next house, the 6th, is your rivals, foes and enemies. The 6th house is where opposition and enemies are read.
cells_derived_method: The topic (rivals and enemies) is fixed; the sign in the 6th shows how enemies behave. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio in the 6th, lagna Gemini. Strong, secretive rivals who attack indirectly and hold grudges.
Derived: Libra in the 6th, lagna Taurus. Polite rivals who hide enmity; disputes are settled by negotiation or the law.
Derived: Gemini in the 6th, lagna Capricorn. Rivals who fight with words, rumours and paperwork.

ambiguity: 'पांचवा छठा' in the caption may be a slip or a hand-over from the 5th to the 6th; he confirms the 6th as rivals in the next minute ('ये छठा घर है जी राइवल्स').
classical_check: Agrees: the 6th (ripu bhava) is the house of enemies, debts and disease.

gist: The audience laughs hard; he says the joke comes from lived experience, that the wife cannot speak, and he apologises that it slipped out of his mouth.
Says a husband's disrepute does not shame him before his wife: she says 'no insult, come home' and he feels no embarrassment in front of her, because she already knows him.

hindi: ये छठा घर है जी राइवल्स दुश्मन कितने हैं
says: He confirms the 6th house as the house of rivals and says it shows how many enemies you have. The count and strength of your opponents is read from the 6th.
cells_derived_method: The topic (number and kind of enemies) is fixed; the sign in the 6th decides how many and how openly they act. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in the 6th, lagna Scorpio. Open, direct fighters; opponents clash with you head-on and quickly.
Derived: Pisces in the 6th, lagna Libra. Hidden, subtle rivals; enmity works through confusion and deceit.
Derived: Taurus in the 6th, lagna Sagittarius. Few rivals, slow to anger but stubborn once they take a stand.

classical_check: Agrees: the 6th is the house of enemies (shatru bhava); the count of enemies is read from it.

hindi: और मम्मी का भाई यानी मामा
says: He adds that the 6th house also stands for the mother's brother, the maternal uncle (mama).
cells_derived_method: The relative (maternal uncle) is fixed; the sign in the 6th gives his nature. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer in the 6th, lagna Aquarius. A caring, family-minded maternal uncle.
Derived: Capricorn in the 6th, lagna Leo. A reserved, strict or older maternal uncle; support is dutiful rather than warm.
Derived: Sagittarius in the 6th, lagna Cancer. A generous, advice-giving maternal uncle, perhaps a teacher or lawyer type.

classical_check: Agrees: the maternal uncle is classically read from the 6th (the 3rd from the 4th, the mother's house).

hindi: कुछ बच्चे मूलों में ऐसे पैदा होते हैं मूल नक्षत्र हो गया जेष्ठा नक्षत्र हो गया आपके कुछ ऐसे छह नक्षत्र होते हैं जिसके अंतर्गत यदि बच्चा पैदा होता है तो मामा पर भारी होता है
says: He says that some children are born in the mool group of stars, such as Moola and Jyeshtha, and that there are six such nakshatras; a child born under them is heavy on the maternal uncle. This is a birth-star rule that harms the mother's brother.
cells_derived_method: The six nakshatras lie in particular signs (Moola in Sagittarius, Jyeshtha in Scorpio, Ashwini in Aries, Ashlesha in Cancer, Magha in Leo, Revati in Pisces), so the Moon's sign points to the risk. Derived link, not said by him, and no house cell can be fixed from the sentence.
ambiguity: He names only Moola and Jyeshtha and counts six; the other four are not named in this sentence. 'भारी होता है' means harmful or burdensome, not necessarily fatal.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the six gandmool nakshatras (Ashwini, Ashlesha, Magha, Jyeshtha, Moola, Revati) are classically held to burden relatives, and the maternal uncle is among those named for some of them.

hindi: छठा भाव राहु का है नेचुरली सारे शत्रु पत्रु ये है नेचुरली
says: He says the 6th house naturally belongs to Rahu, and all enemies and opponents come under Rahu by nature. In his scheme Rahu is the natural significator of the 6th.
cells_derived_method: In his scheme the natural 6th sign is Virgo, which he may give to Rahu. The nearer Rahu is to Virgo's nature, the more direct the claim. Derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo in the 6th, lagna Aries. The natural-zodiac 6th, where Rahu's rulership of enemies is most direct; foes are persistent and work through detail and service matters.
Derived: Leo in the 6th, lagna Pisces. Rahu's enemy signification under the Sun's sign: opponents are proud or powerful, and the Sun-Rahu eclipse theme makes them shadow your standing.

ambiguity: 'नेचुरली' is read as natural karakatva (natural significator), not as the lord of the sign.
classical_check: Differs: classically Mars (and Saturn) are the natural significators of the 6th; Rahu in the 6th is considered favourable, not its karaka.

gist: Filler: asks 'naturally, how?' and says he will explain a little now.

hindi: तो मदर का ब्रदर मामा मामा की साइड से क्या होगा आपके शत्रुता का लफड़ा है मदर की साइड
says: He says that the mother's brother, the maternal uncle, is the source to look at, and that your enmity-and-dispute trouble comes from the mother's side. So disputes and rivalry are tied to the maternal family.
ambiguity: The sentence is half a question ('what will come from the maternal side?') and is answered by the next one; the tie to the 6th is by the previous lines.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 6th links enmity and the maternal uncle, but classical texts do not say that enmity comes from the mother's family.

hindi: मामा के आशीर्वाद लो आपको मामा का आशीर्वाद चाहिए मामा लोग आपकी ना देखना जब कोर्ट कचहरी होगी तुक्के से मदद कर रहे होंगे कोई ना कोई मामा लगा होगा
says: He prescribes taking your maternal uncles' blessings, and says that when a court case comes, some maternal uncle will end up helping you almost by chance. He stresses these are mother's-side uncles, not paternal ones.
cells_derived_method: none: the remedy is the same for every cell.
ambiguity: 'तुक्के से' (by chance) is loose; whether the help is financial, legal or social is not said. The caption 'चाचा नहीं मामा' is a clarification that it is the mother's side.
classical_check: Silent: classics place the maternal uncle in the 6th but give no rule that his blessing wins court cases.

hindi: सातवा घर स्पाउस का है अपने आपके जीवन के अंदर जीवन साथी के और आपके बिजनेस के पार्टनर्स
says: He says the 7th house is the spouse, the life partner, and also your business partners.
cells_derived_method: The topics (spouse and partners) are fixed; the sign in the 7th colours the partner's nature. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra in the 7th, lagna Aries. A balanced, charming and diplomatic partner; business partnerships built on fairness.
Derived: Scorpio in the 7th, lagna Taurus. An intense, private partner; partnerships carry power struggles and shared secrets.
Derived: Capricorn in the 7th, lagna Cancer. A serious, older or career-minded partner; business partnerships are structured and duty-bound.

classical_check: Agrees: the 7th is the house of spouse and partnerships (kalatra bhava), including business partners.

hindi: आठवा इनलॉज ससुराल
says: He gives the 8th house to the in-laws, the family of the spouse (sasural).
cells_derived_method: The topic (in-laws) is fixed; the sign in the 8th shows the nature of the spouse's family. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus in the 8th, lagna Libra. Comfort-loving, well-off or conservative in-laws.
Derived: Aquarius in the 8th, lagna Cancer. Unconventional, independent-minded in-laws, with a loose family structure.
Derived: Scorpio in the 8th, lagna Aries. Intense, secretive in-laws; strong feelings and family secrets.

classical_check: Partly agrees: the 8th is the 2nd from the 7th, so it carries the spouse's family resources; in-law persons themselves are read by bhavat bhavam from the 7th.

hindi: ससुराल के द्वारा कितना धन है यह भी आठवें घर से ही आता है
says: He adds that the wealth that comes through the in-laws, and how much of it, is also read from the 8th house.
cells_derived_method: The topic (money through in-laws) is fixed; the sign in the 8th shows the source and style of that money. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus in the 8th, lagna Libra. Stable, land or asset-based wealth through the spouse's family.
Derived: Gemini in the 8th, lagna Scorpio. Money through the in-laws' trade, contacts or several smaller sources.

classical_check: Agrees: the 8th is the house of inherited and unearned wealth, including from the spouse's side.

gist: Asks the host to remind him of both these 8th-house points later.

hindi: नौवा घर आपके पिता का है आपके मेंटर्स आपको गाइड करने वाले गाइड्स आपके गुरु का
says: He says the 9th house is your father's, and also your mentors, your guides and your guru.
cells_derived_method: The topics (father, mentors, guru) are fixed; the sign in the 9th shows their nature. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius in the 9th, lagna Aries. A learned, principled father and a wise guru; mentors come as teachers of dharma.
Derived: Leo in the 9th, lagna Sagittarius. A proud, authoritative father and mentors with standing and a commanding style.
Derived: Virgo in the 9th, lagna Capricorn. A practical, detail-minded father; mentors who teach through method and service.

classical_check: Agrees: the 9th is the house of father, guru and dharma.

hindi: दसवा बॉस का है और आपके खुद बॉस हो जाने का
says: He says the 10th house is your boss, and also your becoming a boss yourself.
cells_derived_method: The topics (boss and your own authority) are fixed; the sign in the 10th shows the boss's style and how you lead. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 10th, lagna Aries. A strict, structured boss; you rise slowly into a disciplined position of authority.
Derived: Libra in the 10th, lagna Capricorn. A fair, diplomatic boss; you lead by negotiation and by keeping people balanced.
Derived: Leo in the 10th, lagna Scorpio. A commanding, prestige-minded boss; you aim to be the head of the show yourself.

classical_check: Agrees: the 10th is the house of career, status and authority figures.

hindi: 11वां आपके दोस्त हैं मित्र हैं बड़े हैं दूर के लोग आपका भाई है ताऊ इत्यादि
says: He says the 11th house is your friends and companions, your elders and people at a distance, and also your (elder) brother, paternal uncle (tau) and similar relatives.
cells_derived_method: The topics (friends, elders, elder brother) are fixed; the sign in the 11th shows the kind of friends. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aquarius in the 11th, lagna Aries. Many friends from varied groups; an independent, social circle.
Derived: Pisces in the 11th, lagna Taurus. Soft-hearted, spiritual or artistic friends; an elder brother who is gentle and dreamy.
Derived: Gemini in the 11th, lagna Leo. Talkative, clever and networking friends; a lively elder brother.

ambiguity: 'आपका भाई' does not say elder or younger; the 11th suggests elder, and he gave the younger brother to the 3rd.
classical_check: Agrees: the 11th is the house of friends, gains and the elder brother.

hindi: सन इन लॉ यानी कि आपके बच्चे का पति या उसकी पत्नी तो बहू या जवाई
says: He lists the son-in-law and daughter-in-law, the husband or wife of your child, as another relation of this part of the chart. Following the 11th-house list, it reads as the 11th, the 7th from the 5th (the child's spouse).
cells_derived_method: The relation (child's spouse) is fixed; the sign in the 11th shows the nature of the in-law. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius in the 11th, lagna Aquarius. A cheerful, educated or foreign-minded daughter-in-law or son-in-law.
Derived: Virgo in the 11th, lagna Scorpio. A practical, hard-working and critical in-law who keeps the household orderly.

ambiguity: The house is not named in this sentence; it is read as the 11th from the list it follows, and by the 7th-from-the-5th rule.
classical_check: Agrees: the child's spouse is the 7th from the 5th, which is the 11th.

hindi: 12वां आपके फॉरेन कनेक्शंस है डिस्टेंट रिलेशनशिप्स रिलेटिव्स दूर के रिश्तेदार जो दूर के बहुत दूर के हैं
says: He says the 12th house is your foreign connections and distant relationships, meaning relatives who are far, very far, from you.
cells_derived_method: The topics (foreign links and distant kin) are fixed; the sign in the 12th shows where and how. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces in the 12th, lagna Aries. Strong overseas or isolated links; distant relatives across the water.
Derived: Sagittarius in the 12th, lagna Capricorn. Foreign ties through study, religion or long travel; relatives in far countries.
Derived: Gemini in the 12th, lagna Cancer. Foreign contacts kept by messages and trade; distant relatives met mainly by phone or letter.

classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is the house of foreign lands and of those far away.

hindi: एक पास के रिश्तेदार है वो दूसरे घर से दूर के रिश्तेदार ये 12वें घर से हैं
says: He contrasts near and far relatives: the close relatives come from the 2nd house, and the far ones from the 12th. So the 2nd stands for the family you live with and the 12th for the family at a distance.
cells_derived_method: The split (near vs far kin) is fixed; the signs in the 2nd and 12th decide how close or far they are. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer in the 2nd, lagna Gemini. Close, caring kin around you; the near family is strongly emotionally bound.
Derived: Aquarius in the 12th, lagna Pisces. Far relatives in unusual, scattered or international circles with little contact.

ambiguity: 'वो दूसरे घर से' is garbled and is read as 'near relatives come from the 2nd house'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 2nd is the family (kutumba) and the 12th is distance and separation; the specific near/far split is his own.

hindi: और इसी के पास आपके फॉरेन कनेक्शन है विदेश डॉलर डॉलर डॉलर
says: He says that the 12th house is also where your foreign connections lie, with money from abroad (dollars, dollars, dollars). Foreign income and overseas deals are read there.
cells_derived_method: The topics (foreign money) are fixed; the sign in the 12th shows the kind of foreign income. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus in the 12th, lagna Gemini. Steady, asset-based earning from abroad or savings held overseas.
Derived: Virgo in the 12th, lagna Libra. Service, analysis or health-related work abroad; dollars through skills.
Derived: Scorpio in the 12th, lagna Sagittarius. Foreign money linked to research, investments or hidden channels.

classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is the house of foreign lands and expenditure; foreign income is classically also linked to the 11th and 2nd.

gist: Announces a 'terrible but small' fact, points to the 4th and 9th houses, and says nature has arranged them in a wonderful way.

Animal-kingdom digression: parents staying together is rare; the penguin and the crab stay with the mate after the young are born, a dog stays a while, but mostly the female raises the young and the male leaves.
Says in human life too some men, or wives, leave the child with the spouse and walk away.

hindi: कुंडली में ये सारे के सारे हिसाब में चौथा घर जो है ये मां का है माता
says: Tying the animal-kingdom digression back to the chart, he says all such parent-and-child accounts are worked out in the kundli, and the starting point is the 4th house, which is the mother's.
cells_derived_method: none: this restates the 4th as the mother's house, already covered, with no new sign dependence.
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th is classically the mother's house.

gist: A listener reminds him about the 'money from in-laws' point; he says yes, good, remind me again, very good.

hindi: ये मां का खाना यहां से हम मां को देखते हैं यह तो हमारा जीवन का सारा सुख है वैभव है प्रॉपर्टी है एसेट है जायदाद है जमीन
says: He says this box (the 4th house) is the mother's, from where we look at the mother, and it is also all the comfort and splendour of life: property, assets, estate and land. So the 4th covers both the mother and all material happiness.
cells_derived_method: The topics (mother, comfort, property) are fixed; the sign in the 4th shows what kind of comfort and property. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra in the 4th, lagna Cancer. Comfort through beauty, harmony and a well-kept home; property is shared or comes through a partnership.
Derived: Pisces in the 4th, lagna Sagittarius. Comfort through peace and devotion; a home near water or like a retreat; vague about material holdings.
Derived: Virgo in the 4th, lagna Gemini. Comfort through order and practical arrangement; property is well managed but modest.

ambiguity: 'खाना' is the box or house of the chart, not food.
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th (sukha bhava) covers mother, comforts, property, vehicles and land.

hindi: सब मा मा से तो बने हम सब कुछ तो मा ही है हमारे लिए प्रथम
says: He says we are all made from the mother, and for us the mother is everything and comes first. This puts the mother ahead of the father in importance.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the mother is the first nourisher; classically she is signified by the 4th house and the Moon.

hindi: लेकिन कृपा स्पर्म दिया पिता के द्वारा तो हमारा जन्म कृपा इस जन्म में भाग ग जन्म देने का आशीर्वाद तो पिता से मिला
says: He adds that the seed that began our birth came through the father, so the grace of this life, its fortune, and the blessing of being given birth came from the father. The mother comes first, but the father supplies the fortune and blessing that start this life.
cells_derived_method: The topics (father, fortune and blessing) are fixed; the sign in the 9th shows the father's nature and the luck. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces in the 9th, lagna Cancer. A kind, spiritual father; fortune comes through faith, charity and quiet grace.
Derived: Capricorn in the 9th, lagna Taurus. A strict, duty-bound father; fortune comes late and through effort.

ambiguity: 'भाग ग' is cut off and read as 'भाग्य' (fortune). The 9th is inferred from his earlier giving the father to the 9th.
classical_check: Agrees: the 9th is the house of father and fortune (bhagya).

gist: Transition: 'this is done, the father; now see the fun taste'.
Points at the 4th and the 9th houses and starts counting 'one, two, three, four' between them; the numbers after that ('सात आन') are garbled.

hindi: अगर चौथे घर से हम ले कि माता से पिता का रिश्ता कैसा है यह भी तो बताओ कि बच्चे के पैदा होने के बाद मां-बाप कई झगड़ते हैं
says: He says that if we start from the 4th house (the mother) we can read how the mother's relation to the father is, and that this also tells whether the parents quarrel after a child is born. The parents' relationship is read by counting between the 4th and the 9th.
cells_derived_method: The 9th is always the sixth sign from the 4th, so the pair of signs gives the colour of the parents' bond. Derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio in the 4th, lagna Leo, with Aries as the 9th. Both are Mars-type signs, so the parents' bond is intense and prone to sharp clashes once a child arrives.
Derived: Libra in the 4th, lagna Cancer, with Pisces as the 9th. Venus on the mother's side against Jupiter on the father's, and Jupiter treats Venus as an enemy: friction of values and taste.

ambiguity: 'कई झगड़ते हैं' is loose (many quarrel, or sometimes quarrel); the claim is a tendency, not a certainty.
classical_check: Partly agrees: reading one relative from the house of another by counting (bhavat bhavam style) is a recognised method; the 'quarrel after birth' result is his own.

hindi: चौथे से छठा ये एक दो इसको एक मानेंगे हमेशा जहां से गिन रहे
says: He states the counting rule: the house you start counting from is always counted as one. So counting from the 4th, the 4th is one, the 5th is two, and so on.
cells_derived_method: none: it is a counting rule, not a cell effect.
ambiguity: The counting words 'एक दो' just before it are garbled.
classical_check: Agrees: classical house counting is inclusive, the starting house being the first.

hindi: एक दो तीन चार पा छ छठा घर किसका शत्रु
says: Counting from the mother's 4th house with the 4th as one, he lands on the father's 9th house at the sixth place, and the 6th place is the enemy position. So from the mother's side the father sits in her enemy position.
cells_derived_method: The 9th sign is always the sixth sign from the 4th sign, so the pair of signs tells how the enmity shows. Derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in the 9th, lagna Leo, sixth from the mother's Scorpio. The father's position carries a Mars-type clash with the mother; conflict is open.
Derived: Gemini in the 9th, lagna Libra, sixth from the mother's Capricorn. The enmity shows as coldness, talk and misunderstanding rather than open fighting.

ambiguity: 'छठा घर किसका शत्रु' is a question left to the next lines; the answer is read as the mother's enemy.
classical_check: Agrees on the count (the 9th is the 6th from the 4th); calling the father the mother's 'enemy' is his strong form of the 6th-from-a-house idea.

hindi: अब पिता से माता का घर क्या है एक दो तीन चार पाच 6 सात आ मौत
says: Reversing the count, from the father's 9th house to the mother's 4th, with the 9th as one, the 4th falls at the eighth place, the house of death and endings. So from the father's side the mother sits in the 8th.
cells_derived_method: The 4th sign is always the eighth sign from the 9th sign. Derived examples show the sign pair only and give no death prediction. Derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer in the 4th, lagna Aries, eighth from the father's Sagittarius. The Moon's sign sits in the transformation position from Jupiter's, so the mother's role is linked to the father's endings and changes.
Derived: Pisces in the 4th, lagna Sagittarius, eighth from the father's Leo. The mother's Jupiter-ruled house sits in the dissolving position from the Sun-ruled father's house.

ambiguity: 'सात आ' is cut off and read as 'सात, आठ'; the 8th is confirmed by the word 'मौत' (death).
classical_check: Agrees: the 8th from the 9th is the 4th, the classical longevity-of-father measure.

hindi: यानी बच्चे के जन्म के बाद मां का शत्रु तो है बाप और बाप की मौत का कारण बनेगी मां
says: He concludes that after the child's birth the father is the mother's enemy, and that the mother will turn out to be the cause of the father's death. This is a death-related claim recorded as said; it must not be used to give a date or a prediction.
cells_derived_method: none: no derived examples are given because this is a death-related statement.
ambiguity: 'मौत का कारण बनेगी मां' may be figurative (her role leads to the father's decline) or literal; he does not say which.
classical_check: Differs: classics use the 4th as the father's longevity house (8th from the 9th), but do not say the mother causes his death.

hindi: प्रकृति को देखो कितना विचित्र है यानी उनके बीच का रोमांस मस्ती सुख दुख का स्यापा गया तेल लेने अब तो हो गए बेबी
says: He remarks how strange nature is: because of this 6th-and-8th arrangement between the two houses, the romance, fun and shared joys and sorrows between the parents go out of the window, now that they have a baby. In his view, childbirth turns the couple from romance to friction.
ambiguity: 'स्यापा गया तेल लेने' is an idiom meaning the whole fuss is gone; the claim is a general tendency, not a rule for every chart.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text says that the birth of a child ends the romance between parents.

hindi: बच्चे कंसीव होने के बाद भयंकर चेंज आता है जीवन में भयंकर चेंज आता है पता नहीं कैसे क्या होता है अचानक
says: He says a huge change comes into the couple's life as soon as a child is conceived, suddenly and in ways nobody can explain. The change is tied to conception, not just to the birth.
