ambiguity: No house is named in this sentence; the next sentence gives the cause as the 4th and 9th boxes.
classical_check: Silent: classics do not describe conception as a trigger for a sudden change in the parents' marriage.

hindi: क्योंकि यह दो खाने एक्टिवेट हो जाते हैं कि अब माता और पिता के कार्यक्रम में क्या होगा यह इस पुरुष और स्त्री के भी होते हैं जिनके बेबी होने वाला है
says: He explains the sudden change: two boxes, the mother's 4th and the father's 9th, get activated, and what happens between mother and father now depends on them. He says this applies to the man and woman who are about to have a baby.
cells_derived_method: none: the claim concerns the activation of the two houses and does not depend on a sign.
ambiguity: The houses are not named in this sentence; 'दो खाने' are read as the 4th and 9th from the preceding lines.
classical_check: Silent: classics have no concept of the 4th and 9th being switched on by conception.

hindi: ऐसे कॉमिनेशन और ऐसा पैदा हुआ बच्चे की कुंडली से बता बताया जा सकता है कि तेरे अगर तो इन दोनों के अंदर ऐसा कोई ग्रह है जिनकी मित्रता है तो बच्चा पैदा होने के बाद भी मित्र रहेंगे
says: He says that the child's own kundli can show how the parents' bond will go: if there are planets in these two houses that are friendly to each other, the mother and father will stay friends even after the baby is born.
cells_derived_method: The friendship of the two house signs' rulers decides the result. The 9th sign is five signs after the 4th. Derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces in the 4th, lagna Sagittarius, with Leo as the 9th. Jupiter and the Sun are mutual friends, so by his rule the parents stay friends after the birth.
Derived: Leo in the 4th, lagna Taurus, with Capricorn as the 9th. The Sun and Saturn are mutual enemies, so the friendship by his rule would not hold and the strain would show.

ambiguity: 'तेरे अगर' is garbled; 'इन दोनों के अंदर' is read as the planets of the 4th and 9th houses, or their lords. Whether the child's chart or the parents' chart is used is not fully clear.
classical_check: Partly agrees: planetary friendship between the lords of two houses is a classical test of how well the two matters get on; using the child's chart for the parents' bond is not classical.

hindi: लेकिन बेबी होने के बाद वह रोमांस जिंग और चार्म खत्म हो जाता है
says: He adds that even when the planets are friendly, after the baby arrives the romance, the zing and the charm between the parents come to an end. Friendship may survive but the romantic spark does not.
ambiguity: 'वह' (that romance) refers to the parents' romance from the previous lines.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text says that the birth of a child ends romance between the parents.

hindi: अगर आपका ग्रह ऐसा है कि जन्म होने के बाद इन दोनों ग्रहों के भयंकर पावर है तो हो सकता है बच्चे होने के बाद आप ज्यादा प्रेमी हो जाओ पर वो बहुत बहुत रेयर केस है
says: He gives the exception: if the planets of these two houses become very powerful after the birth, the couple may become even more loving once they have children, but he stresses this is a very rare case.
cells_derived_method: A strong planet by sign dignity in the 4th or 9th is the nearest reading of 'powerful'. Derived, not said by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 4th, lagna Aries. A very strong 4th can be the rare case where the couple grow closer after children.
Derived: the Sun in its own sign Leo in the 9th, lagna Sagittarius. A strong father's house with the father's role empowered; the parents' bond can warm after the birth.

ambiguity: 'भयंकर पावर' is not defined (by dignity, aspect or house) and 'जन्म होने के बाद' hints at a dasha or transit timing after the birth.
classical_check: Partly agrees: strong planets in the 4th and 9th (both benefic houses) are classically good for the home and father; the claim about marital warmth after birth is his own.

hindi: क्योंकि छठा और आठवा रिश्ता है माता-पिता का ये आमने सामने नहीं है हर ग्रह ने से सामने काम करता है यह एक अजीब सा योग है
says: He gives the reason for the usual outcome: the relation between mother's and father's houses is a 6th-and-8th relation, not a face-to-face (7th) one, so the two do not look at each other directly. He calls this an odd yoga.
cells_derived_method: none: it describes the geometry of the two houses, which is the same for every sign.
ambiguity: 'हर ग्रह ने से सामने काम करता है' is garbled; it seems to say that every planet normally works by facing (aspecting) the other.
classical_check: Agrees: a 6-8 relation (shadashtaka) between two houses or planets is classically an unfriendly, non-aspecting position.

hindi: यानी आपके बेबी हुए तो बड़ा खतरा है जीवन के अंदर इसलिए कृपा भी ले
says: He sums up that once a baby is born there is a big danger in the couple's life, which is why grace should be taken too; the thought carries on into the next timestamp with 'and take blessing as well'.
ambiguity: 'बड़ा खतरा' is loose and means a risk to the marriage, not to the baby; the sentence is cut at the timestamp edge.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text names the baby's birth as a danger point for the parents' marriage.

hindi: लो और आशीर्वाद भी ले लो कृपा है बैठे बिठाई मिल गई आशीर्वाद क्या है लेना पड़ता है वो लेना पड़ता है
says: He draws a distinction: grace (kripa) comes sitting at home without effort, but a blessing (ashirvad) has to be taken, that is, earned by going to the elders and asking.
classical_check: Silent: the kripa versus ashirvad distinction is his own and not found in classical astrology texts.

gist: Jokes that our backs hurt and no one wants to bow to elders, yet we go from temple to temple doing full prostrations.

hindi: चौथा घर सुधार दो अन्यथा आपकी शादी का रिश्ता शत्रु और मृत्यु का है
says: He advises improving the 4th house, or else the relationship of the marriage stays one of enmity and death (the 6th and 8th pattern between the mother's and father's houses). Repairing the 4th is his remedy for the strained couple.
cells_derived_method: none: how to improve the 4th is not said, and the remedy is the same for every cell.
ambiguity: 'आपकी शादी' is read as the parents' marriage in the 4th-9th context; it could also be the native's own. How to 'improve' the 4th is not stated.
classical_check: Partly agrees: strengthening the 4th lord by remedy is classical, but tying it to the parents' marriage is his link.

hindi: इसलिए माता-पिता कई ऐसे हैं जो जिंदगियां घसीट रहे हैं बस बच्चों के होने के बाद से तो जिंदगी घसीट रहे है
says: He says that for this reason many parents are just dragging their lives along ever since the children were born. He offers this as everyday evidence of the 6th-and-8th link between the mother's and father's houses.
classical_check: Silent: an anecdotal observation with no classical basis.

hindi: जी हम पैसा भी आ गया जी पैसा किसका आया बच्चे के नसीब का अमीर भी बन गए गाड़ियां भी आ गई
says: He says that a couple may even have become rich and bought cars after having children, and asks whose money it is: it came from the child's destiny. Wealth that arrives after a birth is credited to the child's fortune, not to the parents.
ambiguity: No house is named; the child's luck would classically be read from the 5th, but he does not say so here.
classical_check: Partly agrees: folk and classical belief holds that a child's birth can bring luck to the parents, but no text says the money is the child's destiny.

hindi: दुनिया के दिखावा बहुत बढ़िया है लेकिन प्रेम कहां है रिश्ता कहां है शत्रु और मृत्यु के समान है इसलिए प्रेम मर जाता है
says: He says the outward show of the world looks fine, but where is the love and the relationship? It is like enmity and death, and so love dies. Wealth and show can hide a marriage that has lost its love.
classical_check: Silent: a moral observation that is not found in classical texts.

hindi: यह बड़ी विचित्र सी स्थिति है उल्टा ऐसा होता है कई बार बच्चे घर के आ जाते हैं हमारा तो जिंदगी घर नर्क कर देते हैं यह होता है ऐसा
says: He says the reverse also happens: sometimes the children, once they arrive, turn the house and the couple's life into hell. So the 6th-8th strain can show as trouble caused by the children themselves.
ambiguity: 'उल्टा' may mean the opposite of the 'money comes' case or of 'love dies'; the sentence is loose and 'घर के आ जाते हैं' is garbled.
classical_check: Silent: no classical statement on children turning the home into hell; difficult children are read from the 5th and its afflictions.

hindi: यह एक मजे की बात दूसरा हमका बात कर रहे थे सातव और आठवें घर की यह सातवा घर हो गया यह हमारे स्पाउस का है पति का या पत्नी का इससे दूसरा घर है ससुराल
says: Moving to the next pair, he says the 7th house is the spouse, husband or wife, and the house second from it is the in-laws' house (sasural), which is the 8th. So the in-laws are read by counting two houses from the spouse's house.
cells_derived_method: The spouse's sign and the next sign (the in-laws') come as a pair. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in the 7th, lagna Libra, with Taurus as the 8th. A bold, direct spouse; the in-laws' house is a comfortable, wealth-minded Taurus family.
Derived: Cancer in the 7th, lagna Capricorn, with Leo as the 8th. A caring, home-loving spouse; the in-laws' house is proud and status-conscious.

classical_check: Partly agrees: the 8th is the 2nd from the 7th and so carries the spouse's family resources; in-law persons themselves are read by bhavat bhavam.

gist: Starts mapping the first pair of houses with 'this was my house, this is me'; the thought runs on into the next timestamp.
Quips a film-song style line ('one am I, one heart, both given up for you') and says he will not make this subject easy for the audience.

hindi: यह मैं हूं ये मेरा घर हो गया रिश्ते नाते प्रेम रिश्तेदार धन पैसा
says: He labels the first house as 'me' and the house next to it as 'my home', meaning relationships, kinship, love, relatives, wealth and money. He sets up the 1st-2nd pair as the model for the 7th-8th pair of spouse and spouse's home.
cells_derived_method: The self and its home go as a pair; the sign in the 2nd shows the style of family and money. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius in the 2nd, lagna Scorpio. A family with strong beliefs and generosity; money comes through advice, teaching or travel.
Derived: Pisces in the 2nd, lagna Aquarius. A compassionate family; vague about money, which goes out as freely as it comes.
Derived: Aries in the 2nd, lagna Pisces. A quick-tempered, direct family; earns fast and spends fast.

ambiguity: The first words 'यह मेरा घर था' are in the previous timestamp; the mapping 'me = 1st, my home = 2nd' is read from context and not spoken as numbers.
classical_check: Agrees: the 1st is the self and the 2nd is family and wealth (dhana-kutumba bhava).

hindi: ये पति या पत्नी और ये उसका घर हो गया तो यहां से पैसा पत्नी का के घर वाले कितने पैसे वाले हैं या पति के घर वाले कितने पैसे वाले हैं
says: Mirroring the 1st-2nd pair, he says the 7th is the husband or wife and the next house is the spouse's home, and from it you read how rich the wife's or the husband's family is. Money of the in-laws is therefore judged from the 8th.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 8th shows the kind of wealth the spouse's family has. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 8th, lagna Gemini. An old-fashioned, structured and thrifty in-law family; wealth is steady but not shown off.
Derived: Pisces in the 8th, lagna Leo. A generous but disorganised in-law family; money may be plentiful yet leaks away.

classical_check: Agrees: the 8th is the 2nd from the 7th, which is the spouse's wealth and family resources.

hindi: लड़की जिस घर में जाएगी पैसे वाला होगा गरीब होगा कंगाल होगा सुंदर रिश्ते होंगे लड़ाई होगी झगड़ा होगा क्या होगा यहां से
says: He says the kind of home a girl will go into after marriage, whether rich, poor or penniless, with lovely relationships or with fights and quarrels, is all read from this house (the 8th).
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 8th sets the character of the marital home. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra in the 8th, lagna Pisces. A harmonious, refined marital home where relationships stay courteous.
Derived: Aries in the 8th, lagna Virgo. A quick-tempered home where quarrels flare up fast and die fast.
Derived: Cancer in the 8th, lagna Sagittarius. A warm, family-bound home, but moods and clinging can cause emotional quarrels.

ambiguity: He speaks of a girl's chart; whether the same holds for a man going into a spouse's family is not stated.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the marital home is classically judged from the 7th and its 4th (the 10th), with the 8th for the spouse's resources; reading the whole home from the 8th is his usage.

hindi: यहां से ठीक पीछे 12वां घर ये मेरी सेक्स लाइफ है
says: Counting from the first house, he says the house directly behind it, the 12th, is my own sex life.
cells_derived_method: The topic (one's own intimate life) is fixed; the sign in the 12th gives its style. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus in the 12th, lagna Gemini. A sensual, steady and comfort-seeking intimate life.
Derived: Scorpio in the 12th, lagna Sagittarius. An intense, private and secretive intimate life.
Derived: Aquarius in the 12th, lagna Pisces. A detached, experimental and unconventional intimate life.

ambiguity: 'यहां से' is the first house, read from the gesture; the 12th is stated by number.
classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is the house of bed pleasures (shayana sukha).

hindi: यहां से पीछे का छठा घर यह पत्नी की सेक्स लाइफ है
says: Counting back from the spouse's house (the 7th), the house directly behind it, the 6th, is the wife's (spouse's) sex life. The spouse's intimate life is read from the 12th from the 7th, which is the 6th.
cells_derived_method: The topic (the spouse's intimate life) is fixed; the sign in the 6th gives its style. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus in the 6th, lagna Sagittarius. A sensual, steady and perhaps possessive intimate nature in the spouse.
Derived: Leo in the 6th, lagna Pisces. A warm, proud spouse who needs admiration in intimacy.
Derived: Sagittarius in the 6th, lagna Cancer. A free-spirited, frank and adventurous spouse in intimate matters.

ambiguity: 'यहां से' means from the spouse's house (the 7th); this is read from the arithmetic, 12th from the 7th being the 6th, since the sentence does not name the 7th.
classical_check: Agrees by counting: the 12th from the 7th is the 6th, and the 12th from a house is its bed pleasure or loss.

hindi: अगर यह डिस्टर्ब है तो पत्नी को या पति को सेक्स के लिए बाहर जाना पड़ेगा कितना इलीगल सा इलिसिट सा योग है यह
says: He says that if the spouse's intimate-life house is disturbed, the wife or husband will have to go outside the marriage for sex, and he calls it an illegal-looking, illicit-looking yoga. It is a claim about a third person's behaviour and is recorded as said.
cells_derived_method: none: no examples are derived for a claim about infidelity.
ambiguity: 'यह' is not named; it is read as the spouse's sex-life house (the 6th) just mentioned. A minute later he reverses to 'your box' (the 12th).
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts connect affliction of the 7th, 12th and Venus with troubled marital intimacy, but not the 6th as 'spouse's bed'.

hindi: कि यदि आपका यह खाना ठीक नहीं है तो सेक्स लाइफ आपकी खराब होगी
says: He says that if your own box, the 12th house, is not in good order, your own sex life will be poor.
cells_derived_method: A disturbed 12th reads differently by sign. Derived from sign nature, not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 12th, lagna Aquarius. If disturbed, a cold, restricted and delayed intimate life.
Derived: Cancer in the 12th, lagna Leo. If disturbed, mood-driven intimacy; emotional needs block physical comfort.

ambiguity: 'आपका यह खाना' is read as your own 12th box; it could also mean the box just discussed.
classical_check: Agrees: an afflicted 12th is classically a sign of troubled bed pleasures.

hindi: और सेक्स सबसे बड़ा कारण है सबसे बड़ा शायद ओनली कारण है फॉर एक्स्ट्रा मेरिटल अफेयर्स ओनली
says: He says that sex is the biggest cause, perhaps the only cause, of extramarital affairs. So poor intimacy is what pushes a spouse outside the marriage.
ambiguity: No house is named in this sentence; the 6th and 12th are read from the previous lines.
classical_check: Differs: classics link extramarital affairs to the 7th, 12th, Venus and Rahu afflictions, and do not isolate sex as the only cause.

hindi: अगर बेड कंफर्ट ठीक नहीं है तो हर हालत में पति या पत्नी आपका सेक्स करने बाहर जाएगा अगर अगर यह योग है अगर अगर नहीं है कोई बात नहीं और भी मल्टीपल तरीके बनते हैं अन्यथा उसे जाना पड़ेगा
says: He says that if bed comfort is not right, the spouse will go outside, in every case, but then qualifies it with 'if this yoga is present'. If the yoga is absent, no problem, and there are several other ways the same result can arise.
cells_derived_method: none: no examples are derived for a claim about infidelity.
ambiguity: 'हर हालत में' (in every case) is immediately limited by 'अगर यह योग है' (if the yoga exists), so he contradicts himself within the sentence.
classical_check: Partly agrees: several yogas can give marital unfaithfulness in classical texts, so 'multiple ways' is consistent, but the 'in every case' form is not classical.

hindi: और लड़ाई ये होती है कि यह कमीना या लड़की बिगड़ गई है यह बाहर जा रहे हैं वो मजबूर है क्योंकि आपका वो ग्रह खराब है
says: He says couples fight by calling the spouse a scoundrel or saying the girl has gone bad, but the spouse is forced to go outside because your own planet is bad. The cause is placed on the native's afflicted planet, not on the spouse's character.
ambiguity: 'वो ग्रह' is not named; it is the planet of the disturbed intimacy house, which he has not named in this slice.
classical_check: Silent: classics do not reassign blame for infidelity to the native's own planet; it is a modern counselling frame.

gist: Says marriage is made for sex at the level of the body and for companionship at the level of the soul.

hindi: पर शरीर का भोग यदि डिस्टर्ब होगा तो आत्मा का तल खराब होता है
says: He says that if the bodily side of the marriage (physical enjoyment) is disturbed, the soul-level side, the companionship, also gets spoilt. The houses of bodily pleasure therefore affect the quality of the whole marriage.
ambiguity: The houses are not named in this sentence; they are read from the preceding lines.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text links the quality of companionship to the state of the 12th and 6th.

hindi: बाद में तो जीवन में आवश्यकता नहीं रहती शरीर के भोग की इतनी ज्यादा पागलपन नहीं होता लेकिन यह दोष हो तो मनुष्य भटके ग ही बेचारा कहां जाए उसे भटकने को मजबूर होना ही पड़ेगा
says: He says that later in life the need for bodily enjoyment fades and is no longer so frenzied, but if this defect is present the person is bound to stray, the poor fellow, forced to wander because he has nowhere else to go.
ambiguity: 'भटके ग' is garbled and read as 'भटकेगा'. 'यह दोष' refers to the intimacy-house defect without naming it.
classical_check: Silent: classics do not speak of this defect forcing a person to stray, nor of the need fading with age.

hindi: इसलिए बड़े ध्यान से ग्रहों की करेक्शन कीजिए आपस में
says: He concludes that you should correct the planets very carefully (by remedy), rather than quarrelling among yourselves. The sentence runs on into the next timestamp.
ambiguity: 'आपस में' is cut at the timestamp edge and goes with 'लड़ने से कुछ नहीं होगा' in the next line.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical astrology offers planet-wise remedies (upaya) for relationship problems instead of blame.

hindi: लड़ने से कुछ नहीं होगा क्योंकि ये अननोन टेरिटरी है पुरुष और स्त्री लड़ रहे हैं
says: He says that quarrelling will achieve nothing, because this is unknown territory: the man and the woman are fighting over something whose real cause, the planetary set-up behind it, neither of them can see.
ambiguity: 'अननोन टेरिटरी' is read as the planetary cause being unknown to the couple; he does not explain the phrase.
classical_check: Silent: a counselling remark with no classical equivalent; classical practice is to find the planetary cause and remedy it.

gist: Says the attraction between boyfriend and girlfriend is only, only, only physical and nothing else.
Says you can argue for hours about deep inner love, but it is nonsense; those who say 'I am mad for your love' are under hypnosis.
Says we love Krishna the same way, though Krishna is nowhere to be seen, and are mad like Meera; that too is hypnosis and the path of bhakti, a separate programme.
Invites about ten questions from the audience because many sweet and disturbing yogas will come up in the discussion.
Announces the next class: first what result each planet gives in each sign, then how it acts when seated in a house of the kundli, then where in the body injury and trouble show.
Adds a later class on relationships, and a class for children on which colours of stationery, pen, pencil, bag and box they should use from childhood.
Says the guest had touched a small matter, but it is a long and sweet subject; the caption is garbled.
Says the Moon class should be done, leaves it to the audience, and proposes taking it next time because it is very interesting.

hindi: चंदा मामा सबसे फास्ट मूव करता है घूमते र घूमता रहता है
says: He says the Moon (Chanda mama) is the fastest-moving of all the planets and keeps circulating all the time, which is why it makes an interesting subject for the next class.
cells_derived_method: none: a motion fact, not dependent on house or sign.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon travels about 13 degrees a day and changes sign roughly every two and a quarter days, the fastest of the grahas.

gist: Teases the host: these poor men look simple, one seems an artist who said something low-brow, then lets a listener ask a question.
A listener says that after the talk about men needing dopamine, the speaker was telling them about liquor.
He replies that he was not recommending liquor; it was only an example.
Joke about a man with a very long beard who soaks it in liquor and strokes it in front of his wife so the liquor goes in unnoticed; he calls it useless nonsense.
The listener asks whether liquor is used as the example because it is easily available, because most people drink, or whether intoxication is being promoted.

Calls it a weighty question about the anandamaya kosha and says the subconscious mind works on only three koshas, annamaya, pranamaya and manomaya, and not on the anandamaya and jnanamaya koshas; if 'ये' means liquor, this sits oddly with his earlier claim that liquor numbs knowledge.
Jokes 'where are you taking the astrology classes?' and says if we are going there, then we go.
Says the anandamaya kosha is the play of dopamine; the closing words ('मुन्ना से आगे चला') are garbled.

hindi: पर वो फिजिकल चीजों में चिजी में आपका जो राहु है वो ब्लॉक कर देता है मनोमय कोष को ब्लॉक कर देता है राहु
says: Rahu blocks the manomaya kosha (the mental or mind sheath), so the joy a person should be getting from physical things and sense objects is choked off; the sentence opens mid-thought, continuing from the previous batch.
ambiguity: The start of the sentence is the tail of the previous batch, so what exactly the joy 'comes from' is cut off. It could mean Rahu blocks the joy itself or blocks the mind's ability to feel it.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu is classically delusion, intoxicants and obstruction; the kosha (sheath) framework is Vedantic, not a Parashari rule.

gist: Forward reference: says this point will come up again when the Moon is taught.

hindi: राहु खाता है तो राहु जो है उसके द्वारा जो मनोमय कोष मारा जाता है वो राहु की चिज जिया है नशे की जिसमें निकोटीन है चाय कैफीन है आपकी कॉफी में आपका दारू है उसमें नशा है
says: The mental sheath is 'killed' through Rahu's things, meaning intoxicants: nicotine, the caffeine in tea and coffee, and liquor, all of which carry a drug-like high.
ambiguity: 'राहु खाता है' is unclear in the caption; it may be a garbled 'Rahu is eating/consuming' or the start of a new thought. The Rahu-intoxicant link is clear either way.
classical_check: Agrees in part: classical karakatva lists give Rahu poison, narcotics and intoxicating things; caffeine and nicotine are modern additions in his list.

hindi: ये सब डोपामिन बनाते हैं
says: He says all these Rahu substances work by producing dopamine, i.e. they create a chemical pleasure that replaces the natural joy of the mind.
ambiguity: A physiological claim made in passing; no Jyotish rule depends on it.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no concept of dopamine; this is his modern explanation for why Rahu is linked to addiction.

hindi: चर सफीम गांजा चर सफीम गांजा इत्यादि
says: He adds charas (hashish), opium (afeem) and ganja (cannabis) to the list of Rahu's intoxicating substances, and says 'and so on', so the list is open-ended.
ambiguity: 'चर सफीम' is the caption's rendering of charas and afeem; repeated twice in the caption.
classical_check: Agrees: narcotics and poisons are standard Rahu significations in later Jyotish tradition.

gist: Aside that highly educated people (PhD types) know more about ecstasy-creating substances and you cannot argue with them.

hindi: ये सारे के सारे ना आपके ज्ञान को बुझा देते हैं यानी आपके बृहस्पति की बत्ती बुझाते थे
says: All these intoxicants put out your knowledge, which he explains as switching off the lamp of your Jupiter; so Rahu-type substances damage the Jupiter faculty of wisdom and discrimination.
cells_derived_method: The damage to Jupiter is stronger when Rahu sits with Jupiter or aspects it; the life area hit follows the house they share: 5th (judgement, mind), 9th (dharma, guru, grace), 2nd (speech, family values). The sign decides how: Jupiter in own sign or exalted resists more than Jupiter in Capricorn (debilitated).

derived_examples.reading: derived: Rahu with Jupiter in Jupiter's own sign Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries); the grace and dharma house is clouded, but Jupiter's own-sign strength resists, so the lamp flickers rather than goes out.

derived: Rahu with debilitated Jupiter in Capricorn in the 5th (lagna Virgo); judgement and intelligence are the weakest here, which is where substance habits would most easily extinguish discrimination.
derived: Rahu with exalted Jupiter in Cancer in the 2nd (lagna Gemini); the damage shows in speech and family values rather than in the mind house.

ambiguity: 'बुझाते थे' is past tense in the caption, probably a slip for 'बुझाते हैं'. He does not say it is Rahu's conjunction with Jupiter; this is only the substance-effect rule in general.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Guru-Chandala yoga (Rahu with Jupiter) is classically a dimming of Jupiter's wisdom; the lamp image and the substance link are his own.

hindi: जैसे बृहस्पति की बत्ती बुझी कृपा बंद ना आपका इष्ट काम करेगा ना भगवान का मंदिर काम करेगा
says: Once Jupiter's lamp is out, grace (kripa) stops flowing: your chosen deity (ishta) will not work for you and even the temple of God will not work, because the receiving faculty is shut.
classical_check: Silent: Jupiter as the giver of grace and guru's blessing is classical; the claim that the ishta and temple stop working is his own devotional corollary.

hindi: इसलिए दारू की बात की गई है यह राहु की बात की गई है बेसिकली क्योंकि राहु के रिच सोर्स है
says: Liquor is discussed under Rahu, he says, mainly because it cuts off Jupiter's grace, and Rahu is the rich source of such intoxicants.
ambiguity: 'राहु के रिच सोर्स है' is unclear: it may mean Rahu is the richest source of intoxicants, or that these are rich sources of Rahu energy.
classical_check: Agrees: liquor is traditionally assigned to Rahu (and also to Mars/Saturn influences) in later texts.

hindi: बियर राहु है
says: Beer is assigned to Rahu directly, as the pure Rahu drink.
classical_check: Silent: beer as a specific Rahu item is modern; classical texts give only general intoxicants.

hindi: मंगल रूपी जो शराब है वह रेड वाइन है
says: The Mars-type liquor is red wine; red colour and heat tie it to Mars.
classical_check: Silent: assigning drinks to individual planets is his own scheme; Mars as red, hot and fiery is classical.

hindi: चंद्रमा रूपी जो है व वड का और वाइट वाइन है
says: The Moon-type liquor is vodka and white wine, the clear or pale drinks, matching the Moon's whiteness.
ambiguity: The sentence is split across two caption chunks: 'व' at the end and 'वड का' (vodka) at the start of the next; reconstructed as vodka.
classical_check: Silent: the Moon-drink assignment is his own; Moon as white and watery is classical.

hindi: कितने टाइप से नहीं ऐसे चलता है रम अलग है बाकी अलग अलग है
says: Liquors come in many kinds and do not map one-to-one to a single rule; rum is its own category and the rest are different again, so each type has to be assigned separately.
ambiguity: 'कितने टाइप से नहीं ऐसे चलता है' is garbled; the meaning is reconstructed. He does not say which planet rum belongs to.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: विस्की वगैरह य शनि रूपी राहु है
says: Whisky and similar dark spirits are Saturn-type Rahu, a Rahu drink that carries Saturn's heavy, slow, dark quality.
ambiguity: 'य' is likely 'ये' (these). Unclear whether rum is included in 'वगैरह' with whisky.
classical_check: Silent: Rahu acting in Saturn's manner is classical (Rahu behaves like Saturn); the whisky link is his own.

hindi: लेकिन इसमें राहु की इवॉल्वमेंट है क्योंकि नशा है ब्लॉक करता है बॉडी को शिथिल करता है
says: Whatever the planet-flavour of a drink, Rahu is involved in all of them because intoxication blocks the mind and makes the body slack and sluggish.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Rahu is the planet of intoxication and dullness; the body-slackening part is his own addition.

hindi: इसलिए बृहस्पति का कार्य बृहस्पति कृपा बहुत कृपा सबसे बड़ी चीज है
says: Jupiter's job is grace, and grace is the biggest thing there is in life, so whatever blocks Jupiter blocks the most valuable resource.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the natural benefic, giver of grace, guru and wisdom.

hindi: अब राहु यदि कृपा करने पर आ जाए तो सोचो क्या मजा है फिर उसको कौन हरा सकता है राहु तो कोई हरा नहीं सकता
says: If Rahu itself turns generous and grants grace, nobody can defeat that person, because Rahu cannot be beaten by anyone; a favourable Rahu is an unbeatable ally.
cells_derived_method: A favourable Rahu is classically strongest in the upachaya houses (3, 6, 10, 11), where it wins over rivals and grows with time; sign colours how: in Gemini or Virgo it works through intellect and analysis, in Aries through bold action.

derived_examples.reading: derived: Rahu in the 6th in Saturn's sign Capricorn (lagna Leo); enemies, competitors and disputes are crushed, the most direct meaning of 'nobody can defeat him'.
derived: Rahu in the 10th in Aries (lagna Cancer); a bold, unconventional career with strong public rise.
derived: Rahu in the 3rd in Gemini (lagna Aries); courage, media and communication skills, self-made effort that rivals cannot match.

ambiguity: He does not say which house or sign makes Rahu graceful; this is only the general principle that a benevolent Rahu is unstoppable.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu in 3, 6, 10, 11 is widely held to give strong results; the 'unbeatable' phrasing is his own.

hindi: और वो पि है इसलिए पित कृपा चाहिए हमें
says: He identifies Rahu with the ancestors ('pi...' read as pitri), and therefore says we need the ancestors' grace to get Rahu's favour.
ambiguity: 'वो पि है' and 'पित' are truncated. It could be पितृ (ancestors), पिता (father) or पित्त. Context 'पित नाराज है' favours ancestors; he does not say 'Rahu is pitri' in full words.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu and Ketu are linked with ancestral karma (pitri dosha) in later tradition; the Sun and 9th house are the classical father and ancestor markers.

hindi: भगवान भी कृपा नहीं करेगा अगर पित नाराज है यह बात है
says: Even God will not give grace if the ancestors are displeased; ancestral approval comes before divine favour.
ambiguity: 'पित' read as पितृ (ancestors); could also be father (पिता).
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: pitri rina and pitri dosha are classical ideas (9th house, Sun); the 'God will not bless' ranking is his own.

gist: Garbled audience-type fragment ('बा सर के आ') before the cloud example; cannot be read.

hindi: बादल सूरज के आगे केतु है
says: Ketu is the cloud that comes in front of the Sun, so Ketu is what covers or hides the Sun's light.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is the eclipse and shadow factor of the Sun; the cloud image is his.

hindi: हा सूरज ढक जाता है यार पता नहीं रोशनी नजर जिंदगी में रोशनी नहीं है यह बादल केतु काम कर रहा है
says: When the Sun is covered you cannot see any light and life feels without light or direction; that is the Ketu cloud at work, so Ketu on the Sun means a loss of clarity and visible success.
cells_derived_method: The dimmed area is the house where Ketu sits with the Sun; 1st dims identity and confidence, 10th dims recognition and career, 9th dims father, guru and luck. Sign changes the strength of the Sun: exalted in Aries it is only partly covered, debilitated in Libra the cloud adds to a weak light.

derived_examples.reading: derived: Sun and Ketu in Leo in the 10th (lagna Scorpio); a strong own-sign Sun is eclipsed, so career recognition is delayed or hidden despite real ability.
derived: Sun exalted in Aries with Ketu in the 9th (lagna Leo); father, guru and luck are dimmed but the exalted Sun still lets some light through.
derived: Sun debilitated in Libra with Ketu in the 4th (lagna Cancer); inner peace and home happiness are the dark patch, the heaviest covering of the three.

ambiguity: The cloud image is general; he does not say the Sun and Ketu must be conjunct in the chart.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Sun-Ketu is a recognised weakening combination (eclipse-like); the 'no light in life' wording is his.

hindi: आपका अपने गुप्त अंग साफ रखिए क्लीन रखिए उपाय से हो जाएगा
says: Remedy: keep your private parts clean and washed, and that practice itself will correct the matter; he gives it right after describing the Ketu cloud, so it is a Ketu remedy.
ambiguity: He does not name Ketu in this sentence; the link is only by sequence after the cloud example. Hygiene advice, not a medical statement.
classical_check: Silent: Ketu and the private parts are linked in some folk traditions; not found in Parashari remedies.

hindi: कच्चे दूध से धोए जाते हैं ये लाल किताब का उपाय है
says: The washing is done with raw milk, and he names this as a Lal Kitab remedy, not a Parashari one.
ambiguity: 'धोए जाते हैं' refers back to the private parts in the previous sentence; planet again only implied.
classical_check: Differs: Lal Kitab is a separate system; raw milk is a Moon/Venus substance and is not a standard Parashari Ketu remedy.

gist: Says he will talk about this later and moves into question-and-answer time.
First audience question: do threads worn on the hand or foot clear loans or improve studies?
Says he has not yet taught a class on threads (dhaage) at all; the topic has not been covered so far.
Garbled caption ('ये तो धरती पर क है ही नहीं अभी तक तो यही है हमारा'); no clear meaning.
Apparent self-deprecating joke that what he has taught in class is 'stolen goods'; caption is partly garbled.
Noncommittal remark that he does not know what threads will do; he makes no claim either way.

hindi: तो इसमें अपना इंडिविजुअल कर्म मैटर नहीं करेगा नहीं धले का भी नहीं हम कर्म से से ऊपर उठ जाएंगे
says: In his approach the individual's own karma will not matter at all, not even a penny's worth; the claim is that we rise above karma because the chart (fate) decides what happens.
ambiguity: 'इसमें' (in this) is vague: it could mean in remedy work with threads, in his teaching method, or in life in general. 'धले का' is 'dhele ka' (a tiny coin).
classical_check: Differs: Parashari tradition treats prarabdha (fixed fate) and kriyamana (present effort) as both mattering and remedies as acting on karma; he is overstating fate over effort.

gist: Rhetorical restatement: our simple line will be said forcefully, 'to hell with karma' (bhaad mein gaya karma); the same point as the previous sentence.

hindi: किस्मत को इतना पावरफुल सेट कर दो कि वही आपसे कर्म करवाएगी
says: The goal of astrology work is to set your fate (kismet) up so powerfully that it itself makes you do the right actions, instead of you forcing effort against it.
ambiguity: He does not say how fate is 'set' here; presumably by remedies and planet strengthening taught elsewhere.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical remedies aim to strengthen or pacify planets to change results; the 'fate drives your action' framing is his.

hindi: क्योंकि किस्मत प्रारब्ध ही आपसे कर्म करा रहा है
says: The reason is that destiny (prarabdha) is already the thing making you act; your choices are driven by your fate rather than being separate from it.
classical_check: Agrees in part: prarabdha as the portion of karma already ripening is a classical concept; saying it fully drives action is a strong form.

hindi: अब ज्ञान आपको संतुष्ट करना सिखाएगा आप 5 लाख में भी संतुष्ट नहीं है और 500 में भी संतुष्ट है यह ज्ञान का मार्ग की बात यह अलग है
says: Knowledge (gyan) teaches contentment: a person may be dissatisfied with 5 lakh and content with 500, but that is the path of knowledge, a separate track from the fate-and-remedy work he is describing.
ambiguity: He does not name Jupiter or any planet for gyan here.
classical_check: Silent: contentment through knowledge is a Vedantic idea; Jyotish links gyan to Jupiter but the sentence makes no chart rule.

gist: General life point that happiness is a mental game: crores may not please you while five thousand rupees may make you celebrate.
The wise person who is happier with Rs 5,000 than with Rs 85 lakh is a bigger kind of happiness, but that is a different story from the one being taught.

hindi: लेकिन भाग्य के द्वारा आपका कर्म पॉलिश्ड हो जाएगा कर्म तो आप करोगे
says: Through fortune (bhagya) your karma gets polished and refined, but you will still perform karma yourself; fate improves the quality of action rather than replacing it.
ambiguity: This slightly softens his earlier 'to hell with karma' line; both are in the same passage.
classical_check: Agrees: the classical view is that good fortune supports and ripens effort (the 9th-house luck helps the 10th-house karma).

gist: Says many people ask whether, if fate decides, they should stop doing karma.

hindi: फिर हम कर्म ना करें ना करके दिखाओ करके तो दिखाओ ना कर्म तुम करके रहोगे कितने दिन नहीं करोगे
says: His answer to 'should we then stop doing karma' is to challenge the person to try; you will end up doing karma anyway, and he asks how many days you can actually avoid it.
classical_check: Agrees: the Gita and Jyotish both hold that no one can remain actionless even for a moment.

hindi: आपको अगले 15 दिन में कोई कर्म करना है आप अभी करके हले हले चलोगे नहीं 15वें दिन दौड़ा दौड़ा के मारेगा ग्रह आपको
says: If an action is due within the next 15 days and you drag your feet, on about the 15th day the planet will chase you hard until you do it; planets force overdue karma on their own schedule.
ambiguity: '15 days' is an example figure, not a fixed rule. The caption 'हले हले' is 'haule haule' (slowly). He does not name the planet.
classical_check: Silent: no classical rule gives a 15-day window; the idea that dasha and transits push pending karma is classical in spirit.

hindi: नहीं तो उसके कारण आपके शरीर की बली ले लेगा शरीर का कोई अंग तोड़ देगा काट देगा
says: If you still avoid it, the planet takes a sacrifice from your body and may break or cut a limb; this is a harm warning, recorded as his claim and not a medical statement.
ambiguity: A rhetorical warning; he does not say which planet or which limb. Flagged as a health-harm claim.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts link planets to body parts and afflictions but give no such enforcement rule.

hindi: कर्म आपको करना ही पड़ेगा यह भूल जाओ कर्म हम कर रहे हैं
says: Karma has to be done regardless; so drop the idea that 'we are the doers', because the doership feeling is an illusion.
ambiguity: The caption joins 'must do karma' and 'forget that we are doing karma' without a pause.
classical_check: Agrees: akartritva (non-doership) is a Gita and Vedanta idea; not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: हमने धेला नहीं किया सांस तक हम लेते नहीं है आंखें खोल के देखने का काम अपने आप होता है सब अपने आप हो रहा है
says: We have not actually done a thing: we do not even breathe by choice, and opening the eyes to see happens by itself; everything is happening on its own, which is his proof that the sense of doing is false.
classical_check: Silent: a Vedantic argument used to support fate-first astrology.

hindi: इसलिए उपाय दो किस्म के चलेंगे या तो बहुत महंगे महंगे उपाय जो इतने महंगे हैं जो आपके पास पैसे ही नहीं करने के
says: Remedies come in two kinds: the very expensive kind, which can be so costly that you may not have the money to do them at all.
ambiguity: The 'two kinds' is completed in the next sentence (cheap remedies).
classical_check: Silent: classical remedy lists (mantra, daan, gems, puja) do not split by cost this way.

hindi: या दो दो रुपए के धागे कोई छोटा मोटा टैटू नदी में कुछ फेंक देना कहीं जाकर कुछ दबा दो घर में कुछ रख दो वो सस्ते वाले उपाय हैं
says: The second kind is the cheap remedies: two-rupee threads, a small tattoo, throwing something into a river, burying something somewhere, or keeping some object in the house.
ambiguity: No planet or object is named for any of these; they are a category list.
classical_check: Partly agrees: river immersion, burying objects and threads are common Lal Kitab and folk remedies; tattoo as a remedy is not classical.

hindi: सस्ते उपाय की कहानी की प्रॉब्लम क्या होती है कि वो सस्ता उपाय आपका यह हाल है जब कुछ पढ़ना है पड़ोसी से चश्मा ले लिया थोड़ी देर के लिए यानी छोटा सा उपाय किया
says: The problem with a cheap remedy is that it works like borrowing a neighbour's spectacles to read for a short while: a small, temporary fix that does not solve the underlying weakness.
ambiguity: The sentence start is garbled but the spectacle analogy is clear.
classical_check: Silent: his own analogy.

hindi: हर बार पंडित जी महाराज जोश के पास जाते रहो घूमते रहो भटकते रहो महाराज जी अभ हो गया
says: With cheap remedies you must keep going back to the pandit or astrologer each time, wandering from one to another saying 'Maharaj, it has happened again', because the problem returns.
ambiguity: 'महाराज जोश' is probably 'Maharaj Joshi' (an astrologer); 'अभ' is likely 'अब'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जो महंगे उपाय उसका खेला सिर्फ य परमानेंट जान लिया बादाम खाना है यह चश्मा लगा लिया स्टोन पहन लिया परमानेंट काम खत्म 100 साल की छुट्टी
says: The expensive remedy is permanent, like getting your own spectacles or taking almonds regularly or wearing a gemstone: once done, the work is finished and you get a hundred years' holiday from the problem.
ambiguity: 'जो महंगे' is at the end of the previous chunk. The 'hundred years' is figurative. 'Stone' here is a gemstone, but the planet is not named.
classical_check: Partly agrees: gemstones are the classical long-term remedy; the claim of a permanent cure is stronger than the texts.

hindi: वो महंगा है सर्जरी होती है महंगी होती है
says: The expensive remedy is costly, comparable to surgery, which is also expensive; he uses surgery as the picture of the big, permanent fix.
ambiguity: Medical analogy only, no medical claim.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Audience suggestion: some people may get relief from Crocin (a mild painkiller) and others may need surgery, so remedies may differ by person.

hindi: हां किसी को क्रोसिन से आराम आ जाएगा किसी को सर्जरी करानी होगी
says: He agrees: for one person a mild remedy (Crocin-like) is enough, for another a major remedy (surgery-like) is needed, so remedy strength depends on the person's chart.
classical_check: Agrees: classical practice scales remedies to the severity of affliction.

hindi: किसी के ऐसे उपाय कर दिए जाए कि उसे क्रोसिन की जरूरत ही नहीं पड़ेगी अपने आप ही क्रोसिन होती रहेगी टाइम टू टाइम जिंदगी में सर्जरी नहीं होगी
says: For some people remedies can be set so that they need no Crocin at all, the small relief just keeps happening by itself from time to time, and life never reaches surgery; a good structure prevents major crises.
ambiguity: A figure of speech; he does not say what the 'Crocin' or 'surgery' correspond to in remedy terms.
classical_check: Silent: preventive remedy framing is his own.

hindi: कुछ लोग ऐसे हैं जिनको महंगा उपाय चाहिए ही नहीं ऐसा होता है
says: Some people do not need an expensive remedy at all; a light one is enough for them.
classical_check: Agrees in part: a benefic, well-placed chart needs little remedy in the classical view.

hindi: होता है ऐसा कि उसका कॉन्शसनेस इतनी रेज्ड है कि इसको हल्के में भी लग जाएगा
says: The reason is that such a person's consciousness is already so raised that even a light remedy takes effect.
ambiguity: 'Raised consciousness' is not tied to any planet or house.
classical_check: Silent: a Jupiter-strength reading is possible but he does not make it.

hindi: नहीं कॉन्शसनेस रेज नहीं है जैसे कि एक घर होता है बैलेंस्ड वो इतना बैलेंस्ड है वो उसमें वैसे ही जी के मर जाते हैं खत्म हो गया
says: Using the picture of a perfectly balanced house, he says such a house is so balanced that its people simply live and die in it without any trouble; some lives are smooth by structure, with no need for upheaval or remedy.
ambiguity: Unclear whether 'house' means a vastu building, a birth chart or a family; the opening 'नहीं कॉन्शसनेस रेज नहीं है' may be an audience interjection or a correction.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कईयों के टेढ़े मेढ़े बने होते हैं उनको चैन नहीं पड़ता वो कुछ उपद्रव करते हैं और बड़ा करते हैं या नास भी पीटते हैं
says: Many people are built crooked or irregular, so they get no peace; they create disturbance, do big things, or sometimes ruin themselves; an unbalanced structure produces restless, eventful lives.
ambiguity: 'बने होते हैं' could refer to houses (vastu layout) or charts; he is comparing with the balanced house of the previous sentence. 'नास पीटते' is read as 'ruin themselves'.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Life view that for the earth to move forward you should not be fully calm; a bit of crookedness and turbulence is needed.
Motivational push: since you have come into the world, do something new and prepare something before you leave.
Continues the motivational push: make some commotion, you made trouble earlier, now do something constructive.

hindi: इसलिए धागे पता नहीं क्याक कर देंगे उसकी भी लिमिटेशन है हर जगह नहीं हो पाते
says: Threads (dhaage) may do something but not reliably; they have limitations and do not work everywhere, so thread remedies cannot be counted on for every problem or every person.
ambiguity: This is his answer to the first audience question; 'इसलिए' (therefore) links back to the cheap-versus-expensive remedy discussion.
classical_check: Silent: threads (kalava, grah-dhaga) are folk remedies, not Parashari ones.

gist: Audience question: do these remedies interfere with the '12 par' (likely the 12 houses of the chart)? He calls it a big question.

hindi: आपके जीवन में जो 12 पर है ना वो तो फिक्स हो गया
says: Whatever the '12' is in your life, it is already fixed; most likely he means the twelve houses of the chart are fixed at birth, which is the basis for asking whether remedies can interfere with them.
ambiguity: '12 पर' is unclear in the caption: could be 12 घर (houses), the 12th house, or something else. The 'fixed' sense is clear.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the birth chart is fixed; classical remedies do not rewrite the houses but alter how planets deliver results.

gist: Something about 'our remedy game': first, by chatting, 'we break the 72'; the key word '72' is unreadable and the sense is lost.
A psychology point that if a person does not give his '72' he is broken down; again the number-like word is a caption error.
Describes his own reading style: as the client sits before him he either gets him to 'prove' something or waits, and a raw reading arrives by itself with time.
First he tells the client the truth ('yours is not ruined'), the client 'prove's it; caption garbled ('प्रीव'), meaning unclear.
Says all this can be answered and a class could be held on how he knows, because he knows everything; once you know, the reading comes. The batch ends mid-sentence.
Tail of his talk on how he handles a client: what to tell and how, he 'breaks them down', the client ends up 'ruined' and then helps us himself; caption is too garbled to read as a rule.
Otherwise the client is cut off; 'leave it to us' and 'will he leave even a penny to us' are the readable scraps; no clear claim.
Says the client's body and mind are 'broken down' first, so that the mind which was saying 'I will be ruined' is dealt with; part of his talk on counselling technique, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: सबकॉन्शियस ने देखा यहां लाल रंग है पीला रंग है से यह दशा आने वाली है वह शरीर पर नहीं आएगा चिजी पर नहीं आएगा
says: How his remedies work: the subconscious sees the red and yellow signs (the symbolic act) and takes it that the coming dasha has already arrived and been dealt with, so the real event does not land on the body or on physical things.
ambiguity: 'लाल रंग पीला रंग' may mean red and yellow threads or objects used in the remedy, or the colours of the dasha; the caption is rough. 'चिजी' is 'cheezon' (things).
classical_check: Silent: a psychological or symbolic-substitution theory of remedies; classical texts explain remedies through planetary pacification, not the subconscious.

hindi: फिर हम उसके अंदर टांके लगाते हैं तो वह हमारे उपाय है
says: After shaking the client, we 'put stitches' inside the person or situation, and those stitches are our remedies; remedies are repair work done on a damaged structure, not a change of the structure.
ambiguity: Surgical metaphor; he does not say what is 'stitched'.
classical_check: Silent: his own metaphor.

hindi: तो हमने 12 पर के अंदर बैरियर्स लगाए हैं कि 72 ना करें इवॉल्व 12 तो हो गई
says: So remedies place barriers inside the '12' (probably the twelve houses of the chart) so that the harmful outcome does not evolve further; the chart itself stays as it was but its result path is blocked.
ambiguity: '12 पर' and '72' are the same unclear caption tokens as in the previous batch; '12' is read as the twelve houses and '72' as an unreadable word. 'हो गई' ('it is done') is the end of the sentence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: किसी ने फेल होना है एक साल फेल होना पढ़ाई का चौथे या पांचवे घर में डिस्टरबेंस है
says: If a student is going to fail a year in studies, the chart shows a disturbance in the 4th or 5th house, which are the houses of education.
cells_derived_method: The 4th covers school base, learning environment and early education; the 5th covers intelligence, exams and higher study. The planet that disturbs and the sign it sits in decide whether the failure is from distraction, health or instability at home.

derived_examples.reading: derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 4th (lagna Capricorn); schooling base is unstable and results come late or with a repeated year.
derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 5th (lagna Aquarius); confused learning, careless errors in the exam and a distracted mind.
derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 4th (lagna Aries); restlessness at home and school, quarrels around study space.

ambiguity: He says disturbance only; he does not name the planet or the dasha that makes the student fail.
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th (basic education, vidya) and the 5th (intelligence, higher learning) are the classical education houses.

hindi: तो हम उसको एक एडमिशन लवाते हैं उसके पापा मम्मी को बोलके इसको क्लास में एडमिशन दिला दो य और वो वाला पेपर देने नहीं जाएगा लेकिन पैसे पूरे देना
says: Remedy for a fail-a-year dasha: have the parents admit the student into an extra class or course, tell them he will skip one paper there, but pay the full fees; the planet is given a harmless fail to feed on.
ambiguity: Unclear whether the admission is in a lower course or an extra one, and which paper is missed. The remedy is aimed at 4th and 5th house disturbance from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent: a symbolic-substitution remedy of the Lal Kitab or folk kind, not found in Parashari remedies.

hindi: ग्रह रीड कर ले बली हो गई
says: The planet 'reads' the symbolic act (the skipped paper) and counts it as the sacrifice (bali) it was demanding, so the actual fail does not need to happen.
ambiguity: The same phrase is repeated after the marriage example, so it may be a general formula rather than only for studies.
classical_check: Silent: planets accepting a token offering is a Lal Kitab and folk idea, not Parashari.

hindi: शादी खराब होनी है पीपल से शादी करा दो
says: If a marriage is destined to go bad, have the person ceremonially married to a peepal tree first; the tree takes the planetary bad result meant for the real marriage.
cells_derived_method: Marriage is the 7th house; the nature of the affliction (planet and sign in or on the 7th) decides how serious the tree-marriage remedy needs to be.

derived_examples.reading: derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn); a strong Manglik-type affliction, the classic case for a symbolic first marriage.
derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 7th (lagna Libra); delayed or cold marriage; the tree marriage takes the delay and coldness.
derived: Rahu in Sagittarius in the 7th (lagna Gemini); confusion and secrecy in marriage, remedy aimed at the Rahu affliction.

ambiguity: He does not name the planet or the dosha that makes the marriage bad.
classical_check: Agrees: ashwattha (peepal) or kumbh vivah is a traditional remedy for Mangal dosha and similar 7th-house afflictions in later texts, though not in BPHS verses themselves.

hindi: ग्रह रीड कर लेते बली हो गई तलाक नहीं होगा
says: After the tree marriage the planets read it as the sacrifice already made, and he says divorce will not happen; a stated outcome of the remedy.
ambiguity: He states the result as certain; recorded as his claim, not as an astrological guarantee.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts promise removal of the dosha, not a guarantee against divorce.

hindi: 12 चेंज नहीं होता लेकिन 12 को हम ट्विस्ट
says: The chart (the twelve houses) never changes, but remedies twist how it plays out; this is his answer to whether remedies interfere with the fixed chart.
ambiguity: '12' is read as the twelve houses, as in the previous sentences; the verb 'करते हैं' is at the start of the next caption chunk.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical remedies do not alter the birth chart but modify its fruits.

hindi: चेंज नहीं होता भाग्य नहीं बदल सकता जोची ने बदल लेते
says: Fate cannot be changed; if astrologers could change it they would have changed their own, which he uses as proof that remedies do not rewrite destiny.
ambiguity: 'जोची ने बदल लेते' is rough; read as 'jyotishi would have changed (their own)'.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical texts hold that shanti and daan can soften prarabdha, not erase it; he is stating the strong form.

hindi: डॉक्टर क्यों मरते हैं हार्ट का डॉक्टर हार्ट से मर रहा है
says: Example for unchangeable fate: doctors also die, and a heart specialist can die of a heart problem; expert knowledge of a thing does not exempt you from its fate.
ambiguity: A general illustration, not a prediction or diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: भाग्य नहीं बदलेगा राम का नहीं बदला कृष्ण का नहीं बदला
says: Fate will not change; it did not change even for Ram or Krishna, who were avatars, so ordinary people cannot expect remedies to alter it.
classical_check: Silent: a mythological argument, not a chart rule.

hindi: बड़े बड़े ऋषि विशिष्ठ बैठे थे क्या उखाड़ लिया विश्वामित्र क्या क्या कुछ नहीं कर पाए वनवास हुआ ही हुआ
says: Great sages like Vashishtha were present and could not stop it, and Vishwamitra with all his powers could not either; Ram's forest exile happened regardless, so even top-level knowledge cannot avert fate.
ambiguity: 'विशिष्ठ' is Vashishtha in the caption.
classical_check: Silent: a Ramayana example used as an argument.

gist: Audience question: many websites sell online puja of the Goddess or Shani Dev; does one get any benefit from it?
Sarcastic answer: of course there is a benefit, lots of money comes to the seller and he is enjoying himself.
A young woman called him wanting to speak to her boyfriend; an 'aunty' on a social-media account was asking her for money and promising a call within three hours.
He told her to go ahead and pay quickly because she would not stop without paying; the woman calls him her guru of 20 years yet asked his permission before acting.
She begged him to just let her pay, and only after paying about 200 (thousand, as the caption reads) did she see the truth.
Closing remark of the online-puja story: her illusion broke, but someone did benefit, and these days everything is happening even online.
Audience question: sometimes because of planetary positions we cannot even diagnose certain problems; how should one handle that?

hindi: आपका ब्रेन सक्षम कर दिया उन्होंने दूसरे के ब्रेन को यूज करो इसलिए अपने बाल काटने कठिन है
says: When planets cloud your own judgement you cannot diagnose your own problem, so use someone else's brain (consult another person), just as it is hard to cut your own hair.
ambiguity: 'सक्षम' (capable) is probably a slip for 'अक्षम' (incapable): 'they have disabled your brain'. 'उन्होंने' (they) likely means the planets.
classical_check: Silent: a practical rule for consulting an astrologer rather than self-reading; classical texts do not state it.

gist: Audience question begins: you said watching astrology videos will start improving life; the question carries on into the next chunk about an afflicted house.

hindi: लेकिन बेटर नहीं होएगी उसकी खराबी रिड्यूस होगी बस बेटर यही होता है आपका माइनस घट गया यह बेटर बेटर कुछ नहीं होता
says: Astrology or remedy does not make life 'better' in an absolute sense; it only reduces the bad, so 'better' just means your minus has shrunk, and there is no such thing as 'better better'.
ambiguity: 'बेटर' is English 'better'. This is his answer to whether watching the videos improves life.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical remedies pacify afflictions rather than add new fortune beyond the chart.

hindi: आपके पास 10 करोड़ आएगा और आप उसमें कहोगे मजा आ गया अब 10 करोड़ आपकी लिमिट है
says: If 10 crore comes to you and you feel it is wonderful, then 10 crore becomes your own limit; the amount you receive is capped by what you are able to take in and feel satisfied with.
ambiguity: Money figures are illustrative; this is not a prediction or investment advice.
classical_check: Silent: his own point about capacity and contentment.

hindi: आपके पास 100 करोड़ आएगा और आपका हो गया ठीक है परमात्मा की इच्छा है
says: If 100 crore comes instead and you simply accept it as 'fine, it is God's will', the limit moves up; whatever level you accept is the level the chart delivers.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut across two caption chunks ('आपका हो' | 'गया ठीक है'); reconstructed. Money figures are illustrative only.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ग्रह कंफ्यूज होगा आपको 1000 करोड़ देगा देना पड़ेगा उसे
says: He says the planet will get confused and will give you 1000 crore, it will have to give, which suggests that a person who stays unattached to the amount can be given far more than the usual limit.
ambiguity: Unclear what makes the planet 'confused' and what the condition is. The 1000 crore is a rhetorical figure, not a prediction or financial advice.
classical_check: Silent: no classical rule says planets give more to the unattached.

gist: Audience question continues: if the house that needs improving already has negative planets or combinations that are bad for that house, should such videos be watched or not?
For someone with a bad house, watching or not is their choice; he gives no suggestion and calls it a matter of one's own faith (shraddha).

hindi: यह तो आपको जिंदगी बताएगी हर चीज अपने जीवन में स्वयं करके देखो आपके बॉडी के एक्सपीरियंस से पता चलेगा आपको व्ट इज राइट व्ट इ रंग फॉर य
says: Life itself will tell you: try each practice in your own life and your body's experience will show what is right or wrong for you; he makes personal experience the test of any astrological practice.
ambiguity: 'व्ट इज राइट व्ट इ रंग फॉर य' is English 'what is right, what is wrong for you'.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Repeats that he gives no suggestion; do whatever your mind tells you, after saying experience will give the idea.
Says enough class has happened for now and the Moon will be taken up next, where it will explain; a pointer to a future topic.
Audience question: what does love mean, and how does one know whether someone truly loves or it is lust?
Love is just a word; it really means care and respect.
In lust the body is involved; if you love someone and feel no desire for their body that is love, but he adds that this belief is a misunderstanding.
Even the urge to hug and cling to one's own child is a form of lust (vasana) in his view; the batch splits the sentence here.
Says humans hold back from physical relations with their own children only because of propriety (maryada), whereas animals do not even have this awareness; a general view, not a chart rule.

hindi: हम पढ़े लिखे हैं इस कारण हमें इतना तो आईडिया हो जाता है हमारे को मर्यादा समझ आती है हम संस्कार डीएनए जानते हैं नहीं तो क्रॉस ब्रीडिंग करते हैं लोग कहां पता है
says: Educated people understand propriety, sanskar and DNA; people without this understanding end up 'cross-breeding' (marrying or mating without regard to lineage and compatibility) without knowing what they are doing.
ambiguity: 'क्रॉस ब्रीडिंग' is a vague term here; likely mismatched marriages across lineage or gotra rather than a literal statement. He leads into kundali-matching faults in the next sentence.
classical_check: Partly agrees: gotra and lineage rules for marriage and compatibility matching are classical dharma and muhurta topics.

hindi: टेढ़े मेढे जो कहना चाहिए गलत जो योनि दोष होता है वर्ण दोष होता है कई कुंडली के दोष होते हैं
says: Mismatched or 'crooked' pairings arise from faults like yoni dosha, varna dosha and many other kundali doshas in compatibility matching.
ambiguity: He lists the faults but does not say how each is calculated or which ones are serious.
classical_check: Agrees in part: yoni and varna are two of the eight ashtakoota matching factors; classically varna carries only 1 point and yoni 4, so they are minor beside nadi.

hindi: नाड़ी दोष सबसे बड़ा दोष
says: Nadi dosha is the biggest of the matching faults.
classical_check: Agrees: nadi carries 8 of the 36 ashtakoota points, the highest weight, and is traditionally linked with progeny and health of the couple.

hindi: बच्चे रिटा पैदा हो जाते हैं दुख की बात है
says: He claims that when such matching faults are ignored, children can be born with a mental or developmental disability (caption word 'रिटा', likely his word for 'retarded'); recorded as his claim and a health-outcome statement, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'रिटा' is truncated and likely the offensive term for a disability; he calls it sad. He does not say that every nadi-dosha pair has this result.
classical_check: Partly agrees: texts warn nadi dosha harms progeny, but a specific disability claim is not in them.

hindi: उपाय करते नहीं लोग जानते नहीं
says: Remedies exist for these matching faults but people either do not perform them or do not know about them, so the harm goes unaddressed.
ambiguity: He does not name the remedies for nadi or other doshas here.
classical_check: Agrees in part: nadi dosha parihara (cancellation and remedies) are classical, e.g. same-nakshatra different-pada exceptions and daan.

gist: Audience chatter: something is ringing, someone says go ahead and play it, and they carry on.
Audience question: earlier they discussed polite behaviour toward the wife and taking her blessing; the questioner explains the doubt about doing this.
Garbled lines about 'seeking wife's blessing is not a fight, it is a misunderstanding' and what 'we are completing now'; the speaker is unclear.
Tail of the audience question: taking the wife's blessing is described as a 'big guna' (virtue or fault is unclear in the caption).

hindi: अगर आप यह सोच रहे हैं कि पत्नी से आशीर्वाद लेना है तो वह आपको यूं लगेगा जैसे मैं मेल शमनिस्टिक बात कर रहा हूं कि पत्नी से आशीर्वाद मत लो
says: Do not go about deliberately 'taking' blessings from your wife as a duty; he knows that saying this sounds like male chauvinism, but his point is that the blessing should not be sought as an act.
ambiguity: 'मेल शमनिस्टिक' is 'male chauvinistic'. It is slightly unclear whether he literally says 'do not take her blessing' or only anticipates that it will sound so.
classical_check: Silent: marital conduct rule of his own.

hindi: आप बच्चे से भी आशीर्वाद अपने आप लोगे पत्नी से भी आशीर्वाद अपने आप मिलेगा आपको मात्र सम्मान करना है
says: Blessings from your children and from your wife come on their own without asking; all you have to do is respect your wife.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसा भी हो सकता है कि आपकी कुंडली के योगों के आपको अयाशी करनी है भटकना है लेकिन पत्नी का पूर्ण ख्याल ध्यान रखना है वो आशीर्वाद है उसका
says: Your chart's yogas may push you toward indulgence and wandering, but if you still fully look after your wife, that care itself earns her blessing; chart tendency does not cancel the duty of care.
ambiguity: He does not name the yogas that cause the wandering. 'अयाशी' means debauchery or indulgence.
classical_check: Silent: yogas for such tendencies (Venus-Rahu, 7th or 12th house) exist classically, but his conduct rule is his own.

hindi: नहीं चरण छू के आशीर्वाद लेना है
says: The wife's blessing is not obtained by touching her feet; it comes from caring for her, not from the feet-touching ritual.
ambiguity: A short phrase; could also be read as a question or contrast ('no, you do not take blessings by touching feet').
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पत्नी शुक्र का प्योर फॉर्म है
says: The wife is the purest form of Venus, so everything Venus stands for is concentrated in her.
ambiguity: Context is a man's wife; for a woman's husband the classical karaka would be Jupiter (or Mars), which he does not discuss here.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the classical significator of the wife for a male chart.

gist: Aside that the next point is 'very strange'; a lead-in with no content of its own.

hindi: शनि है मूलाधार है पूर्ण रूप से उसके शरीर में जो सेक्सुअल अंग है योनि उसकी प्लेसमेंट ही मूल आधार पे है
says: Saturn is the muladhara (root chakra), and in the wife's body the sexual organ (yoni) is placed exactly at the root; so the Venus-form wife has her base at Saturn's chakra.
ambiguity: 'शनि है मूलाधार है' is terse; read as Saturn = muladhara. He links it with the wife's body, but the exact reason for bringing Saturn in is not stated.
classical_check: Differs: classical Jyotish ties the lower body to Saturn only through the 10th/11th and Capricorn/Aquarius; the chakra assignment (Saturn = muladhara) belongs to a modern or tantric-style scheme.

hindi: पुरुष के पेनिस की प्लेसमेंट इस स्वाधिष्ठान पे है ये प्रकृति ने बनाया
says: In a man, the penis is placed at the swadhisthana (sacral chakra), a difference that nature itself built into the male and female bodies.
ambiguity: He does not name a planet for swadhisthana in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent: a chakra anatomy statement from yoga tradition, not Jyotish.

hindi: अब स्त्री के जो पैर है पुरुष के जो पैर हैं पैरों के एरिया में हमारा इंद्र वरुण और यम आ गया
says: In the feet area of both man and woman, his three outer planets come in: Indra (Uranus), Varuna (Neptune) and Yama (Pluto) govern the feet region.
ambiguity: Indra, Varuna and Yama are read as Uranus, Neptune and Pluto as in his scheme; he does not say so in this sentence.
classical_check: Differs: classical body maps put the feet under Pisces and the 12th house (Jupiter or Ketu); the outer planets are not in Parashari texts.

hindi: अब यह शब्द बना है स्त्री पुरुष के पैर को छुए किसी के पैर छूने का मतलब क्या है वह अपना ग्रह इंप्रूव कर रही है
says: The custom of a woman touching a man's feet, or anyone touching another's feet, means the toucher is improving her own planet; feet-touching is therefore a planetary remedy because the feet carry the outer-planet trio.
ambiguity: 'यह शब्द बना है' (this word has been formed) is rough; read as 'this custom has arisen'. The planet being improved is not named.
classical_check: Silent: charan sparsh is a cultural custom; its explanation as a planetary remedy is his.

gist: Sentence cut off at the end of the batch: 'it is said, no, woman's feet then...'; continues in the next batch.

hindi: ना छुए मैं बहनों को बता देता हूं उसमें उनका कितना नाश पिटेगा
says: Finishing the previous sentence ('it is said a woman's feet should not be touched'): he says he will tell the sisters how much they lose in it, meaning a woman's energy is damaged when a man touches her feet.
ambiguity: The start 'ना छुए' is the tail of the previous batch ('स्त्री के फिर पैर ... ना छुए'). 'उसमें उनका कितना नाश पिटेगा' could also mean what women lose by touching men's feet; the next chunks support the first reading.
classical_check: Silent: charan sparsh customs are social; classical Jyotish has no rule about it.

hindi: पुरुष के पैर छुओ साले को लूट लो
says: Said half in jest to women: touch a man's feet and you loot him, because the person whose feet are touched loses energy to the one touching; the claim is that touching feet transfers energy toward the toucher.
ambiguity: 'साले को' is an insult-style filler; the tone is joking but the mechanism (energy draw) is repeated seriously a few sentences later.
classical_check: Silent: energy transfer through foot-touching is a folk and yoga idea, not Jyotish.

hindi: पुरुष के पास वाय क्रोमोसोम है वो एडिशनल एनर्जी कॉस्मस से ले सकता है
says: A man has a Y chromosome, and through it he can draw additional energy from the cosmos, which he says gives men an extra pull that women do not have in the same way.
ambiguity: A biological-sounding claim used as a metaphor; no chart rule depends on it.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts have no chromosome idea; this is his own modern explanation and is not established biology.

hindi: इसीलिए पुरुष कहीं का कहीं कुछ का कुछ करते हैं धरती पे नास भी पीटते हैं पाताल में भी जाते हैं ऊपर भी जाते हैं
says: Because of that extra energy, men go to extremes: they do all sorts of unpredictable things, ruin themselves on earth, sink to the underworld or rise very high; male lives have a wider swing than female ones.
ambiguity: 'नास पीटते' is read as ruining themselves; 'पाताल' is the underworld in the figurative sense.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्योंकि वाय क्रोमोसोम अलग फड़फड़ा रहा है वो कहता है कुछ नया कर कुछ नया कर कुछ नया कर तभी तो अलग-अलग किस्म के बच्चे पैदा होते हैं
says: The Y chromosome keeps fluttering and urging 'do something new', which is why different kinds of children are born; the male side is the source of variety in offspring.
ambiguity: A metaphor, not a literal genetic statement.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए स्त्री का है मुसलमान की ब्राह्मण से ब्या तो ब्राह्मण कहला दी गई ब्राह्मण की मुस्लिम से ब्या तो मुस्लिम बन गई
says: A woman takes on her husband's community: a Muslim woman married to a Brahmin is called Brahmin, and a Brahmin woman married to a Muslim becomes Muslim; her identity follows the man's.
ambiguity: A social-identity claim stated as a fact about how identity passes through marriage; not a chart rule.
classical_check: Partly agrees: dharmashastra says a wife takes her husband's gotra and social standing; whether this extends across religions is a social matter, not Jyotish.

hindi: उसका अपना वर्ण नहीं है उसका वर्ण परिवर्तन की क्षमता ईश्वर ने दी है उसे वो कहीं आगे है रेस में उसकी औरा के कारण
says: A woman has no varna of her own; God gave her the ability to change varna, and because of her aura she is ahead in the race.
ambiguity: 'रेस में आगे' is vague: it may mean spiritual or evolutionary advantage. 'औरा' is 'aura'. The caption 'उसका वर्ण परिवर्तन की क्षमता' is read as 'her capacity for varna change'.
classical_check: Silent: varna in Jyotish is a sign/planet attribute, not a social one; this is a social-spiritual claim.

hindi: उसको कहते हैं नाभी लगा के धरती पर साष्टांग प्रणाम नहीं कर करना उसको वर्जित है ये कि नाभी लगा केर साष्टांग प्रणाम ना करे क्योंकि उसकी नाभी में ऊर्जा है
says: A woman is told not to do the full prostration (sashtang pranam) with her navel pressed to the ground; it is forbidden for her because her navel holds energy.
ambiguity: The sentence repeats itself in the caption; the meaning is clear.
classical_check: Agrees: dharmashastra and custom limit women to panchang (five-point) prostration and bar the chest and belly from touching the ground in sashtang.

hindi: स्त्री का ड्रेस कोड ये नहीं है उसकी नाभी खुली रखी जाती है उसकी नाभी कमर पूरी खुली रखी जाती है क्योंकि नाभी स्पेस से कनेक्टेड रहे
says: A woman's traditional dress keeps the navel and waist uncovered, so that the navel stays connected to space.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across two caption chunks: 'क्योंकि नाभी' ends the first and 'स्पेस से कनेक्टेड रहे' starts the next. 'ड्रेस कोड ये नहीं है' is read as 'her dress code is not (covered like that)'.
classical_check: Silent: it explains the saree style as an energy matter; no classical Jyotish source.

hindi: पुरुष को नहीं कहा जाता कि तू यहां से नंगा रहे पुरुष कहता कुर्ता इसको ढक के ले ना ढक तेरी मर्जी
says: Men are not told to keep that area bare; a man wears a kurta that covers it, and whether he covers it or not is his own choice.
ambiguity: 'ढक के ले ना ढक' is a rough caption for 'cover it or do not cover it'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: स्त्री की नाभी की प्रोटेक्शन पूजनीय है ये क्योंकि यहीं से तो हम पैदा हुए एक एक व्यक्ति हम भी यहीं से पैदा हुए मां की कृपा से
says: Protecting a woman's navel is a worshipful matter because every person is born from this centre, by the mother's grace; the navel is the source of life.
ambiguity: The umbilical link is the navel; he speaks of birth 'from here' loosely.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए स्त्री जब पुरुष के पैर स्त्री से पैर छुपा रही है तो पुरुष उसका यूरेनस नेप्चून प्लूटो सक कर लेगा
says: When a man has his feet touched by, or touches the feet of, a woman, the man will suck up her Uranus, Neptune and Pluto energy; the foot contact moves the woman's outer-planet energy to the man.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled ('स्त्री जब पुरुष के पैर स्त्री से पैर छुपा रही है'), and who touches whom is unclear. The next sentence gives the reverse case (woman draws from man), so this one is read as man draws from woman.
classical_check: Silent: Uranus, Neptune and Pluto are outside classical Jyotish.

hindi: स्त्री जब पुरुष के पैर छो रही है तो वो उसके यूरेनस नेप्चून प्लूटो को खींच रही है
says: When a woman touches a man's feet she is pulling (drawing) his Uranus, Neptune and Pluto energy toward herself; the outer-planet trio sits in the feet, so foot contact is how the energy moves.
ambiguity: Links back to the previous batch, where he put Indra, Varuna and Yama in the feet; 'छो' is 'छू'.
classical_check: Silent: the three outer planets are not in classical texts.

hindi: इसलिए भोग में आनंद करती है स्त्री
says: Because she draws that energy from the man, the woman is able to enjoy life's pleasures (bhoga) and take delight in worldly enjoyment.
ambiguity: 'भोग में आनंद करती है' could mean she enjoys sensual pleasure or enjoys worldly comforts; the causal link to the energy draw is implied only by 'इसलिए'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब स्त्री की ऊर्जा ना खींचे इसलिए बोल दिया गया कि इसके पैर मत छुओ
says: So that men do not draw a woman's energy, the rule was laid down that men should not touch a woman's feet; it protects her energy.
ambiguity: 'ना खींचे' has no subject; it is read as 'so that men do not draw'.
classical_check: Silent: custom, not Jyotish; in some traditions fathers do touch young girls' feet as devi, which runs the other way.

gist: Banter: women now say 'fine, we will keep touching his feet, you do not touch ours, no tension'; the following 'छुओ की वाली बात नहीं है' is unclear.
Social remark that a woman is stuck living with her husband unless she takes another one.
Calls the world a world of men (dogs); keep one dog so that the other dogs cannot get you, otherwise the wolves will eat you; an analogy for why a woman keeps one man.
Says that is the secret behind it: because woman is vulnerable, for her protection it is very important that she keeps one 'mad one' (her man) with her.
Joke that this is why she puts up with him: training a new husband is complicated, having taught the first how to wash clothes she would have to start again with the next.
Audience quip about forgetting dish-washing in the middle, answered with 'it is okay'.

hindi: तो उसकी ऊर्जा बहुत जल्दी क्षीण होती है इसलिए पुरुष पैर छुआ जाएगा उससे तो पुरुष के पैर छूने मात्र से उसकी ऊर्जा पावर ले रही है
says: Energy drains away quickly (the caption leaves it unclear whether the man's or the woman's), and therefore by merely touching a man's feet the woman takes his energy and power.
ambiguity: The subject of 'उसकी ऊर्जा' (his or her energy) and the grammar of 'पुरुष पैर छुआ जाएगा उससे' are unclear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: छोटे बच्चों को क्या कहते हैं गुरु जी के पैर छू गुरु जी के पैरों से सक्शन लेता है वह उसकी रा बढ़ रही है
says: Small children are told to touch the guru's feet; the child pulls energy by suction from the guru's feet and his aura grows.
ambiguity: 'रा' is read as 'aura' (औरा) as in the surrounding sentences.
classical_check: Silent: a guru's blessing through foot-touching is traditional, but the suction-of-energy explanation is his.

hindi: आनंदा महाराज के पैर छू लिया आनंदा महाराज तो कृष्ण जी से खींच लेंगे तुम्हें तो कृष्ण जी से खींचना आता नहीं
says: If you touch the feet of a saint such as Ananda Maharaj, he in turn draws from Krishna; since you do not know how to draw from Krishna directly, you draw from the saint, who is the link.
ambiguity: 'आनंदा महाराज' is used as an example guru; not a specific claim about a named person.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए स्त्री जो पैर बड़ा छुना चाहती उसके ऊर्जा वक हो जाएंगी
says: A woman who wants to touch feet a great deal will find her energy turning weak (caption 'वक' is 'weak'); too much foot-touching drains her.
ambiguity: 'पैर बड़ा छुना चाहती' is garbled. It sits in tension with his earlier claim that a woman gains energy by touching a man's feet; probably it refers to touching gurus and strangers.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए स्त्री को कहा जाता है जब तक तेरे रजस्वला नहीं हुई तब तक तू भी पैर मत छू किसी के और भी मत ले
says: A girl is told that until she reaches menarche she should not touch anyone's feet and should not let others touch hers either.
ambiguity: 'और भी मत ले' is unclear; read as 'and do not take (from others) either'.
classical_check: Differs: in many traditions girls' feet are worshipped (kanya pujan) and young girls do bow to elders, so this rule is his own.
